lore: C-3PO's arm was pulled off by attacking Tusken Raiders. 'I don't think I can make it. You go on, Master Luke...I'm done for.'

name: Disarmed
title: Disarmed
text: If both players have a character with a weapon present at same site, deploy on that opponent's character during any control phase. Character loses all weapons, is power -1 and may no longer carry weapons. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: When Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba confronted Luke in the Cantina, Obi-Wan pointed out, 'This little one isn't worth the effort.' A brawl ensued.

name: Disarming Creature
title: Disarming Creature
text: If you have a character with a weapon at same site as any creature (except Space Slug), deploy on that creature during any deploy phase, Creature is Disarmed (each time ferocity is calculated, draw destiny, subtract that amount). (Immune to Control.)
lore: Luke's defensive maneuver put him out of arm's way.

name: Dismantle On Sight
title: •Dismantle On Sight
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on a droid with armor (free on IG-88). At end of any opponent's turn, droid is immediately lost if present with an Imperial (or with a bounty hunter if droid is IG-88).
lore: After losing control of several extremely powerful and deadly assassin droids, the Empire issued a decree ordering their immediate destruction.

name: Disruptor Pistol
title: Disruptor Pistol
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior (1 on your non-unique warrior). May target a character or creature using 2 Force (for free if on your non-unique warrior). Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > defense value.
lore: Highly specialized weapon used for disintegration. Commonly found on the black market and in criminal arsenals. One of the favored weapons of the Black Sun.

name: Disruptor Pistol
title: Disruptor Pistol
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior (1 on your non-unique warrior). May target a character or creature using 2 Force (for free if on your non-unique warrior). Draw Destiny. Target lost if destiny > defense value.
lore: Illegal weapon easily purchased by Rebel suppliers on the black market. Rechargeable energy packs make it a cost-effective weapon.

name: Diversionary Tactics
title: •Diversionary Tactics
text: If your starfighter with a pilot character aboard is in a battle, target an opponent's starfighter present that has no characters aboard. For remainder of battle, both starfighters are power = 0, and target starfighter is forfeit = 0. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: Rebel pilots understand that what they lack in numbers, they must make up for in strategy. They often use diversions to remove dangerous opponents from a conflict.

name: Djas Puhr
title: •Djas Puhr
text: Power +1 for each [Dark Side Force] present, +2 under 'nighttime conditions.' Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Male Sakiyan, a race often employed as assassins. Bounty hunter. Incredible infrared peripheral vision. Has excellent aural and olfactory senses. Often tracks by scent.

name: Djas Puhr (V)
title: •Djas Puhr (V)
text: Assassin. Power, defense value, and forfeit +1 for each [Dark Side Force] icon here. Your total ability may not be reduced at same site. Your Force drains here may not be canceled by [Reflections 3] Leia.
lore: Male Sakiyan, a race often employed as assassins. Bounty hunter. Incredible infrared peripheral vision. Has excellent aural and olfactory senses. Often tracks by scent.

name: Do They Have A Code Clearance?
title: •Do They Have A Code Clearance?
text: Deploy on table. Unique (•) Imperials of ability = 3 are forfeit +3. If opponent just retrieved Force using an Interrupt or Utinni Effect, you may place that card here. Opponent's Force retrieval is reduced by X, where X = number of cards here. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Imperial officers are always on the lookout for Rebel espionage.

name: Do They Have A Code Clearance?
title: •Do They Have A Code Clearance?
text: Plays on table. If opponent just retrieved Force using an Interrupt or Utinni Effect, you may place that card here. Opponent's Force retrieval is reduced by X, where X = number of cards here.
lore: Imperial officers are always on the lookout for Rebel espionage.

name: Do, Or Do Not
title: •Do, Or Do Not
text: Plays on table. Sense and Alter are now Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force.
lore: A Jedi may choose to intervene in the natural course of events, but must accept responsibility for the consequences.

name: Do, Or Do Not
title: •Do, Or Do Not
text: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are now Lost Interrupts. Also, when and player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: A Jedi may choose to intervene in the natural course of events, but must accept responsibility for the consequences.

name: Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice
title: •Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice
text: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are now Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force. Your Immediate Effects may deploy for free. Whenever opponent cancels your card with Sense or Alter, place that canceled card in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

name: Docking And Repair Facilities
title: •Docking And Repair Facilities
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on your side of table. A starship you just lost may be placed here. Holds one starship at a time. During your deploy phase, may use X Force to bring starship to hand, where X = deploy cost of that starship.
lore: Most Rebel frigates are equipped with repair facilities for damaged or disabled starfighters. Capital ships are serviced at larger spaceports.

name: Dodge
title: •Dodge
text: If one of your characters of ability > 2 was just targeted by a weapon, subtract 3 from each destiny draw. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at a site against one of your lone characters present, move that character away as a 'react' (for free).
lore: Normally parents try to prevent their children from falling down the stairs.

name: Dodo Bodonawieedo
title: •Dodo Bodonawieedo
text: Power +2 at Mos Eisley. Opponent's Jawas are power -1 here. Once during each of your control phases, may peek at top X cards of your Force Pile, reorder however you wish and replace, where X = number of other musicians at same site.
lore: Rodian musician. Plays slitherhorn. Grew up in the streets of Mos Eisley. 'Frocked' Jawas and stole ronto steaks as a child. Information broker. Was part of the Shawpee gang.

name: Doikk Na'ts
title: •Doikk Na'ts
text: For each other musician at same site, the ability required to draw battle destiny here increases by 1 for both players.
lore: Male Bith musician. Plays Fizz (Dorenian Beshniquel) in Figrin D'an's band. Frustrated by sentients, especially humans, he prefers to work with droids.

name: Domain Of Evil
title: Domain Of Evil
text: Deploy on Dagobah: Jungle or Dagobah: Cave. Target a mentor on Dagobah and an apprentice who has completed Jedi Test #2. Attempt when apprentice is present at the end of your turn and none of your cards participated in battles, Force drains or Jedi Tests during that turn. Draw training destiny. If destiny + apprentice's ability > 14, test completed. Place on apprentice. You may subtract 1 from each of opponent's destiny draws.

name: Dominator
title: •Dominator
text: May add 4 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle and 2 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Laser Cannon Battery may deploy aboard (and may fire twice per battle).
lore: Victory-class hull overhauled with powerful thrusters and latest hyperdrive technology. Engineered to support task forces combating Rebel starfighters.

name: Don't Do That Again
title: •Don't Do That Again
text: Deploy on table. Once per game may take any Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Mobilization Points is suspended. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Jedi won't tolerate silly behavior for very long.

name: Don't Do That Again
title: •Don't Do That Again
text: Plays on table. Once per game may take any Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Mobilization Points is suspended.
lore: The Jedi won't tolerate silly behavior for very long.

name: Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V)
title: •Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V)
text: Plays on table. Cancels Always Thinking With Your Stomach, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.
lore: The Jedi won't tolerate silly behavior for very long.

name: Don't Do That Again (V)
title: •Don't Do That Again (V)
text: Plays on table. Cancels Always Thinking With Your Stomach, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.
lore: The Jedi won't tolerate silly behavior for very long.

name: Don't Forget The Droids
title: •Don't Forget The Droids
text: USED: Cancel 3,720 To 1 if it was just inserted or revealed. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Cancel one opponent's battle destiny just drawn by sacrificing (losing) one of your droids in that battle.
lore: 'We're on our way!'

name: Don't Get Cocky
title: •Don't Get Cocky
text: If Luke and Han are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector, choose one TIE/ln present to be lost.
lore: Luke and Han made an effective team when defending the Millennium Falcon with its quad laser cannons against attacking TIE fighters. 'Great kid! Don't get cocky.'

name: Don't Move!
title: •Don't Move!
text: If a battle was just initiated, and two of your troopers are armed with weapons, target one opponent's character present. Draw destiny: (0-2) no effect, (3-4) target is power = 0 for remainder of turn, (5+) target captured.
lore: Stormtroopers rely on an intimidating presence and technologically superiority.

name: Don't Tread On Me
title: Don't Tread On Me
text: USED: Add 1 to your just-drawn weapon destiny. STARTING: If you have deployed a battleground, deploy Ultimatum, Scrambled Transmission and/or Do, Or Do Not from Reserve Deck. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
lore: Han did not take kindly to Jabba's posturing.

name: Don't Tread On Me (V)
title: Don't Tread On Me (V)
text: USED: Use 1 Force to deploy an Effect that deploys for free on table (or on your side of table) and is always Immune to Alter from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: When drawing your starting hand, draw up to 12 cards instead of 8. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
lore: Han did not take kindly to Jabba's posturing.

name: Don't Underestimate Our Chances
title: Don't Underestimate Our Chances
text: If an opponent has just initiated a battle, triple the resulting battle damage for the eventual loser. OR Triple the result of You Overestimate Their Chances.
lore: 'Stand-by alert. Death Star approaching. Estimated time to firing range, fifteen minutes.'

name: Dooku's Lightsaber
title: •Dooku's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Dooku or a [Separatist] character of ability > 4. Adds 1 to this character's duel and lightsaber combat totals. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Blank.

name: Dooku's Lightsaber (AI)
title: •Dooku's Lightsaber (AI)
text: Deploy on Dooku or a [Separatist] character of ability > 4. Adds 1 to this character's duel and lightsaber combat totals. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Blank.

name: Dorme
title: •Dorme
text: Once per turn, if Amidala at another location, may activate 1 Force. During your move phase, may target an opponent's Undercover spy here and draw two destiny. Choose one (take the other into hand). Target 'breaks cover' if destiny +1 > target's ability.
lore: Spy and handmaiden.

name: Double Agent
title: Double Agent
text: If both players have a spy at same site, draw destiny. Add 2 if opponent's spy is Undercover. Opponent's spy is lost if total destiny > 2. OR Opponent's Tonnika Sisters present at a site cross to your side.
lore: Typical of impersonators, Shada double-crossed everyone. Her true affiliations still remain a mystery.

name: Double Back
title: Double Back
text: If a Bounty Hunter is lost, use 1 Force to retrieve one bounty hunter from your Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one bounty hunter into hand and reshuffle.
lore: Having lost sight of Boba Fett, Luke was surprised by his sudden reappearance.

name: Double Back (V)
title: Double Back (V)
text: USED: Take 4-LOM, non-[Maintenance] Boba Fett, Danz Borin, or Dengar into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: During your move phase, your bounty hunter (or [Independent] starship they are piloting) may make an additional move. OR Move your bounty hunter as a 'react'.
lore: Having lost sight of Boba Fett, Luke was surprised by his sudden reappearance.

name: Double Laser Cannon
title: Double Laser Cannon
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on Jabba's Sail Barge or your sandcrawler; it is power +3 and immune to attrition < 5. If your warrior aboard here, may target a vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Similar power output to the Atgar P-tower. Equipped with a hydraulic coolant system. Effective in dealing with raiding swoop gangs.

name: Double-Crossing, No-Good Swindler
title: •Double-Crossing, No-Good Swindler
text: If Han and your Lando are at same site, opponent loses 3 Force. OR If Nabrun Leids just completed a transport, Nabrun is lost and you may immediately deploy cards to that site from hand (at normal use of the Force, but troopers deploy free).
lore: 'You've got a lot of guts coming here. . . after what you pulled.'

name: Down With The Emperor!
title: •Down With The Emperor!
text: If no Dark Jedi is on table, deploy on Death Star system. If Death Star 'blown away,' relocate to opponent's side of table: each Imperial and Imperial starship is deploy +8 and loses immunity to attrition. Canceled if a Dark Jedi is deployed. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: News of Imperial defeat inspires the citizens of the galaxy. A major loss seriously undermines the Empire's ability to function.

name: Down With The Emperor! (V)
title: •Down With The Emperor! (V)
text: Deploy on table. All immunity to attrition is -3. You may not fire [Permanent Weapon] weapons. If opponent just lost a Dark Jedi or a battle, they lose 1 Force. During your draw phase, use 3 Force or place this Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: News of Imperial defeat inspires the citizens of the galaxy. A major loss seriously undermines the Empire's ability to function.

name: Dr. Chelli Lona Aphra
title: •Dr. Chelli Lona Aphra
text: Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. Deploys free to an unoccupied site. Your droids are deploy -1 here. When deployed, may search your Lost Pile and move one card there to the top of that pile (if that card is a droid, may retrieve it into hand).
lore: Female information broker, spy, and thief. Trade Federation.

name: Dr. Chelli Lona Aphra (AI)
title: •Dr. Chelli Lona Aphra (AI)
text: Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. Deploys free to an unoccupied site. Your droids are deploy -1 here. When deployed, may search your Lost Pile and move one card there to the top of that pile (if that card is a droid, may retrieve it into hand).
lore: Female information broker, spy, and thief. Trade Federation.

name: Dr. Evazan
title: •Dr. Evazan
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. The not-so-good doctor may 'operate' on any other character present that was just 'hit' or just Disarmed; 'patient' is lost.
lore: Thug. Smuggler. Twisted 'doctor'. Disfigured by blaster. Has death sentence in over 12 systems. Notorious partner of Ponda Baba. Aliases: Dr. Cornelius and Rooboo.

name: Dr. Evazan & •Ponda Baba
title: •Dr. Evazan & •Ponda Baba
text: Adds 3 to power of anything they pilot. Power -3 if opponent has a lightsaber present. Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May target any other character present that was just 'hit.' Target character is lost.
lore: Smugglers who met each other in the Corellian system. Gained the rights to Han Solo's old smuggling routes from Jabba the Hutt. They don't like you either.

name: Dr. Evazan's Sawed-off Blaster
title: •Dr. Evazan's Sawed-off Blaster
text: Deploy on Dr. Evazan (may deploy on him as a 'react') or use 3 Force to deploy on your warrior. May target a character or creature at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. May fire repeatedly.
lore: Equipped with powerful infrared scope. Extremely sensitive trigger mechanism. Used to earn Evazan the death sentence on several systems.

name: Dragonsnake
title: <>Dragonsnake
text: Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: swamps, jungles and Dark Waters. May attack droids. Defeated droids are relocated to an adjacent exterior site (opponent of victim chooses).
lore: One of Dagobah's deadliest predators. Has razor-sharp fins, powerful constrictor coils and large fangs. Feeds on almost anything. Often mistaken for a swamp slug, due to its size.

name: Draw Their Fire
title: •Draw Their Fire
text: Deploy on your side of table. Whenever a battle is initiated, player initiating battle retrieves 1 Force and defender loses 1 Force. Also, during a battle you initiate, each time opponent plays an interrupt, opponent must first use 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'I'm going to cut across the axis and try and draw their fire.'

name: Dreaded Imperial Starfleet
title: •Dreaded Imperial Starfleet
text: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may cancel a Force drain by placing her from hand any non-unique starfighter. Starfighters may deploy from here as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any starfighters here may immediately deploy for free).
lore: The Empire uses short-range fighters and patrol craft to maintain a presence in every system within its scope of power.

name: Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser
title: Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser
text: May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 2. Turbolaser Battery may deploy aboard. Your TIEs present are each power +1.
lore: Introduced during the Clone Wars. 600 meters long. Some have cargo space converted to TIE hanger bays. Still used to maintain an Imperial presence in the Outer Rim.

name: Dresselian Commando
title: Dresselian Commando
text: Power +1 when at a forest, jungle or exterior Endor site. When in battle at an exterior site against a non-unique alien, adds one destiny to power only, prevents opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny and is immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Dresselians combat their homeworld's subjugation with supplies provided by Bothans. The Alliance uses their talents as resistance fighters. These scouts prefer to work alone.

name: DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid)
title: •DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid)
text: Nabrun Leids may not transport to or from here. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Dark Jedi (with any captives they are escorting), your Mara, or an Inquisitor from here to same site as a Dark Jedi or Jedi; place this droid in Used Pile.
lore: Patrol droids utilized by the Sith. Each droid has several multispectral imaging devices and a communications package. Used by Maul to track down Amidala.

name: Droid Detector
title: Droid Detector
text: Deploy at any interior site. Cannot be moved. Droids may not deploy to same site. Following the turn this device is deployed, all droids present are lost at end of any turn.
lore: To keep out the mechanicals he so detested, Wuher installed an automatic droid detector at the entrance to the Mos Eisley Cantina.

name: Droid Merchant
title: •••Droid Merchant
text: Spaceport Speeders may be played at same site. Once per game, may do one of the following: activate 1 Force when you deploy a droid OR retrieve 1 Force when you deploy an astromech to a starfighter.
lore: Careful manipulator of funds and Imperial taxation codes. Buys droids from Jawas and sells them to the Alliance.

name: Droid Racks
title: •Droid Racks
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on table. If your battle droid was just lost, may place it here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force (1 Force if your piloted MTT on table) to take any battle droid from here into hand. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Trade Federation utilizes such efficient methods of droid deployment that it is rumored even they do not know exactly how many battle droids are in circulation

name: Droid Racks (V)
title: •Droid Racks (V)
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on table. While present with a Jedi, destroyer droids are defense value +2. If your destroyer droid was just lost, may stack it here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to play any destroyer droid here in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Trade Federation utilizes such efficient methods of droid deployment that it is rumored even they do not know exactly how many battle droids are in circulation

name: Droid Sensorscope
title: Droid Sensorscope
text: Deploy on one of your R-unit droids. During any control phase, you may use 1 Force to peek at the top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. Also, if on Dagobah, droid may move for free.
lore: Full-spectrum transceiver for R-unit droids including electro-photo receptors, DERs and heat and motion detectors. Data is routed directly to droids Intellex IV internal computer.

name: Droid Shutdown
title: Droid Shutdown
text: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target your droid to be stolen, 'hit,' lost or captured. Droid is protected from all such attempts for remainder of turn.
lore: If low on energy and unable to recharge, a droid can shutdown active systems to conserve power.

name: Droid Starfighter
title: Droid Starfighter
text: Deploys -1 to same location as your battleship. Power -1 unless your droid control ship present. While another droid starfighter here, opponent's starfighters present are each power -1.
lore: These automated starfighters are managed by the Droid Control Ship and are used en masse by the Trade Federation to overwhelm an opponent with sheer numbers.

name: Droid Starfighter Laser Cannons
title: Droid Starfighter Laser Cannons
text: Deploy on your droid starfighter. May target a starship using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny > defense value. If destiny +1 = defense value, target is power = 0 until end of turn.
lore: Standard weapon aboard all droid starfighters. Used to eliminate fast- moving starfighters which battleship laser batteries have difficulty targeting.

name: Droideka
title: Droideka
text: Permanent weapon is Twin Blaster Cannons (may target a character or vehicle; draw destiny; add 2 if targeting a vehicle; if total destiny > defense value, target hit and you may activate 1 Force). While with another [Presence] droid at a site, adds one battle destiny.
lore: Blank.

name: Droideka (AI)
title: Droideka (AI)
text: Permanent weapon is Twin Blaster Cannons (may target a character or vehicle; draw destiny; add 2 if targeting a vehicle; if total destiny > defense value, target hit and you may activate 1 Force). While with another [Presence] droid at a site, adds one battle destiny.
lore: Blank.

name: Droopy McCool
title: •Droopy McCool
text: Power +2 at any desert or Tatooine site. Immune to Gravel Storm, Sandwhirl and desert landspeed requirements. While at Audience Chamber, all your other Kitonaks are forfeit +2. Immune to attrition < number of your musicians on table.
lore: Kitonak musician. Lead jizz wailer. Searching for other Kitonak rumored to be living on Tatooine. Rarely uses his real name, Snit.

name: Drop Your Weapons
title: •Drop Your Weapons
text: Target an opponent's weapon at same site as your battle droid. Each of that weapon's destiny draws are -1 for remainder of turn. OR If your battle droid just fired a blaster and hit a character, all opponent's weapons at same site are lost.
lore: In situations of confrontation, a command high on a battle droid's priority queue is to neutralize any kind of armament an opponent has.

name: Drop!
title: •Drop!
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on table. During your move phase, if opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, you may use 4 Force to place all but 8 (random choice) in Used Pile. Once during any control phase, you may place up to three cards from hand in Used Pile.
lore: Anakin had to heed Qui-Gon's advice to avoid the rapidly approaching storm.

name: Drop! (V)
title: •Drop! (V)
text: Plays on table. At end of a turn, if opponent has 15 or more cards in hand, may use 3 Force to shuffle all but 9 (random selection) into Used Pile. If Grimtaash or Thrown Back just targeted your hand, may reveal 3 cards from hand; they cannot be removed or checked for duplicates.
lore: Anakin had to heed Qui-Gon's advice to avoid the rapidly approaching storm.

name: Dryden Vos
title: •Dryden Vos
text: When deployed, may deploy a weapon on Vos from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While armed and present at a site, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and opponent may not 'react' to or from here. Immune to attrition < 5 (<3 if with Qi'ra).
lore: Crimson Dawn leader. Gangster.

name: DS-181-3
title: •DS-181-3
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Saber 3, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Opponent may not 'react' to same system or sector.
lore: Flies Saber 3 in fighting 181st. Studied under Baron Fel at the Prefsbelt Imperial Academy; now flies as his wing. Nicknamed 'Fel's Wrath'. Watches the Baron's back.

name: DS-181-4
title: •DS-181-4
text: Adds 3 to power of any TIE he pilots. Once during each of your deploy phases, you may take one unique (•) TIE Interceptor into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Wingman of Major Phennir. Earned promotion to Fel's squadron by scoring 12 kills at Mon Calamari. Repeatedly refused further promotion so that he could remain in the 181st.

name: DS-61-2
title: •DS-61-2
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 2, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Vader's left wingman. Flies Black 2. Specially trained pilot held in reserve for missions with Vader. Nicknamed 'Mauler Mithel.'

name: DS-61-3
title: •DS-61-3
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Pilot DS-61-3. Vader's right wingman. Flies Black 3. Reputation for ferocity in combat. Corellian pilot with excellent skills. Nicknamed 'Backstabber.'

name: DS-61-3 (V)
title: •DS-61-3 (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a dreadnaught or starfighter, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and opponent's immunity to attrition here is limited to < 7 (< 5 if piloting Black 3 or with Vader). Your non-[Coruscant] Interrupts with 'back' in title are destiny +2.
lore: Pilot DS-61-3. Vader's right wingman. Flies Black 3. Reputation for ferocity in combat. Corellian pilot with excellent skills. Nicknamed 'Backstabber.'

name: DS-61-4
title: •DS-61-4
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 4, also may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to take one Lone Pilot into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Imperial pilot nicknamed 'Dark Curse.' Survived assaults against several dissenter worlds including Ralltiir and Mon Calamari. Intends to retire after his next combat mission.

name: DS-61-5
title: •DS-61-5
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots, 3 when piloting Black 5. While piloting Black 5, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.
lore: Blank.

name: DS-61-5 (AI)
title: •DS-61-5 (AI)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots, 3 when piloting Black 5. While piloting Black 5, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.
lore: Blank.

name: Dual Laser Cannon
title: Dual Laser Cannon
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your T-47. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting a character or creature. Add 2 if targeting a vehicle. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Sund x2-100 laser cannon. Popular among outlaw organizations because it is both cheap and powerful. Frequently mounted on T-47 airspeeders.

name: Dud Bolt's Podracer
title: •Dud Bolt's Podracer
text: Deploy on Podrace Arena. Adds 1 to each of your race destinies here. If Sebulba's Podracer on table, may lose this Podracer to cancel Losing Track or Neck And Neck; place all race destinies here in owner's Used Pile.
lore: RS 557 Podracer. Secretly hired by Sebulba to protect him during Podraces.

name: Dune Sea Sabacc
title: •Dune Sea Sabacc
text: Requirements: A Jawa at a Tatooine site. Wild cards (0-7): sandcrawler sites, Magnetic Suction Tube, Jawa Siesta and Jawa Pack. Clone cards: Tatooine locations, sandcrawlers, Jawa weapons, and Utinni! Stakes: One device or droid with out armor.
lore: Popular among Tatooine's native population. Apart from the Jawas, no one else seems to understand the rules.

name: Dune Sea Sabacc
title: •Dune Sea Sabacc
text: Requirements: A Jawa at a Tatooine site. Wild cards (0-7): Sandcrawler sites, Magnetic Suction Tube, Jawa Siesta and Jawa Pack. Clone cards: Tatooine locations, sandcrawlers, Jawa weapons, and Utinni! Stakes: One device or droid with out armor.
lore: R'kik D'nec remains undefeated in this version of sabacc. Or at least there are no witnesses to the contrary.

name: Dune Walker
title: •••Dune Walker
text: Deploy -1 to a desert or Tatooine site. May add 1 pilot and 6 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. Landspeed may not be increased. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1.
lore: Enclosed armored transport adapted for hot climates by replacing tertiary weapons systems with additional Sienar t23 heat dissipation units.

name: Dutch
title: •Dutch
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 1, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Adds 1 to forfeit of each other Gold Squadron pilot at same location.
lore: Jon 'Dutch' Vander. Gold Squadron leader at Battle of Yavin. Prefers Y-wing fighters. Previously led squadron at Renforra Base. Emblem of Specter Squadron on his helmet.

name: Dutch (V)
title: •Dutch (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if Gold 1). While piloting a Y-Wing, for each Y-wing you have in a battle, attrition against opponent is +1 and attrition against your is -1. Y-wing pilots are forfeit +1 here.
lore: Jon 'Dutch' Vander. Gold Squadron leader at Battle of Yavin. Prefers Y-wing fighters. Previously led squadron at Renforra Base. Emblem of Specter Squadron on his helmet.

name: E Chu Ta
title: •E Chu Ta
text: One of your protocol droids 'insults' one character present, canceling that character's game text for remainder of turn. OR During your battle phase, initiate a battle where both players have droids (but no presence or spies). Both sides add one battle destiny.
lore: 'How rude!'

name: E-3PO
title: •E-3PO
text: Total power at same site is +1 for each of your alien/Imperial pairs present. Once during every turn, may use 1 Force to 'insult' one opponent's droid present (except R2-D2), canceling that droid's game text for remainder of turn.
lore: Brought to Cloud City by the Empire. Facilitates Imperial-to-alien communication. Relayed carbonite chamber modification instructions to Ugloste. Arrogant. Rude. Vulgar.

name: E-web Blaster
title: E-web Blaster
text: Deploy on any site. May be moved with two warriors for 1 additional Force. Your warrior present may target a starfighter (use 5 as defense value), character, creature or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: Massive infantry weapon powerful enough to damage even starfighters.

name: Early Warning Network
title: <>Early Warning Network
text: Deploy on an interior site that has a Scomp link. While you occupy this site, once per battle you may deploy a non-unique Imperial starship as a 'react' (for free if starfighter) to the related system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Listening posts are often constructed as part of a standard Imperial installation. On Endor, such a post was incorporated into the control bunker.

name: Echo Base Destroyed
title: •Echo Base Destroyed
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if Main Power Generators on table, may place a card from hand under Reserve Deck to activate 1 Force; reshuffle Reserve Deck. Once per turn, if 1^ST Marker 'blown away,' may take a [Hoth] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Before an AT-AT's troops can disembark to engage the enemy, the walker must first destroy the Rebel traitors' defensive emplacements.

name: Echo Base Garrison
title: •Echo Base Garrison
text: Deploy on table. Rogue T-47s are immune to attrition < 4 (or < 6 if matching pilot aboard). Once during each of your turns, may take one maintenance droid, Bacta Tank, Lone Rogue, [Hoth] Luke, [Special Edition] Wedge, Zev or Hobbie into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'All troop carriers will assemble at the North Entrance. The heavy Transport ships will leave as soon as they're loaded.'

name: Echo Base Operations
title: •Echo Base Operations
text: Deploy on Main Power Generators if you occupy at least three Echo sites. At every system location, you deploy is -1, your Force drains are +2 and your total power is +3 in battles. Effect canceled if opponent occupies five Hoth sites. (Immune to Alter.).
lore: Following the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance garnered the support of systems ready to oppose the Empire. Echo Base provides a command center for focusing that support.

name: Echo Base Sensors
title: •Echo Base Sensors
text: Deploy on North Ridge if Main Power Generators on table. When opponent deploys a character or vehicle to a marker site, activate 1 Force and that card may not move that turn. Effect lost if opponent occupies an Echo site, or your Ice Storm on table. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'The sensors are in place. You'll know if anything comes around.'

name: Echo Base Trooper
title: Echo Base Trooper
text: Deploy only on Hoth, but may move elsewhere. Power -1 when at a site other than a Hoth site.
lore: The personnel assigned to protect Echo Base are veteran warriors. Troopers such as Jess Allashane are trained to counter Imperial tactics in cold environments.

name: Echo Base Trooper (V)
title: Echo Base Trooper (V)
text: Power +1 on Hoth. Once per turn, may deploy a card with 'Echo' in title (except Echo Base Trooper or a location) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, if on Hoth (or present with a Scomp link), may reveal the top card of each player's Reserve Deck.
lore: The personnel assigned to protect Echo Base are veteran warriors. Troopers such as Jess Allashane are trained to counter Imperial tactics in cold environments.

name: Echo Base Trooper Officer
title: •••Echo Base Trooper Officer
text: Deploy only on Hoth but may move elsewhere. Echo Base Troopers deploy -1 to same site. Your troopers may move to same Hoth site as a 'react.'
lore: Like many Rebel specialists, Trey Callum defected from the Imperial officer corps. Trooper officers are masters at stretching the meager resources of the Rebellion.

name: Echo Base Trooper Rifle
title: Echo Base Trooper Rifle
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on your warrior (Free on your Echo Base trooper). May target a character, creature or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 2 Force (1 if fired by an Echo Base trooper). Draw Destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: BlasTech A295 blaster rifle. Standard-issue longarm at Echo Base. Highly accurate with good range. Favored by marksmen and snipers in a hostile environment.

name: Echo Trooper Backpack
title: Echo Trooper Backpack
text: Deploy on your trooper. May use any number of weapons and devices. Trooper is immune to attrition < 3 when at a planet site.
lore: Rebels carry a variety of equipment to be fully prepared for enemies and the elements. Weather-resistant backpacks keep gear protected and operational.

name: Edcel Bar Gane
title: •Edcel Bar Gane
text: Agenda: ambition. While in a senate majority, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny in battles at battleground sites and you may not cancel opponent's battle destiny draws at sites.
lore: Senator from the planet Roona. One of the first to support Amidala's motion for a vote of no confidence in Supreme Chancellor Valorum. Intolerant of other species.

name: Eee Chu Wawa!
title: •Eee Chu Wawa!
text: USED: For remainder of turn, subtract 1 from forfeit of each opponent's Ewok (or subtract 2 from any one opponent's character). LOST: Cancel one Ewok's game text for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Sound The Attack.
lore: Paploo's brave diversion provided more of a ride than the adventurous Ewok had bargained for.

name: Effective Repairs
title: Effective Repairs
text: USED: Cancel Limited Resources. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve into hand one Effect of any kind.
lore: When the nav computer maintenance program failed to auto-repair the hyperdrive, Han decided to take matters into his own hand.

name: Effective Repairs & Starship Levitation
title: Effective Repairs & Starship Levitation
text: USED: Cancel Broken Concentration, Lateral Damage, or Limited Resources. OR Place a card just stacked on Droid Racks or Strategic Reserves in opponent's Lost Pile. (Immune to Sense) OR If you just drew a starship for destiny, take that starship into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve an Effect of any kind or a non-[Maintenance] starship into hand.

name: EG-4 (Eegee-Four)
title: EG-4 (Eegee-Four)
text: Adds 1 to power of each of your droids present, except power droids. * Destiny equals zero, but if drawn as a battle destiny where you have less power than opponent, your total power present is doubled (once per battle).
lore: Very popular droid on inhospitable worlds. Rugged design. Modified top-mounted power sockets. Donated to the Alliance by the Bothan underground.

name: EG-6 (Eegee-Six)
title: EG-6 (Eegee-Six)
text: Adds 1 to power of each of your droids present, except power droids. *Destiny equals zero, but if drawn as a battle destiny where you have less power than opponent, your total power present is doubled (once per battle).
lore: Ambulatory power generator made by Veril Line Systems to support equipment and vehicles. Slow-witted. This EG unit is memory-wiped and doesn't know its name or serial number.

name: Egregious Pilot Error
title: •Egregious Pilot Error
text: During opponent's control phase, if opponent has two or more capital starships at a system or sector together, draw destiny. If destiny -1 < number of those starships, they may not move or participate in battle until end of your next turn.
lore: Details of the notorious 'Incident at Anoat' are required reading at the Imperial Academy of Raithal, where the pilots' names are posthumously displayed.

name: Eighth Brother
title: •Eighth Brother
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy or move as a 'react' to same site as a 'Hatred' card. During your move phase, unless alone, may return one of your Inquisitors here (and all cards on them) to owner's hand.
lore: Terrelian Jango Jumper. Inquisitor.

name: Either Way, You Win
title: •Either Way, You Win
text: Opponent chooses: opponent may activate up to 2 Force and you may activate up to 4 Force, or opponent retrieves 1 Force and you retrieve 3 Force.
lore: 'Deal!'

name: Either Way, You Win (V)
title: •Either Way, You Win (V)
text: Each player may choose to play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect or to exchange a card in hand with one of their race destinies. [Immune to Sense.] OR If a battle involving Qui-Gon was just initiated at a junkyard, weapons may not be fired this battle.
lore: 'Deal!'

name: Eject! Eject!
title: Eject! Eject!
text: Use 1 Force to target a starfighter having one or more permanent pilots. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on starfighter to remove all permanent pilots (otherwise, Effect is lost). May add 1 pilot for each permanent pilot removed. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Guiderhouser ejection seat has saved many pilots from their exploding starships. However, system malfunctions have sometimes caused spontaneous ejection.

name: Elan Sleazebaggano
title: •Elan Sleazebaggano
text: Power and forfeit +2 at a Coruscant location. At the beginning of opponent's control phase, if present with opponent's character, `sell death sticks' (opponent must use or lose 1 Force; if a Jedi present, also place Elan in Used Pile).
lore: Balosar information broker.

name: Electro-Rangefinder
title: Electro-Rangefinder
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on any AT-AT Cannon. It may fire at targets two sites away. Also, when used to Target The Main Generator, adds 1 to total.
lore: Long-range stereoscopic sighting device connected to the cannons of an Imperial walker. Calibrated to allow the AT-AT commander to accurately fire at distant targets.

name: Electro-Rangefinder (V)
title: Electro-Rangefinder (V)
text: Deploy on an AT-AT; may immediately search your Used Pile and take an AT-AT Cannon or [Hoth] Epic Event into hand; reshuffle. Adds 2 to each of this AT-AT's weapon destiny draws (unless targeting a character).
lore: Long-range stereoscopic sighting device connected to the cannons of an Imperial walker. Calibrated to allow the AT-AT commander to accurately fire at distant targets.

name: Electrobinoculars
title: Electrobinoculars
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. At any time, you may peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck by using 2 Force. You may choose to move that card to the top of your Force Pile.
lore: Enhances distant targets using a computer-assisted zoom technology. Provides range information. Works in low-light. Rugged case protects the internal systems.

name: Electropole
title: Electropole
text: Deploy on your Gungan. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, character is power -4 for remainder of turn. At the end of battle here, may place this electropole on top of Reserve Deck.
lore: Gungan weapon that is very similar to the Force pike. Used to control crowds, wild animals, and the occasional battle droid.

name: Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught
title: •Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught
text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Vanto, who provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 while piloted by Thrawn or while a 'probed' or 'liberated' system on table).
lore: Introduced during the Clone Wars. 600 meters long. Some have cargo space converted to TIE hanger bays. Still used to maintain an Imperial presence in the Outer Rim.

name: Elis Helrot
title: Elis Helrot
text: At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: A Givin pilot who can seal his joints to withstand the vacuum of space. Makes slaving and spike runs to Kala'uun. Has made many special modifications to his ship, the Hinthra.

name: Elis In Hinthra
title: •Elis In Hinthra
text: May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy a smuggler aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Elite Squadron Stormtrooper
title: •••Elite Squadron Stormtrooper
text: Power +2 while armed with a blaster. When using a blaster, subtracts 1 from Force required to fire it. Adds 2 to forfeit of each stormtrooper of ability < 2 at same site.
lore: Commander Igar selected the Empire's most dedicated stormtroopers to guard Endor for the Emperor. All they know is killing and white uniforms.

name: Ello Asty
title: •Ello Asty
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting an X-wing alone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and all immunity to attrition here is canceled. Once during your control phase, may take Sabotage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Abednedo.

name: Ellorrs Madak
title: Ellorrs Madak
text: Deploy on your non-pilot character (except droids) to give that character [Pilot] skill. Adds 2 to power of anything that character pilots. OR Deploy on your pilot. Adds 1 to power of anything that character pilots. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Like many Duros, Madak has natural piloting and navigation skill. Former scout. Freelance instructor. Makes runs to important trade worlds Celanon, Byblos and Yaga Minor.

name: Ellorrs Madak, Pilot Instructor
title: •Ellorrs Madak, Pilot Instructor
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to the hyperspeed of any freighter he pilots. During your move phase, may use 1 Force to 'break cover' of opponent's Undercover spy at same site. Cancels Lateral Damage targeting your starship at same or related system.
lore: Duros scout and smuggler.

name: Elom
title: Elom
text: Power +3 at same site as an Imperial. For remainder of game, Plastoid Armor is an Effect, is not unique, is immune to Alter while on table, and it deploys only on a Rebel or alien at same mobile site as Elom (character is now 'disguised').
lore: Many Elom commit sabotage and theft against the Empire to avenge the invasion of their homeworld. Experts in adapting stolen equipment for use by the Rebellion.

name: Elyhek Rue
title: •Elyhek Rue
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 7 during battle, adds one destiny to total power only. When at Ralltiir system, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.
lore: Piloted Red 7 at the Battle of Yavin. Part of the Griffon flight wing, a Rebel squadron sent to fight the Imperial subjugation of Ralltiir.

name: Emergency Deployment
title: Emergency Deployment
text: If opponent just initiated a battle where opponent has more than double your power, reveal up to 3 cards from your Reserve Deck. Of those 3, deploy anywhere (for free) any characters, starships, vehicles, devices or weapons. Any others are lost.
lore: TIE fighters are stored in large racks far above the hangar deck. Catapulted into space by powerful tractor beam generators, TIEs can quickly scramble to engage the enemy.

name: Emperor Palpatine
title: •Emperor Palpatine
text: Never deploys or moves (even aboard a starship or vehicle) to a site opponent occupies. Where present, subtracts 3 from attempts to cross Vader over. Once per turn, you may take Force Lightning into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition.
lore: Sith Master and leader of Galactic Empire. Dark side mentor to Darth Vader. Controls the Empire by instilling fear in its subjects and greed in its governors.

name: Emperor Palpatine, Foreseer
title: •Emperor Palpatine, Foreseer
text: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a site opponent occupies. Once during your turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Reserve Deck; place one in Used Pile, one in Lost Pile, and take one into hand. Immune to attrition.
lore: From his throne room aboard the second Death Star, Emperor Palpatine monitors activity throughout the galaxy. Leader.

name: Emperor's Orders
title: •Emperor's Orders
text: If you did not deploy an Objective, deploy on table. We're Not Going To Attack?: Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. You may not deploy non-Imperial starships. Unless you occupy a battleground site, Dreaded Imperial Starfleet is suspended. The Alliance Will Die...: Flagship Operations does not require any Executor sites on table to deploy, and does not target squadrons. ...As Will Your Friends: At battleground systems where you have a piloted capital starship/TIE pair, Force drains = 2. During battle at a site related to a system you occupy, may add one destiny to total power and/or re-circulate.

name: Emperor's Personal Shuttle
title: •Emperor's Personal Shuttle
text: May add 1 pilot and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability 2. Emperor deploys for free aboard. While Emperor aboard, immune to attrition and adds one battle destiny.
lore: Transport used extensively by Emperor Palpatine. Extremely well guarded. Pilots ordered to maintain constant contact with all nearby Imperial strike forces.

name: Emperor's Power
title: •Emperor's Power
text: Deploy on your Throne Room. You may not Force drain here. While Emperor here, opponent's characters are deploy +2 to Death Star II sites and, one per turn, you may lose Effect (or 1 Force from top of Reserve Deck) to add one battle destiny anywhere. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: From his throne room aboard the second Death Star, Emperor Palpatine monitors activity throughout the galaxy.

name: Empire's New Order
title: •Empire's New Order
text: Deploy on table. Droid Merchant game text is canceled. Also, while none of your ability on table is provided by aliens, retrieve 1 Force after each battle in which opponent's alien is lost (or 2 if Ewok, Elom or operative). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Palpatine's cruel vision of his Empire included the enslavement and subjugation of entire species.

name: Encampment
title: <>Encampment
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on any exterior planet site where you have a Rebel or alien. You may deploy characters at this site, even without presence, regardless of location deployment restrictions.
lore: Pirates, smugglers and Rebels operate from tiny camps which can be set up quickly and relocated at a moment's notice. A surprise visitor made Luke an unhappy camper.

name: End Of A Reign
title: •End Of A Reign
text: USED: Cancel Overseeing It Personally. OR Use 4 Force to cancel Vader's game text for remainder of turn. LOST: If Emperor just lost from table, draw destiny. Opponent must lose Force equal to the destiny draw.
lore: The turning of Vader and the loss of Palpatine was the beginning of a new era for the entire galaxy.

name: End This Destructive Conflict
title: •End This Destructive Conflict
text: USED: During a battle at a site, instead of firing one character weapon, cause one opponent's character present to be power -4 until end of turn. LOST: During a battle at a site, use 3 Force to cancel one battle destiny just drawn.
lore: 'Join me, and together we can rule the galaxy as father and son.'

name: Endless Legions
title: •Endless Legions
text: If your stormtroopers occupy three battlegrounds and/or Rebel Base locations, choose: Draw three cards from Force Pile, then place two cards from hand on Force Pile. OR Once per game, if you just lost a non-[Maintenance] stormtrooper, take it into hand.
lore: Imperial troopers are fearless and totally indoctrinated. Backed by the most powerful weapons and starships in the galaxy, they tend to consider themselves invincible.

name: Endor
title: •Endor
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Endor site. Light: If you have no Ewoks on Endor, Force drain -1 here. To move or deploy your starship to here requires +1 Force.

name: Endor
title: •Endor
text: Light: Force drain -1 here. To move your starship here from Sullust, Rendezvous Point or Haven requires -1 Force. Dark: If you have no Imperials on Endor, Force drain -1 here.

name: Endor (V)
title: •Endor (V)
text: Light: If you have no Rebels on Endor, Force drain -1 here. If you control, each of opponent's biker scouts is forfeit -1. Dark: If you have no Imperials on Endor, Force drain -1 here.

name: Endor Celebration
title: •Endor Celebration
text: Cancel Tatooine Occupation, Cloud City Occupation or Rebel Base Occupation. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your activate phase, activate 1 Force for each Endor battleground you occupy.
lore: The Rebel presence on Endor meant that the Ewoks would be able to live free from the Empire's tyranny.

name: Endor Commando Team
title: •Endor Commando Team
text: Deploys -1 to Endor. During battle, your other Rebels here may not have their forfeit reduced unless this card 'hit.' Each time this character is 'hit,' it is cumulatively power -2 until end of turn.
lore: General Solo's strike team was made up of the Alliance's finest ground troops. Scout trooper.

name: Endor Occupation
title: •Endor Occupation
text: Cancel Tatooine Celebration, Cloud City Celebration or Coruscant Celebration. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your activate phase, activate 1 Force for each Endor battleground you occupy.
lore: Each planet controlled by the Empire drains potential resources from the Rebel Alliance.

name: Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost
title: Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost
text: Endor Operations: Deploy Endor system, Bunker and Landing Platform. {While} this side up, once during each of your control phases, may take one Ominous Rumors or Establish Secret Base into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Ominous Rumors and Establish Secret Base are both on table. {Place} out of play if an Endor location is 'blown away'. Imperial Outpost: {While} this side up, at each Endor site where you have a biker scout or a piloted AT-ST, your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent, except by a 'react'. Opponent draws no more than one battle destiny in each battle. Your AT-STs are immune to attrition < 3. Once during each of your draw phases, you may retrieve one biker scout. {Flip} this card if Ominous Rumors and Establish Secret Base are not both on table. {Place} out of play if an Endor location is 'blown away.'

back.title: Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost
back.text: Endor Operations: Deploy Endor system, Bunker and Landing Platform. {While} this side up, once during each of your control phases, may take one Ominous Rumors or Establish Secret Base into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Ominous Rumors and Establish Secret Base are both on table. {Place} out of play if an Endor location is 'blown away'. Imperial Outpost: {While} this side up, at each Endor site where you have a biker scout or a piloted AT-ST, your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent, except by a 'react'. Opponent draws no more than one battle destiny in each battle. Your AT-STs are immune to attrition < 3. Once during each of your draw phases, you may retrieve one biker scout. {Flip} this card if Ominous Rumors and Establish Secret Base are not both on table. {Place} out of play if an Endor location is 'blown away.'

name: Endor Scout Trooper
title: Endor Scout Trooper
text: Power -1 while not on Endor. While Endor Scout Trooper is on Endor, Lieutenant Page and each of your Rebel scouts of ability < 3 at same and adjacent exterior sites are immune to attrition < 2.
lore: Rebel troopers receive Scout training that helps them to survive combat in harsh environments. Often protect 'specialists' while they accomplish mission tasks.

name: Endor Shield
title: •Endor Shield
text: Deploy on Bunker. Imperials deploy -1 here while Death Star II system orbits Endor and you control Bunker. At Death Star II system and each Death Star site opponent may not deploy and must use +3 Force to move there.
lore: Planetary scale shield projected from surface of Endor moon. Protected second Death Star during construction. Only another superlaser could penetrate it while operational.

name: Endor Shield (V)
title: •Endor Shield (V)
text: Deploy on table. While your [Endor] objective on table (and opponent's [Endor] objective not on table) opponent generates no Force at Endor system. Twice per game, may take an Imperial admiral into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Planetary scale shield projected from surface of Endor moon. Protected second Death Star during construction. Only another superlaser could penetrate it while operational.

name: Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre
title: •Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre
text: Dark: Light: If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, deploy Like My Father Before Me from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Anakin 'communing,' you may initiate battles for free.

name: Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre (ALT)
title: •Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre (ALT)
text: Dark: Light: If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, deploy Like My Father Before Me from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Anakin 'communing,' you may initiate battles for free.

name: Endor: Ancient Forest
title: •Endor: Ancient Forest
text: Dark: Your aliens are deploy -1 here (or -2 if Yuzzum). If your Yuzzum present, Force drain +1 here. Light:

name: Endor: Back Door
title: •Endor: Back Door
text: Dark: During your move phase, you may move from Back Door to Bunker (or vice versa). Light: If you control, during your move phase, you may move from Back Door to Bunker (or vice versa).

name: Endor: Back Door
title: •Endor: Back Door
text: Light: During your move phase, you may move from Back Door to Bunker (or vice versa). Dark: If you control, during your move phase, you may move from Back Door to Bunker (or vice versa).

name: Endor: Bunker
title: •Endor: Bunker
text: Dark: Once per game, you may deploy Endor Shield from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: You may move here only from Back Door. While you control, Endor Shield is suspended.

name: Endor: Bunker
title: •Endor: Bunker
text: Light: Force drain +1 here. If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny. Dark: Once per game, you may deploy Endor Shield from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Endor: Bunker (V)
title: •Endor: Bunker (V)
text: Light: Unless you occupy Bunker (or Back Door), your characters may not deploy here. Dark: Once per game, may deploy Endor Shield from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut
title: •Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut
text: Light: Your Ewoks are deploy -1 here. Chief Chirpa deploys free here. Dark: If you control Chief Chirpa's Hut, Ewoks at Endor sites are forfeit -1.

name: Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V)
title: •Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V)
text: Light: Deploys only if a [Death Star II] objective on table. During opponent's turn, if an Imperial at Landing Platform, Luke may move from here to there for free. Dark:

name: Endor: Dark Forest
title: •Endor: Dark Forest
text: Dark: Your Yuzzum are each power +1 here. If your Imperial is present, Force drain +1 here. Light: Your Ewoks are each deploy +1 here. If your Ewok present, Force drain +1 here.

name: Endor: Dense Forest
title: •Endor: Dense Forest
text: Dark: No starships or vehicles here except speeder bikes, AT-STs, Ewok gliders and creature vehicles. Light: No starships or vehicles here except speeder bikes, AT-STs, Ewok gliders and creature vehicles.

name: Endor: Dense Forest
title: •Endor: Dense Forest
text: Light: No starships or vehicles here except speeder bikes, AT-STs, Ewok gliders and creature vehicles. Dark: No starships or vehicles here except speeder bikes, AT-STs, Ewok gliders and creature vehicles.

name: Endor: Ewok Village
title: •Endor: Ewok Village
text: Dark: No starships or vehicles here. If no Ewoks on Endor, Force drain +1 here. Light: No starships or vehicles here. If your Ewok present, Force drain +1 here.

name: Endor: Ewok Village
title: •Endor: Ewok Village
text: Light: No starships or vehicles here. Ewok devices and Ewok weapons deploy -1 here. Dark: No starships or vehicles here. If no Ewoks on Endor, Force drain +1 here.

name: Endor: Ewok Village (V)
title: •Endor: Ewok Village (V)
text: Light: No starships or vehicles here. While Prophecy Of The Force with Luke here, it may not relocate. Dark: Force drain -1 here. While opponent's [Set 8] Effect with Luke here, your Force generation is -1 here.

name: Endor: Forest Clearing
title: •Endor: Forest Clearing
text: Dark: Your vehicles are each power +1 here. Force drain +1 here. Light: Your vehicles are each power +1 here.

name: Endor: Great Forest
title: •••Endor: Great Forest
text: Dark: Your character movement from here (except for Yuzzum and scouts) requires +1 landspeed. Light: Your character movement from here (except for Ewok and scouts) requires +1 landspeed.

name: Endor: Great Forest
title: •••Endor: Great Forest
text: Light: Your character movement from here (except for Ewoks and scouts) requires +1 landspeed. Dark: Your character movement from here (except for Yuzzum and scouts) requires +1 landspeed.

name: Endor: Hidden Forest Trail
title: •Endor: Hidden Forest Trail
text: Light: During your move phase, your scouts may move between here and any exterior Endor site. Dark: If you occupy, opponent's Hidden Forest Trail game text is canceled.

name: Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)
title: •Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)
text: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if your Imperial present). Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 7 Force. Your transit to here requires +9 Force.

name: Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)
title: •Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)
text: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if your Imperial present).

name: Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest)
title: •Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest)
text: Light: Your starfighters land here for free. Your droids and [Endor] Rebels are deploy -1 here. Dark: If you occupy, opponent's Rebel Landing Site game text is canceled.

name: Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest) (V)
title: •Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest) (V)
text: Light: Your scouts of ability < 5 are deploy -1 and defense value +2 here. Dark: Unless you occupy, you must first use 1 Force to deploy a non-scout character here.

name: Endurance
title: •Endurance
text: May add 5 pilots, 5 passengers, 5 vehicles, and 5 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Kilian, Mace, and clones deploy -1 aboard and shuttle from here for free. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Blank.

name: Energy Shell Launchers
title: Energy Shell Launchers
text: Deploy on your AAT. May target a character or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. May subtract 1. If destiny = target's destiny number, target is hit.
lore: AAT weapon designed for wide-spread destruction. Can devastate opposing infantry.

name: Energy Walls
title: •Energy Walls
text: During your control phase, deploy on Theed Palace Generator Core. No more than one character may deploy to here each turn, and characters may not move to or from here. Immediate Effect lost at end of opponent's turn.
lore: Theed security protocol proved to be a deciding variable in the duel of the fates.

name: Energy Walls
title: •Energy Walls
text: During your control phase, deploy on Theed Palace Generator Core. No more than one character may deploy to here each turn, and characters may not move to or from here. Immediate Effect lost at end of opponent's turn.
lore: Theed security protocol proved to be a deciding variable in the duel of the fates.

name: Enhanced Proton Torpedoes
title: Enhanced Proton Torpedoes
text: Deploy on your X-wing, Y-wing or B-wing. May target a starship for 1 Force. Add 1 if targeting a capital starship. Otherwise, subtract 1. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Often modified by Rebel technicians. Heavy warhead provides increased armor penetration. Decreased maneuverability and effectiveness against starfighters.

name: Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon
title: Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your TIE. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 2 if targeting a capital starship. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Sienar Fleet Systems' latest laser cannon prototype increases the firepower most Imperial TIEs - but many Moffs consider the weapon too expensive for widespread use.

name: Ensign Chad Hilse
title: •Ensign Chad Hilse
text: During battle, if present at a site with a stormtrooper (or Rebel leader), may add one destiny to total power only. Once per turn, may subtract 1 from a destiny draw of an opponent's Interrupt or weapon targeting a non-Jedi Rebel here.
lore: Corellian Corvette trooper Ensign Chad Hilse, an Alderaanian, typifies the loyal Rebel volunteers dedicated to defeating the Empire. Trained in starship and ground combat.

name: Ensign Eli Vanto
title: •Ensign Eli Vanto
text: [Pilot] 2: any capital starship. While with Thrawn, your starships here are power and hyperspeed +1. During your control phase, may use 1 Force to take a card with 'artwork' or 'studied' in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Blank.

name: Enter The Bureaucrat
title: •••Enter The Bureaucrat
text: If you just lost more than 2 Force to a Force drain, deploy on opponent's location. You lose no more than 1 Force from Force drains here. At any time, you may place Immediate Effect in Used Pile to draw two cards from top of Reserve Deck.
lore: Even the most effective of operations can be easily mired under the Republic's plethora of procedural red tape.

name: Entering The Arena
title: •Entering The Arena
text: USED: Once per game may take Podracer Bay into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: During a battle at Podracer Bay, add one battle destiny.
lore: 'What'd he mean by that?' 'I'll tell you later.'

name: Entrenchment
title: •Entrenchment
text: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand any non-unique Rebel. Rebels may deploy from here as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any Rebels here may immediately deploy for free.)
lore: As the Empire advances, Rebels retreat to fortified positions to marshal their resources and redeploy the troops.

name: Eopie
title: Eopie
text: May add 2 'riders' (passengers). Ability = ¼. Moves for free. While 'ridden' by Amidala in battle, adds one battle destiny.
lore: Herd animal native to Tatooine. Adults are used as beasts of burden, while the young and elderly eopies are useful for consuming desert weeds.

name: Ephant Mon
title: •Ephant Mon
text: Opponent's spies, gamblers and thieves may not deploy or move to same site. When with Jabba in a battle, power +2 and, if forfeited, may satisfy all remaining battle damage and attrition against you.
lore: Chevin smuggler. One of Jabba's few truly loyal associates. Keeps Jabba informed as to the various plots against his life. Leader.

name: Epic Duel
title: •Epic Duel
text: Deploy on your side of table. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader is present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (add 1 to each destiny draw if using a lightsaber). Add character's ability. If Vader loses, place him out of play. You lose 6 Force (9 if dueling Luke). If Obi-Wan loses, place him out of play. Opponent loses 9 Force. If Luke loses, opponent must choose: Cross Luke to the Dark Side and lose X Force, Where X = Luke's ability. OR Lose Luke and lose triple X Force.

name: Eriadu
title: •Eriadu
text: Dark: Tarkin deploys free here. If you control, all Imperials with ability > 2 on table are forfeit +2. Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Eriadu (V)
title: •Eriadu (V)
text: Dark: If Imperials control three battlegrounds, Force drain +1 here. Light: If Tarkin here, your starships deploy +1 here.

name: Eriadu Operative
title: Eriadu Operative
text: While at a Eriadu site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is power +1 (or +2 if your commander, general or moff is on Eriadu) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Eriadu from Reserve Deck- reshuffle.
lore: Used by Imperial officers as a contact between the Empire and local citizenry. Keep the Imperial bureaucracy informed on planetary issues.

name: Escape Pod
title: Escape Pod
text: If your capital starship is about to be lost, relocate your characters aboard to any one planet site.
lore: Capital starships have emergency escape pods. Equipped with food, water, flares, medpacs, hunting blaster and tracking beacon (R2-D2 deactivated this one's beacon).

name: Escape Pod & We're Doomed
title: Escape Pod & We're Doomed
text: Use 1 Force to take a dejarik into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to the following cards on table (if any): Cloud City Occupation, Rebel Base Occupation, Tatooine Occupation, That Thing's Operational, You May Start Your Landing, or You'll Be Dead!
lore: Blank.

name: Escape Pod (V)
title: Escape Pod (V)
text: Use 1 Force to take a dejarik or holosite into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a holosite. OR If opponent is about to place your character our of play, place that character in your Lost Pile instead.
lore: Capital starships have emergency escape pods. Equipped with food, water, flares, medpacs, hunting blaster and tracking beacon (R2-D2 deactivated this one's beacon).

name: Establish Control
title: Establish Control
text: Deploy on a docking bay you control. No Force drains here. Fallen Portal may not target a character at this site. Your Force drains are +2 at adjacent non-docking bay battleground sites. Place Effect in Used Pile if opponent controls this location.
lore: Keeping supply routes clear allows rapid distribution of resources to where they are most required.

name: Establish Control (V)
title: Establish Control (V)
text: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at docking bays you occupy. Your docking bays controlled by opponent are battlegrounds. Once per game, may deploy Corulag or Fondor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Mobilization Points on table, this Effect lost. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Keeping supply routes clear allows rapid distribution of resources to where they are most required.

name: Establish Secret Base
title: •Establish Secret Base
text: Deploy on Endor system if your biker scouts and/or AT-STs control three Endor sites. Your Force drain here is +1 for each Endor site your biker scout or AT-ST controls (limit +3). Place Effect in Used Pile if opponent controls this system. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Empire's remote bases develop new technology and hide sensitive projects from potential Rebel saboteurs.

name: Establish Secret Base (V)
title: •Establish Secret Base (V)
text: Deploy on Bunker if you control that site. Your Force generation at Endor system may not be canceled. Once per turn, may deploy an Endor site from your reserve deck; reshuffle. Place Effect in Used Pile if opponent controls this site. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Empire's remote bases develop new technology and hide sensitive projects from potential Rebel saboteurs.

name: EV-9D9
title: •EV-9D9
text: During your control phase, may search Reserve Deck, take one power droid or Torture into hand and reshuffle. May Force drain at Droid Workshop, Droid Junkheap or Incinerator (+1 for each other droid present, including captive droids).
lore: MerenData EV supervisor droid. Particularly enjoys torturing power droids. A clumsy designer nearly broke this unit before it was shipped. She formerly worked at Cloud City.

name: Evacuate?
title: Evacuate?
text: If your capital starship is about to be lost, unless Tarkin aboard, relocate your characters aboard to any one planet site or to one of your capital starships.
lore: Escape pods are on many starships allowing those in peril to flee, an act considered cowardly by Imperial officers. 'We've analyzed their attack, sir, and there is a danger.'

name: Evacuation Control
title: Evacuation Control
text: Deploy on your war room. Once during each of your move phases, your Planet Defender Ion Cannon at same planet may fire. Also, each of your medium transports at same planet is hyperspeed +2, is immune to attrition < 3 and may move for free.
lore: 'Give the evacuation code signal...and get to your transports!'

name: Evader
title: Evader
text: USED: Cancel all Revolutions in play (owner loses 1 Force for each). LOST: If Vader or Vader's Custom TIE was just lost, relocate that card to Used Pile. OR Relocate to Used Pile one Imperial just lost from any Death Star location.
lore: A panic move by Black 2 send Vader spinning wildly from the Death Star trench-ironically sparing his life. His destiny would be fulfilled another time.

name: Evader & Monnok
title: Evader & Monnok
text: USED: Cancel all Revolutions in play. OR If opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, place all but 8 (random selection) in Used Pile. LOST: Use 4 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has two or more of in hand are lost.

name: Eventually You'll Lose
title: •Eventually You'll Lose
text: USED: If a battle was just initiated, place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck. LOST: Use 3 Force to cause opponent to reveal hand. All cards opponent has 3 or more of in hand are lost.
lore: In the end, Watto finally came to understand the agony of defeat.

name: Eventually You'll Lose (V)
title: •Eventually You'll Lose (V)
text: If Podrace Arena on table, take Skywalker Hut, Amidala, or Jar Jar into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, if you have won a Podrace and [Tatooine] Anakin is present at a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force for each [Dark Side] at that site.
lore: In the end, Watto finally came to understand the agony of defeat.

name: Everything We Need
title: •Everything We Need
text: If My Parents Were Strong on table, choose: take Saddle or a Kef Bir site into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle, add X to your total power, where X = number of your cards out of play.
lore: Blank.

name: Evil Is Everywhere
title: •Evil Is Everywhere
text: Deploy on table. Non-[Episode I] Dark Jedi are lost. Unless with Obi-Wan, Dooku is immune to attrition. Your game text on Jedi Council Chamber is canceled. Once per turn, may deploy a mobile hallway or [Episode I] lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Blank.

name: Ewok And Roll
title: •Ewok And Roll
text: If opponent's creature vehicle or AT-ST just deployed or moved to where your Ewok is present, draw destiny. Creature vehicle lost if destiny > defense value. AT-ST crashed if destiny +2 > armor. OR If your Ewok is defending a battle, add 2 to your total power.
lore: Even an All Terrain Scout Transport cannot stand on all terrain.

name: Ewok Bow
title: Ewok Bow
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Ewok. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 for each other Ewok present who is armed with an Ewok Bow. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Primitive weapon. Effective in large volleys. Imperial troops are not prepared for such simple tactics.

name: Ewok Catapult
title: Ewok Catapult
text: Deploy on an exterior Endor site. Does not require a power source. Your Ewok present may target a vehicle with armor at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 for each Ewok present. Target crashes if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Crowning achievement of Chirpa's engineers. Heavy stones from these weapons distracted Imperial AT-ST walkers.

name: Ewok Celebration
title: •Ewok Celebration
text: Deploy on table. At Endor sites where you have an Ewok, your characters are forfeit and defense value +1 (+3 if you have two Ewoks at that site.) In battles at Endor sites where all your ability is provided by Ewoks, add one battle destiny. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Na na, beecha na noooooooooooooooowa.'

name: Ewok Glider
title: Ewok Glider
text: May add 1 driver (must be an Ewok). Once per turn, when in battle, may target a character or creature present. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny -1 > defense value.
lore: Primitive flying vehicle used by Ewoks. Used to drop rocks on Imperial troops during the Battle of Endor.

name: Ewok Log Jam
title: •Ewok Log Jam
text: If opponent's transport vehicle or AT-ST just deployed or moved to an Endor site, draw destiny. Add 1 for each of your Ewoks present. Vehicle lost if total destiny -1 > defense value. OR Lose 1 Force to take into hand a card you just drew for battle or weapon destiny.
lore: Any problem can be solved by the proper application of the principles of mass and velocity.

name: Ewok Rescue
title: Ewok Rescue
text: If your Ewok is present with an escorted captive, draw destiny. Add 2 if Ewok is a scout. If total destiny > escort's defense value, captive is released. OR If your Ewok is defending a battle, up to three of your Ewoks at one exterior site may move as a 'react' (for free).
lore: Ewoks used superior knowledge of Endor's forested terrain to free commandos captured by Imperial stormtroopers.

name: Ewok Sentry
title: Ewok Sentry
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each Light side icon at same Endor site. May deploy as a 'react'. May move as a 'react' (for free) to a battle where you have a unique (•) Ewok.
lore: Ewok sentries scout the perimeter of their domain. Their watchful eyes search for both predatory animals and invading stormtroopers.

name: Ewok Spear
title: Ewok Spear
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Ewok (free on Ewok Spearman). Adds 1 to power. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Both players draw destiny. Target's power or ferocity for remainder of turn = 0 if your destiny + Ewok's power > opponent's destiny.
lore: Chosen weapon of most Ewok warriors. Pointed tip made of stone or animal horn.

name: Ewok Spearman
title: Ewok Spearman
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each Light side icon at same Endor site. When on Endor and present with any other Ewok, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Ewok fighters train with primitive weapons. Their bravery and careful aim helped defeat the Imperial troops during the Battle of Endor.

name: Ewok Tribesman
title: Ewok Tribesman
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each [Light Side] icon at same Endor site. When forfeited at same site as your Ewok of ability > 1, may satisfy all remaining attrition against you.
lore: Members of Chief Chirpa's Ewok tribe are courageous in battle. They seek to impress older members of the tribe.

name: Executor
title: •Executor
text: May add unlimited pilots, passengers, vehicles and starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilots aboard provide total ability of 3. Immune to attrition < 12.
lore: Flagship of Death Squadron. Over eight kilometers long. Carries 38,000 troops, Can conquer entire star systems by sheer intimidation and terror. Lord Vader's personal command ship.

name: Executor: Comm Station
title: •Executor: Comm Station
text: Dark: If you occupy with Tarkin, Piett or any admiral, your starships may 'react' to same system. Light: If you control, your starships may 'react' from same system as Executor.

name: Executor: Control Station
title: •Executor: Control Station
text: Dark: If an Imperial leader here, Executor is power +1 for each Executor site on table. Light: If you control, only you may move Executor during opponent's move phase.

name: Executor: Control Station (V)
