title: •Executor: Control Station (V)
text: Dark: While your Imperial here, [Dagobah] Executor is deploy -7 (except to Fondor). Light: Force drain -1 here. If you initiate battle here, add one battle destiny.

name: Executor: Docking Bay
title: •Executor: Docking Bay
text: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here is free. If you occupy, opponent may not move to this site. Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 7 Force. Your transit to here requires +9 Force.

name: Executor: Holotheatre
title: •Executor: Holotheatre
text: Dark: If you have Vader or Emperor on table, your Force generation is +1 here (+2 if both). Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Executor: Main Corridor
title: •Executor: Main Corridor
text: Dark: During your move phase, you may move free between here and Executor or any Executor site. Light: If you control, opponent's Main Corridor game text is canceled.

name: Executor: Meditation Chamber
title: •Executor: Meditation Chamber
text: Dark: If Vader alone here, once per turn, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny at any system. Light: If you occupy, opponent's Meditation Chamber game text is canceled.

name: Exegol: Sith Throne
title: •Exegol: Sith Throne
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy [Episode VII] Emperor here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: No Force drains here. [Light Side] icons are canceled here. Your characters deploy +2 here.

name: Exhaustion
title: •Exhaustion
text: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each of opponent's missing characters on table. OR Select one missing character under 'nighttime conditions' to be lost.
lore: 'Sir, the temperature's dropping too rapidly.' 'That's right, and my friend's out in it.'

name: Expand The Empire
title: •Expand The Empire
text: Deploy on any site. 'Expands' your 'game text' for that site to add to your 'game text' at the adjacent sites.
lore: The Emperor disbanded the Imperial Senate 'for the duration of the emergency,' seizing absolute power. He planned to extend rule by terrorizing planets into submission.

name: Explosive Charge
title: Explosive Charge
text: Deploy on an interior site you occupy. Immune to Overload. Place in Used Pile if opponent controls this site. If you just lost a battle opponent initiated here, may draw destiny. All cards (except Effects) here are lost if destiny > 4 (otherwise, Charge lost).
lore: Standard explosive charge carried by Rebel commandos. When used in multiple, these charges have the explosive capacity to level a heavily armored structure.

name: Exposure
title: Exposure
text: Use X Force during your control phase, where X = the total number of characters present or missing at exterior marker sites under 'nighttime conditions.' Those characters are lost.
lore: 'Artoo says the chances of survival are 125 to 1.'

name: Eyes In The Dark
title: Eyes In The Dark
text: Deploy beside either player's Lost Pile. That pile is turned face down. Cards from that player's Life Force may not be viewed when they are lost.
lore: 'I don't like the look of this.'

name: Eyes In The Dark (V)
title: Eyes In The Dark (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once during your turn, if 4-LOM at a non-battleground, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand. While you occupy two battlegrounds, opponent may not cancel your Force drains at battlegrounds.
lore: 'I don't like the look of this.'

name: Ezra Bridger
title: •Ezra Bridger
text: Power +1 for each Dark Jedi or Jedi on table. At start of opponent's turn, if at opponent's site, opponent chooses: their Force generation is -X this turn, or you may activate up to X Force, where X = number of [Dark Side Force] icons here.
lore: Padawan. Spy.

name: Ezra's Blaster Lightsaber
title: •Ezra's Blaster Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Ezra. Once per turn, may return to hand to cancel and redraw a destiny targeting a Rebel here. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 > defense value, target hit, its forfeit = 0 and, if target's ability > 4, user is power +2 until end of turn.
lore: Blank.

name: Ezra, Hero Of Phoenix Squadron
title: •Ezra, Hero Of Phoenix Squadron
text: Other Phoenix Squadron characters here are forfeit and defense value +2. Once per game, may retrieve a Phoenix Squadron character into hand. [Set 13] Maul may not modify destiny draws. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Commander, leader, and Padawan.

name: F-11D Blaster Rifle
title: F-11D Blaster Rifle
text: Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Blank.

name: Failure At The Cave
title: •Failure At The Cave
text: Deploy on Dagobah: Cave. Target an apprentice on Dagobah. All Jedi Test game text is suspended. If target present during any battle phase, opponent draws destiny. If destiny < 4, you retrieve 2 Force (also, if destiny = 0, target is lost). Otherwise, Utinni Effect canceled.
lore: 'That place is strong with the dark side of the Force. A domain of evil it is. In you must go.'

name: Failure At The Cave (V)
title: •Failure At The Cave (V)
text: Plays on table. Stone Pile is canceled. While a Jedi Test on table, opponent may not reduce your Force drains. Unless opponent has deployed a battleground, Domain Of Evil may not modify destiny draws more than once per battle.
lore: 'That place is strong with the dark side of the Force. A domain of evil it is. In you must go.'

name: Faithful Service
title: •Faithful Service
text: Deploy on an opponent's location. Whenever you lose a droid from hand or Life Force, it satisfies Force loss up to its forfeit value. Once per turn, you may play Scomp Link Access to cancel a Force drain where you have a droid. Effect canceled if opponent controls this location.
lore: Unlike the Empire, the Alliance treats their droids with respect. Many droids volunteered to share the risk of battle and aid the Rebellion's assault on the Death Star.

name: Fall Back!
title: Fall Back!
text: If opponent just initiated a battle at an exterior site with more than double your total power, use 1 Force to target an adjacent site where opponent has no presence. All your characters present in battle move away (for free) to the target site. The battle is canceled.
lore: 'K-one zero...all troops disengage.'

name: Fall Of A Jedi
title: •Fall Of A Jedi
text: If your Jedi was just defeated in lightsaber combat, you may either: Reveal a Dark Jedi's combat cards and place one in opponent's Lost Pile (return others). OR Place Qui-Gon out of play and take [Episode I] Obi-Wan into hand from Lost Pile or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: The blow, when it came, was lightning swift and fatal. But Qui-Gon's death gave new life to his former Padawan.

name: Fall Of The Empire
title: •Fall Of The Empire
text: At the end of a battle that you won at an interior site where you have a character of ability > 3 present, relocate one opponent's character present to an adjacent site. (If on Cloud City, character may be relocated to Weather Vane instead.)
lore: 'Aaaaah!'

name: Fall Of The Legend
title: •Fall Of The Legend
text: If you just lost a character during a battle or duel at a Cloud City site, use 2 Force to relocate that character to Weather Vane instead of your Lost Pile. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take one Weather Vane into hand and reshuffle.
lore: Luke had a falling out with his estranged father.

name: Fall Of The Legend (V)
title: •Fall Of The Legend (V)
text: If opponent just lost a Dark Jedi or leader, take a card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. OR If opponent just retrieved Force, opponent loses 1 Force. OR If lightsaber combat or a duel was just initiated, lose 2 Force (3 if during your move phase) to cancel it.
lore: Luke had a falling out with his estranged father.

name: Falleen's Fist
title: •Falleen's Fist
text: Deploys -3 if your Black Sun agent is at a related site. May add 3 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 4. Immune to attrition < 8.
lore: Blank.

name: Fallen Order
title: •Fallen Order
text: If The Hidden Path on table, deploy on table. When deployed, stack three Jedi survivors from Reserve Deck here. During your deploy phase, Jedi survivors here may deploy as if from hand. The Light Will Fade: While The Hidden Path on table, Jedi survivors are deploy = 3, power = 3, forfeit = 3, deploy only to Safehouse, move using landspeed for free, and their game text is canceled. But It Is Never Forgotten: If your Jedi survivor was just lost, may lose 1 Force to stack it here. (Immune to Cold Feet.)

name: Fallen Portal
title: •Fallen Portal
text: Target one creature or up to two characters present that just initiated an attack or battle against you at Back Door, Rancor Pit, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace or any docking bay. Draw destiny. Target(s) immediately lost if destiny +2 > total defense value.
lore: Jabba ordered the two-meter thick door to keep the rancor in. He never thought it would be the instrument of the rancor's demise.

name: Fambaa
title: •••Fambaa
text: May add 2 'riders' (passengers). Ability = ½. Requires +1 Force to use landspeed. May not be attacked by creatures.
lore: Pack animal domesticated by Gungan warriors. Able to bear heavy loads, even during the heat of combat.

name: Fanfare
title: •Fanfare
text: Deploy on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game you may take any Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Boonta Eve crowds are always looking for new and exciting developments at every Podrace.

name: Fanfare
title: •Fanfare
text: Plays on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game you may take any Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended.
lore: The Boonta Eve crowds are always looking for new and exciting developments at every Podrace.

name: Fanfare (Tatooine) (V)
title: •Fanfare (Tatooine) (V)
text: Plays on table. Ice Storm, Lost In The Wilderness, Order To Engage, Sandwhirl, and Scramble are canceled. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Staging Areas is suspended.
lore: The Boonta Eve crowds are always looking for new and exciting developments at every Podrace.

name: Fanfare (V)
title: •Fanfare (V)
text: Plays on table. Ice Storm, Lost In The Wilderness, Order To Engage, Sandwhirl, and Scramble are canceled. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Staging Areas is suspended.
lore: The Boonta Eve crowds are always looking for new and exciting developments at every Podrace.

name: Far More Frightening Than Death
title: •Far More Frightening Than Death
text: USED: Stack top card of Lost Pile face down (as a 'Hatred' card) on opponent's leader (or character of ability > 3) at a battleground. LOST: If your Inquisitor in battle with a Jedi, Padawan, or 'Hatred' card, add one battle destiny (add two if with all three).
lore: Blank.

name: Farm
title: <>Farm
text: Light: During your deploy phase, Hydroponics Station or Vaporator may deploy here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May not be deployed to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth, Kessel. Dark: May not be deployed to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth, Kessel.

name: Fear
title: •Fear
text: Opponent must choose to lose either 2 Force from hand or 1 Force from top of Reserve Deck.
lore: 'I'm not afraid.' 'Oh. You will be.' One of the lessons Luke learned was that fear of the unknown can be stronger than fear of the known.

name: Fear Is My Ally
title: •Fear Is My Ally
text: Before any starting cards are revealed, deploy on table with up to 10 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Cards under here do not count toward your deck limit. Three times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here, as if from hand.
lore: Maul's arsenal includes much more than simple combat training.

name: Fear Will Keep Them In Line
title: Fear Will Keep Them In Line
text: Deploy on any capital starship. When that starship is at a system or sector you control, your total power is +1 in battles at related sites.
lore: 'The regional governors now have direct control over their territories. Fear will keep the local systems in line. Fear of this battle station.'

name: Feltipern Trevagg
title: •Feltipern Trevagg
text: While no droid present with Trevagg, to initiate battles at same location as Trevagg, player must use X Force, where X = total number of [Dark Side Force] and [Light Side Force] present with him.
lore: Corrupt tax collector. A male Gotal. Bounty hunter. Once sought a bounty on Obi-Wan. Has limited sensing ability to droid emanations. Romanced M'iiyoom Onith.

name: Feltipern Trevagg's Stun Rifle
title: •Feltipern Trevagg's Stun Rifle
text: Deploy on Feltipern Trevagg or use 2 Force to deploy on your other bounty hunter. May target a character using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Add 2 if target is the target of any bounty. Target may be captured if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Assault rifle modified by Feltipern. Used by the Gotal bounty hunter before he became a tax collector. Occasionally brought along to 'ease' Feltipern's collection duties.

name: Fenn Rau
title: •Fenn Rau
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if another Mandalorian here, opponent's total power is -2. Once per game, at the end of a battle here, may return Fenn Rau to hand to activate 2 Force (if Fenn Rau won a battle this turn, may also retrieve 1 Force).
lore: Mandalorian scout.

name: Fennec Shand
title: •Fennec Shand
text: While alone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per game, during your control phase, may fire a weapon. During battle, while Quietly Observing on table, Fennec's weapon destiny draws are +2.
lore: Female assassin, bounty hunter, and mercenary.

name: Field Promotion
title: Field Promotion
text: Deploy on an Imperial of ability < 5 present with Vader, Emperor or one of your admirals, generals, or moffs. Imperial gains {leader} skill, is power +1, and is immune to Demotion, Report to Lord Vader, and What is Thy Bidding, My Master? (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Imperial officers are fiercely competitive, especially on the Executor. Lord Vader's flagship is a place where devious political calculation prospers. The naive are doomed to failure.

name: Fifth Brother
title: •Fifth Brother
text: Power +3 and defense value -2 while with a Jedi, Padawan, or 'Hatred' card. Characters here may not have their forfeit increased.
lore: Inquisitor.

name: Fighter Cover
title: •Fighter Cover
text: Each starfighter that fires a weapon in battle is power +3 for the remainder of battle. Once per turn you may cancel and redraw your starship weapon destiny just drawn. At sites related to systems you occupy, your characters who have immunity to attrition each add 2 to immunity and 1 to each of that character's weapon destiny draws.

name: Fighters Coming In
title: •Fighters Coming In
text: Unique (•) starfighters without permanent pilots are immune to attrition < 4 (or add 2 to immunity if starfighter already has immunity). Starships without pilot characters aboard are power -2. At docking bays related to systems you occupy, your Force drains are +1. Once per turn, your starfighter just lost from a system may be relocated to a related docking bay.

name: Fighters Straight Ahead
title: •Fighters Straight Ahead
text: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at systems you control. Opponent's non-unique starfighters are deploy +1 (or +2 to a system you occupy). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Sometimes a swarm of starfighters can look more imposing than it really is. Mostly though, it's just best to avoid them altogether.

name: Figrin D'an
title: •Figrin D'an
text: Once each turn during your control phase, you may use 1 Force to make a 'wager.' Draw three destiny. Opponent draws two destiny. Player with highest total may randomly select one card to be retrieved from that player's Lost Pile.
lore: A male Bith. Musician who leads the Mos Eisley Cantina band, Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes. Expert gambler and card shark.

name: Figrin D'an & •The Modal Nodes
title: •Figrin D'an & •The Modal Nodes
text: Power +2 at an antechamber, bar, cantina, or night club. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During your control phase, if you have alien characters of five different species on table, may retrieve 1 Force. Once per game, may re-circulate.
lore: Bith musicians. Figrin D'an, Doikk Na'ts, Ickabel G'ont, Nalan Cheel, and Tedn Dahai.

name: Finalizer
title: •Finalizer
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 [First Order] starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys -4 to [Episode VII] systems and adds 1 to your Force drains there. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Finalizer (AI)
title: •Finalizer (AI)
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 [First Order] starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys -4 to [Episode VII] systems and adds 1 to your Force drains there. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Finn
title: •Finn
text: Adds 3 to power of any starship or enclosed vehicle he is aboard as a passenger. May deploy as a 'react' to same location as your pilot (free if Poe or Rey). Once per game, may take Blaster Proficiency into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Gunner. Stormtrooper.

name: Finn (AI)
title: •Finn (AI)
text: Adds 3 to power of any starship or enclosed vehicle he is aboard as a passenger. May deploy as a 'react' to same location as your pilot (free if Poe or Rey). Once per game, may take Blaster Proficiency into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Gunner. Stormtrooper.

name: Finn, Resistance Hero
title: •Finn, Resistance Hero
text: During battle, if Luke or Paige out of play (or Jannah or Rose here), adds one destiny to total power. Once per game, may deploy a non-leader Resistance character of lesser ability here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Finn. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Leader.

name: Fire Extinguisher
title: Fire Extinguisher
text: Deploy on your astromech droid. Cancels an 'exploding' Program Trap here. Any starship it is aboard is immune to Lateral Damage and ion cannons. If deployed on R2-D2, may lose Fire Extinguisher to cancel a battle just initiated where present at a site.
lore: Among the various special devices on droids like R2 units are gas-based fire extinguishers. Effective against electrical fires and can cause confusion during battle.

name: Firefight
title: Firefight
text: During a battle, if you have weapons at at least 2 sites adjacent to that battle, add 3 to your total power and add one battle destiny. OR For remainder of turn, your scout at an exterior site is power +1 and adds 1 to each of that character's weapon destiny draws.
lore: Lieutenant Page effectively deployed his detachment of Rebel commandos during the attack at the control bunker.

name: Firepower
title: •Firepower
text: Deploy on your side of table. Each of your starships with two or more starship weapons aboard is power +2. Once during each of your deploy phases, you may use 2 Force to deploy from Lost Pile one starship weapon, vehicle weapon or artillery weapon (for free).
lore: 'About twenty guns. Some on the surface, some on the towers.'

name: Firin Morett
title: •Firin Morett
text: Subtracts 2 from deploy cost of each of your starfighters to same docking bay. Once during each of your control phases, may take one Advanced Preparation, Rebel Planners or docking bay into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Engineer responsible for preparing Red and Gold Squadron starships for battle. Has final launch authority in the Yavin 4 docking bay.

name: First Aid
title: •First Aid
text: If your character's forfeit was just reduced to 0, restore it to normal. OR Reduce your battle damage by 5 by losing from hand a starship, vehicle or character. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: The Alliance used stolen medical droids to help carry on the battle against the Empire.

name: First Light
title: •First Light
text: May add 3 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each gangster aboard. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Crimson Dawn.

name: First Light: Bar
title: •First Light: Bar
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy Margo, Wuher, or a musician here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Force drain -1 here (if your musician here, Force drain +1 instead).

name: First Light: Dryden's Study
title: •First Light: Dryden's Study
text: Dark: During your move phase, your Crimson Dawn leader may move between here and a site. Light: Add 1 to your blaster weapon destiny draws here. Unless Vos on table, Force drain -1 here.

name: First Light: Reception Area
title: •First Light: Reception Area
text: Dark: While your unique (•) alien here, your Force generation is +1 here (+2 if Margo). Light: Force drain -1 here (if your smuggler here, Force drain +1 instead).

name: First Officer Thaneespi
title: •First Officer Thaneespi
text: Deploys -2 to Home One. Adds 3 to power of any capital starship she pilots. When piloting a Star Cruiser with another Mon Calamari pilot aboard, unless opponent has total ability > 6 piloting here, may reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0.
lore: Mon Calamari deck officer. Brilliant tactical analyst. One of several brave leaders of Mon Calamari refugees from Imperial invasion of her planet.

name: First Order AT-M6
title: First Order AT-M6
text: May add 1 pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once during your deploy phase, may deploy a First Order trooper here from Used Pile; reshuffle.
lore: Enclosed.

name: First Order Special Forces TIE
title: •••First Order Special Forces TIE
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 passenger. Matching starfighter for any First Order pilot of ability < 3. Power +1 at opponent's system. While matching pilot aboard, immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Blank.

name: First Order Stormtrooper
title: First Order Stormtrooper
text: Deploys -1 to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).
lore: Blank.

name: First Strike
title: •First Strike
text: Deploy on your side of table. Whenever a battle is initiated, player initiating battle retrieves 1 Force and defender loses 1 Force. Also, during a battle you initiate, each time opponent plays an interrupt, opponent must first use 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'There'll be no escape for the princess this time.'

name: Flagship
title: •Flagship
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Star Destroyer. Your other starships may move as a 'react' to same system or sector (for free). If starship lost, you lose X Force, where X = starship's armor. (Immune to your Alter.)
lore: After the Battle of Yavin, it was politically necessary to demonstrate the unstoppable might of the Empire. The Executor and Death Squadron ensured this objective.

name: Flagship Executor
title: •Flagship Executor
text: May add unlimited pilots, passengers and starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition if target of Flagship Operations.
lore: Command ship of the Imperial Fleet at the Battle of Endor. Originally constructed at the Fondor shipyards. Admiral Piett stationed aboard.

name: Flagship Operations
title: •Flagship Operations
text: Deploy on any Star Destroyer if at least 5 Executor sites on table. Your TIEs are deploy -1, forfeit +2 and destiny +2. At systems where you have a TIE, your Imperial capital starships are deploy -3 and your battle destiny draws are +1 each. (If on Executor, immune to Alter.)
lore: 'There's too many of them!'

name: Flare-S Racing Swoop
title: Flare-S Racing Swoop
text: May add 1 driver and 1 passenger. Landspeed = driver's ability, and may be used at any time to follow an opponent's vehicle or character that just moved from same site (if within range).
lore: Attain speeds of up to 600 kph. 3 meters long. Extremely difficult to control at high speeds. Dengar rode a similar swoop when injured in a race with Han at Agrilat.

name: Flash Of Insight
title: •Flash Of Insight
text: Deploy on your side of table. At any time, you may use 3 Force to draw the top card of your Reserve Deck into your hand. If that card is a space creature, you may immediately deploy it for free.
lore: Occasionally Han was capable of such feats, even without Threepio there to tell him these things.

name: Flawless Marksmanship
title: •Flawless Marksmanship
text: Add X to one starship weapon or tractor beam destiny (before destiny is drawn) when targeting opponent's starship. USED: X = 2. LOST: X = 4.
lore: Heavy-weapons gunners assigned to Imperial facilities undergo intense training. The Imperial Navy boasts a higher weapons accuracy rate than that of the Imperial Army.

name: Fleet Admiral Gial Ackbar
title: •Fleet Admiral Gial Ackbar
text: Your starships here are power +1. If opponent just initiated battle here with a [First Order] starship, may place Ackbar out of play to cancel that battle. Cancels Lateral Damage (or Overwhelmed) targeting a starship at same system.
lore: Mon Calamari leader.

name: Flight Escort
title: •Flight Escort
text: During your move phase, if you have at least two combat vehicles at same cloud sector, relocate one starfighter present to a related docking bay or system. OR If one of your combat vehicles is defending a battle at a cloud sector, add one battle destiny.
lore: 'Rather touchy, aren't they?'

name: Floating Refinery
title: ••Floating Refinery
text: Deploy on a cloud sector (limit one per sector). Force you activate may be drawn into hand (one per turn for each of your Floating Refineries on table). Each cloud sector or gas miner drawn in this way by this device may be revealed to retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Refines Tibanna gas at mines like those at Cloud City. Also used for moisture collection on dry planets.

name: Florn Lamproid
title: •••Florn Lamproid
text: May deploy as a 'react' to any jungle or forest site. Power and forfeit +2 while Dice Ibegon at Audience Chamber. Poison stinger cumulatively adds 1 to attrition against opponent in battles at same site.
lore: Aggressive, serpent-like colonizers. Found on many jungle and forest planets. Have poison stinger that they use when defending themselves.

name: Fly Casual
title: •Fly Casual
text: USED: Cancel Early Warning Network or It's An Older Code. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one starship (deploy -1) and/or one pilot to a system even without presence or Force icons. LOST: Take one Tydirium or Tantive IV into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: As a smuggler, Han had years of experience at avoiding Imperial detection. He chose the approach to Endor's moon as the time to pass some of that knowledge on to Chewie.

name: FN-2003
title: •FN-2003
text: Once per turn, if with your First Order trooper, may use 1 Force to target opponent's character present (free if Finn) and make FN-2003 'hit;' for remainder of turn, target's game text is canceled and target may not fire weapons.
lore: Stormtrooper.

name: FN-2199 (Nines)
title: •FN-2199 (Nines)
text: During battle with a stormtrooper, may cancel one opponent's just drawn automated or lightsaber weapon destiny. Permanent weapon is Z6 Riot Control Baton (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny > defense value).
lore: Stormtrooper.

name: Focused Attack
title: •Focused Attack
text: If Vader is present during a battle at a site, for remainder of turn, he loses his immunity to attrition, but adds ability to power (he may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny). OR During a duel, add one destiny to your total.
lore: Not since his duel with Obi-Wan had Vader unleashed the raw power of the dark side.

name: Fondor
title: •Fondor
text: Dark: Executor deploys -5 here. If you occupy, all opponent's Corellian corvettes are forfeit -4 and deploy +1. Light: Force drain -1 here. If you control, opponent may not deploy Executor.

name: For Luck
title: •For Luck
text: Deploy on table. If Counter Assault is played, may use 1 Force to add one destiny to your total. If Sense or Alter just played, may use X Force to exclude X Dark Jedi from being the 'highest-ability character.'
lore: Before swinging across the treacherous abyss, Leia gave Luke a kiss for luck. Despite an incessant storm of laserblasts, they made it.

name: For Luck (V)
title: •For Luck (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once during your control phase, if opponent occupies a non-battleground location, may peek at top two cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Before swinging across the treacherous abyss, Leia gave Luke a kiss for luck. Despite an incessant storm of laserblasts, they made it.

name: For The Republic!
title: •For The Republic!
text: USED: Deploy Cloning Cylinders for free from hand (or Reserve Deck; reshuffle). LOST: If a battle was just initiated at a site, each of your clones present is power +1 (+2 and immune to attrition if a Jedi there) for remainder of turn.
lore: Blank.

name: Force Field
title: •Force Field
text: USED: Cancel an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon. LOST: If one of your characters was just targeted by a weapon during a battle, use 3 Force to cancel the targeting.
lore: Han was fast. Vader was faster.

name: Force Field (V)
title: •Force Field (V)
text: USED: Cancel an attempt to use a character weapon to target your character of ability > 4. LOST: Use 2 Force to cancel an attempt to use a [Permanent Weapon] weapon to target your character.
lore: Han was fast. Vader was faster.

name: Force Freeze
title: •Force Freeze
text: USED: Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 5 present with Kylo for remainder of turn. LOST: If a battle was just initiated where there are no smugglers, take the first weapons segment action (or first two if you initiated).
lore: Blank.

name: Force Levitation
title: •Force Levitation
text: Take a device (except Landing Claw) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Target one opponent's droid present with your Jedi in battle. For remainder of turn, target is power -1 and may not fire weapons.
lore: Telekinesis is one of the powers awakened during a Jedi's apprenticeship. Using this ability, a student of the Force can learn to levitate objects.

name: Force Lightning
title: •Force Lightning
text: USED: Target any character (even a captive) present with Emperor. Target is defense value -4 for remainder of turn. LOST: Emperor loses immunity to attrition and is defense value -2 for remainder of turn. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: The Emperor is strong in the dark arts of the Force. He can direct pure energy to shoot forth from his outstretched fingers.

name: Force Pike
title: Force Pike
text: Deploy on your Royal Guard (or use 3 Force to deploy on your other warrior). Adds 1 to defense value. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. If hit by a Royal Guard, target's power = 0.
lore: Uses microscopic vibrations emitted from its tip. Cuts through stone, metal, and bone. Ceremonial weapon for most; deadly implement in the hands of an Emperor's Royal Guard.

name: Force Projection
title: •Force Projection
text: USED: If [Episode VII] Luke at a site, target all your characters at one other site. They are defense value = 5 this turn. LOST: Once per game, if opponent just drew battle destiny and Luke is out of play, draw destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's total battle destiny.
lore: Blank.

name: Force Push
title: •Force Push
text: Target opponent's Jedi with at least one combat card present with your Dark Jedi. Reveal one of target's combat cards (random selection). If revealed card's destiny > 4, place it on top of opponent's Reserve Deck. Otherwise, lose 1 Force. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: A fully-trained Sith warrior has more weapons at his disposal than just a lightsaber.

name: Force Push & •Podracer Collision
title: •Force Push & •Podracer Collision
text: USED: If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, search that Reserve Deck and place one Interrupt (except Houjix) found there out of play. LOST: Once per game, exchange two cards from hand with any one card from Force Pile; reshuffle. Immune to Too Close For Comfort.

name: Force Push (V)
title: •Force Push (V)
text: Once per game, choose: During battle, use 2 Force to target your Dark Jedi present with an opponent's character of equal or lesser ability. Both targets are excluded from battle. OR Exchange two cards from hand with any one card from Force Pile; reshuffle.
lore: A fully-trained Sith warrior has more weapons at his disposal than just a lightsaber.

name: Forced Landing
title: •Forced Landing
text: Deploy on a docking bay. Target an opponent's starfighter at the related system or a related cloud sector. Target may not move away from Utinni Effect. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: 'You will not deviate from your present course. . . Permission granted to land on platform three-two-seven.'

name: Forced Servitude
title: •Forced Servitude
text: Deploy on an opponent's location. Whenever you lose a droid from hand or Life Force, it satisfies Force loss up to its forfeit value. Once per turn, you may play Imperial Code Cylinder to cancel a Force drain where you have a droid. Effect canceled if opponent controls this location.
lore: The Empire often uses droids for nefarious purposes. Imperials compel droids to do jobs that are repugnant to humans. An automaton has no ethical conscience.

name: Forest
title: <>Forest
text: Dark: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Your characters present here are immune to attrition. Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine.

name: Forest
title: <>Forest
text: Light: Your characters present here are immune to attrition. May not be deployed to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Dark: May not be deployed to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine.

name: Found Someone You Have
title: Found Someone You Have
text: If you have a character of ability > 4 on table, use 3 Force to find one of your missing characters (your choice). OR During any control phase, examine the top card of your Lost Pile. If that card is a character of ability < 3, take that character into hand.
lore: 'I'm looking for someone.' 'Looking? Found someone you have I would say.'

name: Found Someone You Have (V)
title: Found Someone You Have (V)
text: Find one of your missing characters. OR Retrieve the topmost character of your Lost Pile into hand.
lore: 'I'm looking for someone.' 'Looking? Found someone you have I would say.'

name: Fozec
title: •Fozec
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a site you control, Imperials are immune to Ke Chu Ke Kukuta? at that site.
lore: Spy for the Empire. Keeping tabs on Jabba's activities for the ISB. Secretly hoping to leave the Empire and pursue lucrative opportunities in the underworld.

name: Free Ride
title: •Free Ride
text: If you control a location where opponent has a speeder bike, AT-ST or skiff, steal that vehicle (any characters aboard are lost). OR Peek at one card randomly selected from opponent's hand. If that card is a speeder bike, AT-ST or skiff, steal it into hand.
lore: To prevent biker scouts from reaching their base, Luke and Leia 'borrowed' some nearby transportation.

name: Free Ride & •Endor Celebration
title: •Free Ride & •Endor Celebration
text: Cancel Tatooine Occupation, Cloud City Occupation, Rebel Base Occupation. (Immune to Sense.) OR Peek at one card randomly selected from opponent's hand. If that card is a speeder bike, AT-ST, or skiff, steal it into hand.

name: Free Ride & •Endor Celebration (V)
title: •Free Ride & •Endor Celebration (V)
text: Cancel Cloud City Occupation, Rebel Base Occupation, or Tatooine Occupation. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Force Lightning (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR Cancel an attempt to deploy or move a combat vehicle as a 'react.' OR During your turn, target opponent's spy (or unpiloted combat vehicle) at a site you control; target is lost. (Immune to Oh, Switch Off.) OR For remainder of turn, suspend the following cards on table (if any): A Million Voices Crying Out and An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops.

name: Freeze!
title: •Freeze!
text: If a Rebel just deployed or moved to a site where you have a trooper present armed with a weapon, use 1 Force. For remainder of turn, that Rebel may not battle or move and battle damage against you is limited to 4 at that location.
lore: Despite Wicket's warnings, an Imperial scout got the drop on Leia.

name: Freon Drevan
title: •Freon Drevan
text: Cancels game text of opponent's accountants and tax collectors at same or adjacent site. While in a battle at a site, your battle destiny draws may not be canceled, and you may not draw more than two battle destiny.
lore: Xexto who had his business license revoked when his partner siphoned away his credits, fled the system, and left him with the tax debt.

name: Friendly Fire
title: Friendly Fire
text: An accident occurs at the beginning of a battle at any site where opponent has at least two characters and one weapon. Draw destiny. If destiny < number of opponent's characters at that site, one is lost. (Opponent's choice.)
lore: Overcrowding in heavy fire zones increases chances of accidentally shooting one's own comrades. Stormtroopers never let accuracy get in the way of victory.

name: Frostbite
title: •Frostbite
text: Deploy on Hoth system. At the end of each player's turn, for every character that player has present at a marker site under 'nighttime conditions,' that player must lose 1 Force (2 if character is missing).
lore: 'Luke! Luke! Don't do this. C'mon, gimme a sign here.'

name: Frostbite
title: •Frostbite
text: Deploy on Hoth system. At the end of each player's turn, for every character that player has present at a marker site under 'nighttime conditions,' that player must lose 1 Force (2 if character is missing).
lore: 'Then I'll see you in hell!'

name: Frozen Assets
title: •Frozen Assets
text: Deploy on your side of table. At every site where there is a 'frozen' captive, your Rebels deploy -2 and are power +2 in battle. OR Deploy on top of opponent's Force Pile. Force below this card may not be drawn or used. Effect lost at end of opponent's next turn.
lore: Molten carbonite is released into the chamber and then flash frozen, releasing a blast of air. The subject is instantly covered in the newly solidified material.

name: Frozen Dinner
title: Frozen Dinner
text: Deploy on opponent's character alone at Wampa Cave. Character is power = 0 and may not move. May be canceled if opponent has a lightsaber or total ability > 4 present. If character eaten by a creature, cumulatively adds 2 to ferocity.
lore: Freeze dried and ready to serve, a tasty, wholesome Rebel makes a nutritious meal for the whole wampa clan. They're Gr-r-reat!

name: Frustration
title: •Frustration
text: During your control phase, peek at opponent's hand and target one non-Interrupt card you find there that has a deploy cost < total number of [Light Side] icons on table. Opponent must deploy a card of that title by the end of your next turn, or lose a card of that title from hand (if possible).
lore: 'Rrraaaarrr!'

name: Full Scale Alert
title: Full Scale Alert
text: Use 2 Force. Draw Destiny. If destiny < number of Stormtroopers on the table, all opponent's movement is blocked for the remainder of this turn (except for smugglers and the starships they are aboard).
lore: Imperial stormtroopers adopt strict security measures. Excellent communications and sheer numbers can hinder Rebel movement across entire territories.

name: Full Throttle
title: •Full Throttle
text: If your pilot (or permanent pilot) is defending a battle alone at a system or sector, add one battle destiny. OR If Luke is defending a battle alone at a system or sector, add 1 to power and add one battle destiny.
lore: Rebel pilots use visual scanning to supplement sensors for an edge against Imperial fighter pilots. Natural instincts allow lone Rebels to overcome superior numbers.

name: Fulminatrix
title: •Fulminatrix
text: May add 5 pilots, 4 passengers, 3 [First Order] TIEs, and 2 vehicles. If opponent about to move a starship from here, opponent loses 1 Force. Deploys -2 if Tracked Fleet on table. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
lore: Blank

name: Furry Fury
title: Furry Fury
text: USED: Cancel Wookiee Roar or Han's Back or Life Debt. LOST: If Han and Chewie are in a battle together, draw two destiny. Subtract total from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero).
lore: 'All right, don't lose your temper.' Hoth hath no fury like a Wookiee scorned.

name: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
text: Deploy on your starship at a system or sector where a related docking bay is on table. Adds 1 to hyperspeed, power and maneuver.
lore: Installed at many facilities throughout the Empire to provide power to the Imperial spacefleet. Supplies starships with energy necessary for sub-light and hyperspace travel.

name: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
text: Deploy on your starship at a system or sector where a related docking bay is on table. Adds 1 to hyperspeed, power and maneuver.
lore: Uses standard fusion technology. Provides starships with energy for hyperspace travel. Installed at docking bays and throughout the Outer Rim Territories.

name: FX-10 (Effex-ten)
title: FX-10 (Effex-ten)
text: Once per turn, one of your 'hit' non-droid characters at same or adjacent site may be placed in your Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when forfeited.
lore: Standard medical droid used by Imperial field units. Enhanced programming allows FX-10 to treat a wide variety of battle wounds.

name: FX-7 (Effex-Seven)
title: FX-7 (Effex-Seven)
text: Once per turn, one of your 'hit' non-droid characters at same or adjacent site may be placed in your Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when forfeited. Cumulatively subtracts 2 from X on your Bacta Tank.
lore: Model nicknamed 'Fixit' by Rebels at Echo Base. Though obsolete in advanced hospitals, FX-7 droids still operate at many Rebel outposts as assistant surgeons.

name: Gaderffii Stick
title: Gaderffii Stick
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on any Tusken Raider. If a battle has just been initiated where present, target a character for free; draw two destiny. If total destiny > 5, target's weapons are 'knocked away' (may not be used this battle).
lore: Notorious 'gaffi' weapon favored by Tusken Raiders. Built from scavenged metal. Intimidates and evokes fear.

name: Gailid
title: •Gailid
text: Deploys free to same site as Mosep. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at Audience Chamber, adds 1 to your Force drains at Jabba's Palace sites.
lore: Mosep's assistant. Accountant. Tax collector. Enjoys tending to Jabba's skiffs with Barada.

name: Galactic Republic Navy
title: •Galactic Republic Navy
text: Deploy on table. Unique (•) [Clone Army] capital starships are deploy -1 and immunity to attrition +1. Once per turn, may reveal a [Clone Army] starship from hand to take an [Episode I] pilot character from Reserve Deck (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Blank.

name: Galen Erso
title: •Galen Erso
text: Once per game, may place a non-[Immune to Alter] Effect in owner's Used Pile. If both players just drew one battle destiny here, may use 2 Force (free if with an Imperial) to switch numbers. Opponent must first lose 2 Force to fire a superlaser.
lore: Information broker, leader, and spy.

name: Galen Erso (ALT)
title: •Galen Erso (ALT)
text: Once per game, may place a non-[Immune to Alter] Effect in owner's Used Pile. If both players just drew one battle destiny here, may use 2 Force (free if with an Imperial) to switch numbers. Opponent must first lose 2 Force to fire a superlaser.
lore: Information broker, leader, and spy.

name: Gall
title: •Gall
text: Dark: While you occupy, once per battle you may choose a target just 'hit' by a blaster or rifle (except Permanent weapons) to be lost. Light: Immune to Revolution.

name: Gamall Wironicc
title: •Gamall Wironicc
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While Gamall is in battle, your other characters present with him may not be targeted by opponent's weapons. Place Gamall in Used Pile if he was just 'hit.' Power -2 while on Tatooine.
lore: Strange wanderer. Rumored to have sacrificed himself in battle so that his comrades could live on. Survived and now stranded on Tatooine. He misses everything he'll never be.

name: Gambler's Luck
title: •Gambler's Luck
text: If any gambler is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny (draw two destiny, and choose one). OR if your Lando is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny (draw three and choose two).
lore: Works every time.

name: Gamorrean Ax
title: Gamorrean Ax
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Gamorrean. Adds 1 to power. When present at a site, Gamorrean draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny > defense value.
lore: Built by Snogrutt, a Gamorrean engineer. Ax head contains an ultrasonic generator. Jabba's Gamorrean guards sometimes switch the power off to prove their might.

name: Gamorrean Guard
title: Gamorrean Guard
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Power -1 when not at a Tatooine site. May be sacrificed (lost) to cancel an attack just initiated by a creature present.
lore: Big. Strong. Dumb.

name: Gar Saxon
title: •Gar Saxon
text: If deployed to a site where opponent has more than four characters, opponent loses 2 Force. Jedi here are defense value -1 for each of your Mandalorians here. While armed (or with a Mandalorian), opponent may not move away from (or cancel) battles here.
lore: Mandalorian leader. Death Watch assassin.

name: Gardulla The Hutt
title: •Gardulla The Hutt
text: When you retrieve Force from Boonta Eve Podrace, any or all of your retrieved Force may be taken into hand. Once during your control phase, may use 1 Force; opponent draws one destiny. If destiny > 2, you retrieve 1 Force. Otherwise, lose 1 Force.
lore: Well-known as a gambler and a gangster. Gardulla was a former owner of Shmi and Anakin Skywalker, before losing them in a bet to the Toydarian junk dealer, Watto.

name: Garindan
title: •Garindan
text: When at same location as a Rebel of ability > 2, deploy -1 there for any Imperials, and during your move phase, Imperials at an adjacent site may move there for free.
lore: Long-nosed, male Kubaz from Kubindi. Spy. Squealed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or the highest bidder. Not particularly brave.

name: Garindan, Imperial Spy
title: •Garindan, Imperial Spy
text: Imperials move to here using landspeed for free. If present at a site and not 'hit,' may place Garindan in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting your other character here (or to make an Undercover spy here lost).
lore: Long-nosed, male Kubaz from Kubindi. Spy. Squealed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or the highest bidder. Not particularly brave.

name: Garon Nas Tal
title: •Garon Nas Tal
text: While at Audience Chamber, all your other Saurins are forfeit +2 and all your characters trained by Sai'torr Kal Fas are power and forfeit +1.
lore: Saurin combat expert. Hired by Jabba to train his Gamorrean guards. Regrets taking the job. Dislikes Jabba and his henchbeings. Plotting to kill Jabba.

name: Garouf Lafoe
title: •Garouf Lafoe
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 1 to forfeit of each of your characters at same Tatooine site. Subtracts 1 from forfeit of each of opponent's characters at same Hoth site. Game text suspended if at same site as a tax collector.
lore: Free-trader who imports ice chunks from rings of Ohann and Adriana, outer planets in Tatoo system. Sales remain cold...due to steep Imperial taxes and bribes.

name: Geezum
title: •Geezum
text: During your control phase, if at an exterior planet site, may use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take a related site into hand and reshuffle. While at Audience Chamber, all your other Snivvians are forfeit +2.
lore: Snivvian scout. Enjoys exploring new planets and charting difficult terrain. Paid very well by Jabba to do so. Unsure of his employer's motivations.

name: Gela Yeens
title: •Gela Yeens
text: May deploy for free to your [Independent Starship] starship. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +2 when present with and opponent's smuggler. When targeted by a weapon, subtract one from each weapon destiny.
lore: Bad-tempered smuggler. Makes a few credits more helping Jabba collect debts. Highly regarded for his uncanny anticipation in battle. Searching for Debnoli.

name: General Airen Cracken
title: •General Airen Cracken
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Opponent may not add destiny draws to power or attrition here. While all your ability here is provided by scouts and/or spies, adds one battle destiny and once during your turn may peek at top card of opponent's Force Pile.
lore: Leader, scout, and information broker.

name: General Calrissian
title: •General Calrissian
text: Deploy -2 aboard Falcon. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a freighter, adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. When he attempts to 'blow away' Death Star II, adds 2 to total.
lore: Leader. Gambler. Fair pilot. Lando was given the rank of General for 'a little maneuver' at the Battle of Taanab. Willing to lead Rebel starfighters in a crazy attack.

name: General Carlist Rieekan
title: •General Carlist Rieekan
text: Each Rebel present with him at a Hoth site is power +1. May use 1 Force to cancel Death Squadron. While at an Echo site, opponent must occupy an additional Hoth site to cancel Echo Base Operations.
lore: One of the original founders of the Rebel Alliance. Former civilian strategist with the House of Organa. Somber leader of Echo Base.

name: General Carlist Rieekan (V)
title: •General Carlist Rieekan (V)
text: Deploys -1 to a war room. While at a war room, your capital starships at Rebel Base systems may not be targeted by weapons and your Rebels and T-47s at same and related Rebel Base locations move for free to same or related locations.
lore: One of the original founders of the Rebel Alliance. Former civilian strategist with the House of Organa. Somber leader of Echo Base.

name: General Crix Madine
title: •General Crix Madine
text: Once during each of your deploy phases, may take one scout of ability < 3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at your war room or aboard your capital starship, adds 1 to immunity to attrition of all your scouts who have immunity.
lore: Military advisor to Mon Mothma. Leader of commando project. Corellian native. Defected to the Alliance shortly after the Battle of Yavin. Rescued by Rogue Squadron.

name: General Crix Madine (V)
title: •General Crix Madine (V)
text: Scout. Once during your deploy phase, if present at a battleground, may take a scout of ability < 3 (or any [Endor] scout) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle here or at same system as Ackbar, if you just played Critical Error Revealed, may retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Military advisor to Mon Mothma. Leader of commando project. Corellian native. Defected to the Alliance shortly after the Battle of Yavin. Rescued by Rogue Squadron.

name: General Dodonna
title: •General Dodonna
text: Increases Rebel Planners by 1, doubles if at same site. May use 1 Force to cancel Wrong Turn. Each Rebel present with him at a Yavin 4 site is power +1.
lore: Skilled tactician and natural leader. Planned attack on Death Star after analyzing technical readouts provided by Princess Leia. Star Destroyer captain during Old Republic.

name: General Dodonna (V)
title: •General Dodonna (V)
text: Once per game, if at a war room, may take a related battleground (or a Y-wing) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While present at a war room, opponent's spies may not deploy here and your Epic Event destiny draws are +1.
lore: Skilled tactician and natural leader. Planned attack on Death Star after analyzing technical readouts provided by Princess Leia. Star Destroyer captain during Old Republic.

name: General Grievous
title: •General Grievous
text: Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Trade Federation.

name: General Grievous (AI)
title: •General Grievous (AI)
text: Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Trade Federation.

name: General Grievous (Holo AI)
title: •General Grievous (Holo AI)
text: Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Trade Federation.

name: General Hux
title: •General Hux
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 aboard Finalizer. Your First Order characters and [First Order] starships are destiny +1. Once per game, may take a First Order stormtrooper into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Leader.

name: General Hux (AI)
title: •General Hux (AI)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 aboard Finalizer. Your First Order characters and [First Order] starships are destiny +1. Once per game, may take a First Order stormtrooper into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Leader.

name: General Jar Jar
title: •General Jar Jar
text: Once per game may take Brisky Morning Munchen into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle, may use 1 Force to target an opponent's droid present. Both players draw destiny. If your destiny + 1 > opponent's destiny, target lost.
lore: After uniting the Gungans and the Naboo, Boss Nass promoted Jar Jar Binks to General. He's still a bit clumsy.

name: General Jar Jar (AI)
title: •General Jar Jar (AI)
text: Once per game may take Brisky Morning Munchen into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle, may use 1 Force to target an opponent's droid present. Both players draw destiny. If your destiny + 1 > opponent's destiny, target lost.
lore: After uniting the Gungans and the Naboo, Boss Nass promoted Jar Jar Binks to General. He's still a bit clumsy.

name: General Kenobi
title: •General Kenobi
text: During battle, if alone or with a clone, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn destiny. Once per game, may take a clone or [Reflections 3] lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Jedi Council member. Leader.

name: General Kenobi (AI)
title: •General Kenobi (AI)
text: During battle, if alone or with a clone, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn destiny. Once per game, may take a clone or [Reflections 3] lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Jedi Council member. Leader.

name: General Leia Organa
title: •General Leia Organa
text: While at a war room or battleground, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and whenever you initiate a battle with a Resistance character, retrieve 1 Force (2 if initiating against a First Order character). Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Female leader.

name: General Leia Organa (AI)
title: •General Leia Organa (AI)
text: While at a war room or battleground, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and whenever you initiate a battle with a Resistance character, retrieve 1 Force (2 if initiating against a First Order character). Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Female leader.

name: General McQuarrie
title: •General McQuarrie
text: While McQuarrie is on Hoth, your Hoth Sentry is not unique (•), is doubled, deploys free, applies all of its modifiers and is immune to Alter. Power -1 when not on Hoth.
lore: Commander from Ralltiir. Fled from his homeworld after its occupation by the Empire. Was instrumental in the establishment of the new Rebel base on Hoth.

name: General Nevar
title: •General Nevar
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots (3 if Blizzard 2). Deploys -1 to Hoth. When deployed, may peek at top card of any Reserve Deck. When a spy here is targeted by Trample, adds 1 to your destiny draw.
lore: ISB leader.

name: General Poe Dameron
title: •General Poe Dameron
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle, if opponent has a greater total number of characters and piloted starships here than you, may add one destiny to attrition. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Blank.

name: General Solo
title: •General Solo
text: Deploys -2 on Falcon, Tydirium or Endor. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When in battle with Chewie (or another of your scouts at an exterior site), may use 2 Force to cancel one opponent's battle destiny just drawn. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Scout. Leader of the Rebel strike team on Endor. Needed the cleverness of a Corellian to destroy the Endor control bunker. Discovered the truth about Luke and Leia.

name: General Solo (V)
title: •General Solo (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, may use 1 Force to take an Interrupt into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle), play it, then place that card out of play. Once per turn, may take a non-Interrupt card with 'door' in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Scout. Leader of the Rebel strike team on Endor. Needed the cleverness of a Corellian to destroy the Endor control bunker. Discovered the truth about Luke and Leia.

name: General Tagge
title: •General Tagge
text: Tagge's forfeit +1 for each Imperial trooper, of any kind, present with him at a site.
lore: Oversees defense operations of Death Star. Outstanding tactician. No-nonsense leader. Member of House of Tagge, a powerful noble family and corporate conglomerate.

name: General Tagge (V)
title: •General Tagge (V)
text: Your non-[Maintenance] troopers have armor = 4. At same and adjacent sites where you have a non-pilot trooper, your total power is +3. Once per game, if with two troopers, may re-circulate.
lore: Oversees defense operations of Death Star. Outstanding tactician. No-nonsense leader. Member of House of Tagge, a powerful noble family and corporate conglomerate.

name: General Veers
title: •General Veers
text: Power +1 when at same site as Admiral Ozzel. Adds 1 to power of each Imperial at same Hoth site. Adds 3 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. On Blizzard 1, also adds 1 to armor and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: General Maximillian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. Cunning, loyal and a ruthlessly efficient leader. In charge of the ground assault troops in Vader's forces.

name: General Veers (V)
title: •General Veers (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting an AT-AT, draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While piloting a combat vehicle at a site where you have no other characters, its immunity to attrition is +2.
lore: General Maximillian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. Cunning, loyal and a ruthlessly efficient leader. In charge of the ground assault troops in Vader's forces.

name: General Walex Blissex
title: •General Walex Blissex
text: Deploys -2 aboard your Star Cruiser or to same location as your Admiral. Adds 1 to the power of anything he pilots. Adds 1 to the power and forfeit of each of your A-wings at same and related locations.
lore: Engineer who worked with Jan Dodonna to design the A-wing starfighter. Given honorary rank due to his service to the Rebellion.

name: General Walex Blissex (V)
title: •General Walex Blissex (V)
text: While at a war room, at systems where you have two piloted snub fighters, opponent may draw no more than one battle destiny (you may not cancel those destiny draws) and opponent must use +1 Force to move an Imperial starship away.
lore: Engineer who worked with Jan Dodonna to design the A-wing starfighter. Given honorary rank due to his service to the Rebellion.

name: Generation One Armor Always Holds Up
title: Generation One Armor Always Holds Up
text: For remainder of turn, your clones are armor +2. OR Cancel You Are Beaten. OR If your clone in battle, cancel an attempt by opponent to target your character to be lost. [Immune to Sense.] OR If you just drew a clone for destiny, add 1 to that destiny.
lore: Blank.

name: Geonosis
title: •Geonosis
text: Light: Your [Clone Army] starships are power +1 here. Your starships at the nearest related asteroid sector may move here as a `react.' Dark: Unless your Fett (or [Separatist] starship) here or at a related asteroid sector, Force drain -1 here.

name: Geonosis: Badlands Of N'g'zi
title: •Geonosis: Badlands Of N'g'zi
text: Light: Your [Clone Army] characters and [Clone Army] vehicles are power +1 here. Dark: Your [Separatist] characters and [Separatist] vehicles are power +1 here.

name: Get Alongside That One
title: •Get Alongside That One
text: Target two non-creature vehicles with maneuver (one yours, one opponent's) present at same site. Both players draw destiny; add your vehicle's maneuver to your total. Lowest total loses vehicle. OR Your speeder bike piloted by Luke or a scout adds one battle destiny.
lore: Versatility is key to the Rebellion. The Rebels' ability to adapt to any situation is well-known.

name: Get To Your Ships!
title: •Get To Your Ships!
text: Deploy on table. Once during your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted starfighter from hand to take its matching pilot character from Reserve Deck (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Queen's plan called for the remnants of Bravo Flight to eliminate the Droid Control Ship. Not an easy task.

name: Ghana Gleemort
title: •Ghana Gleemort
text: Your Force generation at same site is +X, where X equals the number of opponent's aliens at same and adjacent sites. May lose 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at an adjacent site.
lore: Part of Jabba's Gamorrean security force. Negotiating with the B'omarr monks regarding his possible defection.

name: Ghhhk
title: Ghhhk
text: During the damage segment of a battle you lost, if you have no cards left that can be forfeited, cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel Nightfall.
lore: Dejarik of creature from Clak'dor VII. Ghhhk rise with the dawn, screeching their mating calls across the jungle. Locals use their skin oils as a healing salve.

name: Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
title: Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
text: USED: Cancel Nabrun Leids. LOST: If you just forfeited all your cards that participated in a battle you lost, cancel all remaining battle damage (Immune to Sense). OR Cancel Hyper Escape, Closer!?, or one 'react.' OR During your move phase, cancel Landing Claw.

name: Ghoel
title: •Ghoel
text: Deploys only at interior sites. Cannot move. During a battle at same site, may target one character present. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 > ability, target may not use ability toward drawing battle destiny this turn.
lore: Wol Cabbasshite. Immobile. Species evolved from parasites. Mistakenly left in Jabba's palace. No one suspects its intelligence. Often tries to lick passersby.

name: Ghost
title: •Ghost
text: Deploys -2 to Lothal. May add 2 pilots, 3 passengers, and Phantom. Has ship-docking capability. May deploy Phantom here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Hera piloting, immune to attrition < 5 (may not be canceled).
lore: Phoenix Squadron

name: Gian Speeder
title: Gian Speeder
text: May add 1 driver and 3 passengers. May move as a 'react' to Naboo sites. Your battle destiny draws are +1 for each of your Royal Naboo Security present. (Limit +3.)
lore: Military repulsorlift armed with three light repeating blasters. With a top speed of 160 kilometers per hour, they have the ability to out-flank an opponent in battle.

name: Gift Of The Mentor
title: •Gift Of The Mentor
text: If Luke and Obi-Wan or Yoda are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR Use 1 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take any one lightsaber into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.
lore: Luke relied on Obi-Wan's knowledge and advice to learn the ways of the Force. Obi-Wan continued to counsel Luke long after the old Jedi's apparent 'death.'

name: Gimme A Lift!
title: •Gimme A Lift!
text: Relocate Jar Jar to a battle just initiated at an adjacent site. OR Increase Jar Jar's landspeed by 1 for remainder of turn. OR If Jar Jar on Brisky Morning Munchen, take him into hand.
lore: Jar Jar Binks's courage on the battlefield put quite a thorn in the Trade Federation's side. Many believed it wasn't actually courage.

name: Giran
title: •Giran
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Power +3 when defending a battle at a Jabba's Palace site. May forfeit in place of one of your alien leaders present who was 'hit' by a weapon, restoring that leader to normal.
lore: Kajain'sa'Nikto. Loyal to Jabba. Helps tend the rancor with Malakili. Hopes to snare a krayt dragon someday and pit it against the rancor.

name: Glancing Blow
title: •Glancing Blow
text: If you have a character with a lightsaber present in a battle with Vader, lose 1 Force to reduce Vader's power to zero. OR If you have a character with a lightsaber in a duel, cancel one opponent's destiny draw immediately after it is revealed.
lore: It had been decades since Vader had felt the sting of an enemy's blade.

name: Go For Help!
title: •Go For Help!
text: If opponent just initiated a battle at an exterior site with double your total power, reveal top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck. If any of those cards are scouts or speeder bikes, deploy them for free to that battle (replace others on top of Reserve Deck in same order).
lore: When confronted with enemy troops, biker scouts are instructed to immediately call for reinforcements.

name: Golan Laser Battery
title: Golan Laser Battery
text: Deploy on any exterior planet site. Your warrior present may target a creature, character or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Add 2 if targeting a creature or character. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Modified Golan Arms DForfeit: 9 anti-infantry battery. Proton-shielded control cylinder capped by one or more rotating turret-mounted laser cannons.

name: Gold 1
title: •Gold 1
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers.
lore: Lead fighter of Gold Squadron at Battle of Yavin. Flown by Jon 'Dutch' Vander. Designated Specter 1 at Renforra Base.

name: Gold 2
title: •Gold 2
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. May forfeit in place of your other starfighter hit in Death Star: Trench, restoring that starfighter to normal.
lore: Tiree's Y-wing during the Battle of Yavin. Custom high-power lateral thrusters provide enhanced maneuverability, allowing Gold 2 to better draw and evade enemy fire.

name: Gold 3
title: •Gold 3
text: If deployed to Dantooine, may retrieve 1 Force. May add 2 pilots or passengers. Proton Torpedoes deploy and fire free aboard. Immune to attrition < 4 when matching pilot aboard.
lore: Part of Pops' Y-wing squadron at the Rebel base on Dantooine. Led evacuation efforts from the base. Piloted by Ryle Torsyn.

name: Gold 4
title: •Gold 4
text: If deployed to Anoat, may retrieve 1 Force. May add 2 pilots or passengers. SW-4 Ion Cannon deploys and fires free aboard. Immune to attrition < 4 when matching pilot aboard.
lore: Point starfighter for Gold Squadron during the approach to the Death Star. Impact scars on its hull caused by small asteroids.

name: Gold 5
title: •Gold 5
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers, and 1 astromech.
lore: Flown by the veteran Rebel fighter pilot Pops during the Battle of Yavin. He personally supervised all repairs and maintenance.

name: Gold 6
title: •Gold 6
text: If deployed to Kashyyyk, may retrieve 1 Force. May add 2 pilots or passengers. SW-4 Ion Cannon deploys and fires free aboard. Immune to attrition < 4 when matching pilot aboard.
lore: Led an attack on an Imperial outpost at Kashyyyk. Disabled the outpost's shields with ion cannons. Flown by Hol Okand during the Battle of Yavin.

name: Gold Leader In Gold 1
title: •Gold Leader In Gold 1
text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard is •Dutch, who provides ability of 2, adds 2 to power and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: At the Battle of Yavin, Dutch led his squadron of outdated but reliable Y-wings in the first wave of the assault against the Death Star.

name: Gold Leader In Gold 1 (V)
title: •Gold Leader In Gold 1 (V)
text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot is •Dutch, who provides ability of 2. Opponent may not 'react' to here and must first use 1 Force to draw a card for battle destiny here.
lore: At the Battle of Yavin, Dutch led his squadron of outdated but reliable Y-wings in the first wave of the assault against the Death Star.

name: Gold Squadron 1
title: •Gold Squadron 1
text: Deploy -2 to Endor. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to Tallon Roll. Immune to attrition < 4 when Lando or Nien Nunb piloting (< 6 when both).
lore: The Millennium Falcon relies on heavily upgraded speed and maneuverability to survive in combat. General Calrissian's starship at Battle of Endor.

name: Gold Squadron Y-wing
title: •••Gold Squadron Y-wing
text: Deploy -2 at Yavin 4 or to same location as Dutch. May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Adds 1 to its ion cannon weapon destiny draws.
lore: Gold Squadron had the best Y-wing pilots in the Alliance. Lead by Jon 'Dutch' Vander. First wave of starfighters to assault the Death Star. Many were lost in the Battle of Yavin.

name: Goo Nee Tay
title: •Goo Nee Tay
text: Deploy on opponent's side of table. All opponent's characters of ability > 2 deploy +2. Also, opponent may not play Surprise and may not use M'iiyoom Onith's game text.
lore: 'Nah nah nah. Ohhhh! Louwa! GOO NEE TAY!'

name: Gor Koresh
title: •Gor Koresh
text: Your mercenaries are power +1 here. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have a gangster or non-[Maintenance] bounty hunter. When deployed, may deploy a mercenary here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Abyssin gambler and information broker.

name: Governor Pryce
title: •Governor Pryce
text: If an artwork card was just stacked (or a Rebel was just captured here), may take a card without ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While in a battle you lost, unless 'hit' (or no other Imperials present), Pryce may not be forfeited. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Female leader and miner.

name: Graak
title: •Graak
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each Light side icon at same Endor site. When opponent is losing Force from Force drains at same or adjacent Endor site, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck if possible.
lore: Cunning Ewok. Led successful attacks, encircling enemies and cutting off their retreats.

name: Gragra
title: •Gragra
text: Once per turn, may use 1 Force to target opponent's card with ability just deployed to same site. Opponent must use 2 Force or return target to hand. Power +2 at Mos Espa.
lore: Female Swokes Swokes. Lives in the city of Mos Espa and runs a street-corner market there. Seller of chuba.

name: Grakchawwaa
title: •Grakchawwaa
text: Once per turn, may deploy a bowcaster on your Wookiee at same or adjacent site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your control phase, if present at a Kashyyyk battleground site and armed with a bowcaster, opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Wookiee leader.

name: Gran
title: •••Gran
text: May retrieve 1 Force whenever opponent initiates battle at same or adjacent site (if at same site, retrieved Force may be taken into hand).
lore: From an ancient civilization. Pacifists. Those who commit acts of violence are banished from their home planet, Kinyen. Organizes peaceful protests against the Empire.

name: Grand Admiral Thrawn
title: •Grand Admiral Thrawn
text: Adds 3 to power of any starship he pilots. When piloting a star destroyer in battle, adds one battle destiny. While no other admiral and no star cruiser on table, your Admiral's Order just placed in Used Pile from table, may be taken into hand instead.
lore: The last remaining Grand Admiral. Found legendary Katana fleet of missing dreadnaughts. Military genius. Master of unorthodox tactics. Passionate collector of art. Leader.

name: Grand Admiral Thrawn (V)
title: •Grand Admiral Thrawn (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. if a Rebel just moved from here, your Imperials present may follow that character (using landspeed). While at a battleground site, functions as a general and game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled.
lore: The last remaining Grand Admiral. Found legendary Katana fleet of missing dreadnaughts. Military genius. Master of unorthodox tactics. Passionate collector of art. Leader.

name: Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (AI)
title: •Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (AI)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. if a Rebel just moved from here, your Imperials present may follow that character (using landspeed). While at a battleground site, functions as a general and game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled.
lore: The last remaining Grand Admiral. Found legendary Katana fleet of missing dreadnaughts. Military genius. Master of unorthodox tactics. Passionate collector of art. Leader.

name: Grand Moff Tarkin
title: •Grand Moff Tarkin
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When with Vader in a battle, once per battle may cancel one opponent's destiny just drawn.
lore: Leader. Governor of Outer Rim Territories. Commanded Death Star. Helped disband Imperial Senate. Defined doctrine of rule by fear. Plotted to use Death Star against Emperor.

name: Grand Moff Tarkin (V)
title: •Grand Moff Tarkin (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (if with Vader or an Imperial leader, may add one instead). During battle, if you just drew a destiny < number of Imperials here, may cancel and redraw that destiny.
lore: Leader. Governor of Outer Rim Territories. Commanded Death Star. Helped disband Imperial Senate. Defined doctrine of rule by fear. Plotted to use Death Star against Emperor.

name: Grappling Hook
title: Grappling Hook
text: If opponent just played an Interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table and stack that Interrupt here. All Interrupts of that title are unique (•). (Immune to Control.)
lore: Stormtrooper utility belts contain basic tools such as a grappling hook to grab onto protrusions. The hook can also be used to ensnare escaping targets.

name: Grappling Hook (V)
title: Grappling Hook (V)
text: Deploy on table. Imperial Barrier is a Lost Interrupt. If no card stacked here, may stack one Interrupt just played here. To play any new Interrupt of the same name, player must first stack it here. Once per game, may shuffle any deck or pile. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Stormtrooper utility belts contain basic tools such as a grappling hook to grab onto protrusions. The hook can also be used to ensnare escaping targets.

name: Gravel Storm
title: Gravel Storm
text: Strikes at Dune Sea, Jundland Wastes, Beggar's Canyon, Lars' Moisture Farm, Jawa Camp, or Mos Eisley. Target opponent's character present at that site. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > ability.
lore: Tatooine's twin suns cause turbulent storms that strike with little or no warning. Strong winds whip rocks through the air with enormous force.

name: Graveyard Of Giants
title: •Graveyard Of Giants
text: Deploy on table. Starships and vehicles just lost from Jakku locations are stacked here face down. Unless no cards here, if a player just Force drained on Jakku: that player may retrieve 1 Force (if they Force drained with a scavenger, may randomly retrieve instead), peek at cards stacked here, and then place one in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: High-speed collisions are a constant danger during chaotic starfighter dogfights. Scanners can be jammed. Pilots rely on vision, increasing the chances of such accidents.

name: Gravity Shadow
title: •Gravity Shadow
text: If opponent's starship is about to move through hyperspace, target that starship and its highest-ability pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny > pilot's ability, starship may not move this turn. If destiny = pilot's ability, starship is lost.
lore: 'Traveling through hyperspace ain't like dustin' crops, boy!' Gravitational phenomena cast shadows in hyperspace, posing a serious threat to lightspeed navigation.

name: Graxol Kelvyyn
title: •Graxol Kelvyyn
text: While at Podrace Arena, at end of opponent's turn: you retrieve 1 Force if Anakin's Podracer is leading the Podrace, or you lose 1 Force if Anakin's Podracer is losing the Podrace.
lore: Gentle male Anx who enjoys the risk and reward of the Podraces. Has a bet against Watto that Skywalker will win the Boonta Eve event.

name: Gray Squadron 1
title: •Gray Squadron 1
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. Ion cannons may fire free aboard. Each of its ion cannon destiny draws is +2. Immune to attrition < 4 when Salm or Kian piloting.
lore: Y-wing flown by Colonel Salm at the battle of Endor. Ordered to disable capital starships between the Death star and General Calrissian.

name: Gray Squadron 2
title: •Gray Squadron 2
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. Immune to attrition < 3 when Lieutenat Telsij or Karie Neth piloting (when both immune to attrition < 5 and adds one destiny to power only).
lore: Flown by Lieutenant Telsij as Colonel Salm's wingman. Part of gray squadron at the battle of Endor.

name: Gray Squadron Y-wing Pilot
title: •••Gray Squadron Y-wing Pilot
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. When piloting a Y-wing, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. When a starship he pilots fires an ion cannon, once per turn, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one.
lore: Veteran pilots of the reliable Koensayr starfighter were assigned by Ackbar to a key role at Endor. Both the pilots and their venerable Y-wings were up to the task.

name: Great Shot, Kid!
title: •Great Shot, Kid!
text: Deploy on table. If Death Star 'blown away': Whenever you deploy a unique (*) starship to a system location, retrieve 3 Force; Once per during each of your turns you may deploy (for free) a starship from hand or Reserve Deck and reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: With the destruction of the Death Star, the Rebel Alliance received new-found support throughout the galaxy.

name: Great Warrior
title: Great Warrior
