text: Deploy on a Dagobah site. Target a mentor here. Also, target or deploy (regardless of location deployment restrictions) an apprentice here. Attempt when targets are present at the beginning of your control phase. Draw training destiny. If destiny + apprentice's ability > 12, test completed: Place on apprentice. All opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. Mentor: Your character of ability > 2. Apprentice: Your non-droid, non-Jedi character of lesser ability than mentor. Each time you complete any Jedi Test, you may exchange one card in hand for one Jedi Test in your Lost Pile.

name: Greeata
title: •Greeata
text: Other Rodians deploy -1 to same site. Once during each of your control phases, may use 1 Force to take any Rodian into hand from Reserve Deck- reshuffle. While at Audience Chamber, all your other musicians are deploy -1 and forfeit +3.
lore: Rodian musician. In addition to her singing talents, she plays kloo horn. Befriended Sy Snootles on the luxury liner Kuari Princess.

name: Greedo
title: •Greedo
text: During opponent's control phase, may 'threaten' one smuggler at same site. Opponent may use all Force Pile cards to cancel threat, allowing you to activate same amount. Otherwise, draw destiny. If destiny + Greedo's ability > 6, smuggler lost.
lore: Male Rodian bounty hunter. Sent by Jabba to capture Han. Arrogant, overconfident and not too bright. Trained by bounty hunters Nataz and Goa, who betrayed him to Thuku.

name: Greedo (V)
title: •Greedo (V)
text: May deploy as a 'react.' Opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon at same site. Weapons fired using Sorry About The Mess must target Greedo (if possible). Nabrun Leids may not transport characters to or from here.
lore: Male Rodian bounty hunter. Sent by Jabba to capture Han. Arrogant, overconfident and not too bright. Trained by bounty hunters Nataz and Goa, who betrayed him to Thuku.

name: Green Leader
title: •Green Leader
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Green Squadron 1, draws on battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Adds 3 to total weapon destiny of any starfighter he pilots firing at a starfighter with lower maneuver.
lore: Leader. Assigned to fly fighter screen for General Calrissian at Endor.

name: Green Leader In Green Squadron 1
title: •Green Leader In Green Squadron 1
text: Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'
lore: Blank.

name: Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (AI)
title: •Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (AI)
text: Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'
lore: Blank.

name: Green Squadron 1
title: •Green Squadron 1
text: May add 1 pilot. Power -1 when opponent has a starfighter present with higher maneuver. Immune to attrition < 4 when Green Leader piloting.
lore: Constructed at Chardaan Shipyards, a zero-gravity facility. Typically used as an escort for Y-wings or B-wings on critical attack missions.

name: Green Squadron 3
title: •Green Squadron 3
text: May add 1 pilot. Power -1 when opponent has a starfighter present with higher maneuver. Maneuver +2 at a Death Star II sectors. Immune to attrition < 4 when Tycho Celchu piloting.
lore: Flown by Tycho Celchu at the Battle of Endor. Modified canopy improves pilot vision in tight confines. Assigned to fly top cover for Millennium Falcon.

name: Green Squadron A-wing
title: •••Green Squadron A-wing
text: Deploy -2 to Sullust or same system or sector as Green Leader. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Power -1 when opponent has a starfighter present with a higher maneuver.
lore: A-wing starfighters from Green Squadron. Assigned mission of screening Rebel capital starships from enemy fighters and bombers.

name: Green Squadron Pilot
title: •••Green Squadron Pilot
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting an A-wing, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and is forfeit +2.
lore: Many top X-wing pilots transferred to A-wing squadrons when the new starfighter entered service. The best A-wing pilots were selected to fly for Green Squadron at the Battle of Endor.

name: Grievous Will Run And Hide
title: •Grievous Will Run And Hide
text: Deploy on a battleground. [Clone Army] Jedi deploy -1 here. If you just won a battle (or just Force drained here), relocate this card to your [Clone Army] objective. If opponent just won a battle, opponent may relocate this Effect to an [Episode I] battleground. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Blank.

name: Grievous' Gambit
title: •Grievous' Gambit
text: LOST: Deploy [Episode I] Coruscant from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If A Stunning Move on table, deploy three Effects that deploy on your side of table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.
lore: Blank.

name: Grimtaash
title: •Grimtaash
text: USED: If opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, place all but 8 (random selection) in Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Molator (even at a holosite). OR Use 4 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has two or more of in hand are lost.
lore: Dejarik representation of mythical Molator guardian. The spirit of Grimtaash is said to protect Alderaanian royalty from corruption and betrayal.

name: Grogu
title: •Grogu
text: May deploy Foundling on Grogu from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or Lost Pile. Once per game, if present during battle, may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt or place your just lost Mandalorian in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Blank.

name: Grondorn Muse
title: •Grondorn Muse
text: While Grondorn is on Yavin 4, your Yavin Sentry is not unique (•), is doubled, deploys free, applies all three of its modifiers and is immune to Alter. Power -1 when not on Yavin 4.
lore: Formerly belonged to the Corellian militia. Popular musician before the Empire blacklisted his songs for their political content. Joined the Alliance with his wife, Duriet.

name: Grotto Werribee
title: •Grotto Werribee
text: Deploys -1 to a docking bay. Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While at opponent's docking bay, adds 2 to your Force drains there, and your vehicles and other characters there are immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Once a junior traffic controller for an interstellar shipping corporation, Grotto brags that there is nothing about docking bay procedure that he doesn't know. Information broker.

name: Grounded Starfighter
title: Grounded Starfighter
text: Deploy on a landed starship (not at a docking bay). Starship may not move. OR Deploy on a starship or vehicle on Dagobah. Starship or vehicle may not move. At the start of your next control phase, starship or vehicle 'sinks' to bottom of the Lost Pile.
lore: 'If you're saying coming here was a bad idea. I'm beginning to agree with you.'

name: Grugnak
title: •Grugnak
text: While on Cloud City, once during each of your deploy phases may use or lose X Force to relocate any one of your characters at same site to a related site, where X equals ability of your character being relocated.
lore: Elderly Ugnaught who despised the Empire for occupying his home on Cloud City. Helped the Rebellion secretly move personnel to aid the resistance movement.

name: Grummgar
title: •Grummgar
text: During battle with an information broker (or during an attack), adds one destiny to total power. Once per game, may deploy a creature (or a blaster or rifle without 'lost' in game text) here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Dowutin mercenary.

name: Gungan Energy Shield
title: •••Gungan Energy Shield
text: Deploy on an exterior site. While your Fambaa here: your characters here may not be targeted by weapons, opponent's battle destiny draws here are -1, and characters must use +1 Force when moving to or from here using their landspeed.
lore: Gungan energy shields can only be passed through by slow-moving objects. This allowed the Gungans to neutralize the threat posed by longrange tank weapons.

name: Gungan General
title: •••Gungan General
text: Deploys -1 to Naboo. Your Gungans at same site are forfeit +2. While in a battle, if you just drew a Gungan for battle destiny you may take that card into hand.
lore: Many Gungans spend years studying the art of war in the depths of Otoh Gunga. Only at the Battle of Naboo were these Gungans able to exercise that knowledge. Leader.

name: Gungan Guard
title: Gungan Guard
text: Your Gungan leaders present may not be targeted by weapons. While defending a battle on Naboo, Power +4 and, whenever you draw a Gungan for battle destiny, add 3 to that destiny. Requires +2 Force to use landspeed.
lore: Equipped with portable Gungan shields, these front line troops provide a secondary defense against blaster fire.

name: Gungan Warrior
title: Gungan Warrior
text: Deploys -1 to a Naboo site opponent occupies. While with another Gungan, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Power +3 while armed with an electropole.
lore: Residing in the underwater city of Otoh Gunga, the Gungans established an alliance with the Naboo to fight the Trade Federation's forceful occupation of their planet.

name: Guri
title: •Guri
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. When present with Xizor, he may not be targeted by weapons. While Vader not here, opponent may draw no more than one battle destiny here. Immune to purchase, Restraining Bolt, and attrition < 5.
lore: Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor's personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.

name: Guri (V)
title: •Guri (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. While Guri and Xizor present at same site, Force drain +1 here and Xizor may not be targeted by weapons (unless Guri 'hit'). While your [Reflections II] objective on table, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor's personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.

name: H'nemthe
title: H'nemthe
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Adds 2 to deploy cost of each opponent's male Imperial when that Imperial is deploying to same or adjacent site.
lore: Starfaring explorers. H'nemthe have a reputation for being sly and unforgiving. Many abandoned their homeworld after the Empire invaded. The females ritually kill their mates.

name: Halt!
title: •Halt!
text: During any deploy phase, target a character at same site as your battle droid. Target is landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn. OR If opponent just deployed a character to same site as your battle droid, opponent must use 1 Force or place that character in hand.
lore: 'Coruscant?'

name: Han
title: •Han
lore: Corellian. Graduated with honors from the Imperial Academy. Dishonorably discharged. Wanders the galaxy building a reputation as a gambler and a hot-shot pilot.

name: Han (V)
title: •Han (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Force retrieval with Or Be Destroyed is immune to Secret Plans. While armed with a blaster, Han is defense value +2. While Or Be Destroyed on table, immune to attrition < Han's power.
lore: Corellian. Graduated with honors from the Imperial Academy. Dishonorably discharged. Wanders the galaxy building a reputation as a gambler and a hot-shot pilot.

name: Han Seeker
title: Han Seeker
text: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Han (or alien) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker is also lost.
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.

name: Han Solo
title: •Han Solo
text: Once during battle, may use 1 Force to cancel and re-draw your just drawn destiny. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Smuggler, gambler and 'freelance law-bender.' Crafty Corellian pirate. Rebel hero. Owns Millennium Falcon. Co-pilot Chewbacca promised him 'life-debt.' Has bounty on head.

name: Han Solo (V)
title: •Han Solo (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Adds one battle destiny with Chewie. While piloting Falcon, adds 2 to maneuver and, once during battle, may re-circulate.
lore: Smuggler, gambler and 'freelance law-bender.' Crafty Corellian pirate. Rebel hero. Owns Millennium Falcon. Co-pilot Chewbacca promised him 'life-debt.' Has bounty on head.

name: Han Solo, Optimistic General
title: •Han Solo, Optimistic General
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand. Cancels Kylo's game text here. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.
lore: Leader. Scout.

name: Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol
title: •Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Luke or Chewie. Permanent weapon is •Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
lore: Scoundrel, smuggler, gambler and risk taker. 'Everything's going to be fine. Trust me.'

name: Han's Back
title: Han's Back
text: If Han is lost, use 1 Force to retrieve him from the Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take Han into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.
lore: 'Didn't we just leave this party?'

name: Han's Dice
title: Han's Dice
text: If one of your characters of ability > 2 is in a battle, use 1 Force to draw another battle destiny instead of the one you just drew.
lore: A pair of dice dangling above Millennium Falcon's cockpit, for luck. 'I've never seen anything to make me believe there's one, all-powerful Force controlling everything.'

name: Han's Dice (V)
title: Han's Dice (V)
text: If Han or your gambler is in battle (with no Jedi), draw destiny: (0-2) subtract that amount from opponent's total battle destiny; (3-4) cancel the game text of a character participating in battle (if any); (5+) opponent loses all immunity to attrition (if any) this battle.
lore: A pair of dice dangling above Millennium Falcon's cockpit, for luck. 'I've never seen anything to make me believe there's one, all-powerful Force controlling everything.'

name: Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol
title: •Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Han, or 3 on your warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. If hit by Han, target's forfeit = 0.
lore: BlasTech DL-44 heavy blaster pistol. Short range, but relatively powerful. Carries energy for 25 shots. Illegal or restricted in most systems.

name: Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V)
title: •Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V)
text: Deploy on Han. Battles may not be canceled at same site. Greedo's game text is canceled here. May target a character. Draw destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. Once per game, if on Han, may fire during your control phase.
lore: BlasTech DL-44 heavy blaster pistol. Short range, but relatively powerful. Carries energy for 25 shots. Illegal or restricted in most systems.

name: Han's Medal
title: •Han's Medal
text: Deploy on Han or a Wookiee. Once per game, when deployed, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. If on Chewie, may place this device in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of a Wookiee here.
lore: Blank.

name: Han's Toolkit
title: •Han's Toolkit
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your characters, vehicles or starships (free on Falcon or Han). While aboard a vehicle or starship, you may use 1 Force to cancel any Interrupt or Effect of any kind (except those immune to Alter or Control) which targets that vehicle or starship.
lore: Experienced pilots keep a well equipped toolkit. Horizontal boosters, alluvial dampers and hydrospanners aid in performing high-tech repairs aboard starships.

name: Han, Chewie, And The Falcon
title: •Han, Chewie, And The Falcon
text: Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie: provide ability of 5, add one battle destiny, and add 5 to power. Immune to attrition < 6, Come With Me, and Lateral Damage. End of your turn: Use 3 Force to maintain OR Place out of play.
lore: Although temperamental, this trusty hunk of junk always seems to perform for its proud owner and his Wookiee co-pilot when needed the most.

name: Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V)
title: •Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V)
text: Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie, who provide total ability of 5. While in battle, adds one destiny to total power. Immune to Come With Me, Life Debt, and attrition < 6.
lore: Although temperamental, this trusty hunk of junk always seems to perform for its proud owner and his Wookiee co-pilot when needed the most.

name: Han... Solo
title: •Han... Solo
text: Adds 2 to power and maneuver of anything he pilots or drives. If exactly one 'coaxium' card here, may take it into hand. While piloting Falcon and you have completed a Kessel Run, adds one battle destiny and opponent generates no Force here.
lore: Corellian gambler, smuggler, and thief.

name: Harc Seff
title: •Harc Seff
text: Power +1 at a swamp. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a battleground site, whenever you must lose Force from a Force drain at an adjacent site, may reduce the loss by X by using X Force.
lore: Ishi Tib accountant. Experienced administrator. Freelance consultant. Worked for many planetary governors. Knows how to get the most out of any taxation scheme.

name: Harc Seff (V)
title: •Harc Seff (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. For each of opponent's non-battleground locations on table, your Force generation is +1. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Ishi Tib accountant. Experienced administrator. Freelance consultant. Worked for many planetary governors. Knows how to get the most out of any taxation scheme.

name: Harvest
title: •Harvest
text: If Luke is in a battle with Owen or Beru, add one battle destiny (two if both). OR If Owen or Beru is on table, retrieve any one card (two if both, four if both present at Lars' Moisture Farm).
lore: 'Harvest is when I need you the most. It's only one season more. This year we'll make enough on the harvest that I'll be able to hire some more hands.'

name: Haven
title: •Haven
text: Deploy on one of the following systems: Rendezvous Point, Hoth, Yavin 4, Alderaan or Sullust. Your starships deploy -2 and your pilots deploy -1 here. When battling here, you may add one battle destiny. Effect canceled if opponent controls this system. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: After pursuit, asteroids, a slug, Jedi training, capture, torture, escape, a duel, losing Han and losing a hand, Luke and Leia finally made it to the Alliance's rendezvous point.

name: He Can Go About His Business
title: •He Can Go About His Business
text: Plays on table. Cancels Responsibility Of Command and You Overestimate Their Chances. While Brangus Glee on table, once per turn you may search opponent's Lost Pile and place all docking bays found there out of play.
lore: 'You can go about your business.'

name: He Hasn't Come Back Yet
title: He Hasn't Come Back Yet
text: During your control phase, target any character alone at one of your exterior planet sites (except a docking bay). Draw destiny. Target is missing if destiny + 3 > ability.
lore: 'Princess Leia is wondering about Master Luke...She doesn't know where he is.' 'I don't know where he is.' 'Nobody knows where he is.'

name: He Is Not Ready
title: •He Is Not Ready
text: Deploy on any character. Subtracts 2 from that character's training destiny draws. OR Deploy on an opponent's pilot at a site. During each of opponent's move phases, opponent must choose to move that character, lose that character or lose 1 Force.
lore: 'All his live has he looked away. To the future, to the horizon. Never his mind on where he was! Hmm? What he was doing! Hm.'

name: He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance
title: He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance
text: He Is The Chosen One: Deploy Anakin's Funeral Pyre (with Prophecy Of The Force there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] or [Episode VII] characters or locations (except Obi-Wan, Yoda, and Lars' Moisture Farm). If Luke just won a battle, may re-circulate and shuffle Reserve Deck. Emperor's Power does not increase deploy costs at battlegrounds. While this side up, you may initiate battles for free. Flip this card if Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site (unless an opponent's character of ability > 4 is). He Will Bring Balance: {While} this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand face down on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. {Flip} this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability > 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site.

back.title: He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance
back.text: He Is The Chosen One: Deploy Anakin's Funeral Pyre (with Prophecy Of The Force there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] or [Episode VII] characters or locations (except Obi-Wan, Yoda, and Lars' Moisture Farm). If Luke just won a battle, may re-circulate and shuffle Reserve Deck. Emperor's Power does not increase deploy costs at battlegrounds. While this side up, you may initiate battles for free. Flip this card if Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site (unless an opponent's character of ability > 4 is). He Will Bring Balance: {While} this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand face down on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. {Flip} this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability > 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site.

name: He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter
title: He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter
text: USED: Cancel Captive Pursuit. LOST: During your move phase, transfer an escorted captive to another bounty hunter or warrior present.
lore: Once Skywalker had taken the bait, Han was of no use to the Empire.

name: He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V)
title: He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V)
text: USED: For remainder of turn, your bounty hunter draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and moves for free during your move phase. LOST: Cancel an attempt to use a weapon to target your bounty hunter escorting a captive.
lore: Once Skywalker had taken the bait, Han was of no use to the Empire.

name: He's No Good To Me Dead
title: •He's No Good To Me Dead
text: For remainder of turn, your Fetts add 1 to their weapon destiny draws and targets they `hit' are forfeit = 0. OR Once per game, cancel a battle just initiated where a Fett is escorting a captive; opponent's cards there move for free this turn. [Immune to Sense.]
lore: Blank.

name: He's The Best Smuggler Around
title: •He's The Best Smuggler Around
text: USED: Take Kessel Run, L3-37, or Lando into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you just moved a 'coaxium' card to Used Pile, randomly retrieve 1 Force. LOST: Once per game, place a card stacked on [Set D] A Useless Gesture in your Lost Pile.
lore: Blank.

name: Head Back To The Surface
title: •Head Back To The Surface
text: If your piloted unique (•) starfighter is present with opponent's piloted starfighter during your move phase at a non-cloud sector, relocate both to related system. OR Target your starfighter in battle. During this battle, your other starships may not be targeted by weapons.
lore: 'And see if you can get a few of those TIE fighters to follow you.'

name: Heading For The Medical Frigate
title: •Heading For The Medical Frigate
text: USED: Add 1 to your battle destiny just drawn. STARTING: Deploy up to three Effects if each of them deploys for free, is always immune to Alter and has 'deploy on table' (or 'deploy on your side of table') in its game text. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: At the Battle of Endor, Rebel starships fought to defend key capital starships, such as the Redemption.

name: Hear Me Baby, Hold Together
title: Hear Me Baby, Hold Together
text: If opponent just targeted your starship with a starship weapon, subtract 2 from each of that weapon's destiny draws.
lore: Smuggler and Rebel starships use black market armor plating and deflector shields to withstand enemy fire. Expensive but life-saving modifications.

name: Hear Me Baby, Hold Together (V)
title: Hear Me Baby, Hold Together (V)
text: USED: Play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Counter Attack, [Set 0] Defensive Fire, or Hidden Weapons. OR Make a just drawn Overload destiny = ½. LOST: Cancel Cease Fire! or I Have You Now.
lore: Smuggler and Rebel starships use black market armor plating and deflector shields to withstand enemy fire. Expensive but life-saving modifications.

name: Heart Of The Chasm
title: Heart Of The Chasm
text: During your deploy phase, use X Force to rearrange all Cloud City sites, where X = total number of those sites. All cards at a given site move along with that site. OR Cancel Off The Edge. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take one Weather Vane into hand and reshuffle.
lore: The Cloud City chasm's central fin was engineered with a tensile strength unsurpassed by anything in the region, save the silk of the Kashyyyk treeworm.

name: Heavy Fire Zone
title: Heavy Fire Zone
text: If a battle was just initiated, deploy (for free) a vehicle weapon or starship weapon from hand (or Reserve Deck; reshuffle) on your participating vehicle or starship.
lore: 'Heavy fire boss! Twenty-three degrees.'

name: Heavy Infantry Mandalorian
title: •••Heavy Infantry Mandalorian
text: May 'fly' (landspeed = 3). May move as a 'react.' Permanent weapon is Flamethrower (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny +1 > defense value).
lore: Blank.

name: Heavy Turbolaser Battery
title: Heavy Turbolaser Battery
text: Use 4 Force to deploy in your Star Destroyer (adds 2 to power) or any mobile system. May target a starship using 2 Force. Draw two destiny. Subtract 1 when targeting a capital starship. Otherwise, subtract 6. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: The ultimate in armor penetration. Relies in dense capacitor banks for massive firing charge. Capacitors regularly malfunction. Hitting maneuverable targets nearly impossible.

name: Heavy Turbolaser Battery
title: Heavy Turbolaser Battery
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on your Star Cruiser. Adds 2 to power. May target a starship using 2 Force. Draw two destiny. Subtract 1 when targeting a capital starship. Otherwise, subtract 6. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Built to penetrate the armor of the toughest Star Destroyers. Cooling technology pilfered from the Empire.

name: Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi
title: Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi
text: If Obi-Wan is at a site you control, he may apply any amount of his ability toward drawing a battle destiny at any other location. Ability he uses this way cannot be used again this turn. OR One Rebel may move as a 'react' to an adjacent battle site.
lore: Leia sent a hologram plea, 'General Kenobi, years ago you served my father in the Clone Wars. Now he begs you to help him in his struggle against the Empire.'

name: Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)
title: Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)
text: During battle, target an opponent's character of ability of < 2 present with your Jedi;  target is excluded from battle. OR Cancel a 'react'. OR If Obi-Wan is at a battleground site, and your Rebel of Republic character (or Leia) is in battle at another location, add one battle destiny.
lore: Leia sent a hologram plea, 'General Kenobi, years ago you served my father in the Clone Wars. Now he begs you to help him in his struggle against the Empire.'

name: Hem Dazon
title: •Hem Dazon
text: Once during each of your deploy phases, may place, face down, one card from hand or Force Pile under Hem, as 'salt consumption.' If Hem lost, cards underneath also lost. *Power = 1 + number of cards underneath.
lore: Male scout from Cona. As with many Arconas, Hem has succumbed to the power of salt, and addiction indicated by his gold eye color.

name: Herat
title: •Herat
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. During your control phase may search Reserve Deck, take 1 Utinni! or Jawa into hand and reshuffle. If you have 3 or more Jawas on table, may play Utinni! to cancel a Force drain at a related site or to cancel Control.
lore: Female Jawa shaman. Advised Wittin during his plotting with Jabba. Agreed to fan the Hutt in return for his cooperation to help usurp Kalit.

name: Here We Go Again
title: •Here We Go Again
text: If a battle that opponent initiated just ended, initiate a new battle at same location. 'Reacts' are allowed only for opponent, but cards may not 'react' away or hide from battle. Loser ignores battle damage. If your droid present there, add one battle destiny (two if C-3PO).
lore: C-3PO had been through enough battles that many of the Rebels in the strike team considered him a good luck charm. That isn't what Han considers him.

name: Hermi Odle
title: •Hermi Odle
text: When in a battle, you may 'react' by deploying any one non-unique blaster (for free) on Hermi from Reserve Deck. reshuffle. When present with your Advosze at a site, allows your character weapons to transfer for free there.
lore: Baragwin assigned by Jabba to be the palace's master weaponsmith. Enemy of Pote Snitkin.

name: Hero Of A Thousand Devices
title: Hero Of A Thousand Devices
text: Deploy on one of your droids. During your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one device that deploys on a droid into hand and reshuffle. Also, you may forfeit devices deployed on this droid (forfeit value = destiny number).
lore: Left to his own devices, Artoo used his spunk and creativity to save his companions' lives time and time again.

name: Hero Of A Thousand Devices (V)
title: Hero Of A Thousand Devices (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy an R-unit droid from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During a battle where your droid present with a Scomp link, your total power is +1 (+3 if your other droid present with a Scomp link at a related location). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Left to his own devices, Artoo used his spunk and creativity to save his companions' lives time and time again.

name: Heroes Of Yavin
title: •Heroes Of Yavin
text: If Luke, Chewie and Han are in a battle together, draw destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power. OR If Red 5 and Falcon are in a battle together, add one battle destiny.
lore: The three Rebels proved to be a deadly combination time and time again.

name: Heroic Sacrifice
title: Heroic Sacrifice
text: If you just forfeited a Rebel of ability > 2 from a battle at a battleground, deploy on that location; place that Rebel out of play and retrieve 2 Force for each Heroic Sacrifice on table. Immediate Effect canceled if opponent controls this location. (Immune to Control.)
lore: The Alliance lost many fine soldiers at conflicts such as the Battle of Hoth. The Rebel High Command is aware of the cost of freedom from Imperial tyranny.

name: Het Nkik
title: •Het Nkik
text: * Deploys only on Tatooine for 2 Force from each player's Force Pile. Het is power +1 for each Stormtrooper at same site, unless Reegesk is present.
lore: Jawa scout. Wants to avenge deaths of relatives killed in stormtrooper assault on sandcrawler. Reegesk pilfered the powerpack from his blaster at a critical moment.

name: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers
title: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers
text: Hidden Base: Deploy Rendezvous Point. Place a planet system (with a parsec number from 1 to 8) from outside your deck face down on your side of table (not in play); that card indicates the planet where your 'Hidden Base' is located. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at systems and sectors. {Flip} this card any time after you have deployed five battleground systems and your 'Hidden Base' system. Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers: {While} this side up, to draw a card from Force Pile, opponent must first use 1 Force. For each battleground system you control, you may cancel one opponent's Force drain (limit twice per turn). You may not deploy any systems. At each system opponent occupies during any deploy phase, opponent may 'probe' there by placing one card from hand face down beneath that system. {Place} out of play if 'Hidden Base' system is 'probed.' Dark side places 'probe' cards in Used Pile (and may retrieve 1 Force for each Probe Droid used to 'probe').

back.title: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers
back.text: Hidden Base: Deploy Rendezvous Point. Place a planet system (with a parsec number from 1 to 8) from outside your deck face down on your side of table (not in play); that card indicates the planet where your 'Hidden Base' is located. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at systems and sectors. {Flip} this card any time after you have deployed five battleground systems and your 'Hidden Base' system. Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers: {While} this side up, to draw a card from Force Pile, opponent must first use 1 Force. For each battleground system you control, you may cancel one opponent's Force drain (limit twice per turn). You may not deploy any systems. At each system opponent occupies during any deploy phase, opponent may 'probe' there by placing one card from hand face down beneath that system. {Place} out of play if 'Hidden Base' system is 'probed.' Dark side places 'probe' cards in Used Pile (and may retrieve 1 Force for each Probe Droid used to 'probe').

name: Hidden Compartment
title: Hidden Compartment
text: Deploy on any R-unit droid. At start of a battle, you may 'react' by deploying one character weapon (at normal use of the Force) from Reserve Deck on a warrior present; reshuffle.
lore: Standard astromech internal cargo area measures 20 centimeters by 8 centimeters. Some models have a custom compressed-air launcher for shooting flares.

name: Hidden Weapons
title: •Hidden Weapons
text: If Boba Fett, or your character with Mandalorian Armor is present during the weapons phase of a battle, target one opponent's character present. Draw Destiny: (0-1) no effect (2-3) character immediately captured (4-5) character is hit (6+) character immediately lost.
lore: Boba Fett's Mandalorian armor was so versatile that his opponents never knew what to expect.

name: Hiding In The Garbage
title: •Hiding In The Garbage
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your side of table. At any time, you may declare a card type. Use Force one by one, revealing each card used, until a card of that type is revealed (take it into hand) or Force Pile is depleted.
lore: Rebels often exploit loopholes in Imperial procedures to gain an advantage.

name: High Anxiety
title: •High Anxiety
text: If an opponent's character with ability > 2 has just become missing, deploy on a Rebel with ability > 2 on same planet. Rebel may not participate in battle. Immediate Effect canceled if missing character is found or lost.
lore: When a Rebel is missing, ranking members of the Alliance express a professional yet dispassionate concern. Some are not so dispassionate.

name: High-speed Tactics
title: •High-speed Tactics
text: Target two non-creature vehicles with maneuver (one yours, one opponent's) present at same site. Both players draw destiny, add your vehicle's maneuver to your total. Lowest total loses vehicle. OR You speeder bike piloted by a biker scout adds one battle destiny.
lore: Biker scouts train relentlessly on their speeder bikes to ensure that their speed advantage is a potent weapon. This training includes highvelocity brawling.

name: Higher Ground
title: •Higher Ground
text: USED: During a battle at a site, instead of firing one character weapon, cause one opponent's character present to be power -4 until end of turn. LOST: During a battle at a site, use 3 Force to cancel one battle destiny just drawn.
lore: Using his position to his advantage, Luke managed to hold off Vader's onslaught, if only for a few seconds.

name: Hindsight
title: •Hindsight
text: Deploy on C-3PO. Eyes In The Dark, The Professor, Mantellian Savrip and Hopping Mad are immune to Alter. Also, during each draw phase, unless C-3PO is present with a Wookiee, you may examine the cards in your Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'I'm backwards! You fleabitten furball... only an overgrown mophead like you would be stupid enough-'

name: Hindsight (Readable)
title: •Hindsight (Readable)
text: Deploy on C-3PO. Eyes In The Dark, The Professor, Mantellian Savrip and Hopping Mad are immune to Alter. Also, during each draw phase, unless C-3PO is present with a Wookiee, you may examine the cards in your Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'I'm backwards! You fleabitten furball... only an overgrown mophead like you would be stupid enough-'

name: His Destiny
title: •His Destiny
text: If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Indeed You Are Powerful: Once per turn, if you just won a battle or duel, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. I Have To Face Him: Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. Father, Please!: Non-[Set 13] Anakin Skywalker does not cause Force loss and, once per game, you may lose 1 Force to play it from outside your deck as if from hand.

name: His Name Is Anakin
title: •His Name Is Anakin
text: Deploy on table. Each non-battleground docking bay generates no more than one Force for either player. Opponent's aliens deploy +1 on Tatooine (or +2 if non-unique or to same Tatooine site as your Dark Jedi, or +4 if both). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Anakin dreamt that one day he would return to Tatooine to free the slaves. His aggression will one day be felt by the entire Republic.

name: History, Philosophy, And Art
title: •History, Philosophy, And Art
text: USED: During battle, add 1 to your total battle destiny for each artwork card on table. LOST: Once per game, if your [Set 19] objective just `studied' an Interrupt, you may take one Interrupt into hand from Lost Pile.
lore: Blank.

name: Hit And Run
title: •Hit And Run
text: Just after the weapons segment of a battle, you may move any or all of your starships there away. ('Hit' cards must still be lost.)
lore: Many pilots for the Rebellion learned their skills using modified T- 47s and other airspeeders. Being able to weave in and out of combat has become second nature to them.

name: Hit Racer
title: •Hit Racer
text: During your control phase, use 2 Force to target opponent's Podracer with a race total within 4 of one of your race totals. Draw destiny. If destiny > target Podracer's destiny number, opponent may not draw race destiny this turn and target Podracer is 'damaged.'
lore: Sebulba is willing to utilize a variety of 'tactics' to maintain his lead position. Mars Guo learned this lesson the hard way.

name: Hol Okand
title: •Hol Okand
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 6 during battle, adds one destiny to total power only. When at Kashyyyk system, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.
lore: Piloted Gold 6 at the Battle of Yavin. Flew as Dutch's wingman during an attack on an Imperial supply outpost at Kashyyyk. Befriended by Chewbacca before leaving Yavin 4.

name: HoloNet Transmission
title: ••HoloNet Transmission
text: USED: Cancel Transmission Terminated. LOST: Take one Imperial or Visage Of The Emperor into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle.
lore: The Empire uses a real-time hologram communication network. Provides extensive coordination in battles, blockades and searches. Allows rapid deployment and reinforcement.

name: Holoprojector
title: Holoprojector
text: Deploy on any R-unit droid. During your control phase, may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one hologram or dejarik card into hand and reshuffle.
lore: Common feature on astromechs. Displays technical information. Sometimes used by princesses to send distress calls to old Jedi Knights, but not often.

name: Holowan Laboratories
title: •Holowan Laboratories
text: Deploy on table. If your IG-88 or MagnaGuard was just lost, may place it here. Once per turn, may deploy a droid from here to same site as Insidious Prisoner as if from hand. While two MagnaGuards aboard Invisible Hand, Menace Fades is suspended. [Immune to Alter.]

name: Home One
title: •Home One
text: May add unlimited pilots, passengers, vehicles and starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 4. Immune to attrition < 8 (< 10 when Ackbar piloting).
lore: Command ship of the Rebel fleet. 1200 meters long. Masterpiece of aesthetic form. Most heavily armed and armored ship in the fleet. Admiral Ackbar's personal flagship.

name: Home One: Docking Bay
title: •Home One: Docking Bay
text: Light: Your docking bay transit from here is free. If you occupy, opponent may not move to this site. Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 7 Force. Your transit to here requires +9 Force.

name: Home One: War Room
title: •Home One: War Room
text: Light: While you control with a Rebel here, Home One is deploy -5 and power +3. Dark: Force drain -1 here. When you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.

name: Homing Beacon
title: •Homing Beacon
text: Deploy on opponent's starship (even if 'concealed') if your bounty hunter or Imperial leader is on table. Your starships may move for free (and may move as a 'react') to this location. During your move phase, may cancel Landing Claw on this starship.
lore: 'You're sure the homing beacon is secure aboard their ship? I'm taking an awful risk, Vader. This had better work.'

name: Hondo Ohnaka
title: •Hondo Ohnaka
text: Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. While at Audience Chamber (or stacked on your Objective), your other Weequays are deploy -1, power +1, and forfeit +2. Once per game, may deploy Aurra, Slave I, or a Kowakian from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Weequay gangster, leader, and pirate.

name: Hondo Ohnaka (AI)
title: •Hondo Ohnaka (AI)
text: Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. While at Audience Chamber (or stacked on your Objective), your other Weequays are deploy -1, power +1, and forfeit +2. Once per game, may deploy Aurra, Slave I, or a Kowakian from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Weequay gangster, leader, and pirate.

name: Honor Of The Jedi
title: •Honor Of The Jedi
text: Deploy on table. Unless opponent occupies three battlegrounds, each time you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss by 2. (Immune to Alter while you occupy any battleground).
lore: The final act of Luke's ascension to Jedi Knighthood was sending off his father, draped in the garb of Vader.

name: Honoring What They Fight For
title: •Honoring What They Fight For
text: If a [Cloud City] Rebel controls a battleground, turn a card stacked on Patience! face up. OR Place a card stacked on Patience! out of play to choose: If a [Cloud City] Rebel in battle, add one battle destiny. OR Take a character weapon into hand from Lost Pile.
lore: Han's habit of leaving during a crisis was offset by his tendency to return when his friends needed him the most.

name: Hopping Mad
title: •Hopping Mad
text: Deploy on one of your droids. During your control phase, may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one Droid Shutdown, The Professor, We're Doomed, Scomp Link Access, This Is All Your Fault or Shocking Information into hand and reshuffle.
lore: 'I'm standing here in pieces and you're having delusions of grandeur!'

name: Horace Vancil
title: •Horace Vancil
text: Deploys -1 on Naboo. While at Theed Palace Throne Room, once during your control phase may reveal one card (random selection) from opponent's hand. Opponent must place card in Used Pile or lose 1 Force.
lore: Part of Amidala's advisory council, Horace monitors political crises, as well as providing the Queen with information regarding the current economic state of the city.

name: Horox Ryyder
title: •Horox Ryyder
text: Agendas: order, taxation, peace. While in a senate majority, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny at battleground systems, and you may not cancel opponent's battle destiny draws at systems.
lore: Anx senator. Known for his patience, Horox exhibits unique insight into many complicated Senate issues.

name: Hosnian Prime
title: •Hosnian Prime
text: Dark: While your [Episode VII] objective on table and your First Order leader here, Menace Fades is suspended. Light: If Starkiller Base on table, your Force generation is -1 here.

name: Hot Pursuit
title: •Hot Pursuit
text: USED: If opponent's card present with your vehicle of landspeed > 2 has just begun to move as a 'react', cancel that 'react'. LOST: Select one opponent's vehicle present with your vehicle of landspeed > 2 to be power = 0 for remainder of turn.
lore: The mobility of speeder bikes is greatly valued by the Empire's advanced scout detachments.

name: Hoth
title: •Hoth
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites. Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.

name: Hoth
title: •Hoth
text: Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites. Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.

name: Hoth Sentry
title: •Hoth Sentry
text: Use 2 Force to deploy at any Hoth site. Declare one of the following to affect that site and adjacent sites while 'sentry' present: Opponent's deploy +1. OR Opponent's ability required for battle destiny +1. OR Your total power +1.
lore: 'Reroute all power to the energy shield. We've got to hold them till all transports are away.'

name: Hoth Survival Gear
title: Hoth Survival Gear
text: Deploy on any Rebel or warrior. While on Hoth, that character is power and forfeit +1 and is immune to Frostbite, Exposure and Ice Storm.
lore: Cold-weather gear worn and carried by Echo Base troops. Enhances their ability to function and survive in Hoth's hostile environment.

name: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
title: •Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
text: Light: Your Echo Base Troopers deploy -1 here. If you control, Force drain +1 here. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
title: •Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
text: Dark: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. If you control, Force drain +1 here. Light: Your troopers are forfeit -1 here.

name: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (V)
title: •Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (V)
text: Light: During opponent's turn, if you occupy with a [Hoth] character or [Hoth] vehicle, may activate 1 Force. Dark: If you occupy, your Force generation is +1 here.

name: Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
title: •Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
text: Dark: Add 1 to total of Commence Primary Ignition when targeting the Hoth system. Light: If you control, your starship movement from Hoth sites to the Hoth system is free.

name: Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
title: •Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
text: Light: If you control, with X leaders here, your total power is +X in battles at Hoth locations. Dark: If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny. If you control, Force drain -1 here.

name: Hoth: Echo Corridor
title: •Hoth: Echo Corridor
text: Dark: If you occupy, you may raise all of your converted Hoth locations to the top. Light:

name: Hoth: Echo Corridor
title: •Hoth: Echo Corridor
text: Light: If you control, once per turn, may use 4 Force to raise a converted Hoth site to the top. Dark: -

name: Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
title: •Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
text: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.

name: Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
title: •Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
text: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your transit to here requires +4 Force.

name: Hoth: Echo Med Lab
title: •Hoth: Echo Med Lab
text: Light: Once per turn, when you deploy a medical droid, it is deploy -2. Dark: If you control, with an Imperial present, Force drain +1 here.

name: Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)
title: •Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)
text: Dark: During your move phase, you may move free from here directly to Mountains (or vice versa). Light: If you control, and Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.

name: Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V)
title: •Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V)
text: Dark: Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck. Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites. Light:

name: Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V) (AI)
title: •Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V) (AI)
text: Dark: Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck. Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites. Light:

name: Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
title: •Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
text: Dark: If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 5 Force. Light: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. Your artillery weapons on Hoth are powered.

name: Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
title: •Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
text: Light: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. Your artillery weapons here are powered. Dark: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 8 Force.

name: Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)
title: •Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)
text: Light: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. Your artillery weapons here are powered. Dark: Your movement to or from here requires +1 Force. If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 8 Force.

name: Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)
setName: Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two Player Game
title: •Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)
text: Dark: Your Imperials and combat vehicles deploy -1 here. Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
title: •Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
text: Light: This site does not count when calculating Epic Events. Dark: This site does not count when calculating Epic Events.

name: Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
title: •Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
text: Dark: Your AT-ATs move to here for free. Light:

name: Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (V)
title: •Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (V)
text: Dark: AT-ATs move to and from here for free. During your first turn, AT-ATs may not deploy here. Light: T-47s are power +1 here. If you have two piloted T-47s here, Force drain +1 here.

name: Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker)
title: •Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker)
text: Light: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. Dark: If you control, Force generation +1 for you here.

name: Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V)
title: •Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V)
text: Light: Your artillery weapons deploy -2 here. Once per game, may deploy an artillery weapon here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Your deploy costs may not be modified here.

name: Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker)
title: •Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker)
text: Dark: Your Wampas deploy free here. Light: If you control, and Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.

name: Houjix
title: Houjix
text: During the damage segment of a battle you lost, if you have no cards left that can be forfeited, cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel Sunsdown.
lore: Dejarik creature. These ferocious-looking beasts are gentle, loyal, and often domesticated as guard animals or pets on Kinyen, the Gran homeworld.

name: Houjix & Out Of Nowhere
title: Houjix & Out Of Nowhere
text: USED: If opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector where you have a starship with maneuver > 3, use 1 Force to add one battle destiny. LOST: If you just forfeited all your cards that participated in a battle you lost, cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Sense.)

name: Hound's Tooth
title: •Hound's Tooth
text: May add 1 pilot (must be smuggler or bounty hunter), 6 passengers and 1 vehicle. Immune to attrition < 4 if Bossk piloting. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Has ship-docking capability.
lore: Controlled by state-of-the-art-voice-activated X10-D computers. Internal sensors and security systems monitor prisoner activity. Modified for Bossk's Trandoshan physiology.

name: Hound's Tooth (V)
title: •Hound's Tooth (V)
text: May add 1 alien pilot, 6 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Deploys (even using Combat Response) and moves like a starfighter. While Bossk piloting, adds one battle destiny and immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Controlled by state-of-the-art-voice-activated X10-D computers. Internal sensors and security systems monitor prisoner activity. Modified for Bossk's Trandoshan physiology.

name: How Did We Get Into This Mess?
title: How Did We Get Into This Mess?
text: If one of your droids is at the Dune Sea or where there is a Scomp link, use 1 Force to discard your entire hand to your Used Pile. Draw the same number of cards from your Reserve Deck. Draw one extra card if droid is C- 3PO or R2-D2.
lore: Stranded in the Dune Sea, R2-D2 insisted on heading into rocky canyons where he thought settlements were likely to exist. Threepio had other ideas.

name: How Liberty Dies
title: •How Liberty Dies
text: Deploy on Galactic Senate. Your Political Effects are canceled. Twice per turn, may target your agenda here: Justice: During battle, subtract 1 from a just drawn weapon destiny. Order: During any move phase, peek at the top 2 cards of any Reserve Deck and replace in any order. Peace: Subtract 1 from attrition against you. Taxation: Place a character with politics from hand in Used Pile to choose: Activate 1 Force or deploy Senate Hovercam from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Human Shield
title: Human Shield
text: USED: If an opponent's weapon is about to 'hit' an Imperial present with a captive being escorted, the captive is 'hit' instead. LOST: During the damage segment of a battle at a site, you may forfeit any captives present (once per battle per captive).
lore: A shining example of Imperial honor and bravery.

name: Hunchback
title: •Hunchback
text: On a hunch, if opponent just initiated a Force drain at an adjacent site, you may use 1 Force to search opponent's Force Pile and place out of play one card there that has 'back' in the title; reshuffle.
lore: What hump?

name: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
title: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
text: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi: Deploy Holotheatre and Visage Of The Emperor. May deploy Meditation Chamber and/or Epic Duel. {While} this side up, during your move phase, may use 4 Force to take Vader into hand from a location you control (cards on him go to owner's Used Pile). Add 4 to each player's destiny draw for Sense and Alter. {Flip} this card if Vader is at a battleground site and no Light Jedi or Luke is at a battleground site. {Place} out of play if you play Scanning Crew, initiate a non-Epic duel or Force drain at an Executor site. Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe: {While} this side up, opponent cannot initiate battles or Force drains where opponent has a Jedi or Skywalker. You lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader at Meditation Chamber, subtract 2 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws. Opponent may not play Sense or Alter. {Flip} this card if opponent has Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site or if Vader is not on table. {Place} out of play if you play Scanning Crew, initiate a non-Epic duel or Force drain at an Executor site.

back.title: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
back.text: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi: Deploy Holotheatre and Visage Of The Emperor. May deploy Meditation Chamber and/or Epic Duel. {While} this side up, during your move phase, may use 4 Force to take Vader into hand from a location you control (cards on him go to owner's Used Pile). Add 4 to each player's destiny draw for Sense and Alter. {Flip} this card if Vader is at a battleground site and no Light Jedi or Luke is at a battleground site. {Place} out of play if you play Scanning Crew, initiate a non-Epic duel or Force drain at an Executor site. Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe: {While} this side up, opponent cannot initiate battles or Force drains where opponent has a Jedi or Skywalker. You lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader at Meditation Chamber, subtract 2 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws. Opponent may not play Sense or Alter. {Flip} this card if opponent has Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site or if Vader is not on table. {Place} out of play if you play Scanning Crew, initiate a non-Epic duel or Force drain at an Executor site.

name: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)
title: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)
text: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi: Deploy Vader's Castle, [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor, and a [Cloud City] site with exactly one [Dark Side]. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials. Where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if with a 'Hatred' card). Inquisitors are destiny +1. {While} this side up, once per turn, may deploy a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Vader is at a battleground site unless Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site. Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe: {While} this side up, you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader armed with a lightsaber, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. {Flip} this card if Vader not on table or if Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site; once per game, may take Vader and your cards on him into hand from a site you control.

back.title: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)
back.text: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi: Deploy Vader's Castle, [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor, and a [Cloud City] site with exactly one [Dark Side]. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials. Where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if with a 'Hatred' card). Inquisitors are destiny +1. {While} this side up, once per turn, may deploy a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Vader is at a battleground site unless Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site. Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe: {While} this side up, you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader armed with a lightsaber, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. {Flip} this card if Vader not on table or if Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site; once per game, may take Vader and your cards on him into hand from a site you control.

name: Hunt For The Droid General / He's A Coward
title: Hunt For The Droid General / He's A Coward
text: Hunt For The Droid General: Deploy a [Clone Army] battleground, Clone Command Center (to same planet), Cloning Cylinders, and Grievous Will Run And Hide. For remainder of game, you may not deploy non-[Episode I] cards with ability. [Reflections II] objectives target Anakin instead of Luke. Your Destiny is suspended. Jedi gain [Pilot] skill. Your [Episode I] sites are immune to No Escape. At end of opponent's turn, if you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Grievous Will Run And Hide here unless Grievous alone at a battleground. He's A Coward: While this side up, your Force drains are +1 where you have a clone with a Jedi or Padawan. X = number of battlegrounds your [Clone Army] cards occupy. If you just initiated a battle: peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck or Used Pile (may take it into hand or place it on bottom of Reserve Deck), then if X > 1, retrieve a [Clone Army] card into hand, then if X > 2, your clone may make a regular move (using landspeed for free) to the battle location. Flip this card if Grievous Will Run And Hide at a battleground or Grievous alone at a battleground.

back.title: Hunt For The Droid General / He's A Coward
back.text: Hunt For The Droid General: Deploy a [Clone Army] battleground, Clone Command Center (to same planet), Cloning Cylinders, and Grievous Will Run And Hide. For remainder of game, you may not deploy non-[Episode I] cards with ability. [Reflections II] objectives target Anakin instead of Luke. Your Destiny is suspended. Jedi gain [Pilot] skill. Your [Episode I] sites are immune to No Escape. At end of opponent's turn, if you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Grievous Will Run And Hide here unless Grievous alone at a battleground. He's A Coward: While this side up, your Force drains are +1 where you have a clone with a Jedi or Padawan. X = number of battlegrounds your [Clone Army] cards occupy. If you just initiated a battle: peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck or Used Pile (may take it into hand or place it on bottom of Reserve Deck), then if X > 1, retrieve a [Clone Army] card into hand, then if X > 2, your clone may make a regular move (using landspeed for free) to the battle location. Flip this card if Grievous Will Run And Hide at a battleground or Grievous alone at a battleground.

name: Hunting Party
title: •Hunting Party
text: During your control phase, form a search party for an opponent's missing character at same site. Add 1 to search party destiny draw for each bounty hunter in search party. If successful, capture the character found.
lore: Sometimes a missing person is found by the wrong search party.

name: Hunting Party (V)
title: •Hunting Party (V)
text: During your control phase, if your bounty hunter or Trandoshan is escorting a non-frozen captive at a battleground site you control, opponent loses 1 Force. OR If your bounty hunter or Trandoshan just captured a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: Sometimes a missing person is found by the wrong search party.

name: Hutt Bounty
title: •Hutt Bounty
text: Deploy on an opponent's smuggler, gambler, or thief. If subsequently captured, seized by a bounty hunter and then transfered to Jabba's Palace Dungeon, retrieve Force equal to character's forfeit (+6 if Han) and lose effect. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Chissaa, picha gawanki Chewbacca. Yupon cogorato kama walpa kyess kashung kawa Wookiee.'

name: Hutt Influence
title: •Hutt Influence
text: Deploy on table. Opponent may not cancel or modify Force drains at each Tatooine battleground site where you have two aliens with different card titles. Also, attrition against you is reduced by 2 when two of your non-unique aliens with different card titles are in battle.
lore: Jabba's criminal empire extends to all reaches of the Outer Rim.

name: Hutt Influence (V)
title: •Hutt Influence (V)
text: Deploy on table. I Must Be Allowed To Speak may only target opponent's locations (even if converted). At Tatooine battlegrounds where you have an alien and a gambler, gangster, or Dug, Force drains may not be canceled or reduced by opponent. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Jabba's criminal empire extends to all reaches of the Outer Rim.

name: Hutt Smooch
title: •Hutt Smooch
text: Capture one opponent's undercover spy ('cover is broken'). OR if opponent just deployed a spy to a site where opponent has no presence or Force icons, return spy to hand. Any Force used to deploy the spy remains used, and spy may not deploy this turn.
lore: 'We have powerful friends. You're gonna regret this.' 'Rota go ma namatota.'

name: Hydroponics Station
title: Hydroponics Station
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on any exterior Tatooine site. Cannot be moved. The first Force you activate during your activate phase may be drawn into hand instead. If a Vaporator on table, the second Force you activate may also be drawn into hand.
lore: Grows fruits and vegetables. Very efficient water use. Often underground. Feeds moisture farm families, but excess vegetables are often sold at markets.

name: Hylobon Enforcer
title: ••Hylobon Enforcer
text: Deploy -1 and forfeit +1 at same or related location as Vos or at an opponent's site. Permanent weapon is Percussive Cannon (may target a character using 1 Force; draw destiny; if destiny +1 > defense value, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn).
lore: Crimson Dawn. Hylobon guard.

name: Hyper Escape
title: Hyper Escape
text: If a battle was just initiated at any system or sector, move all your starships and vehicles there away.
lore: 'We'll be safe enough once we make the jump to hyperspace.' A starship in hyperspace cannot be tracked unless a homing beacon has been hidden aboard.

name: Hyperoute Navigation Chart
title: Hyperoute Navigation Chart
text: [0] Corscant [1] Carida, Corellia, Eriadu, Kirdo III, Kuat [2] Alderaan, Bothuwui, Kiffex, Rendili, Tibrin, Wakeelmui [3] Malastare, Nal Hutta, Raithal, Ralltiir [4] Aquaris, Chandrila, Corulag, Yavin 4* [5] Anoat, Dantooine, Hoth*, Naboo [6] Bespin, Fondor, Kashyyyk, Mon Calamari [7] Clak'dor VII, Ord Mantell, Roche, Sullust, Tatooine [8] Endor, Kessel [9] Dagobah, Gall * Known Rebel Base

name: Hyperoute Navigation Chart (V)
title: Hyperoute Navigation Chart (V)
text: [0] Corscant [1] Carida, Corellia, Eriadu, Kirdo III, Kuat [2] Alderaan, Bothuwui, Kiffex, Rendili, Tibrin, Wakeelmui [3] Malastare, Nal Hutta, Raithal, Ralltiir [4] Aquaris, Chandrila, Corulag, Yavin 4* [5] Anoat, Dantooine, Hoth*, Naboo [6] Bespin, Fondor, Kashyyyk, Mon Calamari [7] Clak'dor VII, Ord Mantell, Roche, Sullust, Tatooine [8] Endor, Kessel [9] Dagobah, Gall * Known Rebel Base

name: Hyperwave Scan
title: Hyperwave Scan
text: Deploy on your side of table. Scanning Crew is immune to Sense. If Scanning Crew is played against an opponent who has 13 or more cards in hand, opponent also loses all cards with 'Rebel' in the title found there.
lore: Full Imperial scans include full-spectrum transceivers, dedicated energy receptors, crystal gravfield traps, and hyperwave signal interceptors.

name: Hyperwave Scan (V)
title: Hyperwave Scan (V)
text: Deploy on a location. At same battleground, opponent may not cancel or reduce your Force drains here. You initiate battles here for free. If you just initiated battle here, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Total battle destiny and forfeit values may not be increased here.
lore: Full Imperial scans include full-spectrum transceivers, dedicated energy receptors, crystal gravfield traps, and hyperwave signal interceptors.

name: Hypo
title: Hypo
text: Deploy on your IT-O. Once during each of your control phases, if present with a captive: You may ask one yes-or-no question about cards in opponent's hand. Opponent must answer truthfully or lose 1 Force. OR May add 1 to Force drain where present.
lore: Truth drugs like Bavo Six decrease resistance to interrogation. The enormous needle adds psychological pressure, facilitating the interrogation process.

name: I Am Part Of The Living Force
title: •I Am Part Of The Living Force
text: If your starting location had 'communing' in game text, deploy Communing and stack a Jedi with 'communing' in game text on it. Deploy up to three Effects that deploy on table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Blank.

name: I Am Your Father
title: •I Am Your Father
text: If Vader just won a battle or duel against a Luke of ability < 6, deploy on Luke. During each of your move phases, opponent loses 2 Force. Also, when at same location as Vader, Luke is power and forfeit = 0 and does not add power to any starships he pilots.
lore: 'Search your feelings, you know it to be true.'

name: I Am Your Father (V)
title: •I Am Your Father (V)
text: Deploy on table. [Death Star 2] Vader is deploy = 6. Once per turn, may deploy Vader's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or lose 1 Force to deploy it from Lost Pile). Whenever a lightsaber swung by Vader 'hits' a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to NOOOOOOOOOOOO! [Immune to Alter.]
lore: 'Search your feelings, you know it to be true.'

name: I Am Your Father (V) (AI)
title: •I Am Your Father (V) (AI)
text: Deploy on table. [Death Star 2] Vader is deploy = 6. Once per turn, may deploy Vader's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or lose 1 Force to deploy it from Lost Pile). Whenever a lightsaber swung by Vader 'hits' a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to NOOOOOOOOOOOO! [Immune to Alter.]
lore: 'Search your feelings, you know it to be true.'

name: I Can't Believe He's Gone
title: •I Can't Believe He's Gone
text: If Obi-Wan was just placed out of play, use 1 Force to deploy Immediate Effect on table. If a battle was just initiated at a site, may use 1 Force to increase your total power by 5. (Immune to Control.)
lore: Even though Luke felt the pain of losing his mentor, Obi-Wan continued to give him strength and guidance through the Force.

name: I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)
title: •I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)
text: If Obi-Wan 'communing,' deploy on table. Once per battle involving a Rebel, may activate 1 Force or add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny. Once per game, may take Old Ben into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or retrieve Old Ben. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Even though Luke felt the pain of losing his mentor, Obi-Wan continued to give him strength and guidance through the Force.

name: I Can't Shake Him!
title: •I Can't Shake Him!
text: If your starship weapon aboard your starfighter was just fired during a battle, add one battle destiny. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one starship weapon or tractor beam from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'You've picked one up... watch it!'

name: I Can't Shake Him! (V)
title: •I Can't Shake Him! (V)
text: For remainder of turn, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon and opponent's starship weapon destiny draws are -1. OR During opponent's deploy phase, deploy an Imperial of ability < 3 (except an admiral) aboard your starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'You've picked one up... watch it!'

name: I Did It!
title: •I Did It!
text: Deploy on table if you've won a Podrace. Once per game, may place Boonta Eve Podrace out of play to retrieve 4 Force. If you occupy a battleground site and a battleground system, once during each of your control phases may reveal the bottom card of your Lost Pile and place it on top of your Force Pile. At the end of opponent's turn opponent must lose 2 Force or place their Force Pile onto their Used Pile.

name: I Don't Like Sand
title: •I Don't Like Sand
text: Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top two cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)

name: I Don't Like Sand (ALT)
title: •I Don't Like Sand (ALT)
text: Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top two cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)

name: I Don't Need Their Scum, Either
title: •I Don't Need Their Scum, Either
text: USED: Search your Reserve Deck, take one We Don't Need Their Scum into hand and reshuffle. LOST: If a bounty hunter and your Lando are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two if bounty hunter is Boba Fett).
lore: Of all the scum and villainy Lando had dealt with (pirates, smugglers, con-artists, thieves, swindlers, politicians and Imperial lackeys), he hated bounty hunters the most.

name: I Don't Need Their Scum, Either (V)
title: •I Don't Need Their Scum, Either (V)
text: USED: Take Houjix, Ounee Ta, or Scanner Techs into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain initiated by a lone Slave I. LOST: If an Imperial and a bounty hunter are in a battle together, draw one destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power.
lore: Of all the scum and villainy Lando had dealt with (pirates, smugglers, con-artists, thieves, swindlers, politicians and Imperial lackeys), he hated bounty hunters the most.

name: I Feel The Conflict
title: •I Feel The Conflict
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. Each time you win a battle or duel, opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down. When attempting to cross Vader over, add 3 to total destiny for each card in stack. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'I know there is good in you. The Emperor hasn't driven it from you fully.'

name: I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing
title: I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your Dark Jedi. Opponent's total ability at same location is reduced by 2, unless an opponent's Jedi is also present.
lore: Darth Vader ruthlessly used the Force to strike down enemies and soldiers who displeased him. He could choke victims from afar without touching them.

name: I Had No Choice
title: •I Had No Choice
text: Deploy on an opponent's gambler. Cancels gambler's game text. If a battle was just initiated, you may use X Force to exclude gambler from that battle, where X = gambler's ability.
lore: Gamblers are vulnerable to bribery, extortion and other forms of manipulation. Their notorious dealings can be easily taken advantage of.

name: I Have A Bad Feeling About This
title: I Have A Bad Feeling About This
text: Use 3 Force: Retarget an Interrupt or Utinni Effect which specifies a target to another appropriate target on the same side of the Force. OR Relocate any Effect (except those immune to Alter) deployed on a location to another appropriate location.
lore: 'This grounds sure feels strange. Doesn't feel like rock. I don't know...'

name: I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This
title: •I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This
text: If opponent just initiated a battle where opponent has more than double your power, target your highest-ability character in that battle. Draw destiny. If destiny < target's ability, deploy one character there from hand (for free).
lore: 'I'm rather embarrassed, General Solo, but it appears you are to be the main course at a banquet in my honor.'

name: I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This
title: I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This
text: If opponent just deployed four or more characters to same location this turn, prevent all of those characters from battling this turn. OR If opponent just 'reacted' to a battle, cancel the battle.
lore: 'Look at him, he's heading for that small moon.' Luke became apprehensive when Obi-Wan informed him, 'That's no moon. It's a space station.'

name: I Have You Now
title: I Have You Now
text: If a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two destiny if Rebel is Luke)
lore: 'Several fighters have broken off from the main group. Come with me.' Darth Vader targets his TIE fighter's fire-linked blaster cannons at the Rebel pilots in the trench.

name: I Have You Now (V)
title: I Have You Now (V)
text: If Revenge Of The Sith on table, choose: If a Dark Jedi is in battle with an opponent's character of ability > 3, add one battle destiny. OR During your move phase, use 2 Force to relocate your apprentice from an [Episode I] site to another site.
lore: 'Several fighters have broken off from the main group. Come with me.' Darth Vader targets his TIE fighter's fire-linked blaster cannons at the Rebel pilots in the trench.

name: I Hope She's All Right
title: •I Hope She's All Right
text: Deploy on table. Your non-unique scouts are forfeit +1. During every draw phase, unless opponent's character of destiny < 4 occupies a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Effect canceled unless your characters of destiny < 4 occupy two battleground sites.
lore: 'I'm afraid that Artoo's sensors can find no trace of Princess Leia.'

name: I Know
title: •I Know
text: If Leia and Han are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Han, you may 'react' by deploying there (for free) Leia and/or her matching weapon from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Han and Leia chose unusual times to express their true feelings for each other.

name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak
title: •I Must Be Allowed To Speak
text: Deploy on a Jabba's Palace site. Luke may deploy at this site regardless of presence or location deployment restrictions. When he is deployed here, relocate Effect to Luke, he is immune to attrition while on Tatooine. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Jedi mod spienko eek.'

name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak & •Smuggler's Blues
title: •I Must Be Allowed To Speak & •Smuggler's Blues
text: If Watch Your Step on table, deploy on table. Corran is a smuggler. Once per character, when you deploy Corran, Mara, Mirax, or Talon Karrde to a Tatooine location, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. Once per game, may deploy a [Reflections 2] location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent may not cancel or modify Force drains at battlegrounds where you have two smugglers. [Immune to Alter.]

name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V)
title: •I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once per character, when you deploy Chewie, Lando, Leia, or Luke to a Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. While Han is frozen, Rebels are immune to None Shall Pass. Once per game, may deploy a farm from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Jedi mod spienko eek.'

name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V) (ALT)
title: •I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V) (ALT)
