lore: Female stormtrooper.

name: Janus Greejatus
title: •Janus Greejatus
text: Deploys -3 to Emperor's site. When with Emperor at a battleground site, adds 1 to your Force drains here. Once per turn, you may use 1 Force to place a card from hand to bottom of Used Pile and draw top card of Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Imperial council member. Very cruel at heart. Has lusted for power his entire life. Predictable and controllable.

name: Jar Jar Binks
title: •Jar Jar Binks
text: May deploy to any site, even without presence or Force icons. During battle may use 1 Force to target one opponent's character present. Both players draw destiny. If your destiny + 2 > opponent's destiny + target's ability, Jar Jar and target are lost.
lore: Young Otolla Gungan. Clumsy. Outcast from Otoh Gunga for continually making mistakes that placed other members of Gungan society at risk.

name: Jar Jar's Electropole
title: •Jar Jar's Electropole
text: Deploys on Jar Jar. May 'throw' (place in Used Pile) to target a character, creature or vehicle. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > defense value, target is landspeed = 0 and power -2 for remainder of turn.
lore: Jar Jar had to be instructed on how to use an electropole prior to the battle on the great grass plains. It's not his weapon of choice.

name: Jawa
title: Jawa
text: To deploy, requires 1 Force from each players' Force Pile. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine, but may move elsewhere.
lore: Small, rodent-like scavenger species. Refurbish and sell droids. Nest in sandcrawlers. Considered to be pests by most species.

name: Jawa
title: Jawa
text: *To deploy, requires 1 Force from each players' Force Pile. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine, but may move elsewhere.
lore: Pesky scavenger species. One meter tall. Trade language nearly unintelligible...unless Jawas wish to be understood. Sometimes build massive stone fortresses.

name: Jawa
title: Jawa
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. To deploy, requires 1 Force from each players' Force Pile. Power +1 on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, if opponent just initiated a Force drain at adjacent site, may use 2 Force to reduce it by 1.
lore: Every now and then, Jawas will pause in their scavenging duties to take in a Podrace. Many believe this is only because they want to be first to a crash scene.

name: Jawa
title: Jawa
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. *To deploy, requires 1 Force from each players' Force Pile. Power +1 on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, if opponent just initiated a Force drain at adjacent site, may use 2 Force to reduce it by 1.
lore: Always on the prowl, Jawas work hard for every credit they earn.

name: Jawa Blaster
title: Jawa Blaster
text: Deploy on your Jawa. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. If destiny -1 > defense value, target hit. If destiny = 0, Jawa Blaster 'explodes' (weapon and character firing it are lost).
lore: Built from scavenged parts, Jawa blasters are not required to adhere to any design standards. An etching on this stock warns 'datinni greb zroom.'

name: Jawa Ion Gun
title: Jawa Ion Gun
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Jawa, 3 on your warrior. May target a character using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Targeted droid stolen if destiny +1 > forfeit. Targeted non-droid character excluded from battle if destiny = defense value.
lore: Cobbled-together weapon built from salvaged power cells, droid restraining bolts and an ion accelerator. Fires a stream of ion energy that stuns droids and irritates others.

name: Jawa Pack
title: •Jawa Pack
text: To deploy (on your side of table), requires 3 Force from both players' Force Piles. Cannot deploy otherwise. All your Jawas are forfeit +1.
lore: Jawas travel in packs for protection. They use ambush tactics against unwary droids in the canyons of the Jundland Wastes. 'Aeeeyaa!'

name: Jawa Siesta
title: •Jawa Siesta
text: To deploy (on your side of table), requires 3 Force from both players' Force Piles. Cannot deploy otherwise. All your Jawas are forfeit +1.
lore: Three Jawas take a cool, energy-saving nap in the noon-day suns at Mos Eisley.

name: Jaxxon T. Tumperakki
title: •Jaxxon T. Tumperakki
text: Deploys -1 to Cloud City. Any blaster may deploy on Jaxxon. Once per game, may deploy a blaster on Jaxxon from Lost Pile (or Jaxxon may steal one from opponent's Lost Pile). While at opponent's battleground, Imperial Enforcement is suspended.
lore: Lepi gambler, smuggler, and thief. Star-Hopper mercenary.

name: Jedha
title: •Jedha
text: Dark: While you control, your superlaser weapon destiny draws are +1. Light: Unless Baze, Bodhi, Chirrut, or Saw here, Force drain -1 here.

name: Jedha: Jedha City
title: •Jedha: Jedha City
text: Dark: May be deployed instead of Alderaan by Set Your Course For Alderaan. Light: Baze, Chirrut, and Saw deploy -1 here.

name: Jedha: Jedha City (AI)
title: •Jedha: Jedha City (AI)
text: Dark: May be deployed instead of Alderaan by Set Your Course For Alderaan. Light: Baze, Chirrut, and Saw deploy -1 here.

name: Jedi Business
title: •Jedi Business
text: Deploy on table. Non-[Episode I] Jedi are lost. Qui-Gon is deploy -1. Unless with Anakin or Vader, Mace is immune to attrition. Once per turn, may choose: deploy an [Episode I] lightsaber from Reserve Deck (reshuffle), or once per game, deploy Malastare, Mos Espa, or Night Club from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter)
lore: The peacekeepers of the galaxy are not to be taken lightly.

name: Jedi Business (ALT)
title: •Jedi Business (ALT)
text: Deploy on table. Non-[Episode I] Jedi are lost. Qui-Gon is deploy -1. Unless with Anakin or Vader, Mace is immune to attrition. Once per turn, may choose: deploy an [Episode I] lightsaber from Reserve Deck (reshuffle), or once per game, deploy Malastare, Mos Espa, or Night Club from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter)
lore: The peacekeepers of the galaxy are not to be taken lightly.

name: Jedi Escape
title: •Jedi Escape
text: If opponent just initiated a duel against one of your non-captive Jedi at a site, use 1 Force to cancel the duel and you may relocate any number of your characters there to an adjacent site.
lore: Qui-Gon escaped with his friends from Tatooine, barely getting away from the clutches of Darth Maul.

name: Jedi Holocron
title: •Jedi Holocron
text: Deploy on your character of ability > 4. While present: adds 1 to training destiny draws and Force drains here; the first Force lost to a Force drain here is stacked here face down; opponent's ability required to draw battle destiny here is +1 for each card stacked here.
lore: Blank.

name: Jedi Leap
title: •Jedi Leap
text: During your deploy phase, lose 1 Force to relocate [Episode I] Obi- Wan to an adjacent Naboo site. OR Raise your converted interior Theed Palace site to the top.
lore: Obi-Wan's youth combined with his Jedi training meant that he was not to be dispatched easily.

name: Jedi Levitation
title: Jedi Levitation
text: Use X force, where X = (7 - ability of your highest ability character on table). Search through your Used Pile and take one card into hand. Shuffle, Cut and replace.
lore: A Jedi can adjust the force within and around an object, causing it to move as the Jedi wills.

name: Jedi Levitation (V)
title: Jedi Levitation (V)
text: USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, choose: Take that card into hand. OR Cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to take a character into hand from Lost Pile.
lore: A Jedi can adjust the Force within and around an object, causing it to move as the Jedi wills.

name: Jedi Lightsaber
title: Jedi Lightsaber
text: Use X Force to deploy on your warrior where X = (7 - warrior's ability). May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature by using X Force. Draw two destiny. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. 'This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster. A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.'

name: Jedi Lightsaber (V)
title: Jedi Lightsaber (V)
text: Deploy on your character of ability > 4 or Padawan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. 'This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster. A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.'

name: Jedi Lightsaber (V) (ALT)
title: Jedi Lightsaber (V) (ALT)
text: Deploy on your character of ability > 4 or Padawan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. 'This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster. A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.'

name: Jedi Marshal Avar Kriss
title: •Jedi Marshal Avar Kriss
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots (3 if piloting a capital starship). While piloting a capital starship, it is immune to attrition < 5. Once per game, may retrieve a musician (or take one into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle). Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Female musician. High Republic.

name: Jedi Mind Trick
title: •Jedi Mind Trick
text: USED: Cancel a Force drain at a site if Luke is at an adjacent site. LOST: If your character of ability > 4 is present with an opponent's leader, release a captive from a related prison (canceled if opponent loses 2 Force).
lore: 'You will bring Captain Solo and the Wookiee to me.'

name: Jedi Mind Trick (V)
title: •Jedi Mind Trick (V)
text: USED: If opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain, they must use 2 Force, or it is canceled. LOST: If your Jedi in battle (unless with a Dark Jedi, Hutt, or Toydarian), 'wave hand at' (add or subtract 2 from) an opponent's just drawn destiny.
lore: 'You will bring Captain Solo and the Wookiee to me.'

name: Jedi Presence
title: Jedi Presence
text: If one of your Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Rebels there to battle at double power.
lore: Jedi Knights inspired allies on the battlefield through bravery and heroism. Obi-Wan's presence encouraged the Rebels and gave them a chance to escape the Death Star.

name: Jek Porkins
title: •Jek Porkins
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 6, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Piloted Red 6 at Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing runs. Served in Tierfon Yellow Aces squadron at Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Free trader from Bestine system.

name: Jeroen Webb
title: •Jeroen Webb
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When in battle with a Rebel leader, subtracts 1 from opponent's total battle destiny.
lore: Native of Ralltiir. Spy for Ralltiir's underground network after his homeworld was subjugated.

name: Jerus Jannick
title: •Jerus Jannick
text: Deploys - 2 to same site as Amidala. While in a battle with Amidala or Leia, your leaders present may not be targeted by weapons, and Jerus may be forfeited to satisfy all battle damage and attrition against you.
lore: Part of Amidala's Royal Naboo Security Forces, Jerus has been trained as a protector of royalty, and is determined that his responsibility be carried out professionally.

name: Jess
title: •Jess
text: May retrieve 1 Force each time you deploy a musician to same site. During your turn, may use 1 Force to 'charm' one male alien of ability < 3 present; that male is forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.
lore: Popular musician. Often seen with Bib Fortuna. Captivates those around her. Hoping to join a band and leave Jabba's palace.

name: Jet Pack
title: •••Jet Pack
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on any alien (except Boba Fett or Jabba). May 'fly' (landspeed = 3). May use 2 Force to move as a 'react'.
lore: Mitrinomon Z-6 jet pack. Exhaust vents are used to maneuver in midflight. Gyro-stabilizer automatically applies counterthrust when landing.

name: Jodo Kast
title: •Jodo Kast
text: When in battle, if opponent draws more than one battle destiny, may cancel one. Once per turn, when firing a rifle or blaster, may target for free and add 2 to total weapon destiny. May be targeted by Hidden Weapons. May 'fly' (landspeeed = 3).
lore: Bounty Hunter and scout. Perfectionist. Equipped with mandalorian armor and a jet pack. He doesn't mind being mistaken for Boba Fett. Occasionally works for Black Sun.

name: Joh Yowza
title: •Joh Yowza
text: Power +2 on Endor or when present with your musician. When opponent draws destiny, Joh may 'jam' (place that card face down under Joh). Holds one card at a time. If Joh leaves table, place card under Joh in opponent's Used Pile.
lore: Yuzzum musician and thief. Singer for The Max Rebo Band. Stage name given to him by Sy Snootles. Jabba likes his performance, even though the Hutt despises Yuzzum.

name: Join Me!
title: •Join Me!
text: Use 3 Force if Luke was just 'hit' by a lightsaber swung by Vader. Opponent must choose: Place Luke in owner's Used Pile OR Luke may not be forfeited this battle and crosses to the Dark Side at the end of the turn if still on table (is no longer 'hit').
lore: '...And together, we can rule the galaxy as father and son!'

name: JS-1975
title: •JS-1975
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may take Gideon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While piloting a speeder bike, Grogu is forfeit -2 here and opponent's weapon destinies targeting your speeder bikes are -1 here.
lore: Biker scout trooper. Imperial Remnant.

name: Judicator
title: •Judicator
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Each of its weapon destiny draws is +2. Starfighters it 'hits' are power = 0.
lore: Incorporates latest design modifications from Kuat Drive Yards. Targeting computers outfitted with antenna locking, in-line calibration and helical-motion extrapolators.

name: Jungle
title: <>Jungle
text: Dark: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Your aliens and creature vehicles are each power +1 here. Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Force Drain -1 here. Your attrition against opponent is -2 here.

name: Jungle
title: <>Jungle
text: Light: Your aliens and creature vehicles are each power +1 here. May not be deployed to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Dark: Force drain -1 here. Your attrition against opponent is -2 here. May not be deployed to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine.

name: Juri Juice
title: •Juri Juice
text: Deploy on any alien if Cantina, Mos Eisley or Jabba's Sail Barge on table. That alien may not use ability in battles (if Kabe, she also cannot 'steal'). Utinni Effect canceled by moving that alien to one of those sites without 'driving' a vehicle.
lore: Popular beverage served in many cantinas and tapcafes. Has intoxicating effect on many species. Favorite drink of Kabe, Chadra-Fan thief of Mos Eisley.

name: Juri Juice (V)
title: •Juri Juice (V)
text: Deploy on table. May deploy Cantina from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your Cantina may not be converted. Once per turn, if you just deployed an alien to Cantina, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. Immune to Blue Milk. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Popular beverage served in many cantinas and tapcafes. Has intoxicating effect on many species. Favorite drink of Kabe, Chadra-Fan thief of Mos Eisley.

name: Jyn Erso
title: •Jyn Erso
text: May deploy to a site as an Undercover spy. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. If just lost, may peek at opponent's hand.
lore: Female Spy.

name: Jyn Erso (AI)
title: •Jyn Erso (AI)
text: May deploy to a site as an Undercover spy. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. If just lost, may peek at opponent's hand.
lore: Female Spy.

name: Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel
title: •Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel
text: While Stardust on your spy, Jyn adds one battle destiny. While Stardust on Jyn and present at a battleground, Force drain +1 here and non-trooper Rebel spies here may not be 'choked.' If just lost, opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Female leader and spy.

name: K'lor'slug
title: •K'lor'slug
text: Deploy on your side of table. For each unit of ability you have present during a battle, you may use 1 Force to raise your total power by 1. Ability used in this way cannot also be used to draw destiny.
lore: Dejarik of venomous swamp creature from Noe'ha'on. Keen senses of smell and vision. Dangerous hunter. Lays eggs - hundreds of ravenously hungry hatchlings.

name: K'lor'slug (V)
title: •K'lor'slug (V)
text: Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Dejarik of venomous swamp creature from Noe'ha'on. Keen senses of smell and vision. Dangerous hunter. Lays eggs - hundreds of ravenously hungry hatchlings.

name: K-2SO (Kay-Tuesso)
title: •K-2SO (Kay-Tuesso)
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to Data Vault. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While with Cassian or at Data Vault, your total battle destiny here is +1. If just lost from a site, may take Jyn into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Spy.

name: K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)
title: •K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)
text: May initiate battle and be battled. K-3PO is power +1 for each of your other droids at same Hoth or Yavin 4 site. Functions as a leader if present with another of your droids.
lore: Old-model protocol droid. Learned military tactics while under the ownership of Commander Narra. In charge of the droid pool at Echo Base. May initiate battle and be battled.

name: Kaadu
title: Kaadu
text: May add 1 'rider' (passenger). Ability = ½. Moves for free. While 'ridden' by a Gungan, may move as a 'react.' While at a swamp, adds 1 to your Force drains there.
lore: Used by many Gungan warriors due to their fearless nature. Kaadu lay large numbers of eggs to compensate for those eaten by predators.

name: Kabe
title: •Kabe
text: During your control phase, may target one opponent's weapon or device at same site. Draw destiny. If destiny < target's destiny number, Kabe 'steals' device to use, or weapon to hold and transfer (for free) to a warrior at same site.
lore: Young female Chadra-Fan. Thief. Guardian is Muftak. Abandoned on Tatooine by slavers. Loves intoxicating juri juice. Once robbed Jabba the Hutt's dwelling in Mos Eisley.

name: Kal'Falnl C'ndros
title: •Kal'Falnl C'ndros
text: When in a battle, if both players draw only one battle destiny and yours is higher, reduces opponent's total battle destiny to zero. Landspeed = 3. Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. May not be aboard starfighters or enclosed vehicles.
lore: A female Quor'sav, a warm-blooded, avian/monotreme species. 3.5 meters tall. Over-protective mother. Freelance pilot. Has custom-built ship with tall corridors. Lays eggs.

name: Kalit
title: •Kalit
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Your Jawa Siesta is not unique (•), is doubled, deploys free (or for 6 Force from each player) and cumulatively affects your Jawas' forfeit. While at Audience Chamber or Jawa Camp, all your other Jawas are power +2.
lore: Jawa leader. Seeking to peacefully settle a long standing disagreement with his rival, Wittin. Wants Jabba to mediate their talks.

name: Kalit's Sandcrawler
title: •Kalit's Sandcrawler
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 1 driver and 7 passengers. While your Jawa is aboard, this vehicle and your Jawas at same site are immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if Kalit at same site).
lore: Provides enclosed shelter from harsh Tatooine climate, Tusken Raiders and krayt dragons. Kalit offers sanctuary to others when traveling (even members of enemy Jawa tribes).

name: Kamino
title: •Kamino
text: Light: Once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy a Kamino site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: If opponent has two clones on table, Force drain -1 here.

name: Kamino: Clone Birthing Center
title: •Kamino: Clone Birthing Center
text: Light: During your deploy phase, your clone here may move to a site you occupy for free. Dark: If you initiate battle here, add one battle destiny. Fetts may move to and from here for free.

name: Kamino: Clone Training Center
title: •Kamino: Clone Training Center
text: Light: While you control, your non-unique clone troopers are power and forfeit +1. Dark: Fetts deploy -1 here.

name: Kanan Jarrus
title: •Kanan Jarrus
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While present with an Imperial (or two Rebels), all immunity to attrition here is canceled.
lore: Padawan.

name: Kanan Jarrus (AI)
title: •Kanan Jarrus (AI)
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While present with an Imperial (or two Rebels), all immunity to attrition here is canceled.
lore: Padawan.

name: Kanan Jarrus, Jedi Knight
title: •Kanan Jarrus, Jedi Knight
text: Whenever you deploy Chopper, Ezra, Hera, Kanan, Sabine, or Zeb, may draw top card of your Used Pile. Once during your draw phase, if Kanan at a battleground and he did not move this turn, may peek at cards in your Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Karie Neth
title: •Karie Neth
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. While aboard your starship, adds 1 to each of its weapon destiny draws (2 if Gray Squadron 2 or when with Telsij).
lore: Gray Squadron 2's gunner at the Battle of Endor. Member of Rogue Squadron. Replaced Bothan pilot lost during secret mission ordered by Rebel command staff.

name: Kashyyyk
title: •Kashyyyk
text: Dark: Force drain +1 here. If you control, all Wookiees on table are forfeit -3. Light: Your starships with any Wookiee aboard are power and forfeit +2 here.

name: Kashyyyk
title: •Kashyyyk
text: Light: Your Wookiees and smugglers deploy -2 here. Dark: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

name: Kashyyyk Operative
title: Kashyyyk Operative
text: While at a Kashyyyk site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is power +1 (or +2 if your Trandoshan is on Kashyyyk) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Kashyyyk from Reserve Deck- reshuffle.
lore: Hunters who track down escaped Wookiee slaves and report on their location. The Empire and Trandoshans pay a high price for that kind of information.

name: Kashyyyk Operative
title: Kashyyyk Operative
text: While at a Kashyyyk site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is forfeit +1 (and power +1 if your Wookiee is on Kashyyyk) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Kashyyyk from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Following the subjugation of Kashyyyk by the Empire, the Alliance hired merchants to 'purchase' Wookiee slaves to be freed.

name: Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut
title: •Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut
text: Light: Deploys only as a starting location. Once per game, may take a Wookiee into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Wookiee Homestead on table, no Force drains here. Dark: Blank.

name: Kashyyyk: Forest Depths
title: •Kashyyyk: Forest Depths
text: Light: While you control, Wookiees are destiny +1. Dark: No starships or vehicles here.

name: Kashyyyk: Kachirho
title: •Kashyyyk: Kachirho
text: Light: Once per turn, if you occupy with a Wookiee, may deploy a Kashyyyk location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Unless you occupy, your non-Wookiee characters deploy and move to here for +1 Force.

name: Kashyyyk: Sacred Falls (Forest)
title: •Kashyyyk: Sacred Falls (Forest)
text: Light: Your Wookiees move from here for free when using landspeed. Dark: While opponent occupies with a Wookiee, your Force generation here is canceled.

name: Kashyyyk: Work Settlement #121
title: •Kashyyyk: Work Settlement #121
text: Light: While you occupy, your Wookiees at Kashyyyk sites are forfeit +1. Dark: While you control, opponent's Wookiees at Kashyyyk sites are power -1.

name: Kazak
title: •Kazak
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each Light side icon at same Endor site. When present at an Endor site, adds 1 to your Force drains at each Endor site where another of your Ewoks is present.
lore: Elder Ewok advisor to Chief Chirpa. Studied Imperial patrols and helped plan attacks.

name: Ke Chu Ke Kukuta?
title: Ke Chu Ke Kukuta?
text: If opponent just deployed an Imperial to a Jabba's Palace site (and you have no Rebels at any Jabba's Palace site), return Imperial to opponent's hand. Any Force used to deploy that Imperial remains used and Imperial may not be deployed for remainder of turn.
lore: 'Balka. Hachu ma blinki?'

name: Kebyc
title: •Kebyc
text: When at a site and opponent is losing Force from Force drains at cloud sectors on same planet, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck, if possible.
lore: Senior accountant for the Cloud City Miner's Guild. Administrates the annual dues and fights corruption among her fellow guild members.

name: Keder The Black
title: •Keder The Black
text: Deploys only to a site as an Undercover spy (-2 on Coruscant). During your control phase, may 'break cover' to target one character with politics present. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > target's politics, target and Keder are lost.
lore: A highly paid assassin and spy, Keder has infiltrated the Senate disguised as a Coruscant Guard. The identity of his target and his employer remains a mystery to all but him.

name: Keep Your Eyes Open
title: Keep Your Eyes Open
text: If a battle was just initiated where you have two smugglers, you may move any or all of your characters, vehicles and starships away (at normal use of the Force). OR Glance at the cards in any Lost Pile and replace unshuffled.
lore: 'Look, don't worry. Everything's gonna be fine. Trust me.'

name: Keep Your Eyes Open (V)
title: Keep Your Eyes Open (V)
text: USED: Cancel an attempt to fire a weapon during any move phase. LOST: If a battle was just initiated, lose 1 Force to prevent all weapons from being fired for remainder of battle.
lore: 'Look, don't worry. Everything's gonna be fine. Trust me.'

name: Keeping The Empire Out Forever
title: •Keeping The Empire Out Forever
text: Deploy on table. If you control two Cloud City sites and occupy Bespin system, flip Quiet Mining Colony. While Independent Operation on table, it may not flip and once per turn may search your Force Pile and take one card there into hand; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Our operation is small enough not to be noticed...'

name: Kef Bir: Oceanic Ruins
title: •Kef Bir: Oceanic Ruins
text: Light: If you occupy with a Jedi, you lose no more than 1 Force to That Thing's Operational. Dark: When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect as if from hand.

name: Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage
title: •Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage
text: Light: While Rey alone here, she is immune to attrition. Dark: While Rey alone here, you may not Force drain at Kylo's location.

name: Keir Santage
title: •Keir Santage
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. When at a system, sector, or docking bay, once during each of your deploy phases, subtracts 2 from deploy cost of your unique (•) X-wing deploying here.
lore: Rescued from an Imperial detention center by Wedge Antilles. Rogue Squadron veteran. Assigned to Red Squadron at the Battle of Endor. Coordinates with Rebellion procurement.

name: Kelleran Beq
title: •Kelleran Beq
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny with Grogu or a Padawan. Any lightsaber may deploy on Beq. Once per game, may deploy a lightsaber on Beq from Lost Pile. Your other characters here are defense value +1 for each lightsaber on Beq. Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Jedi survivor.

name: Kelnacca
title: •Kelnacca
text: Once per turn, if Wookiee Homestead on table, may place a card from hand on Force Pile to draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, may deploy a unique (•) forest from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Wookiee Strangle and You Are Beaten.
lore: High Republic. Wookiee.

name: Kessel
title: •Kessel
text: Dark: Your starships deploy -1 here, -2 if Tarkin is aboard a starship here. If you control, Kessel Run is canceled. Light: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

name: Kessel
title: •Kessel
text: Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here. Dark: If you control, Kessel Run is prevented (canceled).

name: Kessel (V)
title: •Kessel (V)
text: Light: Force drain +1 here. For remainder of game, Kessel Run is immune to Alter and may not be canceled. Dark:

name: Kessel Operative
title: Kessel Operative
text: While at a Kessel site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is power +1 (or +2 if your smuggler is on Kessel) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Kessel from Reserve Deckreshuffle.
lore: Mercenaries that make a profit selling materials to the troops stationed on Kessel. Help the Empire prevent escape attempts by the prisoners there.

name: Kessel Run
title: •Kessel Run
text: Deploy on Kessel. Target one of your smugglers at another system. X = parsec distance between the two systems. When target reaches Kessel, opponent draws destiny. If = 0, starship lost. Otherwise, by returning to first system, 'retrieve' X Lost Force.
lore: Planet Kessel has infamous glitterstim spice mines attracting smugglers and pirates. A 'Kessel run' is a long, dangerous hyper-route they must travel quickly.

name: Kessel Run (V)
title: •Kessel Run (V)
text: Deploy on Kessel; draw 'coaxium' destinies, stacking face up here until total > 12 (cannot deploy otherwise). During each move phase, if your smuggler here, move a 'coaxium' card from here to Used Pile. If no 'coaxium' cards here, retrieve 4 Force; place Effect out of play.
lore: Planet Kessel has infamous glitterstim spice mines attracting smugglers and pirates. A 'Kessel run' is a long, dangerous hyper-route they must travel quickly.

name: Ket Maliss
title: Ket Maliss
text: Deploy on your non-warrior character (except droids) to give that character [Warrior] skill. OR Deploy on your warrior. That character is power +1. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Assassins are highly valued by Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters. Ket Maliss, Prince Xizor's 'shadow killer,' has unknown but undoubtedly lethal business in Mos Eisley.

name: Ketwol
title: •Ketwol
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may exchange a docking bay from hand with top card of Lost Pile. Your docking bay transit is free when moving to or from same site.
lore: Pacithhip scout. From an unknown system on the Outer Rim. Spends most of his time talking to pilots and travelers at local docking bays.

name: Ketwol (V)
title: •Ketwol (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Your docking bay transit is free when moving to or from same site. If piloting a freighter or starfighter, may lose 1 Force to cancel an attempt by opponent to target that starship to be captured, 'hit,' or lost.
lore: Pacithhip scout. From an unknown system on the Outer Rim. Spends most of his time talking to pilots and travelers at local docking bays.

name: Ki-Adi-Mundi
title: •Ki-Adi-Mundi
text: Deploys +3 if not to Jedi Council Chamber. While at a battleground site, if opponent just initiated a battle at same or adjacent site, opponent must lose top card of their Reserve Deck (if possible). Immune to attrition < 5 while at Jedi Council Chamber.
lore: Cerean Jedi trained by Yoda since the age of four. Only Jedi Council member who is a Jedi Knight. Freed his homeworld from a group of rogues without any bloodshed.

name: Kiffex
title: •Kiffex
text: Dark: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Tonnika Sisters anywhere are doubled. Light: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2.

name: Kiffex
title: •Kiffex
text: Light: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Vul Tazaene anywhere is doubled. Dark: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2.

name: Kiffex Operative
title: Kiffex Operative
text: While at a Kiffex site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is power +1 (or +2 if your spy is on Kiffex) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Kiffex from Reserve Deck- reshuffle.
lore: Couriers. Watchful for any kind of activity by the Alliance or the Empire. Sell their information to anyone willing to buy.

name: Kiffex Operative
title: Kiffex Operative
text: While at a Kiffex site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is forfeit +1 (and power +1 if your spy or Vul Tazaene is on Kiffex) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Kiffex from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Some Snivvians on Kiffex maintain a covert presence and coordinate information to help plan attacks on Imperial convoys.

name: Kijimi
title: •Kijimi
text: Dark: If you control, your starships are hyperspeed +1 when moving from here. Light: Poe and your smugglers may deploy here as a 'react.'

name: Kill Them Immediately
title: •Kill Them Immediately
text: Use 5 Force to reveal opponent's hand. If opponent has no duplicate cards there, place this Interrupt in Used Pile. OtherwiseUSED: place a revealed card in opponent's Used Pile. LOST: all cards opponent has two or more of are lost. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: Darth Sidious instructed Nute Gunray to dispose of the Jedi ambassadors. Rune Haako was not so confident.

name: Kin Kian
title: •Kin Kian
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard your starship, adds 2 to each of its weapon destiny draws. While aboard a unique (•) Gray Squadron Y-wing at a system or sector, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.
lore: Rogue Squadron pilot. Assigned as gunner aboard Colonel Salm's Y-wing at Battle of Endor, as part of Gray Squadron. Former member of Aggressor Squadron.

name: Kin Kian (V)
title: •Kin Kian (V)
text: Matching pilot for any snub fighter. While piloting a snub fighter, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and opponent may not substitute battle destiny draws here.
lore: Rogue Squadron pilot. Assigned as gunner aboard Colonel Salm's Y-wing at Battle of Endor, as part of Gray Squadron. Former member of Aggressor Squadron.

name: Kintan Strider
title: Kintan Strider
text: If opponent just forfeited or lost a character, use 1 Force to regenerate one of your own characters. Retrieve the character closest to the top of your Lost Pile into your hand.
lore: A dejarik of a ferocious creature with incredible healing abilities. Extinct on the homeworld of Kintan, but used as a guard beasts by many Hutt gangsters.

name: Kir Kanos
title: •Kir Kanos
text: When armed with a Force pike, adds one battle destiny. Once during each of your deploy phases, lose 1 Force or place Kanos and cards deployed on him in owner's Used Pile (if Emperor on table, may use 1 Force instead).
lore: Fiercely devoted Royal Guard. Feels deeply indebted to those who risk their life for him. Unaware of the extent of Palpatine's atrocities and cruelty.

name: Kir Kanos (V)
title: •Kir Kanos (V)
text: When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, if with an Imperial and present at a site, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.
lore: Fiercely devoted Royal Guard. Feels deeply indebted to those who risk their life for him. Unaware of the extent of Palpatine's atrocities and cruelty.

name: Kirdo III
title: •Kirdo III
text: Light: If you occupy, once per turn, may search Reserve Deck and take any Desert, Kitonak, or Sandwhirl into hand; reshuffle. Dark: If you control, Force drain -1 here.

name: Kirdo III Operative
title: Kirdo III Operative
text: While at a Kirdo III site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is forfeit +1 (and power +1 if your Kitonak is on Kirdo III) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Kirdo III from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Some traders who run convoys to Kirdo III relay secret information from the Rebel population of Kirdo III. These traders have extensive experience with the Kitonak.

name: Kit Fisto
title: •Kit Fisto
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to an [Episode I] site (-2 if underwater). Landspeed = 2. Once per turn, may use 1 Force (or place your combat card here in Used Pile) to draw top card of Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Nautolan Jedi Council member.

name: Kit Fisto (Holo AI)
title: •Kit Fisto (Holo AI)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to an [Episode I] site (-2 if underwater). Landspeed = 2. Once per turn, may use 1 Force (or place your combat card here in Used Pile) to draw top card of Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Nautolan Jedi Council member.

name: Kithaba
title: •Kithaba
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. Power = 1 + ability of opponent's highest-ability character present.
lore: Famous Klatooinian assassin. After disposing of a few more prisoners, plans to quit the killing business and become a full-time musician. Rises to the challenges he faces.

name: Kitik Keed'kak
title: •Kitik Keed'kak
text: Immediately lost if at same site as overprotective mother, Kal'Faln C'ndros. Cannot board starfighters or enclosed vehicles.
lore: A female insectoid Yam'rii. Very strong and easily angered. Known for stealth, but also has good technological aptitude. Meat eater. Loves eggs.

name: Kitonak
title: •••Kitonak
text: Power +1 at a Tatooine site, or power +2 at any desert. Immune to Gravel Storm, Sandwhirl and desert landspeed requirements. Immune to attrition < the number of your musicians present.
lore: Natives of Kirdo III, a desert world, Kitonak possess tough, leathery skin. Many become musicians. Very patient. Thousands have been enslaved by the Empire.

name: Klaatu
title: •Klaatu
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Power +2 when with Barada or defending a battle a a Jabba's Palace site. During a battle at same site, may forfeit a transport vehicle present to satisfy all remaining battle damage and attrition against you.
lore: Kadas'sa'Nikto. Barada's main assistant. In charge of repairing Jabba's skiffs. Gambler. Always tries to make it back to the palace to watch the Rancor get fed.

name: Klatooinian Revolutionary
title: Klatooinian Revolutionary
text: Power +2 at any Jabba's Palace site. May 'react' by deploying or moving to same site as any Hutt.
lore: Some Klatooinians escaped enslavement by Hutt organizations. Continually fighting to free their species. Hate all Hutts.

name: Knights Of The Old Republic
title: •Knights Of The Old Republic
text: USED: If present with a Dark Jedi or [Episode I] Jedi, your Padawan is power +2 for remainder of turn. OR Deploy one [Episode I] lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Once per game, retrieve a Padawan or [Episode I] lightsaber.
lore: A Jedi seeks nonviolent solutions to problems, but may fight to preserve the existence of life. An apprentice must learn which battles to fight and which to avoid.

name: Knowledge And Defense
title: •Knowledge And Defense
text: Insert in opponent's Reserve Deck. When Effect reaches top it is lost, but opponent may not initiate any battles for remainder of turn. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'A Jedi uses the Force for knowledge and defense, never for attack.'

name: Knowledge And Defense (V)
title: •Knowledge And Defense (V)
text: Deploy on table with up to any number of Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.
lore: 'A Jedi uses the Force for knowledge and defense, never for attack.'

name: Koensayr Manufacturing
title: •Koensayr Manufacturing
text: Deploy on Ralltiir system. Once during each of your control phases, you may retrieve one Y-wing. Also Special Modifications is not unique (•) and makes its target immune to attrition < 4. Suspended while opponent controls Ralltiir. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Company responsible for design of the rugged Y-wing snub fighter. Maintains sales offices on many planets. Koensayr parts often find their way into a variety of ships.

name: Krayt Dragon
title: •Krayt Dragon
text: Ferocity = 6 + two destiny. Habitat: deserts and Tatooine exterior sites. May not deploy to an occupied site. If defeated, opponent may draw destiny and retrieve Force equal to destiny draw.
lore: Krayt dragons have beautiful and valuable pearls inside them as a gizzard to grind up food. Their fierceness is legendary. Up to 10 meters tall and 30 meters long.

name: Krayt Dragon Bones
title: •Krayt Dragon Bones
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on table. Each opponent's destiny draw, you do the following: (0) Put top used card in hand; (1) lose 1 Force; (2) activate 1 Force; (3) lose this Effect; (4) retrieve 1 Force; (5) deploy a character for free; (6+) nothing.
lore: Tusken Raiders, Jawas and other desert dwellers believe that krayt dragon bones possess mystical powers that can bring good or bad luck.

name: Krayt Dragon Howl
title: •Krayt Dragon Howl
text: If Obi-Wan is defending a battle alone at a site, add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. OR If any other Rebel with ability > 2 is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny.
lore: Using Jedi skill, Obi-Wan Kenobi imitated perfectly the mournful howl of the dangerous krayt dragon to scare Tusken Raiders away from Luke Skywalker.

name: Krennic, Death Star Commandant
title: •Krennic, Death Star Commandant
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, if Death Star orbiting a battleground, may peek at top two cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand. Once per game, may take a non-unique Star Destroyer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Commander. Leader.

name: Kuat
title: •Kuat
text: Dark: Your starships move as a 'react' (for free) to a battle here. Light: If you occupy, all Star Destroyers are deploy +1 (+3 if you control). Your movement to here requires +1 Force.

name: Kuat Drive Yards
title: •Kuat Drive Yards
text: Deploy on Kuat system. All your Imperial-class Star Destroyers are immune to attrition < 4. Once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one Imperial-class Star Destroyer here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter while you occupy Kuat.)
lore: Company that produces current generation of Star Destroyers, as well as Nebulon-B Frigates. Ship yards are extremely well defended.

name: Kuat Drive Yards (V)
title: •Kuat Drive Yards (V)
text: Deploy on table. Unique (•) Imperial-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Company that produces current generation of Star Destroyers, as well as Nebulon-B Frigates. Ship yards are extremely well defended.

name: Kylo Ren
title: •Kylo Ren
text: Adds one destiny to total power when with a [First Order] shuttle. While present at a battleground, Honor Of The Jedi is suspended. Whenever a player loses a battle here, that player loses 2 Force. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Leader.

name: Kylo Ren With Lightsaber
title: •Kylo Ren With Lightsaber
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Kylo's Lightsaber (may target a character for free; draw 2 destiny; target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force if total destiny > defense value; otherwise you lose 1 Force).
lore: Leader.

name: Kylo Ren With Lightsaber (AI)
title: •Kylo Ren With Lightsaber (AI)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Kylo's Lightsaber (may target a character for free; draw 2 destiny; target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force if total destiny > defense value; otherwise you lose 1 Force).
lore: Leader.

name: Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle
title: •Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle
text: May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May deploy to exterior sites. When deployed, may deploy Kylo aboard (deploy -2) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Takes off and lands for free.
lore: Blank.

name: Kylo Ren's Lightsaber
title: •Kylo Ren's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Kylo. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > defense value, target hit, its forfeit = 0, and both players lose 1 Force.
lore: Blank.

name: Kylo Ren's TIE Silencer
title: •Kylo Ren's TIE Silencer
text: May add 1 pilot. Kylo deploys -2 aboard. May reveal from hand to take Kylo into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and deploy both simultaneously. While Kylo piloting, Kylo and this TIE are immune to It Can Wait, Rebel Barrier, and attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren
title: •Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While in battle alone: your total power here is +3, battle destiny draws may not be added and, if defending, once per game may take an Interrupt (except Ghhhk) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if alone).
lore: Knight of Ren. Leader.

name: L3-37 (Elthree-Threeseven)
title: •L3-37 (Elthree-Threeseven)
text: While aboard (or stacked on) a freighter, adds 1 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed, and when forfeiting L3-37, stack her on that freighter. May lose L3-37 to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt targeting a freighter she is aboard or stacked on.
lore: Female smuggler.

name: Labria
title: •Labria
text: Once each turn, during your control phase, you may reveal the top card of your Reserve Deck to both players. If it is a vehicle or starship, card is immediately lost. Otherwise, return it to the top of your Reserve Deck, Force Pile or Used Pile.
lore: Information broker. Spy. Devaronian males instinctively have 'wanderlust.' Frustrated that he must be reclusive due to shady past. Suffers from prejudice due to devilish appearance.

name: Lady Proxima
title: •Lady Proxima
text: Lost if at an exterior site. While with two of your other aliens, adds one battle destiny. During your control phase, may reveal the top three cards of your Reserve Deck, take one alien into hand (if possible), and shuffle your Reserve Deck.
lore: Female Grindalid. Gangster. Leader.

name: Lak Sivrak
title: •Lak Sivrak
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May move as a 'react' for free. While at opponent's battleground, may not be targeted by opponent's Interrupts and your Force drains here may not be canceled or reduced by opponent.
lore: Lak Sivrak is a typical Shistavanen male. Ferocious, but not aggressive. Often trained as scouts at Imperial academies, but they despise the ambitions of the New Order.

name: Lambda-Class Shuttle
title: Lambda-Class Shuttle
text: Deploy -1 if Sienar Fleet Systems on table. May add 1 pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Takes off and lands for free.
lore: Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. Length 20 meters. Bottom wings fold for docking and landing. Boarding ramp allows easy access to passenger and cargo areas.

name: Lana Dobreed
title: •Lana Dobreed
text: During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one exterior site to 'transport' (relocate) to another exterior site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Dobreed used to have dreams of opening up his own shop in Mos Espa. Now broke from his gambling activities, he provides transportation services to pay for his urges.

name: Lana Dobreed & •Sacrifice
title: •Lana Dobreed & •Sacrifice
text: If your character is about to be hit, use 1 Force (free if by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon); for remainder of turn, its forfeit may not be reduced and it may not be used to satisfy attrition. OR Cancel Disarmed. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel a 'react'. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

name: Landing Claw
title: ••Landing Claw
text: Deploy on one of your starfighters. During any control phase, may target one opponent's capital starship present. Starfighter attaches to target (automatically moves with target and is 'concealed'). May detach at any time (even as target begins to move).
lore: Special modification for starfighters. Size may vary depending on mass of starship. Allows a stable connection to a spacedock, uneven terrain or even another starship.

name: Lando Calrissian
title: •Lando Calrissian
text: Deploys only on Cloud City. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When playing Sabacc, may subtract 1 from or add 1 to your total. If present at a site, can be replaced by opponent with any Light Side Lando.
lore: Scoundrel and gambler. Petty administrator of a small Tibanna gas mining operation. Easily coerced. Has problems of his own. Had dealings with the Tonnika Sisters - twice.

name: Lando Calrissian
title: •Lando Calrissian
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if piloting Falcon). Power +1 for every Cloud City location you control. When playing Sabacc, may add 1 to or subtract 1 from your total.
lore: Gambler. Scoundrel. Former owner of the Millennium Falcon. Despite a notorious past, has become a successful chief administrator of a Tibanna gas mining facility.

name: Lando Calrissian (V)
title: •Lando Calrissian (V)
text: Smuggler. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may take a character with 'Cloud City' in lore into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may use 1 Force to cancel the game text of a Dark Jedi (except Vader) at same site.
lore: Gambler. Scoundrel. Former owner of the Millennium Falcon. Despite a notorious past, has become a successful chief administrator of a Tibanna gas mining facility.

name: Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel
title: •Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel
text: Adds one battle destiny. If opponent initiates battle at same location, retrieve 1 Force and add its destiny number to Lando's power, or power of Falcon he is piloting. End of your turn: Use 1 Force to maintain OR Lose 2 Force to place in Used Pile OR Place out of play.
lore: With a silvery tongue or a rapid-fire blaster, Lando prides himself on being able to get out of tight situations. Is at his best when cornered.

name: Lando Calrissian, Vader's Broker
title: •Lando Calrissian, Vader's Broker
text: Once during opponent's turn, if with an Imperial on Cloud City, may activate 1 Force. Once during your turn, if with an alien on Cloud City, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Once per game, may place a non-[Immune to Alter] Effect in owner's Used Pile.
lore: Scoundrel and gambler. Petty administrator of a small Tibanna gas mining operation. Easily coerced. Has problems of his own. Had dealings with the Tonnika Sisters - twice.

name: Lando In Millennium Falcon
title: •Lando In Millennium Falcon
text: May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Lando, who provides ability of 3 and adds 3 to power. May not be piloted by Han unless he won a hand of sabacc this game. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Heavily modified Corellian YT-1300 freighter. 'She's the fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy.'

name: Lando System?
title: Lando System?
text: During your control phase, use 1 Force to move any one of your [Dagobah] icon characters of ability > 1 to any [Cloud City] icon location where you have presence. If moving to a Cloud City site, this movement is free and you do not need presence.
lore: 'Lando's not a system, he's a man.' Regardless of where Rebels flee, dark agents are sure to follow.

name: Lando With Blaster Pistol
title: •Lando With Blaster Pistol
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with your other alien on Cloud City. Permanent weapon is blaster pistol (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
lore: Smuggler, gambler and leader. 'Yeah, I'm responsible these days. It's the price you pay for being successful.'

name: Lando With Blaster Rifle
title: •Lando With Blaster Rifle
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Lando's Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value). During battle, if your total battle destiny is odd, may retrieve 1 Force (2 if total is 11).
lore: Works every time. Smuggler.

name: Lando With Vibro-Ax
title: •Lando With Vibro-Ax
text: Deploys -2 on Tatooine. When at a Tatooine site, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is vibro-ax (may target character for free; both players draw destiny; target excluded from battle if your destiny +4 > target's power + opponent's destiny).
lore: Gambler. Spy in Jabba's Court. Has walked the palace's passageways and overheard many details of Jabba's operations on Tatooine.

name: Lando's Blaster Rifle
title: •Lando's Blaster Rifle
text: Deploy on your Lando or use 3 Force to deploy on your other warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. If Lando targeting a character, target is power -2 for remainder of turn. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: Standard-issue Imperial blaster rifle appropriated by Lando from a stormtrooper. Used by Calrissian to pin down stormtroopers as he made his escape from Cloud City.

name: Lando's Not A System, He's A Man
title: •Lando's Not A System, He's A Man
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, may target a character present with [Cloud City] Lando. For remainder of turn, target is forfeit = 0. During battle on Cloud City, you may use X Force (maximum 3) to add X to your total battle destiny. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Lando Calrissian has quite a reputation amongst gamblers and smugglers. This is not always a good thing.

name: Lando's Wrist Comlink
title: •Lando's Wrist Comlink
text: Deploy on a character. When at a Cloud City site, Lobot and your Cloud City troopers may deploy or move here as a 'react.'
lore: Easily concealed device used by Lando to remain in contact with his subordinates. Directly connected to Cloud City's central computer.

name: Lando, Hero Of The Rebellion
title: •Lando, Hero Of The Rebellion
text: Adds one destiny to total power with Chewie or Jannah (or while piloting). During your turn, may reveal the top three cards of your Reserve Deck, take one starship with a deploy cost < 6 into hand (if possible), and shuffle your Reserve Deck.
lore: Leader. Resistance Agent.

name: Larma D'Acy
title: •Larma D'Acy
text: Finn and Poe are power +1 here. During your control phase, if with an opponent's spy, opponent loses 1 Force (2 if spy is Undercover). While Leia present at a battleground site, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back.
lore: Female commander. Leader.

name: Laser Cannon Battery
title: Laser Cannon Battery
text: Deploy on your capital starship. May deploy as a 'react'. May target a starship using X Force, where X = 0 to 3. Draw destiny. Subtract 2 if targeting a starship with maneuver. If destiny +X > defense value, target hit and opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Trade Federation battleships use concealed quad laser emplacements. Though their coverage is limited, the surprise factor and ferocious firing rate is often overwhelming.

name: Laser Gate
title: ••Laser Gate
text: Deploy between any two interior mobile sites. To pass, a character must have (power + ability) > 4 or use a Lift Tube (all other vehicles are blocked). Laser Gate defense value = 3; may be targeted (as if a character) by a character weapon from either site.
lore: Security corridors are guarded by a grid of laser emplacements which can be activated upon demand to seal off sensitive areas from intrusion.

name: Laser Projector
title: Laser Projector
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on an interior site. May target a seeker (use defense value = 1), character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny -1 > defense value. Laser Projector may be targeted by any weapon (use defense value = 1).
lore: Laser system activated by distress signal from guards. Used at security checkpoints and detention block control rooms. Targeting guided by centralized droid controller.

name: Lateral Damage
title: •Lateral Damage
text: Deploy on any system. Target an opponent's starship. Target's power and forfeit = 0. When target reaches Utinni Effect, target draws one destiny. Utinni Effect canceled if destiny > 2. Otherwise, draw again next move phase, etc.
lore: Starships can become damaged in combat and rendered ineffective until they can be repaired and re-outfitted.

name: Lathe
title: •Lathe
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If opponent has 2 or more aliens of the same title at this site, may place Lathe in Lost Pile to cause all of them to be lost. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to shuffle opponent's Reserve Deck.
lore: Was one of Jabba's vile Nikto henchmen. Leaving Tatooine to see what the galaxy has to offer. Deep down, he loathes the slave trade. Information broker.

name: Laudica
title: •Laudica
text: When in a battle, you may 'react' by deploying any one non-unique blaster (for free) on Laudica from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. When present with your non-unique Corellian at a site, allows your character weapons to transfer for free there.
lore: Corellian gun-runner. Skilled markswoman. Friends with Brindy Truchong and the Tonnika sisters. Romantically involved with Rayc Ryjerd, against her better judgment.

name: Launching The Assault
title: •Launching The Assault
text: Deploy on any system. Once per game, may take Home One into from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your Force drains are +1 at battleground systems where you have a Star Cruiser piloted by a character. Effecte canceled when Rendezvous Point on table. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: By recruiting the Mon Calamari, a race of master shipwrights, the Rebel starfleet gained capital starships rivaling the dreaded Imperial Star Destroyers.

name: Launching The Assault (V)
title: •Launching The Assault (V)
text: If your Endor (or Rebel Base) location on table, deploy on table. May deploy Home One or Sullust from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Home One is deploy = 8 to an [Endor] or [Death Star II] system and its power may not be reduced. Once per game, Home One may move as a 'react' to [Death Star II] Falcon's location (or vice versa). [Immune to Alter.]
lore: By recruiting the Mon Calamari, a race of master shipwrights, the Rebel starfleet gained capital starships rivaling the dreaded Imperial Star Destroyers.

name: LE-BO2D9 (Leebo)
title: •LE-BO2D9 (Leebo)
text: May be battled. While aboard any freighter adds 2 to hyperspeed and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If you have completed Rycar's Run or Kessel Run, opponent loses 1 Force (2 if both) during each of your control phases.
lore: Smuggler. Heavily modified Cybot Galactica LE-series repair droid. Information broker. Provides information gained through underworld channels to the Alliance.

name: Leave Them To Me
title: •Leave Them To Me
text: Plays on table. While you occupy a Subjugated planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains, and your Force drains may not be reduced. (Subjugated planet is defined on the Objective card Local Uprising.)
lore: 'I will deal with them myself.'

name: Leave Them To Me
title: •Leave Them To Me
text: Deploy on table. While you occupy a 'Subjugated' planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains and your Force drains may not be reduced. At any time, you may place Effect out of play to retrieve 1 Force.
lore: 'I will deal with them myself.'

name: Leesub Sirln
title: •Leesub Sirln
text: Once each turn during your control phase, may use 1 Force to guess a card type and point to a card in opponent's hand. Card must be shown. If guessed correctly, card is lost.
lore: Leesub is a Qiraash (near-human). Enslaved as child. Limited precognition. Selected by Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne as Force adept. Escaped and hiding in Mos Eisley.

name: Leesub Sirln (V)
title: •Leesub Sirln (V)
text: Once during your control phase, may use 1 Force to name a card type. Reveal top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. If that card matches the named card type, it is lost. Otherwise, replace it or move it to opponent's Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Leesub is a Qiraash (near-human). Enslaved as child. Limited precognition. Selected by Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne as Force adept. Escaped and hiding in Mos Eisley.

name: Legendary Starfighter
title: •Legendary Starfighter
text: If opponent just lost a starship in a battle you won, deploy on your participating starfighter. Once during each of opponent's move phases, opponent loses 1 Force (2 if starfighter is Falcon or Red 5). Also, that starfighter is power +2 (Immune to Control.)
lore: The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well.

name: Leia
title: •Leia
lore: Adopted daughter of the Viceroy and First Chairman of Alderaan. Became a political leader at a young age. The injustices of the New Order led her to join the Rebellion.

name: Leia (V)
title: •Leia (V)
text: While at opponent's Galactic Senate, Leia's game text may not be canceled and may lose 1 Force to place Leia and any character present out of play. During battle, may cancel game text of a leader of ability < 5 with Leia for remainder of turn.
lore: Adopted daughter of the Viceroy and First Chairman of Alderaan. Became a political leader at a young age. The injustices of the New Order led her to join the Rebellion.

name: Leia Of Alderaan
title: •Leia Of Alderaan
text: Deploy on Leia. While at any Rebel Base site, your Rebels, except unique (•) Rebels, are deploy -2 and power +2 at same and adjacent sites. While at any system, your starfighters, except unique (•) starfighters, are deploy -2 there.
lore: The face that launched a thousand starships.

name: Leia Of Alderaan (V)
title: •Leia Of Alderaan (V)
text: Deploy on Leia (or your female of ability < 4). Opponent may not cancel or reduce Force drains at same battleground. If on Leia, she is power +2 and, once per battle, may cancel the game text of an opponent's leader of ability < 4 here.
lore: The face that launched a thousand starships.

name: Leia Organa
title: •Leia Organa
text: Adds 1 to power of each Rebel present with her at a Death Star site. 'Diplomatic' immunity to attrition < 2.
lore: Strong-willed princess from Alderaan. Youngest Imperial Senator ever. Used diplomatic immunity to spy for Rebels. Led relief effort on Ralltir. Natural leader.

name: Leia Organa (V)
title: •Leia Organa (V)
text: Agenda: rebellion. May not be 'choked.' Gains [Republic] at Galactic Senate. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (if with an Imperial leader, may add one destiny to total power or attrition instead). 'Diplomatic' immunity to attrition < 3.
lore: Strong-willed princess from Alderaan. Youngest Imperial Senator ever. Used diplomatic immunity to spy for Rebels. Led relief effort on Ralltir. Natural leader.

name: Leia Seeker
title: Leia Seeker
text: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Leia (or warrior) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker is also lost.
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.

name: Leia With Blaster Rifle
title: •Leia With Blaster Rifle
text: Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Han. Permanent weapon is •Leia's Blaster Rifle (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
lore: Spirited leader. 'I am not a committee!'

name: Leia's Back
title: Leia's Back
text: If Leia is lost, use 1 Force to retrieve her from the Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take Leia into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.
lore: 'It's not over yet!'

name: Leia's Blaster Rifle
title: •Leia's Blaster Rifle
text: Deploy on your Leia or use 3 Force to deploy on your other warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. If hit by Leia, target is lost.
lore: Standard production blaster rifle issued at Echo Base. Modified by Rebel engineers for Leia's use. Has less recoil and a higher recharge rate.

name: Leia's Lightsaber
title: •Leia's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Leia (or Ben Solo or Rey) of ability > 4. Adds 1 to defense value and immunity to attrition. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Blank

name: Leia's Resistance Transport
title: •Leia's Resistance Transport
text: May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may deploy a female Resistance character aboard (deploy -2 if a leader).
lore: Blank.

name: Leia's Resistance Transport (AI)
title: •Leia's Resistance Transport (AI)
text: May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may deploy a female Resistance character aboard (deploy -2 if a leader).
lore: Blank.

name: Leia's Sporting Blaster
title: •Leia's Sporting Blaster
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Leia, or 2 on your warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny -1 > defense value. If hit by Leia, target's forfeit = 0.
lore: Defender sporting blaster, made by Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for personal defense or small-game hunting. Short range. Low power. Carries energy for 50 shots.

name: Leia, Rebel Princess
title: •Leia, Rebel Princess
text: Twice per game, may place top card of Lost Pile on top of Reserve Deck to cancel a Force drain at a related site. Unless opponent's non-alien character here, opponent's total ability at same site = 0. Immune to attrition < 5 if with Luke, Han or Jabba.
lore: After attracting Luke's attention and then Han's attention, Leia should not have been surprised when she got more attention than desired from Jabba.

name: Leslomy Tacema
title: •Leslomy Tacema
text: Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. While at Audience Chamber, adds 2 to the power bonus provided by Ellorrs Madak.
lore: Female Duros. Expert pilot. Helps run the docking facilities in Mos Eisley. Friends with Ellorrs Madak. Approves all cargo manifests. Forgiving of minor transgressions.

name: Leslomy Tacema (V)
title: •Leslomy Tacema (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. Smuggler. Adds 1 to hyperspeed of any freighter she pilots. Your total ability at same docking bay or system may not be reduced. Once per game, may deploy a card with 'Ellorrs' in title here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Female Duros. Expert pilot. Helps run the docking facilities in Mos Eisley. Friends with Ellorrs Madak. Approves all cargo manifests. Forgiving of minor transgressions.

name: Let The Wookiee Win
title: •Let The Wookiee Win
text: During a battle at a holosite, add one battle destiny. OR Target an opponent's character of ability < 5 present with your Wookiee that just participated in a battle you lost; character is Disarmed (power -1 and may no longer carry weapons). Stack on that character.
lore: 'It's not wise to upset a Wookiee.' 'But sir, nobody worries about upsetting a droid.' 'That's cause a droid don't pull people's arms out of their sockets when they lose.'

name: Let The Wookiee Win (V)
title: •Let The Wookiee Win (V)
text: USED: Subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny targeting your Wookiee's ability or defense value. STARTING: If your starting location had exactly two [Light Side], deploy a Kashyyyk location and three Effects that are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
lore: 'It's not wise to upset a Wookiee.' 'But sir, nobody worries about upsetting a droid.' 'That's cause a droid don't pull people's arms out of their sockets when they lose.'

name: Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge
title: Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge
text: Let Them Make The First Move: Deploy Theed Palace Generator Core, Theed Palace Generator, and Deep Hatred. {While} this side up, opponent may not Force drain where opponent has a Jedi, and your Force drains at Naboo sites where you have a Dark Jedi may not be canceled. Once during your control phase, may target one opponent's character present with your Dark Jedi at an interior Theed Palace site. Target is lost. {Flip} this card if an opponent's Jedi present at an interior Naboo battleground site. At Last We Will Have Revenge: {While} this side up, you may not Force drain or initiate battle at any location where you have a Dark Jedi. Once during your move phase, your Dark Jedi may initiate lightsaber combat against an opponent's Jedi present: Each player draws 2 destiny. Loser (lowest total) loses 2 Force (cannot be reduced). If difference is 5 or greater, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck, and losing character is lost. {Flip} this card and retrieve 1 Force if opponent has no Jedi present at any interior Naboo battleground.

back.title: Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge
back.text: Let Them Make The First Move: Deploy Theed Palace Generator Core, Theed Palace Generator, and Deep Hatred. {While} this side up, opponent may not Force drain where opponent has a Jedi, and your Force drains at Naboo sites where you have a Dark Jedi may not be canceled. Once during your control phase, may target one opponent's character present with your Dark Jedi at an interior Theed Palace site. Target is lost. {Flip} this card if an opponent's Jedi present at an interior Naboo battleground site. At Last We Will Have Revenge: {While} this side up, you may not Force drain or initiate battle at any location where you have a Dark Jedi. Once during your move phase, your Dark Jedi may initiate lightsaber combat against an opponent's Jedi present: Each player draws 2 destiny. Loser (lowest total) loses 2 Force (cannot be reduced). If difference is 5 or greater, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck, and losing character is lost. {Flip} this card and retrieve 1 Force if opponent has no Jedi present at any interior Naboo battleground.

name: Let's Go Left
title: •Let's Go Left
text: Non-pilot characters aboard starships are forfeit -4. Whenever a player's starship is 'hit', that player loses 1 Force (2 if starship was hit by Proton Torpedoes). At systems where you have only [Republic] starships, all of those starships are immune to attrition < 4. At sites related to a system you occupy, your battle destinies may not be canceled by opponent.

name: Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here
title: •Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here
text: Plays on table. While you occupy a Renegade planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains and your Force drains may not be reduced. (Renegade planet is defined on the Objective card Imperial Occupation.)
lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.

name: Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here
title: •Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here
text: Deploy on table. While you occupy a Renegade planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains and your Force drains may not be reduced. At any time, you may place Effect out of play to retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.

name: Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V)
title: •Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V)
text: Plays on table. Do They Have A Code Clearance? does not modify forfeit values. While you occupy a Renegade planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains, and your Force drains may not be reduced.
lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.

name: Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V)
title: •Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V)
text: Plays on table. Do They Have A Code Clearance? does not modify forfeit values. While you occupy a Renegade planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains, and your Force drains may not be reduced.
lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.

name: Levitation
title: Levitation
text: USED: Cancel Silence Is Golden or Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down. LOST: Search your Used Pile and take any one droid, device or Stone Pile you find there into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.
lore: Telekinesis is one of the powers awakened during a Jedi's apprenticeship. Using this ability, a student of the Force can learn to levitate objects.

name: Levitation Attack
title: •Levitation Attack
text: If a battle was just initiated where you have a character of ability > 3 present, search your Used Pile for one device which deploys on a character. Add device's destiny number to your total power, then place device on top of Used Pile.
lore: Vader used his mastery of the Force to levitate objects from around the room. This calculated attack was designed to break Luke's spirit as well as his body.

name: Liana Merian
title: •Liana Merian
text: Agendas: peace, trade. While in a senate majority, once during opponent's turn, target an opponent's just drawn battle destiny; opponent must use or lose 2 Force or that battle destiny = 0.
lore: Alderaanian senator. Known for her efforts to promote peace throughout the Republic by using her homeworld as an example.

name: Liberator
title: •Liberator
text: May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Phoenix Squadron pilots deploy -1 aboard. While at opponent's battleground system, Force drains here may not be reduced or canceled.
lore: Phoenix Squadron.

name: Libertine
title: •Libertine
text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. During your deploy phase, may relocate your character of ability < 4 aboard from a related exterior site. While BB-8, DJ, or Rose aboard, immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Liberty
title: •Liberty
text: May add 5 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 3 starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May go to Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when forfeited (unless 'hit').
lore: Winged star cruiser. Military transport for technical units. Afforced special care by the Alliance's top engineers.

name: Lieutenant Arnet
title: •Lieutenant Arnet
text: Deploys free aboard Blizzard Scout 1. Adds 2 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots (or 3 if an AT-ST). When piloting Tempest Scout 1, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Opponent may not 'react' to or from same site.
lore: Veteran AT-ST pilot assigned to coordinate the surprise counterattack in the Battle of Endor. Commanded a prototype AT-ST in General Veers' assault upon Hoth.

name: Lieutenant Arven Wendik
title: •Lieutenant Arven Wendik
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Bravo 3 at same system as a battleship, adds one destiny to attrition only.
lore: Bravo Squadron pilot who assisted in the attack at the battle of Naboo. Tactical expert of capital starship shield capabilities.

name: Lieutenant Blount
title: •Lieutenant Blount
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Tala 2, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. While he occupies any Coruscant location, Empire's Sinister Agents is flipped and ISB Operations may not be flipped.
lore: Wingman of Colonel Cracken. Spy and scout. Former agent of the Imperial Security Bureau. Defected and joined Rebel Intelligence. Seasoned combat veteran.

name: Lieutenant Cabbel
title: •Lieutenant Cabbel
text: Adds 2 to power of any starship he pilots. On Tyrant, also adds one to Armor. When in battle with an Imperial leader, subtracts 1 from opponent's total battle destiny.
lore: A recent graduate of the Officer's Candidate School on Carida. Serves as first officer of the Tyrant. Ambitious, ruthless and efficient.

name: Lieutenant Cecius
title: •Lieutenant Cecius
text: Deploys free to any Executor site. Power +3 when participating in a Besieged battle. During your control phase, may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one Besieged or Set For Stun into hand and reshuffle.
lore: Former member of the Imperial infantry. Specializes in boarding and taking control of enemy ships. Native of Vogel 7. Hasn't had a date in years.

name: Lieutenant Chamberlyn
title: •Lieutenant Chamberlyn
text: Deploys -1 to Naboo. Once per game may deploy a blaster on Chamberlyn from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once during your control phase, may target a battle droid present and draw destiny. If destiny > 3, target lost.
lore: Royal Naboo security officer who became a leader of the underground movement against the Trade Federation. Known for discovering and analyzing battle droid weaknesses.

name: Lieutenant Commander Ardan
title: •Lieutenant Commander Ardan
text: If at a site, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Immune to attrition < X, where X = the number of opponent's aliens present.
lore: Commander of Executor bridge pit crews. Native of Brentaal. Participated in the subjugation of Ithor, Kashyyyk, Firro, Sinton and other planets populated by non-humans.

name: Lieutenant Dedra Meero
title: •Lieutenant Dedra Meero
text: When deployed, may target an opponent's spy present to be power = 0 until end of turn. Once per turn, if an ISB agent on table, may place a card from hand on Used Pile; the next ISB agent you deploy this turn is deploy -1.
lore: Female ISB leader.

name: Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka
title: •Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to (and forfeit -2 at) same location as Kylo. During your deploy phase, may relocate Kylo from here to same site as a Resistance Agent.
lore: Blank.

name: Lieutenant Endicott
title: •Lieutenant Endicott
text: Deploys -2 to any docking bay or launch bay. While he is at Death Star II: Docking Bay, you may shuttle for free between here and exterior sites related to system Death Star II orbits.
lore: Docking bay technician. Orphan. Offered post on new Death Star when he graduated third in class from the Imperial Academy at Carida.

name: Lieutenant Greeve
title: •Lieutenant Greeve
text: Adds 1 to each of his character weapon destiny draws (characters he 'hits' are forfeit -3). When firing an A280 Sharpshooter Rifle, may fire repeatedly at same target for 2 Force each time.
lore: Scout. Famous guide who was recruited for Madine's commando unit from the forests of Kashyyyk. Sharpshooter who uses one of the BlasTech rifles brought by Corporal Janse.

name: Lieutenant Grond
title: •Lieutenant Grond
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots or any swoop he drives. When in battle at an exterior site, adds 2 to attrition against opponent for each of your biker scout/trooper (non-biker scout) pairs present.
