lore: Colonel Dyer's aide. Coordinates scout actions. As a youth, raced swoops on homeworld of Corellia. Formerly served with Emperor's Demonstration Team.

name: Lieutenant Hebsly
title: •Lieutenant Hebsly
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Scythe 3, once per turn may subtract 1 from maneuver of one opponent's starfighter at same location for remainder of turn.
lore: Served in Anoat sector. Uses excellent maneuverability of TIE/ln to his advantage in combat.

name: Lieutenant Kaydel Connix
title: •Lieutenant Kaydel Connix
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Your shuttling, landing, and taking off to or from here is free. Once per game, may use 1 Force to take Evacuation Control, a [Resistance] bomber, or a [Resistance] transport into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Female.

name: Lieutenant Lepira
title: •Lieutenant Lepira
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 4 during battle, adds one destiny to total power only. When at Anoat system, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.
lore: Piloted Gold 4 at the Battle of Yavin. Learned to fly a starfighter by racing through the Anoat system.

name: Lieutenant Naytaan
title: •Lieutenant Naytaan
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 9 during battle, adds one destiny to total power only. When at Clak'dor VII system, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.
lore: Piloted Red 9 at the Battle of Yavin. Led the relief effort of Clak'dor VII in the Mayagil sector. Became an 'ace' in only two missions.

name: Lieutenant Page
title: •Lieutenant Page
text: Adds 1 to each of your battle destiny draws when with Derlin, Cracken or Madine at a site (or when with at least two of your other scouts at an exterior planet site). Your Rebel scouts deploy -1 to same exterior site (except Rebel Landing Site).
lore: Scout who served under General Veers' command. Defected and was recruited by General Madine's commando organization. Works closely with Colonel Cracken.

name: Lieutenant Renz
title: •Lieutenant Renz
text: Power +2 while present with a stormtrooper. You Rebel Scum target a Rebel at same site is a Used Interrupt and is immune to Sense. Immune to attrition < number of stormtroopers present.
lore: Leader of one of the Emperor's finest legions of troops. His command was placed at the disposal of Colonel Dyer. Always on the lookout for Rebel activity.

name: Lieutenant Rya Kirsch
title: •Lieutenant Rya Kirsch
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard Bravo 4, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and opponent's droid starfighters are deploy +2 at same system.
lore: Became a member of Bravo Flight after embarrassing himself in front of Amidala as a guard. Has redeemed himself by becoming an expert in defense aviation tactics.

name: Lieutenant s'Too Vees
title: •Lieutenant s'Too Vees
text: When in battle at a site with Lando or Marmor, adds one destiny to total power only. When he is at a docking bay, once during each of your deploy phases, you may deploy one starship weapon from Reserve Deck on your starfighter present; reshuffle.
lore: Dock mechanic. Installs starfighters cannons. Gambler. Followed Lando from Cloud City. Turned down assignment in rear guard to work on General Calrissian's starship.

name: Lieutenant Sheckil
title: •Lieutenant Sheckil
text: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one Human Shield into hand and reshuffle. When escorting a captive, captive is forfeit +2 and Sheckil is immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Former warrant officer from Concord Dawn. Promoted due to superb performance. Specializes in transporting high-profile criminals. Twin brother of a famous mercenary.

name: Lieutenant Suba
title: •Lieutenant Suba
text: While at a Death Star or Executor site, your troopers deploy free there and are power and forfeit +1 there, and you may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Tactical Support into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.
lore: Chief of security and political officer on Executor. Responsible for ensuring the loyalty of his fellow officers. Disapproved of Vader's unwillingness to simply kill Skywalker.

name: Lieutenant Tanbris
title: •Lieutenant Tanbris
text: Deploy -1 for starship weapons of any starship he pilots. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Subtracts 1 from maneuver of any starfighter he pilots.
lore: Former fighter pilot grounded after injury. Tactical officer aboard Death Star. Competent strategist. Specializes in directing Imperial starfighters.

name: Lieutenant Tarn Mison
title: •Lieutenant Tarn Mison
text: Deploys -1 aboard your unique (•) Rebel starfighter. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When starfighter he pilots fires a starship weapon, characters aboard target are forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.
lore: Former Imperial pilot. Joined the Alliance shortly after the Battle of Yavin. Flew cover for Bright Hope during the evacuation of Hoth. Expert marksman.

name: Lieutenant Telsij
title: •Lieutenant Telsij
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When at a system, sector or docking bay, once during each of your deploy phases, subtracts 2 from deploy cost of your unique (•) Y-wing deploying there.
lore: One of only four attackers who survived the raid on the Imperial Academy at Carida. Gray Squadron pilot.

name: Lieutenant Venka
title: •Lieutenant Venka
text: Power +2 when at an Executor site or same site as Tarkin or Chief Bast, or if the Death Star has been 'blown away.' Fear Will Keep Them In Line is destiny +2 and, when it adds 1 to your power, also adds 1 to attrition against opponent.
lore: Worked hard for a transfer to the Executor. One of the many noncommissioned personnel promoted to replace the vast number of officers lost during the Death Star disaster.

name: Lieutenant Venka (V)
title: •Lieutenant Venka (V)
text: Deploys -1 to Executor. While aboard a capital starship, adds 1 to armor and its defense value may not be reduced. If Fear Will Keep Them In Line here and your Imperial just won a battle at a related site, opponent loses 2 Force.
lore: Worked hard for a transfer to the Executor. One of the many noncommissioned personnel promoted to replace the vast number of officers lost during the Death Star disaster.

name: Lieutenant Watts
title: •Lieutenant Watts
text: Adds 2 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. Adds 1 to each weapon destiny draw of any combat vehicle he pilots (or 2 if on Tempest Scout 2 or if present with Marquand).
lore: Native of Corulag. Watts' gunnery skills produce devastating results. Temporarily assigned to Kuat Drive Yards to work on prototype AT-ST weaponry.

name: Lieutenant Williams
title: •Lieutenant Williams
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Radiant VII and you have no other starships at same system, unless opponent has total ability > 6 piloting here, opponent's total battle destiny here is -3.
lore: Pilot of the Radiant VII. Was personally requested by Captain Madakor to assist in the transportation of the Jedi ambassadors.

name: Life Day
title: •Life Day
text: When drawn for destiny, if three Wookiees and/or Ewoks on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.
lore: Wookiees are known to be fierce warriors. Combine high technology with a primitive lifestyle. Escaped Imperial slavery after the Battle of Endor.

name: Life Debt
title: •Life Debt
text: If Han and Chewie are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take Falcon into hand, and reshuffle. OR If Han is defending a battle alone, you may 'react' by deploying Chewie there (for free) from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'I'm all right, pal. I'm all right.'

name: Lift Tube
title: Lift Tube
text: May carry 4 passengers. Deploy and move only at interior mobile sites. May move without presence aboard. Also, may move as a 'react' only to a battle or Force drain (if within range).
lore: System of enclosed high-speed vertical and horizontal transport cylinders. Used in space stations, large starships, Death Stars, etc.

name: Lift Tube
title: Lift Tube
text: May carry 4 passengers. Deploy and move only at interior mobile sites. May move without presence aboard. Also, may move as a 'react' only to a battle or Force drain (if within range).
lore: System of enclosed high-speed vertical and horizontal transport cylinders. Used in space stations, large starships, Death Stars, etc.

name: Lift Tube Escape
title: •Lift Tube Escape
text: If opponent just initiated a battle, one of your Lift Tubes present may move as a 'react' from that battle. OR Place one of your unoccupied Lift Tubes on table in your Used Pile. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take one Lift Tube into hand and reshuffle.
lore: First floor: parasols and powdered blue milk. Second floor: bantha skin rugs, bog-wing drapes and juri juice tables. Third floor: a squadron of Imperial stormtroopers.

name: Light Maneuvers
title: Light Maneuvers
text: Cancel Dark Maneuvers, Emergency Deployment, Lone Pilot, I Want That Ship, Defensive Fire, Rogue Asteroid or Take Evasive Action. OR Double Special Modifications until end of turn.
lore: Rookie TIE pilots often fail to grasp the gravity of their situation and are easily lured into compromising positions.

name: Light Repeating Blaster Rifle
title: Light Repeating Blaster Rifle
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior. If your power droid or fusion generator present, may target a character, creature or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. May fire repeatedly for 2 Force each time.
lore: BlasTech model T-21 light repeating blaster. Excellent power, good range. Carries energy for 25 shots. Unlimited firepower when attached to a power generator.

name: Lightmaker
title: •Lightmaker
text: Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When in battle, adds 1 to attrition against opponent for each opponent's starship present. Cancels opponent's immunity to attrition here.
lore: Phoenix Squadron.

name: Lightsaber Deficiency
title: Lightsaber Deficiency
text: Cancel Lightsaber Proficiency. OR Target a character with ability < 4 using a lightsaber in a battle or a Force drain. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > ability. Lightsaber lost if destiny = ability.

name: Lightsaber Parry
title: •Lightsaber Parry
text: USED: If a battle was just initiated where you have a character armed with a lightsaber, characters may not be targeted by lightsabers for remainder of battle. LOST: If opponent just initiated a duel, opponent must choose to lose 4 Force or cancel the duel.
lore: Vader had to show Luke that giving in to the dark side of the Force was his only destiny.

name: Lightsaber Proficiency
title: •Lightsaber Proficiency
text: Deploy on your character with ability > 2 and a lightsaber. That character is power +3 in battles or may add 1 to Force drain where present. Effect is lost if character loses lightsaber.
lore: A Jedi learns not only to wield a lightsaber, but how to channel the Force to increase skill and control the lightsaber's damage.

name: Like My Father Before Me
title: •Like My Father Before Me
text: If an Endor site on table, deploy on table. [Death Star II] Luke is deploy = 6 and may not be Disarmed. If Luke is at a battleground (even as a captive), your battle destiny draws are +1 there and, once during your turn, may deploy Luke's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or place a card from hand on Force Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The final act of Luke's ascension to Jedi Knighthood was sending off his father, draped in the garb of Vader.

name: Like My Father Before Me (AI)
title: •Like My Father Before Me (AI)
text: If an Endor site on table, deploy on table. [Death Star II] Luke is deploy = 6 and may not be Disarmed. If Luke is at a battleground (even as a captive), your battle destiny draws are +1 there and, once during your turn, may deploy Luke's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or place a card from hand on Force Pile. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: The final act of Luke's ascension to Jedi Knighthood was sending off his father, draped in the garb of Vader.

name: Limited Resources
title: •Limited Resources
text: If the opponent has two cards or less in hand, opponent must immediately lose 2 Force (4 Force if it is your turn). If the opponent has Fusion Generator Supply Tanks aboard a starship, loss is reduced by 2.
lore: The Empire dominates consumption of resources. Despite being efficient, Rebel logistical and maintenance officers often are compelled to expend emergency reserves.

name: LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)
title: LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)
text: At any time during your turn, may use 1 Force to 'defuse' (lose) any one mine at same site.
lore: Representative of armored mining/demolition droids. Converted for military duty. Sets and defuses mines and explosives. LIN-V8K was refurbished by Jawas.

name: LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)
title: LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)
text: At any time during your turn, may use 1 Force to 'defuse' (lose) any one mine at same site.
lore: Armored military droid which specializes in laying explosive mines. Originally intended to set charges inside ore and spice mines, but has also been converted for military use.

name: Lirin Car'n
title: •Lirin Car'n
text: For each other musician present, adds a 'cover charge' of 1 to the Force required to move or deploy each character to same site.
lore: Bith mercenary. Male back-up to Kloo Horn player in Figrin D'an's band. Only musician, besides Doikk, who has not lost ownership of his instrument to Figrin.

name: Liswarr
title: •Liswarr
text: May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While Wookiee Homestead on table: deploy -1, power +2, immune to attrition < 5 and, if Liswarr at Kashyyyk, your total power is +2 at Kashyyyk sites.
lore: Blank.

name: Little Real Power
title: •Little Real Power
text: During any control phase, target an opponent's character with politics present with your senator at Galactic Senate. For remainder of turn, target's game text is canceled and target is politics = 0.
lore: 'He is mired by baseless accusations of corruption.'

name: Lobel
title: Lobel
text: Subtracts 2 from forfeit of each opponent's pilot at same site. Prevents characters from moving to or from same or adjacent site using Elis Helrot or Nabrun Leids.
lore: Powerful magnetic fields in the Lobel physiology make the operation of nearby navigation devices impossible. Pilots claim these fields also produce headaches.

name: Lobot
title: •Lobot
text: Deploys only as a 'react' to a Cloud City site or to where your Lando is present. When present at a Scomp link, power +2 and opponent's total power is -2 at same site. Your Cloud City Troopers deploy free and are power +1 at same Cloud City site.
lore: Former criminal. Fitted with a cybernetic device. Now repays his debt to society by ensuring the smooth running of Cloud City. Becomes disoriented when not with a computer.

name: Lobot
title: •Lobot
text: Deploys only on Cloud City. Power +2 when present at a Scomp Link. If present at a site, can be replaced by opponent with any Light Side Lobot. While present on Cloud City with your Lando, prevents replacement of Lobot and Lando.
lore: Son of a traveling slaver. Helps run Cloud City with Administrator Lando Calrissian. Speech capability worn away by constant cyborg neural connection.

name: Lobot (V)
title: •Lobot (V)
text: Deploys free to Cloud City or a site with a scomp link. If a battle was just initiated at same site, may deploy an alien here (free if Lando) as 'react' from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May deploy Cyborg Construct on Lobot from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Former criminal. Fitted with a cybernetic device. Now repays his debt to society by ensuring the smooth running of Cloud City. Becomes disoriented when not with a computer.

name: Lobot, Lando's Broker
title: •Lobot, Lando's Broker
text: Deploys free to Cloud City. Your characters of ability < 5 at same Cloud City site are immune to Clash Of Sabers, may not be targeted to be lost during the weapons segment of a battle, and during your move phase, may use 1 Force to relocate to a related site.
lore: Son of a traveling slaver. Helps run Cloud City with Administrator Lando Calrissian. Speech capability worn away by constant cyborg neural connection.

name: Local Defense
title: •Local Defense
text: Take one cloud car or [Independent] starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at a sector where none of your ability comes from Rebels or Rebel starships, add one battle destiny.
lore: Even seasoned smugglers respect a well-planned, well-armed defense.

name: Local Defense & •Put That Down
title: •Local Defense & •Put That Down
text: Take an [Independent] starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your starship (or non-Jedi character) is about to be captured or lost during the weapons segment of a battle, it is hit instead and may not be captured or lost until the damage segment. OR If opponent just played an Interrupt during battle, activate 2 Force.

name: Local Trouble
title: Local Trouble
text: Use 1 Force at the beginning of your battle phase to allow any two of your Stormtroopers in the Cantina to battle any one opponent's character (your choice). You may add one battle destiny. No other battles may occur in Cantina this turn.
lore: 'Look like somebody's beginning to take an interest in your handiwork.' Imperial stormtroopers coerce local residents to assist them in the apprehension of Rebel scum.

name: Local Uprising / Liberation
title: Local Uprising / Liberation
text: Local Uprising: Deploy any planet system and one <> site to that system. This system is the Subjugated planet. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, you may deploy one <> site to the Subjugated planet from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if your matching operatives control at least three battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet. Liberation: {While} this side up, opponent's Force drains are -1. You may retrieve 1 Force whenever you deploy a matching operative to the Subjugated planet. Your matching operatives on that planet are each forfeit +2 and, when at the same site as an Imperial or AT-AT, are each power +2. When you have at least one matching operative in a battle on the Subjugated planet, you may add one battle destiny. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy at least two battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet.

back.title: Local Uprising / Liberation
back.text: Local Uprising: Deploy any planet system and one <> site to that system. This system is the Subjugated planet. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, you may deploy one <> site to the Subjugated planet from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if your matching operatives control at least three battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet. Liberation: {While} this side up, opponent's Force drains are -1. You may retrieve 1 Force whenever you deploy a matching operative to the Subjugated planet. Your matching operatives on that planet are each forfeit +2 and, when at the same site as an Imperial or AT-AT, are each power +2. When you have at least one matching operative in a battle on the Subjugated planet, you may add one battle destiny. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy at least two battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet.

name: Location, Location, Location
title: •Location, Location, Location
text: Deploy on table. At the end of each player's deploy phase, if they did not deploy a location, they lose 1 Force. Effect canceled if any player deploys three or more locations in a single turn.
lore: 'Mudhole? Slimy? My home this is!'

name: Loci Rosen
title: •Loci Rosen
text: Power +X in a battle at a site, where X equals the number of cards in opponent's hand. During your deploy phase, opponent may place any number of cards in their hand in their Used Pile.
lore: Good-willed Mon Calamari merchant. Looking for work. Unfortunately, everywhere he goes he comes up empty handed.

name: Logistical Delay
title: •Logistical Delay
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on opponent's side of table. All opponent's TIEs are deploy +1.
lore: The Empire's tremendous military machine requires extensive coordination at every level. Slight errors in any step can quickly escalate supply delays.

name: Logray
title: •Logray
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each Light side icon at same Endor site. When on Endor, adds 1 to total battle destiny wherever you have any Ewok at an Endor site.
lore: Ewok tribal shaman and medicine man. Musician. Wears the skull of a great Churi bird. Suspicious of outsiders. Revered for his wisdom.

name: Loje Nella
title: •Loje Nella
text: While at Audience Chamber, suspends Gailid's and Mosep's game text and allows you to activate 1 Force whenever you Force drain with an alien.
lore: Accountant. Descended from a species of cliff boring worms. Reluctant assistant to Mosep. Purposefully mismanages funds to obstruct Jabba's nefarious activities.

name: Lone Pilot
title: •Lone Pilot
text: If your pilot (or permanent pilot) is defending a battle alone at a system or sector, add one battle destiny. OR If Motti is defending a battle alone at a system or sector, add two battle destiny.
lore: One lone TIE fighter, acting as a scout near the Death Star, suddenly encountered the Millennium Falcon.

name: Lone Rogue
setName: Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two Player Game
title: Lone Rogue
text: If one of your pilots is at an exterior Hoth site, use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one T-47 into hand. OR If your piloted T-47 is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny.
lore: The pilots at the Rebel Base on Hoth are trained to respond quickly to the Empire's forces. Many Rebels feel that they could take on the whole Empire themselves.

name: Lone Rogue (V)
title: Lone Rogue (V)
text: LOST: If your [Hoth] objective on table, take Dack or Wes into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If a [Hoth] objective on table, deploy Echo Base Garrison and two Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: The pilots at the Rebel Base on Hoth are trained to respond quickly to the Empire's forces. Many Rebels feel that they could take on the whole Empire themselves.

name: Lone Warrior
title: •Lone Warrior
text: If any warrior is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny. OR If Tagge is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny.
lore: Though generally deployed in squads, all Imperial warriors are trained in the close combat techniques and have a reputation for ferocity when cornered.

name: Look Sir, Droids
title: Look Sir, Droids
text: Use 1 Force to search through the opponent's Used Pile and move any droids you find there to opponent's Lost Pile. OR Use X Force to destroy any one droid on table where X = droid's deploy cost.
lore: Trooper 1124, Davin Felth, discovered droid plating dropped by R2- D2 and C-3PO when exiting escape pod.

name: Lor San Tekka
title: •Lor San Tekka
text: If you just deployed BB-8 or a Resistance leader to same or related location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. During your control phase, one of your other Resistance characters present may make a regular move.
lore: Information broker. Leader.

name: Lor San Tekka (AI)
title: •Lor San Tekka (AI)
text: If you just deployed BB-8 or a Resistance leader to same or related location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. During your control phase, one of your other Resistance characters present may make a regular move.
lore: Information broker. Leader.

name: Lord Maul
title: •Lord Maul
text: Deploys -2 to Naboo. While with Qui-Gon, your battle destinies here are each +1. When Maul wins a lightsaber combat, adds 2 to opponent's Force loss. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5 (or < 6 if armed with a lightsaber). May not be Disarmed.
lore: Sent by Darth Sidious to Naboo in order to assist the Trade Federation in their blockade there. His confrontation with Obi-Wan and Qui-Gon would impact history forever.

name: Lord Maul With Lightsaber
title: •Lord Maul With Lightsaber
text: Permanent weapon is •Maul's Lightsaber (may add 1 to Force drain where present; adds 1 to your battle destiny draws here; may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
lore: Trade Federation.

name: Lord Sidious
title: •Lord Sidious
text: Once per game, may take Always Two There Are or a Neimoidian into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If alone (or a [Theed Palace] objective on table) and opponent just initiated battle here, may exclude one character of ability < 6 present. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader. Trade Federation.

name: Lord Sidious (ALT)
title: •Lord Sidious (ALT)
text: Once per game, may take Always Two There Are or a Neimoidian into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If alone (or a [Theed Palace] objective on table) and opponent just initiated battle here, may exclude one character of ability < 6 present. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader. Trade Federation.

name: Lord Vader
title: •Lord Vader
text: Deploys -2 to Executor, Death Star II or Endor. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While armed with a lightsaber, adds 2 to his defense value and 1 to each of his lightsaber weapon destiny draws. Immune to Uncontrollable Fury and attrition < 6.
lore: Forgiving administrator of Imperial policy. Emperor Palpatine's most trusted leader. Believes converting Skywalker is key to the Alliance's downfall.

name: Losing Track
title: •Losing Track
text: USED: During battle, place top card of opponent's Lost Pile on top of their Reserve Deck. LOST: Use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer. OR Target a Podracer. Draw destiny. If destiny > Podracer's destiny number, target is 'damaged.'
lore: 'Wha-? Chuba da noya!'

name: Lost In Space
title: Lost In Space
text: If a pilot was just lost from a system or sector, deploy on that location and stack pilot here. Pilot may be rescued or captured by any capital starship present here during any move phase, and may be targeted by weapons (except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with defense value = 0). Lost if no pilot here.
lore: Congratulations on purchasing the TIE/ln starfighter by Sienar. Equipped with a jettison device and distress beacon, it should provide you with years of worry-free subjugation.

name: Lost In The Wilderness
title: •Lost In The Wilderness
text: Cancel a Force drain at an exterior planet site where opponent has no vehicles or starships. Draw destiny. If destiny > number of opponent's characters at that site, choose one of those characters to be missing.
lore: Survival training becomes essential when an Imperial Scout trooper is separated from his speeder bike.

name: Lost Relay
title: Lost Relay
text: Target one opponent's starfighter present with one of your starships at an asteroid sector, before asteroid destiny is drawn this turn. If target lost this turn due to asteroid destiny, opponent also loses Force equal to target's forfeit value.
lore: Asteroid fields require starfighters to act as comm relays, forwarding orders to the squadron via subspace AE-35 Transceivers. If ships are lost, communications break down.

name: Lothal
title: •Lothal
text: Dark: While you occupy, gains one [Dark Side] icon. Light: Piloted Rebel starships here are power and forfeit +1 and immune to Gravity Shadow.

name: Lothal
title: •Lothal
text: Light: Once per game, may simultaneously deploy Ghost and Hera here from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Thrawn and Pryce deploy -1 (and shuttle for free) to here. While Lothal converted, gains one [Dark Side] icon.

name: Lothal: Advanced Projects Laboratory
title: •Lothal: Advanced Projects Laboratory
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy TIE Defender Project, Pryce, or Thrawn here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Opponent may not reduce or cancel your Force drains here.

name: Lothal: Capital City
title: •Lothal: Capital City
text: Dark: Rukh, Imperials, AT-DPs, AT-STs, and speeder bikes are power and defense value +1 here. Light: While you occupy, your Imperial Complex game text is canceled.

name: Lothal: Capital City
title: •Lothal: Capital City
text: Light: If a player controls, their total power is +2 at related locations. Dark: May deploy Thrawn here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Lothal: Comm Tower E-272 (Ezra's Roost)
title: •Lothal: Comm Tower E-272 (Ezra's Roost)
text: Light: Ezra deploys -1 (and is immune to attrition) here. Dark:

name: Lothal: Imperial Complex
title: •Lothal: Imperial Complex
text: Dark: If you control with a leader, once per battle at a related site, you may deploy a card as a `react'. Light: Unless you occupy, your spies may not deploy here.

name: Lothal: Imperial Strip Mines
title: •Lothal: Imperial Strip Mines
text: Dark: If your miner present, your Force generation is +2 here. Light: If you control, your Force generation is +1 here.

name: Lothal: Jedi Temple
title: •Lothal: Jedi Temple
text: Light: Ezra and Kanan deploy -1 here. Unless you occupy, Vader may not deploy here and opponent's characters, vehicles, and starships deploy and move to here for +2 Force. Dark:

name: Lothal: Tarkintown
title: •Lothal: Tarkintown
text: Light: During battle here, Sabine or Zeb may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Dark: Unless Tarkin here, Force drain -1 here.

name: Lott Dod
title: •Lott Dod
text: Agendas: ambition, blockade, trade. While in a senate majority, once during your control phase, may search your Force Pile and take any one card there into hand; reshuffle. While at Galactic Senate, your other Neimoidians are forfeit +2.
lore: Primary Neimoidian senator who represents the Trade Federation in the Galactic Senate. Thwarted attempts by Amidala to end the blockade of Naboo.

name: Lt. Pol Treidum
title: •Lt. Pol Treidum
text: While at Docking Control Room 327, adds 2 to your total power at Docking Bay 327. Once during each of your control phases, if at same site as an Undercover spy, may draw destiny. Spy's 'cover is broken' if destiny = spy's ability.
lore: Gantry officer charged with maintaining magnetic field, atmosphere and security in Death Star docking bay. After mission on Ralltiir, paranoid about infiltration by Rebel spies.

name: Lt. Pol Treidum (V)
title: •Lt. Pol Treidum (V)
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed (or leaves table), may draw top card of Reserve Deck or Used Pile. During battle, attrition against you is -1 for each ISB agent here (limit -3). Your spies here (unless Undercover) are immune to Double Agent.
lore: Gantry officer charged with maintaining magnetic field, atmosphere and security in Death Star docking bay. After mission on Ralltiir, paranoid about infiltration by Rebel spies.

name: Lt. Poldin Lehuse
title: •Lt. Poldin Lehuse
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if piloting a [First Order] TIE, may target an opponent's capital starship at same system. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, choose one pilot character aboard target to be forfeit = 0 for remainder of battle.
lore: Blank.

name: Lt. Shann Childsen
title: •Lt. Shann Childsen
text: Power +2 when at Detention Block Corridor or Detention Block Control Room. Also, power +2 when an opponent's alien is present (+3 if alien is a Wookiee, Talz or Ewok).
lore: Demoted after a superior blamed him for a clerical error. Considered a bully by fellow officers. Fanatically supports the New Order doctrine of alien subjugation.

name: Lucky Shot
title: Lucky Shot
text: Add X to one weapon destiny (before weapon destiny is drawn) when targeting a combat vehicle. USED: X = 1. LOST: X = 3.
lore: AT-ATs are nearly impervious to infantry fire, but occasionally a blaster bolt hits between the plating. It's one shot in a million, but such odds are a familiar to the Rebellion.

name: Luke
title: •Luke
text: Must deploy on Tatooine, but may move elsewhere. May not be deployed if two or more of opponent's unique (•) characters on table. Your warriors at same site as Luke, or adjacent sites are forfeit +1.
lore: Raised by guardians Owen and Beru Lars on a moisture farm on Tatooine, where Owen wanted him to stay. Nicknamed 'Wormie' by childhood friends Camie and Fixer.

name: Luke Seeker
title: Luke Seeker
text: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Luke of ability < 4 or pilot of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker is also lost.
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.

name: Luke Skywalker
title: •Luke Skywalker
text: While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.

name: Luke Skywalker (V)
title: •Luke Skywalker (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle or retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.

name: Luke Skywalker (V) (ALT)
title: •Luke Skywalker (V) (ALT)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle or retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.

name: Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight
title: •Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight
text: Deploys -3 to Home One or Endor. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +2 when armed with a lightsaber. Subtracts 3 from any attempt to cross him over (even if captured). Immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if alone or armed with a lightsaber, < 7 if both).
lore: Scout trained in the ways of the Force. Key figure for both the Alliance and the Empire. Desired by Vader as an ally, by Palpatine as a servant and by the Alliance as its savior.

name: Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout
title: •Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout
text: May cancel immunity to attrition of any vehicle here. If escorted by Vader and Take Your Father's Place on table, during your move phase may relocate Vader (with Luke) to Death Star II: Throne Room. Immune to Always Thinking With Your Stomach and Attrition < 5.
lore: Resourceful scout and member of the Rebel infiltration team assembled to destroy the shield generator. Surrendered to his father so that he would not endanger the mission.

name: Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V)
title: •Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Power +1 for each Dark Jedi here. Luke's weapon destiny draws are +1. At same site, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon. Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Resourceful scout and member of the Rebel infiltration team assembled to destroy the shield generator. Surrendered to his father so that he would not endanger the mission.

name: Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize / Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize
title: •Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize / Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize
text: This is a Dark Side card and does not count toward your deck limit. Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. Deploys to Death Star II: Throne Room only at start of game as a frozen captive if Bring Him Before Me on table and Your Destiny is suspended; otherwise place out of play. {For} remainder of game, may not be placed in Reserve Deck. This is a persona of Luke only while on table. {While} this side up, Bring Him Before Me may not flip. May not be escorted. {Flip} this card if Vader present and not escorting a captive. {Place} out of play if released or about to leave table.

back.title: •Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize / •Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize
back.text: {Immediately} 'thaw' Luke (Luke is non-frozen, captured, and seized by Vader). {While} this side up, subtracts 3 from attempts to cross Lule over (even while a captive). {Place} out of play if released or about to leave table.

name: Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi
title: •Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi
text: Never deploys to a site opponent occupies. Deploys -2 to Ahch-To. Once per turn, may take Force Projection into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny to cause a re-draw. Immune to attrition.
lore: Blank.

name: Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi (ALT)
title: •Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi (ALT)
text: Never deploys to a site opponent occupies. Deploys -2 to Ahch-To. Once per turn, may take Force Projection into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny to cause a re-draw. Immune to attrition.
lore: Blank.

name: Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope
title: •Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If armed with a blaster or rifle at a site (or piloting Red 5), may add one destiny to total power or attrition. Run Luke, Run! is a Used Interrupt. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Blank.

name: Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope (AI)
title: •Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope (AI)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If armed with a blaster or rifle at a site (or piloting Red 5), may add one destiny to total power or attrition. Run Luke, Run! is a Used Interrupt. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Blank.

name: Luke With Lightsaber
title: •Luke With Lightsaber
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Luke's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
lore: 'I've taken care of everything.'

name: Luke's Back
title: Luke's Back
text: If Luke is lost, use 1 Force to retrieve him from the Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take Luke into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.
lore: 'It looks like I'm going nowhere.'

name: Luke's Backpack
title: •Luke's Backpack
text: Deploy on any character. May carry and use any number of devices. May also carry Yoda, Kabe or any one Jawa or Ewok (as if riding a creature vehicle). Adds 1 to training destiny when carrying the Mentor.
lore: Made on Dantooine. Luke used the many pockets in his gundark-skin backpack to carry supplies while on patrol.

name: Luke's Bionic Hand
title: •Luke's Bionic Hand
text: Deploy on Luke. Luke's power and immunity to attrition are +2. Once per game, during battle, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt in Lost Pile. This device lost if Luke Disarmed.
lore: Uses state-of-the-art digital processors. Although Luke had lost his hand, the Alliance could rebuild it. They had the technology. They could make it better, stronger, faster.

name: Luke's Blaster Pistol
title: •Luke's Blaster Pistol
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Luke, 3 on a warrior. May target a character, creature, or vehicle using 2 Force. If targeted by Luke, target loses any immunity to attrition until end of turn. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a character or creature. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Merr-Sonn Model 57. Part of an arms lot purchased for the Alliance from a black market dealer on Ord Mantell. Carried by Luke as a backup for his father's lightsaber.

name: Luke's Blaster Pistol (V)
title: •Luke's Blaster Pistol (V)
text: Deploy on non-Jedi Luke. May target a character for free. Target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn. Draw destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. If about to be lost, may lose 1 Force to place on bottom of Used Pile.
lore: Merr-Sonn Model 57. Part of an arms lot purchased for the Alliance from a black market dealer on Ord Mantell. Carried by Luke as a backup for his father's lightsaber.

name: Luke's Cape
title: •Luke's Cape
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on a Rebel or alien. If Luke's Cape is not at a Tatooine location, your total Force generation is +1. That character is immune to attrition < 3.
lore: A symbol of the adventurous pilot and the awakening of his destiny. 'You've taken your first step into a larger world.'

name: Luke's Hunting Rifle
title: •Luke's Hunting Rifle
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Luke or Owen Lars, 3 on your non-droid character. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting a character. Add 2 if targeting a creature. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Czerka 6-2Aug2. Extended barrel provides long-range targeting without expensive laser sight. Sturdy construction, but no match for a Tusken Raider's gaderffii stick.

name: Luke's Hunting Rifle (V)
title: •Luke's Hunting Rifle (V)
text: Deploy on your alien or Rebel. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, if destiny +2 > defense value. If hit by Luke or Owen, target's forfeit = 0 and you retrieve 1 Force. Once during your move phase, may fire at a Jawa or Undercover spy.
lore: Czerka 6-2Aug2. Extended barrel provides long-range targeting without expensive laser sight. Sturdy construction, but no match for a Tusken Raider's gaderffii stick.

name: Luke's Lightsaber
title: •Luke's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Luke. Adds 1 to defense value and training destiny. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character, creature, speeder bike, or swoop for free. Draw 2 destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0 if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Weapon of a truly powerful warrior. Constructed by Luke as part of his training.

name: Luke's T-16 Skyhopper
title: •Luke's T-16 Skyhopper
text: Requires 1 pilot to use. May carry 1 passenger. May move as a 'react.' may 'bullseye' one Womp Rat per turn. *Landspeed = 4, OR 1 character may shuttle to or from same site for free.
lore: Enclosed vehicle used by Luke Skywalker for his early pilot training. Often raced with Biggs Darklighter through Beggar's Canyon.

name: Luke's X-34 Landspeeder
title: •Luke's X-34 Landspeeder
text: May add 1 driver and 2 passengers. Moves free if Luke aboard. May move as a 'react.'
lore: Skywalker's SoroSuub. Common open-air transport. Top speed 250 km per hour. Repulsorlift drive keeps it suspended one meter above ground, even when parked.

name: Luke? Luuuuke!
title: •Luke? Luuuuke!
text: Deploy on any Tatooine site. Target any Rebel. Target is power and forfeit -1 (-3 if target is Luke). If Rebel's forfeit reaches zero, Rebel is lost. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: 'All right. I'll be right there, Aunt Beru.'

name: Lumat
title: •Lumat
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each Light side icon at same Endor site. When on Endor, adds 1 to total weapon destiny whenever you have any Ewok using an Ewok weapon at an Endor site.
lore: Ewok archer. Wood carver. Tribal elder that advises Chief Chirpa. Crafts and maintains weapons.

name: Luminous
title: •Luminous
text: Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 1 pilot and 6 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May use Covert Landing like a shuttle or starfighter (even while landed).
lore: Medium transport with boosted hyperdrive. Armor and capacity diminished. Crew trained for reconnaissance and swift intergalactic transport.

name: Lyn Me
title: •Lyn Me
text: Subtracts 1 from deploy cost of Bounty hunters at same site (Boba Fett deploy free). During battle, subtracts X from opponent's total power, where X = number of your musicians present (+2 if battling Luke or Han, or +4 if both).
lore: Twi'lek musician whose village hired Boba Fett for protection from slavers. Fell in love with the famous mercenary. Vowed to kill Luke and Han.

name: M'iiyoom Onith
title: •M'iiyoom Onith
text: Once during each of your control phases, may reveal opponent's hand by using X Force, where X = number of cards in opponent's hand. All unique (•) male Rebels and unique (•) male aliens there are lost.
lore: Female H'nemthe, a species whose females ritually kill their mates. Stranded on Tatooine due to questionable passage tax. Razor-sharp tongue. M'iiyoom means, 'nightlilly'.

name: M-HYD 'Binary' Droid
title: M-HYD 'Binary' Droid
text: Adds 2 to forfeit of each non-droid character at same and adjacent sites. At any time, any player may use 1 Force to turn M-HYD off (face down) or on again (face up).
lore: Pretentious hydroponics droid. Specializes in working with binary load lifters and vaporators. Proficient in a number of languages but prefers to converse only in binary.

name: Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach
title: •Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may take a TIE Defender into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While piloting, opponent may not cancel or substitute battle destiny draws here. While piloting an Imperial starfighter, it is maneuver +2 and he draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: Leader.

name: Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (ALT)
title: •Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (ALT)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may take a TIE Defender into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While piloting, opponent may not cancel or substitute battle destiny draws here. While piloting an Imperial starfighter, it is maneuver +2 and he draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: Leader.

name: Mace Windu
title: •Mace Windu
text: Deploys +3 to any location except Jedi Council Chamber. While at Jedi Council Chamber, immune to attrition and once during your control phase, if Amidala at a battleground site and Maul not on table, opponent loses 2 Force.
lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.

name: Mace Windu (AI)
title: •Mace Windu (AI)
text: Deploys +3 to any location except Jedi Council Chamber. While at Jedi Council Chamber, immune to attrition and once during your control phase, if Amidala at a battleground site and Maul not on table, opponent loses 2 Force.
lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.

name: Mace Windu (V)
title: •Mace Windu (V)
text: During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Fetts may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition <6 (<8 if with a Dark Jedi).
lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.

name: Mace Windu (V) (AI)
title: •Mace Windu (V) (AI)
text: During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Fetts may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition <6 (<8 if with a Dark Jedi).
lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.

name: Mace Windu (V) (C-Slip AI 2)
title: •Mace Windu (V) (C-Slip AI 2)
text: During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Fetts may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition <6 (<8 if with a Dark Jedi).
lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.

name: Mace Windu (V) (C-Slip AI)
title: •Mace Windu (V) (C-Slip AI)
text: During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Fetts may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition <6 (<8 if with a Dark Jedi).
lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.

name: Mace Windu's Lightsaber
title: •Mace Windu's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Mace. May add 1 to Force drain where present. Mace may add 1 to his duel total. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. 'This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster.' A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.

name: Mace Windu's Lightsaber (AI)
title: •Mace Windu's Lightsaber (AI)
text: Deploy on Mace. May add 1 to Force drain where present. Mace may add 1 to his duel total. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. 'This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster.' A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.

name: Mace Windu, Jedi Master
title: •Mace Windu, Jedi Master
text: Deploys -2 on Naboo. While on Naboo, once during your control phase may use 1 Force to cancel Maul's immunity to attrition for remainder of turn. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while on Naboo).
lore: Jedi Council member who is known to be one of the strongest members of the Council. Has come to Naboo to investigate the death of the mysterious 'dark warrior.'

name: Mace Windu, Jedi Master (AI)
title: •Mace Windu, Jedi Master (AI)
text: Deploys -2 on Naboo. While on Naboo, once during your control phase may use 1 Force to cancel Maul's immunity to attrition for remainder of turn. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while on Naboo).
lore: Jedi Council member who is known to be one of the strongest members of the Council. Has come to Naboo to investigate the death of the mysterious 'dark warrior.'

name: Macroscan
title: Macroscan
text: Use 2 Force to deploy near opponent's Reserve Deck. At any time, you may use 1 Force to peek at the top card of that deck. If 'nighttime conditions' exist anywhere on table, you may peek at the top three cards.
lore: Electrobinocular view. Readouts list object's true and relative azimuth, elevation and range. Built-in night vision.

name: Madakor In Radiant VII
title: •Madakor In Radiant VII
text: May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Madakor, who provides ability of 2. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak' (or reset your total battle destiny) here. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Optimized for diplomatic missions with sensor-proof pods that have ejection capabilities. Easily identified by its red coloration.

name: Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth
title: •Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth
text: While present at a battleground site and you control more systems than opponent, Force drain +1 here. Power and defense value +2 while Thrawn at a system with a parsec number > 5. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Female leader.

name: Magnetic Suction Tube
title: Magnetic Suction Tube
text: Deploy on your Sandcrawler. Once during each of your control phases, may target one character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's ability, 'suck up' character (relocate to related interior Sandcrawler site or owner's Used Pile).
lore: 'Slurp.'

name: Magnetic Suction Tube
title: Magnetic Suction Tube
text: Deploy on your sandcrawler. Once during each of your control phases, may target one character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's ability, 'suck up' character (relocate to related interior Sandcrawler site or owner's Used Pile).
lore: Retractable tube originally designed to collect mined materials for transport to refining facilities. Jawas now use it to suck up droids (and anything else that's not nailed down).

name: Main Course
title: •Main Course
text: USED: Cancel Frozen Assets. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: If opponent's alien and Rebel are in battle together without a protocol droid, draw one destiny (or two if Rebel is Han) and subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power.
lore: Threepio always tried to be polite to Captain Solo and to keep him from getting hot under the collar.

name: Major Bren Derlin
title: •Major Bren Derlin
text: While on Hoth, opponent may not 'react' to any Echo site, and Derlin may use 1 Force to cancel Breached Defenses. While at Cantina, power +1 and may use 1 Force to cancel Local Trouble.
lore: Hero of Nentan. Supervised construction of Echo Base on Hoth. Head of base security. At the Mos Eisley Cantina, everyone knows his name.

name: Major Bren Derlin (V)
title: •Major Bren Derlin (V)
text: Scout. Deploys free to (and power +2 at) Cantina, Endor, or Hoth. Opponent may not 'react' to or from here. Once per game, may retrieve an Explosive Charge into hand.
lore: Hero of Nentan. Supervised construction of Echo Base on Hoth. Head of base security. At the Mos Eisley Cantina, everyone knows his name.

name: Major Caluan Ematt
title: •Major Caluan Ematt
text: May deploy -2 as a react to an [Episode VII] site. At the end of each turn, you must use 2 Force, lose 2 Force, or return Ematt to your hand.
lore: Blank.

name: Major Haash'n
title: •Major Haash'n
text: Deploys -2 to any Star Cruiser. Adds 2 to the power of any capital starship he pilots. When piloting a Star Cruiser, adds 1 to hyperspeed and armor and cancels Lateral Damage targeting a starship at same system.
lore: Mon Calamari master engineer. Joined the Alliance to fulfill his personal goal of piloting star cruisers.

name: Major Harter Kalonia
title: •Major Harter Kalonia
text: Resistance characters here may not have their forfeit reduced. If you just forfeited a 'hit' non-droid character from same or related site, may lose 1 Force to place that character in Used Pile.
lore: Female.

name: Major Hewex
title: •Major Hewex
text: Adds 1 to total power for each of your troopers present at same site. When on Endor, subtracts 1 from total for Deactivate The Shield Generator and your troopers are forfeit +1 on Endor. When at Bunker, allows Imperials to deploy there as a 'react'.
lore: Leader of Navy detachment assigned to guard the Endor control bunker. Liaison between Imperial technicians and command staff.

name: Major Marquand
title: •Major Marquand
text: Adds 3 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. When piloting a combat vehicle with Watts, may add one battle destiny and, if that vehicle has immunity to attrition, adds 2 to immunity.
lore: Directed a counterattack against the Ewoks on Endor. Formerly crewed an AT-AT assigned to Devastator. Originally from Kessel.

name: Major Mianda
title: •Major Mianda
text: Adds 3 to power of any TIE he pilots. Adds 2 to total weapon destiny of any TIE/ln he pilots.
lore: Commander of a TIE squadron assigned to defend the second Death Star during construction. Hand picked pilots to serve with him.

name: Major Olander Brit
title: •Major Olander Brit
text: Power and forfeit +1 while present with Major Panno. When with Major Panno at a site, adds one battle destiny. When present with a Scomplink, cancels Counter Assault at a related site where you have a spy or scout.
lore: Communications expert. Staff monitors entire spectrum of electromagnetic signals. Politically minded. Followed Panno to the Alliance.

name: Major Palo Torshan
title: •Major Palo Torshan
text: Deploys -2 on a Rebel Base. While at your war room, adds 1 to your Attack Run total. Once during each of your control phases, may use 1 Force to take one Double Agent or Sabotage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Coordinator of Rebel base security. Served under General Dodonna at Yavin 4. Sat in on conferences planning the Battle of Yavin. Developed counterintelligence techniques.

name: Major Panno
title: •Major Panno
text: While at a system or an exterior battleground site, allows you to activate up to 2 additional Force for each related exterior battleground site you occupy with a scout (limit 4 additional Force).
lore: Male Dresselian scout. Former commando. Tactician. Works with General Madine to plan logistics of strike operations.

name: Major Panno (V)
title: •Major Panno (V)
text: Opponent may not 'react' to same site. Your scouts here are immune to Trample. Once per turn, if [Set 21] Strike Planning on table, may place a card from hand on Used Pile; the next scout you deploy this turn is deploy -1.
lore: Male Dresselian scout. Former commando. Tactician. Works with General Madine to plan logistics of strike operations.

name: Major Partagaz
title: •Major Partagaz
text: When deployed, may shuffle any player's Reserve Deck, Lost Pile, or Used Pile. ISB agent leaders at same and related sites (or at all locations while Partagaz present at a Coruscant site) are power and defense value +1.
lore: ISB leader.

name: Major Rhymer
title: •Major Rhymer
text: Deploys -2 aboard Scimitar 1. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a bomber making a Bombing Run, prevents opponent's characters at same site from using landspeed.
lore: Leader of Scimitar Squadron, the elite bomber wing assigned to defend the Endor shield generator from any ground assault.

name: Major Taslin Brance
title: •Major Taslin Brance
text: If opponent just looked at cards in their deck or pile, after replacing, you may peek at the top card of that deck or pile. At the start of your control phase, if the top card of your lost pile is a Resistance character or [Restistance] starship, opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Blank.

name: Major Turr Phennir
title: •Major Turr Phennir
text: Adds 3 to power of any TIE he pilots. When piloting Saber 2, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Once per game, you may take Fighters Coming In into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Executive officer of the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing. Older brother killed by Wedge Antillies at the Battle of Yavin.

name: Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred
title: •Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred
text: If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Nightfall is canceled. Saw is a spy. Rebel spies deploy -1 to Scarif. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Blank.

name: Makurth
title: Makurth
text: When in a battle at a site, may use 2 Force (or 1 Force if you initiated the battle) to 'scream' (add one destiny to your total power only). Immune to attrition < 4 under 'nighttime conditions.'
lore: A fierce race of nocturnal carnivores from Moltok. Charge into battle with a terrifying scream. Often find employment as bodyguards for Black Sun.

name: Malachor
title: •Malachor
text: Light: While you control with a Phoenix Squadron character, Vader is power -2 and his weapon destiny draws are -1. Dark: While you control, Ezra is power -2 and may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny.

name: Malachor: Sith Temple Entrance
title: •Malachor: Sith Temple Entrance
text: Dark: You initiate battles here for free. Unless you occupy, Inquisitors deploy -1 here. Light: Once per game, you may deploy a Padawan (except Anakin) here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Malachor: Sith Temple Gateway
title: •Malachor: Sith Temple Gateway
text: Dark: [Set 13] Maul ignores [Set 13] objective deployment restrictions here. Light: Opponent's weapons here may not target Ezra.

name: Malachor: Sith Temple Upper Chamber
title: •Malachor: Sith Temple Upper Chamber
text: Dark: Force drain +1 here. While Vader alone here, he is power +2. Light: While Ahsoka alone (or with Ezra) here, she is power +2.

name: Malakili
title: •Malakili
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. During your control phase, may snare (steal) one creature or unoccupied creature vehicle present. Creatures at same site (except Sarlacc) do not attack and cannot be attacked.
lore: Corellian. Worked for Circus Horrificus. Disapproves of Jabba's treatment of the rancor. Plotting with Lady Valarian to steal the immense beast away from Jabba's palace.

name: Malastare
title: •Malastare
text: Dark: If you control, during your control phase may deploy Watto's Box (regardless of your current race total). Light: If you control, may use 4 Force to cancel Watto's Box.

name: Malastare
title: •Malastare
text: Light: If you have won a Podrace, Force drain +1 here. Dark: If you have lost a Podrace, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.

name: Malastare (V)
title: •Malastare (V)
text: Dark: If you control Podrace Arena, Force drain +1 here. Light: If opponent controls Podrace Arena, Force drain -1 here.

name: Mandalore
title: •Mandalore
text: Light: If your Mandalorian here, Force drain +1 here (+2 if armed with Darksaber). Dark: If your character armed with Darksaber on table, opponent may not deploy (or Force drain) here.

name: Mandalorian Armor
title: •Mandalorian Armor
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on any Imperial or alien (except Vader or Boba Fett). Character is power +2, has armor = 5 and is immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Contains wrist lasers, rocket dart launchers, a flame projector, a projectable grappling hook, a concussion grenade launcher, four kinds of sensors and a broad band antenna.

name: Mandalorian Mishap
title: •Mandalorian Mishap
text: If Boba Fett is defending a battle, draw one battle destiny. Subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero). OR Cancel, for the remainder of the turn, the game text of Jet Pack or any weapon that may fire repeatedly.
lore: Most space-faring adventurers meet their fate with a calm, quiet dignity.

name: Mandalorian Mishap (V)
title: •Mandalorian Mishap (V)
text: Cancel the game text of Jodo or any Fett for remainder of turn. OR Take Sabine, Under Attack, or a blaster into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During a battle, if opponent just drew more than two battle destiny, cancel one of those destiny draws (your choice).
lore: Most space-faring adventurers meet their fate with a calm, quiet dignity.

name: Maneuver Check
title: •Maneuver Check
text: Deploy on Death Star:Trench. Opponent must make maneuver check for starfighters leaving the trench. For each starfighter, owner draws destiny. If destiny + maneuver < 5, starfighter is lost.
lore: 'Luke, at that speed will you be able to pull out in time?'

name: Maneuvering Flaps
title: Maneuvering Flaps
text: Deploy on your side of table. Once during each of your control phases, may use 1 Force: your combat vehicles and shuttle vehicles are power and forfeit +2, maneuver +1 and landspeed=0 until start of your next turn. (Immune to Alter if Luke or Zev on table.)
lore: Enhanced steering mechanisms on Rebel T-47s provide increased maneuverability in planetary atmospheres.

name: Maneuvering Flaps (V)
title: Maneuvering Flaps (V)
text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to take its matching pilot character (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. May not be suspended (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Enhanced steering mechanisms on Rebel T-47s provide increased maneuverability in planetary atmospheres.

name: Mantellian Savrip
title: •Mantellian Savrip
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on your side of table (free if C-3PO on table). After losing any battle: characters, starships and vehicles may be forfeited directly from your hand (for forfeit value) to reduce attrition or battle damage.
lore: Dejarik game uses mythological and real creatures from across the galaxy. The hulking Mantellian savrip is a nasty predator from Ord Mantell.

name: Mapuzo: Mining Village
title: •Mapuzo: Mining Village
text: Light: Your miners are power +1 here. Once per game, may deploy Tala Durith here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: While Vader or an Inquisitor present, your Force drains here may not be modified.

name: Mapuzo: Safehouse
title: •Mapuzo: Safehouse
text: Light: The first Jedi you deploy here each turn is immune to Imperial Barrier. Dark: Unless Third Sister here, Force drain -1 here.

name: Mapuzo: Underground Corridor
title: •Mapuzo: Underground Corridor
text: Light: During your move phase, Jedi survivors may move from here to a Jabiim site (or to opponent's battleground site). Dark: Blank.

name: Mara Jade
title: •Mara Jade
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. While Luke or Talon Karrde on table, power +1 and she moves for free. Anakin's Lightsaber may deploy on your Mara. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Female smuggler.

name: Mara Jade In VT-49 Decimator
title: •Mara Jade In VT-49 Decimator
text: May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Mara Jade, who provides ability of 5. While alone and piloted by an Imperial, adds one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Blank.

name: Mara Jade With Lightsaber
title: •Mara Jade With Lightsaber
text: While Luke or Emperor on table, power +1 and she moves for free. Permanent weapon is •Mara Jade's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
lore: Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's palace.

name: Mara Jade's Lightsaber
title: •Mara Jade's Lightsaber
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force Drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: As part of her training to become the Emperor's hand, Mara Jade learned from Palpatine himself how to effectively fight with a lightsaber.

name: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
title: •Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Power +2 if Emperor on table. May be targeted by Vader's Obsession and Epic Duel instead of Vader. Once per game, may deploy a weapon on her from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Spy. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's palace.

name: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)
title: •Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)
text: Functions as your apprentice. Battle destiny draws may not be added here. May deploy Mara Jade's Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just won a battle here, may retrieve a card with 'Mara' in game text. Immune to Rebel Barrier and attrition < 4 (< 5 if Luke on table).
lore: Spy. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's palace.

name: Margo
title: •Margo
text: Once during opponent's deploy phase, may use 1 Force to choose: 'break cover' of opponent's Undercover spy here or draw destiny; if destiny = number of opponent's characters at same site, to initiate battle here this turn requires +1 Force.
lore: Female Imroosian. Crimson Dawn.

name: Marquand In Blizzard 6
title: •Marquand In Blizzard 6
text: May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Marquand, who provides ability of 2. Cards Blizzard 6 hits are power and forfeit -2 and may not apply ability towards drawing battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Enclosed. Death Squadron.

name: Mas Amedda
title: •Mas Amedda
text: Agenda: order. If with Valorum, your Force generation at this location is +1. While in a senate majority, once during your control phase, if you occupy a battleground site and a battleground system, opponent loses 2 Force.
lore: Chancellor's Chagrian advisor who maintains order in the Senate. Although Senator Palpatine suggested he may be on the Trade Federation's payroll, nothing has been proven yet.

name: Masanya
title: •Masanya
text: Deploys -4 to same system as any non-unique Star Cruiser. May add 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Cannot be 'hit' by missiles.
lore: Frequently escorts Mon Calamari star cruisers. Personally assigned by Ackbar to main Rebel fleet. Advanced scanners continuously disrupt target acquisition signals.

name: Masanya (V)
title: •Masanya (V)
text: Deploys -2 to same system as any Star Cruiser. May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Weapon destinies targeting your starships here are -2.
lore: Frequently escorts Mon Calamari star cruisers. Personally assigned by Ackbar to main Rebel fleet. Advanced scanners continuously disrupt target acquisition signals.

name: Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million
title: Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million
text: Massassi Base Operations: Deploy Yavin 4 system and Yavin 4: Docking Bay. {For} remainder of game, you may not play Revolution or Force drain at Yavin 4 sites or sectors. {While} this side up, you generate no more than 1 Force from each Yavin 4 site. Once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one Yavin 4 site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each Imperial is deploy +2 to Yavin 4. {Flip} this card if you control three Yavin 4 sites and opponent controls fewer than three Yavin 4 sites. {Place} out of play if Yavin 4 is 'blown away.' One In A Million: {While} this side up, may deploy Death Star system without completing Death Star Plans. Once during each of your deploy phases, may take one Rebel Tech, Death Star system, Attack Run or Proton Torpedoes into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power is +3 in battles at systems. If Death Star is 'blown away,' adds 3 to Force lost for each opponent's Death Star site and, for remainder of game, your Force drains at battleground systems where you have a starfighter present with a pilot character aboard are each +2.

back.title: Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million
back.text: Massassi Base Operations: Deploy Yavin 4 system and Yavin 4: Docking Bay. {For} remainder of game, you may not play Revolution or Force drain at Yavin 4 sites or sectors. {While} this side up, you generate no more than 1 Force from each Yavin 4 site. Once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one Yavin 4 site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each Imperial is deploy +2 to Yavin 4. {Flip} this card if you control three Yavin 4 sites and opponent controls fewer than three Yavin 4 sites. {Place} out of play if Yavin 4 is 'blown away.' One In A Million: {While} this side up, may deploy Death Star system without completing Death Star Plans. Once during each of your deploy phases, may take one Rebel Tech, Death Star system, Attack Run or Proton Torpedoes into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power is +3 in battles at systems. If Death Star is 'blown away,' adds 3 to Force lost for each opponent's Death Star site and, for remainder of game, your Force drains at battleground systems where you have a starfighter present with a pilot character aboard are each +2.

name: Master Kenobi
title: •Master Kenobi
text: While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi (except Yoda) or [Permanent Weapon] cards; if a Rebel in battle, may use 1 Force to add 3 to your total power (5 if Luke); once per turn, may deploy a battleground that is related to a location on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter.' The inner consciousness of a Jedi can transcend even death.

name: Master Luke
title: •Master Luke
text: Deploys -2 on Tatooine. Power -2 when present with Vader. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When in battle, may target one opponent's alien present. Draw destiny. Target returns to opponent's hand if destiny > ability. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Until being reunited with Yoda, Luke suspected that he had completed his training. Has a strong influence on the weak minded.

name: Master Luke (V)
title: •Master Luke (V)
text: While alone at a site, unless opponent's character of ability > 3 here, reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0. Once per game, may deploy a lightsaber on Luke from Lost Pile. Opponent's aliens deploy +1 to same site. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Until being reunited with Yoda, Luke suspected that he had completed his training. Has a strong influence on the weak minded.

name: Master Qui-Gon
title: •Master Qui-Gon
text: Deploys -2 on Coruscant. If opponent's Dark Jedi on table, during your move phase may use 4 Force to return Qui-Gon (and all cards on him) to owner's hand. Immune to attrition and You Are Beaten.
lore: Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.

name: Master Qui-Gon (AI)
title: •Master Qui-Gon (AI)
text: Deploys -2 on Coruscant. If opponent's Dark Jedi on table, during your move phase may use 4 Force to return Qui-Gon (and all cards on him) to owner's hand. Immune to attrition and You Are Beaten.
lore: Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.

name: Master Qui-Gon (V)
title: •Master Qui-Gon (V)
text: Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition.
lore: Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.

name: Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI)
title: •Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI)
text: Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition.
lore: Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.

name: Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend
title: •Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend
text: While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi (except Jedi Council members) or Rebels; Jedi are destiny +1; your total power in battles is +1 for each Jedi 'communing'; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Force Pile.
lore: Blank.

name: Master Qui-Gon With Lightsaber
title: •Master Qui-Gon With Lightsaber
text: Permanent weapon is •Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
lore: The lightsaber is an extremely versatile weapon, making a Jedi a rather difficult opponent to slow down. 'This is impossible!'

name: Master Sidious
title: •Master Sidious
text: While alone on Coruscant, your apprentice is immune to attrition. During your move phase, if on Coruscant, may use 1 Force to relocate to your apprentice's site. Once per game, may take Hyperwave Scan, Unlimited Power!, or Young Fool into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader. Trade Federation.

name: Master Windu
title: •Master Windu
text: During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Power +1 for each opponent's character of ability < 2 here. Your clones are forfeit +1 here. Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Jedi Council member.

name: Master Windu (ALT)
title: •Master Windu (ALT)
text: During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Power +1 for each opponent's character of ability < 2 here. Your clones are forfeit +1 here. Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Jedi Council member.

name: Master Yoda
title: •Master Yoda
text: While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi Knights, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards; your immunity to attrition is limited to < 4; once per turn, may deploy a battleground with two [Dark Side] from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; once per game, may retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Blank.

name: Master, Destroyers!
title: •Master, Destroyers!
text: USED: Target a character at same site as two of your destroyer droids. For remainder or turn, target may not fire weapons and is power -2. LOST: Lose 1 Force to take up to three non-unique destroyer droids into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Shields protect destroyer droids from incoming or deflected blaster fire. Starfighter cannons, on the other hand, can cause some problems.

name: Masterful Move
title: •Masterful Move
text: Use 1 Force to take one hologram, dejarik or Imperial holotable into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Mantellian Savrip. OR Cancel opponent's Force drain at a holosite.
lore: A skillful hologamer nullifies the advantage of even the most powerful game piece with clever maneuvering.

name: Masterful Move & •Endor Occupation
title: •Masterful Move & •Endor Occupation
text: Cancel Tatooine Celebration, Cloud City Celebration, or Coruscant Celebration. (Immune to Sense.) OR Use 1 Force to take one hologram, dejarik, or Imperial Holotable into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Mantellian Savrip. OR Cancel opponent's Force drain at a holosite.

name: Maul
title: •Maul
text: Never deploys to a battleground. Once per turn, may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn battle destiny or blaster weapon destiny. Battle destiny draws may not be canceled where you have a non-unique blaster. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Crimson Dawn leader. Gangster.

name: Maul (Holo AI)
title: •Maul (Holo AI)
text: Never deploys to a battleground. Once per turn, may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn battle destiny or blaster weapon destiny. Battle destiny draws may not be canceled where you have a non-unique blaster. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Crimson Dawn leader. Gangster.

name: Maul In Scimitar
title: •Maul In Scimitar
text: May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Maul, who provides ability of 6. Once per battle, may lose 1 Force to 'cloak' (either add one destiny to total power or make this starship immune to attrition < 6).
lore: Maul's Sith Infiltrator.

name: Maul Strikes
title: Maul Strikes
text: If Maul in battle with a Jedi, add one battle destiny (two if Jedi is Qui- Gon). OR Use 1 Force to take any lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Target a Jedi present with Maul; they duel: Both players draw 2 destiny. Loser (lowest total) is lost.
lore: A Sith needs no introduction.

name: Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber
title: •Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Maul. Adds 1 to Maul's lightsaber combat total. May lose 1 Force to add 2 to Force drain where present. Twice per battle, may target a character. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total > defense value. While on Maul, may not be stolen.
lore: Maul's double-bladed lightsaber is two lightsabers fused into one that requires years of training wield properly. Like its mysterious owner, this weapon hasn't been seen for a millennia.

name: Maul's Electrobinoculars
title: •Maul's Electrobinoculars
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on Maul. At any time you may use 1 Force to peek at the top card of your Force Pile. You may move that card to the top of your Reserve Deck.
