lore: Advanced optics used by Darth Maul to help track Queen Amidala. Image enhancement features allow for better sensor readings.

name: Maul's Lightsaber
title: •Maul's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Maul. While on Maul, may not be stolen. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Trained in the Sith arts, Maul's ferocity in combat is matched by no other. When armed with a lightsaber, his opponent's only option is usually that of escape.

name: Maul's Sith Infiltrator
title: •Maul's Sith Infiltrator
text: May add 2 pilots. Maul deploys -3 aboard. While Maul piloting, immune to attrition and during your move phase, may lose 2 Force to 'cloak' (does not participate in battles) until end of next turn.
lore: One of Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratories' prototype designs. Equipped with advanced weaponry and a full-effect stygium-based cloaking device for invisibility on command.

name: Maul's Sith Infiltrator (AI)
title: •Maul's Sith Infiltrator (AI)
text: May add 2 pilots. Maul deploys -3 aboard. While Maul piloting, immune to attrition and during your move phase, may lose 2 Force to 'cloak' (does not participate in battles) until end of next turn.
lore: One of Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratories' prototype designs. Equipped with advanced weaponry and a full-effect stygium-based cloaking device for invisibility on command.

name: Max Rebo
title: •Max Rebo
text: Power +2 on Hoth. If at same site as another of you musicians, you may play Bith Shuffle to cancel a Force drain at an adjacent site. While at Audience Chamber, all your other musicians are deploy -1 and forfeit +3.
lore: Ortolan musician and gambler. Head of The Max Rebo Band. Signed a lifetime contract to Jabba in exchange for unlimited food.

name: Maz Kanata
title: •Maz Kanata
text: Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. Opponent's total battle destiny is -1 here. During your turn, may reveal the top three cards of your Reserve Deck, take one alien into hand (if possible), and shuffle your Reserve Deck.
lore: Female information broker and leader.

name: Maz's Castle: Antechamber
title: •Maz's Castle: Antechamber
text: Light: Once per game, may deploy an [Episode VII] alien here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Force drain -1 here. While you control, Dobra Doompa is suspended.

name: Maz's Castle: Hidden Recess
title: •Maz's Castle: Hidden Recess
text: Light: Once per game, if you control, may retrieve a weapon or device into hand. Dark: Instead of Force draining here, may retrieve a weapon or device.

name: Mechanical Failure
title: •Mechanical Failure
text: Deploy on an exterior site. Target an opponent's combat vehicle at a related site. Target's power and forfeit = 0. When target reaches Utinni Effect, target draws one destiny. Utinni Effect canceled if destiny > 2. Otherwise, draw again next move phase, etc.
lore: The massive war machines of the Empire require tremendous effort to maintain combat readiness.

name: Meditation
title: •Meditation
text: Deploy on your character of ability > 3 (Effect lost if that character battles this turn). On a subsequent turn, if in a battle at a site, character's total weapon destiny is +3 and character adds one battle destiny. Effect lost at the end of that battle.
lore: To prepare for the inevitable conflict with Jabba's minions, Luke entered a calm state of mental preparation.

name: Meditation (V)
title: •Meditation (V)
text: Deploy on your character of ability > 3. Opponent's aliens here are power -1 (and forfeit -2 if a leader, [Maintenance], or [Permanent Weapon] card). During battle at same site, if opponent has more characters participating than you, may add one battle destiny (then lose Effect at end of battle).
lore: To prepare for the inevitable conflict with Jabba's minions, Luke entered a calm state of mental preparation.

name: Medium Bulk Freighter
title: Medium Bulk Freighter
text: Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 2 pilots, 6 passengers and 1 vehicle. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Has ship-docking capability. Quad Laser Cannon may deploy aboard.
lore: Modern Corellian design. Length 100 meters. Features engine system similar to that of a Corellian corvette. Dorsal hatch reveals hangar bay.

name: Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon
title: Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon
text: Deploy on a site. May be moved by two warriors for 1 additional Force. Your warrior present may target up to two characters or two creatures at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw two destiny. Target(s) hit if total destiny > total defense value.
lore: Merr-Sonn Mark II repeating blaster. Accepts power cells from a very wide variety of sources, a benefit for Rebels accustomed to scavenging for supplies.

name: Medium Transport
title: Medium Transport
text: May add 1 pilot, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
lore: Passenger and cargo transport built by Gallofree Yards. Enormous cargo bays can be outfitted to safely accommodate large numbers of troops, munitions or supplies.

name: Melas
title: •Melas
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +2 under 'nighttime conditions.' Immune to attrition < X, where X = number of your aliens present (including himself).
lore: Sarkan smuggler. Smokes an Essoomian gruu pipe to heighten awareness. Exiled from his home planet of Sarka for displaying curiosity in other aliens. Misses his homeworld.

name: Melas (V)
title: •Melas (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Your StarSpeeders are destiny +2 and move for free. Once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to 'smoke pipe' (for remainder of turn, Melas is power and defense value +2 and may not move).
lore: Sarkan smuggler. Smokes an Essoomian gruu pipe to heighten awareness. Exiled from his home planet of Sarka for displaying curiosity in other aliens. Misses his homeworld.

name: Menace Fades
title: •Menace Fades
text: Deploy on table. While you control any three Coruscant, Death Star and/or Death Star II locations, or any battleground site and one battleground system, all opponent's Force drain bonuses everywhere are canceled. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: As the Executor crashed into the Death Star, hope surged throughout the ranks of the outmanned Rebel fleet.

name: Merc Sunlet
title: Merc Sunlet
text: Deploy on your non-thief to give that character thief skill. Once during each of your control phases, may target one device at same site. Draw destiny. If destiny < target's destiny number, it is stolen. OR Deploy on a weapon to prevent theft. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: A crafty purloiner from Tirac Munda with a heart of gold. Often hired to advise the wealthy on how to protect their own property. Well traveled and skilled in many languages.

name: Mercenary Armor
title: ••Mercenary Armor
text: Use 2 Force (free on Leia) to deploy on a Rebel without armor. Character gains {spy} skill, power +3, armor = 4, and immunity to attrition < 3. Imperial Barrier is canceled. Blasters deploy for free and fire for free on this character.
lore: Worn by hired guns throughout the galaxy. Often used by Rebels when infiltrating underworld organizations. Leia wore Boushh's armor when she infiltrated Black Sun.

name: Mercenary Pilot
title: Mercenary Pilot
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots or drives. When driving a transport vehicle, adds one battle destiny. When piloting at a cloud sector, once per turn adds one battle destiny during battle at a related exterior site.
lore: Smugglers. Candidates who resent authority often abandon Imperial academies to sell their piloting skills to criminals. Will work for any high paying crime syndicate.

name: Meson Martinet
title: •Meson Martinet
text: May add 2 pilot and 3 passengers. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each pirate aboard. While Quiggold or Sidon piloting, immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: Meteor Impact?
title: •Meteor Impact?
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on an exterior planet site. Target a character on same planet. Character may not leave planet or move away from Utinni Effect. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: 'There's a meteorite that hit the ground near here. I wanna check it out. Won't take long.'

name: Might Of The Republic
title: •Might Of The Republic
text: Once per game, retrieve 1 Force for each of your senators at Galactic Senate. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one senator (or Coruscant Guard, Sei Taria or Mas Amedda) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Despite its current reputation, the Republic still has able citizens that are willing to try and fight the injustices before them.

name: Mighty Jabba
title: •Mighty Jabba
text: Deploys -2 to a Jabba's Palace site. When with your alien leader, adds one battle destiny. May escort a captive. To use his landspeed requires +1 Force. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other aliens present are each 'hit.' Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Hutt leader of notorious criminal organization. Gangster of the vilest ilk. Would rather forfeit a fortune in cash than risk one whisper attesting to his mercy.

name: Millennium Falcon
title: •Millennium Falcon
text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to attrition < 5 if Han, Chewie or Lando piloting. Has ship-docking capability. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.
lore: Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. 'She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts.'

name: Millennium Falcon (V)
title: •Millennium Falcon (V)
text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Once per game, may deploy Han or Chewie aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While [A New Hope] Han piloting, Force drain +1 here. While Han or Chewie piloting, immune to attrition < 5 (< 7 if both).
lore: Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. 'She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts.'

name: Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me
title: •Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on table. During the damage segment of a battle your opponent initiated, if you have no cards left that can be forfeited, you may place this Effect out of play to cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Watto is smart enough to not let himself get swindled by a Jedi bully.

name: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can
title: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can
text: Mind What You Have Learned: Deploy Dagobah system (may not be converted). {While} this side up, during your deploy phase, may deploy Luke, Yoda (deploy -2), Yoda's Hope, At Peace and/or Luke's Backpack to Dagobah from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. Place Luke's completed Jedi Tests on table. Your cards at Dagobah may not Force drain or contribute to Force retrieval. Add 4 to each player's destiny draw for Sense and Alter. {Flip} this card when Luke completes Jedi Test #5. Save You It Can: {Immediately} retrieve 10 Force and place destiny card from Jedi Test #5 on that Jedi Test. {While} this side up, during your move phase, may use 3 Force to take Luke into hand from a location you control (cards on Luke go to owner's Used Pile). Luke's Jedi Test are suspended (not lost) whenever Luke not on table. Luke may ignore location deployment restrictions. Opponent may not play Sense or Alter. {Place} out of play if you Force drain at Dagobah or if Luke is placed out of play. Cancel Luke's Jedi Tests.

back.title: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can
back.text: Mind What You Have Learned: Deploy Dagobah system (may not be converted). {While} this side up, during your deploy phase, may deploy Luke, Yoda (deploy -2), Yoda's Hope, At Peace and/or Luke's Backpack to Dagobah from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. Place Luke's completed Jedi Tests on table. Your cards at Dagobah may not Force drain or contribute to Force retrieval. Add 4 to each player's destiny draw for Sense and Alter. {Flip} this card when Luke completes Jedi Test #5. Save You It Can: {Immediately} retrieve 10 Force and place destiny card from Jedi Test #5 on that Jedi Test. {While} this side up, during your move phase, may use 3 Force to take Luke into hand from a location you control (cards on Luke go to owner's Used Pile). Luke's Jedi Test are suspended (not lost) whenever Luke not on table. Luke may ignore location deployment restrictions. Opponent may not play Sense or Alter. {Place} out of play if you Force drain at Dagobah or if Luke is placed out of play. Cancel Luke's Jedi Tests.

name: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)
title: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)
text: Mind What You Have Learned: Deploy Beldon's Corridor, Yoda's Hut (with [Dagobah] Yoda there), [Cloud City] No Disintegrations!, and Patience! For remainder of game, Sense may not target characters at non-battlegrounds. You may not Force drain on Dagobah. Your non-[Dagobah] characters of ability > 4 (except Ahsoka) are lost. Once per turn, may deploy Bespin system or a Cloud City site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, may deploy Wise Advice or Yoda's Hope from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, may deploy a Dagobah location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May flip this card if Luke on Dagobah during your turn. Save You It Can: Immediately return Luke and any cards on him to owner's hand. While this side up, may deploy Luke (deploy -3) and/or a weapon on him as a 'react.' May place a completed Jedi Test (even if suspended) out of play to take a [Cloud City] Rebel into hand from Lost Pile. When your [Cloud City] Rebel Force drains at a battleground site, unless a captive on table, lost Force must come from top of Reserve Deck if possible.

back.title: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)
back.text: Mind What You Have Learned: Deploy Beldon's Corridor, Yoda's Hut (with [Dagobah] Yoda there), [Cloud City] No Disintegrations!, and Patience! For remainder of game, Sense may not target characters at non-battlegrounds. You may not Force drain on Dagobah. Your non-[Dagobah] characters of ability > 4 (except Ahsoka) are lost. Once per turn, may deploy Bespin system or a Cloud City site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, may deploy Wise Advice or Yoda's Hope from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, may deploy a Dagobah location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May flip this card if Luke on Dagobah during your turn. Save You It Can: Immediately return Luke and any cards on him to owner's hand. While this side up, may deploy Luke (deploy -3) and/or a weapon on him as a 'react.' May place a completed Jedi Test (even if suspended) out of play to take a [Cloud City] Rebel into hand from Lost Pile. When your [Cloud City] Rebel Force drains at a battleground site, unless a captive on table, lost Force must come from top of Reserve Deck if possible.

name: Mindful Of The Future
title: •Mindful Of The Future
text: USED: Use 2 Force to deploy a unique (•) battleground not on table, from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy from your Reserve Deck one Effect which deploys on table (or your side of table) and has no deploy cost; reshuffle. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: 'But not at the expense of the moment.'

name: Mindful Of The Future (V)
title: •Mindful Of The Future (V)
text: USED: If Maul just swung a lightsaber during battle, that lightsaber may not target again this battle. LOST: If [Episode I] Obi-Wan or non-[Permanent Weapon] Qui-Gon is in battle with a Dark Jedi, add one battle destiny. OR Cancel Maul Strikes or The Phantom Menace.
lore: 'But not at the expense of the moment.'

name: Mirax Terrik
title: •Mirax Terrik
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. When piloting Pulsar Skate, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile and draw top card of Reserve Deck.
lore: Called 'Myra' by childhood friend Wedge Antilles. Corellian smuggler. Captain of the Pulsar Skate. Responsible for starship repairs and upgrades. Information Broker.

name: Mist Hunter
title: •Mist Hunter
text: May add 2 pilots (one must be a smuggler or bounty hunter) and 3 passengers. Immune to attrition < 3 if Zuckuss is piloting. Has ship-docking capability.
lore: Commissioned by a group of Gand venture capitalists headed by Zuckuss. Manufactured by Byblos Drive Yards. Uses repulsorlift technology developed for combat cloud cars.

name: Mitth'raw'nuruodo
title: •Mitth'raw'nuruodo
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may target a related location; opponent loses 1 Force the next time they move to that location this turn. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting. Thrawn's game text may not be canceled.
lore: Thrawn. Chiss commander. Leader.

name: Mobilization Points
title: •Mobilization Points
text: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at each docking bay you occupy (or +2 if you control). Once per game, you may take one Carida, Wakeelmui, Gall, Kuat or Rendili system or Executor into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The imperial noose relies on swift troop dispatch from docking bays.

name: Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater
title: Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater
text: May add 1 driver and 1 passenger. Moves free if Jabba or any bounty hunter aboard. May move for free as a 'react' to a battle where your thief, smuggler or bounty hunter is participating.
lore: Enclosed landspeeder often used by nefarious characters due to its luxury and evasive capabilities. Features include automated steering and fine Corellian leather.

name: Moff Gideon
title: •Moff Gideon
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Rebels here (and at adjacent sites if your E-web blaster here) are power -1. When deployed, may deploy an E-web blaster (or an Imperial stormtrooper) here from Reserve Deck for -2 Force; reshuffle.
lore: ISB leader.

name: Moff Gideon, Suited For Battle
title: •Moff Gideon, Suited For Battle
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If you just deployed Darksaber here, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. You initiate battles here for free. Your total battle destiny here is +1. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Imperial Remnant leader.

name: Moff Jerjerrod
title: •Moff Jerjerrod
text: Adds 2 to power of any capital starship he pilots. Once during each of your turns, you may take one Death Star II sector or Superlaser Mark II into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Prevents opponent's spies from deploying to same Death Star II site.
lore: Leader. Found discussions with Vader to be particularly motivating. Does not want to find out if the Emperor is more forgiving than Vader.

name: Moisture Farmer
title: Moisture Farmer
text: Deploy -1 to a farm or exterior Tatooine site. Power and forfeit +1 when Ardon Crell at Audience Chamber. Once during each of your control phases, may take one Hydroponics Station or Vaporator into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Many native Tatooine citizens shun larger settlements. Form small communities in the desert. Their vaporators harvest water from the atmosphere.

name: Molator
title: •Molator
text: Deploy on your side of table. For each unit of ability you have present during a battle, you may use 1 Force to raise your total power by 1. Ability used in this way cannot also be used to draw destiny.
lore: Creature in dejarik hologame drawn from Alderaanian mythology. Stories describe molators as powerful, enchanted protectors of Alderaanian kings and queens.

name: Momaw Nadon
title: •Momaw Nadon
text: During your control phase, may snare (steal) one Bantha, Dewback, Wampa, Rancor, Bubo, or Dragonsnake present at same site.
lore: Male Ithorian, from a tree-loving race derogatorily nicknamed, 'Hammerheads.' Master of animal husbandry and horticulture. Former herd ship leader. Rebel spy.

name: Moment Of Triumph
title: •Moment Of Triumph
text: If Tarkin is defending a battle alone, add two battle destiny. OR If any alien is defending a battle alone, add one battle destiny.
lore: A ruthless ruler of Outer Rim Territories. Grand Moff Tarkin used the Death Star to destroy Alderaan, creating the doctrine of rule by fear.

name: Moment Of Triumph (V)
title: •Moment Of Triumph (V)
text: LOST: Deploy Kessel or [Set 17] Eriadu from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Ralltiir Operations on table, deploy Insignificant Rebellion and up to two Effects that deploy on table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.
lore: A ruthless ruler of Outer Rim Territories. Grand Moff Tarkin used the Death Star to destroy Alderaan, creating the doctrine of rule by fear.

name: Mon Calamari
title: •Mon Calamari
text: Dark: If you occupy with a Star Destroyer, opponent's Star Cruisers are deploy +2 (and may not deploy here). Light: Force Drain -1 here. If you occupy with a Star Cruiser, opponent's Star Destroyers deploy +2 here.

name: Mon Calamari
title: •Mon Calamari
text: Light: If you occupy with a Star Cruiser, opponent's Star Destroyers may not deploy here. Your Star Cruisers deploy -1 here. Dark: If you control without a Star Destroyer, Force drain -1 here.

name: Mon Calamari Admiral
title: ••Mon Calamari Admiral
text: Adds 2 to power of any capital starship he pilots. Your Rebel starships may move to here for free. While piloting a Rebel capital starship, opponent may not modify or cancel your battle destinies here.
lore: Leader.

name: Mon Calamari Dockyards
title: •Mon Calamari Dockyards
text: Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Profundity) may deploy -2 (to a maximum of -3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Admiral Ackbar's hit-and-fade tactics force the Imperial Navy to spread throughout the galaxy in a futile attempt to engage the Rebels.

name: Mon Calamari Star Cruiser
title: Mon Calamari Star Cruiser
text: Deploys only at Mon Calamari or any Rebel Base. May add 5 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle and 3 starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2.
lore: Mon Cal MC80 cruiser. Originally a civilian ship. Converted to military use following the liberation of Mon Calamari from the Empire.

name: Mon Mothma
title: •Mon Mothma
text: While at your war room, subtracts 1 from each opponent's battle destiny at all system locations and adds 2 to forfeit of all non-unique rebels. During your deploy phase, may deploy one non-unique Rebel from Reserve Deck and reshuffle.
lore: Native of Chandrila. Leader of the Alliance. A former member of the Imperial Senate where she was a formidable opponent to then-Senator Palpatine. Friend of Bail Organa.

name: Monnok
title: Monnok
text: USED: If opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, place all but 8 (random selection) in Used Pile. LOST: Use 4 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has two or more of in hand are lost.
lore: Dejarik creature. Savage predator from remote deserts of Soccorro. Respected and honored by Soccorran hunters, considered 'good luck' by superstitious smugglers.

name: More! MORE!!!!
title: •More! MORE!!!!
text: Fire an [Episode VII] blaster or [Episode VII] cannon into a battle at an adjacent site. OR If Kylo in battle, add 1 to a just drawn destiny. OR Once per game, during battle, if you just fired an [Episode VII] weapon (except a lightsaber), it may fire again this battle.
lore: Blank.

name: Mos Eisley Blaster
title: Mos Eisley Blaster
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free if on Tatooine). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target is forfeit -2 for remainder of turn if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: BlasTech DL-18. Carried by Jabba's guards. Typically used for covering fire, to protect a comrade or pin an enemy down. Nicknamed 'Mos Eisley Special.'

name: Mos Eisley Blaster
title: Mos Eisley Blaster
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free if on Tatooine). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target is forfeit -2 for remainder of turn if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Easily obtained by the Rebellion. Many are copies of the BlasTech DL-18 design. Plentiful on Tatooine. Used for suppressive fire.

name: Mosep
title: •Mosep
text: When opponent is losing Force from Force drains at the same or an adjacent site, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck if possible.
lore: Jabba's Nimbanel accountant. Inside contacts allow him to disrupt the cash flow of the Hutt's enemies. He knows a mistake could make him the next write-off.

name: Mostly Armless
title: •Mostly Armless
text: If your character with a lightsaber just won a battle, deploy on an opponent's character present. Character is Disarmed (power -1 and may no longer carry weapons). Opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each opponent's turns. (Immune to Control.)
lore: One lesson learned in Jedi training is that when you have been injured, don't panic.

name: Motion Supported
title: •Motion Supported
text: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to add 2 to your next Force drain at a battleground this turn. If a wealth agenda here, once per turn, you may lose your just drawn battle destiny to substitute it with a card from hand.
lore: 'The delegates from Malastare concur the with delegates from the Trade Federation. A commission must be appointed!'

name: Motti
title: •Motti
lore: Considered an overrated leader by many subordinates. Has a disturbing lack of faith. Became a member of the Death Star's command triumvirate despite his failings.

name: Motti Seeker
title: Motti Seeker
text: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Motti (or pilot) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker also lost.
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.

name: Mournful Roar
title: •Mournful Roar
text: Deploy on Chewie if Han was just lost or just became missing. Opponent cannot play Let The Wookiee Win or Wookiee Roar. Opponent must also lose 1 Force at end of every player's turn. If Han on table, Effect canceled.
lore: With the thought of losing Han, Chewbacca let out an anguished, sorrowful, lamenting, mournful, angst-ridden, tormented, agonizing roar.

name: Move Along...
title: Move Along...
text: If a battle was just initiated at a site where your Jedi is present, use 1 force to draw destiny; that number of opponent's characters with ability = 1 (your choice) must each move away (for free), or be lost.
lore: Obi-Wan used Jedi 'affect mind' power to convince stormtroopers, 'These aren't the droids you're looking for.'

name: Moving To Attack Position
title: •Moving To Attack Position
text: Target one starfighter participating in a battle at a system or sector. For remainder of turn, starfighter may not move, is immune to attrition and, if piloted by any Corellian, is power +2.
lore: Sometimes the best defense is an insane offense.

name: MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid
title: MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid
text: Landspeed = 3. Deploys to same site as a character targeted by a Utinni Effect (except Kessel Run). If this droid 'reaches' Utinni Effect, may relocate it here. Upon delivery, 'mouse' droid returns to your hand.
lore: Nicknamed for rodent-like appearance. Delivers orders and sensitive documents. Retractable manipulator arms. Made by Rebaxan Colmuni. Easily frightened.

name: Much Anger In Him
title: •Much Anger In Him
text: Deploy on a Rebel. At the end of each opponent's battle phases, if you have presence at the location where that Rebel has presences and a battle did not take place there, opponent loses 4 Force.
lore: 'Adventure, heh. Excitement, heh. A Jedi craves not these things. You are reckless.'

name: Multi Troop Transport
title: Multi Troop Transport
text: May add 1 pilot and 7 passengers. Your battle droids may move from this site for free. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Vehicle utilized by the Trade Federation droid army. 31 meters tall. Capable of holding, transporting, and deploying up to 112 battle droids. Enclosed.

name: Murr Danod
title: •Murr Danod
text: Your weapons and devices deploy -1 to same site. While with your unique (*) smuggler at an exterior site, opponent's total battle destiny here is -1 for each [Light Side] at same site.
lore: A peaceful Ithorian, Murr is a member of a Trade Guild based on an Ithorian herd ship. He treats his customers honestly, but does like to deal in 'grey' items. Smuggler.

name: Murttoc Yine
title: •Murttoc Yine
text: During your control phase, if at a Jabba's Palace site you control, may use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one other alien that is a smuggler, information broker, thief or spy into hand and reshuffle.
lore: Information broker. Spy. Has many nefarious contacts in the underworld. Contact point for many seeking employment with Jabba.

name: Mustafar
title: •Mustafar
text: Dark: While Anakin or Vader here, gains one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon. Light: If Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.

name: Mustafar: Private Platform (Docking Bay)
title: •Mustafar: Private Platform (Docking Bay)
text: Dark: Once per turn, may deploy a starfighter with 'Vader' in title here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Your docking bay transit to or from here requires +4 Force (+6 Force if Vader or Vanee here).

name: Mustafar: Vader's Castle
title: •Mustafar: Vader's Castle
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy Vader here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your move phase, Vader may move between here and any battleground site. Light:

name: Mustafar: Vader's Castle (AI)
title: •Mustafar: Vader's Castle (AI)
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy Vader here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your move phase, Vader may move between here and any battleground site. Light:

name: My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive
title: My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive
text: My Kind Of Scum: Deploy Desert Heart and a Jabba's Palace site. May deploy Well Guarded. Reveal one unique (•) alien from your deck whose lore specifies its species. This card is your Rep. {For} remainder of game, your Rep is a leader. Well Guarded is immune to Alter. You may not deploy 'insert' cards or operatives. While frozen Han on table, Rebels are immune to No Bargain and Bad Feeling Have I. {Flip} this card if you occupy two battleground sites (must occupy a third with a non-unique alien of your Rep's species if a non-Tatooine location is on table). Fearless And Inventive: {While} this side up, once per turn you may cancel a Force drain or a just-drawn battle destiny by placing here from hand a copy of your Rep. Once during each of your control phases, you may retrieve a non-unique alien of your Rep's species. While Jabba and Bib on table, your battle destiny draws are each +2. Wounded Wookiee is destiny +3. Unless a non-Tatooine location is on table, your aliens are forfeit +2. For remainder of game, your Rep may deploy from here as if from hand. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy 2 battleground sites.

back.title: My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive
back.text: My Kind Of Scum: Deploy Desert Heart and a Jabba's Palace site. May deploy Well Guarded. Reveal one unique (•) alien from your deck whose lore specifies its species. This card is your Rep. {For} remainder of game, your Rep is a leader. Well Guarded is immune to Alter. You may not deploy 'insert' cards or operatives. While frozen Han on table, Rebels are immune to No Bargain and Bad Feeling Have I. {Flip} this card if you occupy two battleground sites (must occupy a third with a non-unique alien of your Rep's species if a non-Tatooine location is on table). Once during each of your control phases, you may retrieve a non-unique alien of your Rep's species. While Jabba and Bib on table, your battle destiny draws are each +2. Wounded Wookiee is destiny +3. Unless a non-Tatooine location is on table, your aliens are forfeit +2. For remainder of game, your Rep may deploy from here as if from hand. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy 2 battleground sites.

name: My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal
title: My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal
text: My Lord, Is That Legal?: Deploy Galactic Senate and any other [Episode I] location. {For} remainder of game, Rebel and Imperial leaders of ability < 4 are politics +2. Counter Assault and Surprise Assault are canceled. Your Republic characters are immune to Goo Nee Tay. Cards on your Political Effects may deploy to table. At Galactic Senate, weapon destiny draws are -6, creatures are lost and game text of non-Republic characters is canceled. {Flip} this card if you have 3 senators (or 2 senators, at least 1 with a blockade agenda) at Galactic Senate. I Will Make It Legal: {While} this side up, once during your control phase may use 3 Force to place up to two random cards from opponent's hand into their Used Pile. Once per turn may take a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your senators are destiny +2 (or +3 if senator has an ambition agenda) when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. May use 2 Force at end of any turn to place all cards on your Political Effects into Used Pile. {Flip} this card if you have less than two senators at Galactic Senate.

back.title: My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal
back.text: My Lord, Is That Legal?: Deploy Galactic Senate and any other [Episode I] location. {For} remainder of game, Rebel and Imperial leaders of ability < 4 are politics +2. Counter Assault and Surprise Assault are canceled. Your Republic characters are immune to Goo Nee Tay. Cards on your Political Effects may deploy to table. At Galactic Senate, weapon destiny draws are -6, creatures are lost and game text of non-Republic characters is canceled. {Flip} this card if you have 3 senators (or 2 senators, at least 1 with a blockade agenda) at Galactic Senate. I Will Make It Legal: {While} this side up, once during your control phase may use 3 Force to place up to two random cards from opponent's hand into their Used Pile. Once per turn may take a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your senators are destiny +2 (or +3 if senator has an ambition agenda) when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. May use 2 Force at end of any turn to place all cards on your Political Effects into Used Pile. {Flip} this card if you have less than two senators at Galactic Senate.

name: My Loyal Bodyguard
title: •My Loyal Bodyguard
text: Deploy a handmaiden to Amidala's location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated battle at same site as your handmaiden and Amidala, add one battle destiny.
lore: Amidala's handmaidens served more functions than a casual observer would ever notice.

name: My Parents Were Strong
title: •My Parents Were Strong
text: Deploy on Training Course. When deployed, stack [Set 4] Falcon face up here from outside your deck. Falcon may deploy from here as if from hand. Rey is a Skywalker. Once per battle involving Rey, may take your just drawn destiny into hand. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Blank.

name: My Sister Has It
title: •My Sister Has It
text: USED: Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, take Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.
lore: 'He's my brother.'

name: Myn Kyneugh
title: •Myn Kyneugh
text: Deploys only on Coruscant or to Emperor's site (or related site). When armed with a Force pike, adds one battle destiny. Your troopers and Royal Guards may 'react' to here for free. Adds 1 to defense value of other Royal Guards at same and related sites.
lore: Royal Guard leader. Remembers nothing of his past other than serving his Emperor. Early instructor of Kir Kanos and Carnor Jax.

name: Myn Kyneugh (V)
title: •Myn Kyneugh (V)
text: When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While at opponent's battleground, Force drains here may not be reduced. Once per game, may use 1 Force to place opponent's just-played Interrupt out of play.
lore: Royal Guard leader. Remembers nothing of his past other than serving his Emperor. Early instructor of Kir Kanos and Carnor Jax.

name: Mynock
title: Mynock
text: Habitat: unlimited. Parasite: Starfighter. Host's power and hyperspeed are cumulatively -2; while both < 1, Mynocks randomly detach one at a time (cannot attach for remainder of turn). Moves like a starfighter.
lore: Silicon-based space borne lifeform. Frequently called a 'power sucker.' Feeds on energy such as stellar radiation and electrical discharges. Absorbs minerals from starship hulls.

name: Mynock
title: Mynock
text: Habitat: unlimited. Parasite: Starfighter. Host's power and hyperspeed are cumulatively -2; while both < 1, Mynocks randomly detach one at a time (cannot attach for remainder of turn). Moves like a starfighter.
lore: Starship parasite. Flourishes in vacuum of space. Consumes radiation and other forms of energy. Chews on power cables. Adults have one-meter wingspan. Reproduces by macromiosis.

name: Myo
title: •Myo
text: Power +1 if present with Lirin Car'n or any bounty hunter. If lost or forfeited as a result of a battle, Myo 'regenerates' (place on top of your Used Pile).
lore: A regenerating, primitive, violent, desert dwelling, fearless, mercenary-joining, Lirin Car'n-befriending, cyclopian Abyssin from Byss. Calling him 'monoc' will start a fight.

name: Naboo
title: •Naboo
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Naboo sites. Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Naboo sites.

name: Naboo
title: •Naboo
text: Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Naboo sites. Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Naboo sites.

name: Naboo (V)
title: •Naboo (V)
text: Dark: If you control with a [Trade Federation] starship, your Force generation is +1 here. Light: If opponent controls and In Complete Control on table, your characters and vehicles deploy +1 to Naboo sites.

name: Naboo Blaster
title: Naboo Blaster
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your warrior or battle droid. May target a character, creature, or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: Weapons were confiscated by battle droids during the Trade Federation's occupation of Naboo. Considered superior to blasters manufactured in the Outer Rim.

name: Naboo Blaster Rifle
title: Naboo Blaster Rifle
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your warrior or battle droid. May target a character, creature, or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: A large quantity of these blasters found their way onto the black market after the Trade Federation's blockade of Naboo failed.

name: Naboo Blaster Rifle
title: Naboo Blaster Rifle
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your warrior. May target a character, creature, vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Standard issue blaster given to Naboo security volunteers. Noted for its effectiveness in battle and cheap manufacturing cost.

name: Naboo Celebration
title: •Naboo Celebration
text: Deploy on table. If Amidala at a Theed Palace site (or Boss Nass at an exterior Naboo site), opponent's cards with ability deploy +2 there. Once during battle at a Naboo site, if you just drew a Gungan or Royal Naboo Security for battle destiny, opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: The heroic actions of Amidala's forces and Boss Nass' army saved Naboo from the Trade Federation. Definitely a cause for celebration!

name: Naboo Defense Fighter
title: Naboo Defense Fighter
text: Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). Power +1 at Naboo system. While with another N-1 starfighter, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: Part of the Royal Naboo Air Security Forces. Designed by Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps and used in the attack on the Trade Federation Droid Control Ship.

name: Naboo Fighter Pilot
title: Naboo Fighter Pilot
text: Deploys -2 at Naboo. If just deployed aboard a N-1 starfighter, you may activate 1 Force. Adds 2 to the power of any starfighter he pilots (or 3 if piloting a N-1 starfighter). Forfeit + 1 when forfeited during a battle at a system.
lore: One of many pilots who assisted at the Battle of Naboo. Determined to fight for the planet he's lived on all his life.

name: Naboo Occupation
title: •Naboo Occupation
text: Deploy on table. During your draw phase, may use 3 Force: until end of next turn, opponent generates no Force at Naboo sites you control with a battle droid. Place Effect in Lost Pile if you have no battle droids on Naboo. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Battle droid armies require less credits to maintain than the average soldier. Trade Federation tactics are designed to take advantage of these numbers.

name: Naboo Security Officer Blaster
title: Naboo Security Officer Blaster
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your warrior. May target a character, creature, vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a leader. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Used primarily by high-ranking Naboo security officers, and known for its precision targeting.

name: Naboo: Battle Plains
title: •Naboo: Battle Plains
text: Dark: Unless Gungan Energy Shield on table, your AATs are each power +2 here. Light: Once per game may take Gungan Energy Shield into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Naboo: Battle Plains
title: •Naboo: Battle Plains
text: Light: Once per game may take Gungan Energy Shield into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Your AATs deploy +1 here.

name: Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers
title: •Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers
text: Light: Once per game may take Boss Nass into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Opponent may not Force drain here. Immune to Revolution.

name: Naboo: Otoh Gunga Entrance
title: •Naboo: Otoh Gunga Entrance
text: Light: Your Gungans deploy -1 here and move from here for free. You may not Force drain here. Dark: Cards with ability (except Gungans) deploy +4 to underwater sites. Immune to Revolution.

name: Naboo: Swamp
title: •Naboo: Swamp
text: Dark: If your battle droid present, Force drain +1 here. Light: If your Gungan present, Force drain +1 here.

name: Naboo: Swamp
title: •Naboo: Swamp
text: Light: Your Gungans are each power +1 and deploy -1 here. Dark: Unless your battle droid present, Force drain -1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard
text: Dark: During your move phase, may move your characters from here to any interior Naboo site. Light: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard
text: Light: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. Dark: (none)

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay
text: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay
text: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Generator
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Generator
text: Dark: Your Dark Jedi are power +2 here. Light: Your Jedi are power +1 here. Force drain -1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Generator
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Generator
text: Light: Your Jedi are power +2 here. Dark: Your Dark Jedi are power +1 here. Force drain -1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Generator (V)
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Generator (V)
text: Light: While Qui-Gon 'communing,' opponent's [Reflections II] objective targets Anakin instead of Luke. Dark: Dark Jedi are power +1 here. Jedi are power +2 here. Force drain -1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
text: Dark: Any characters of ability < 5 'hit' here (and all cards on them) are placed in owner's Used Pile. Light: Any characters of ability < 5 'hit' here (and all cards on them) are placed in owner's Used Pile.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
text: Light: Any characters of ability < 5 'hit' here (and all cards on them) are placed in owner's Used Pile. Dark: Any characters of ability < 5 'hit' here (and all cards on them) are placed in owner's Used Pile.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Hallway
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Hallway
text: Light: Once per game may take Ascension Guns into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: If your battle droid present, Force drain +1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Hallway
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Hallway
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy a battle droid here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Force drain -1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Hallway (V)
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Hallway (V)
text: Light: Once per game, may take [Set 1] Ascension Guns into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. You move to here using landspeed for free. Dark: While We Have A Plan on table, your Force icons here are canceled.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room
text: Dark: If Haako or Gunray present, Force drain +1 here. Light: Unless Amidala present, Force drain -1 here.

name: Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room
title: •Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room
text: Light: While you occupy, opponent's [Presence] droids require +1 Force to move to here. Dark: (none)

name: Nabrun Leids
title: Nabrun Leids
text: At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Four-armed smuggler and pilot for hire. A Morseerian male. Breathes methane. Former fighter pilot. He can take you anywhere for the right price.

name: Nal Hutta
title: •Nal Hutta
text: Dark: During your control phase, may search Reserve Deck, take one Bounty or Hutt Bounty into hand; reshuffle. Light: If you control, Force drain -1 here and opponent's Nal Hutta game text is canceled.

name: Nal Hutta Operative
title: Nal Hutta Operative
text: While at a Nal Hutta site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is power +1 (or +2 if your gangster or Rodian is on Nal Hutta) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Nal Hutta from Reserve Deck- reshuffle.
lore: Strong-armed H'nemthe thugs working for the Hutts. Work alongside Rodians and other unscrupulous aliens.

name: Nalan Cheel
title: •Nalan Cheel
text: After using Bith Shuffle, peek at top X cards of pile or deck just shuffled, where X = number of other musicians at same site. May reshuffle without peeking.
lore: Male Bith musician. Though he enjoys playing his Bandfill in Figrin D'an's band, he misses the bubblink pink swamps of his homeworld, Clak'dor VII.

name: Nar Shaddaa
title: •Nar Shaddaa
text: Light: Force drain +1 here. Once per game, if your control, may take Han's Toolkit into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Starships piloted by bounty hunters are power +1 here. All starships may move between here and Nal Hutta as a react.

name: Nar Shaddaa (AI)
title: •Nar Shaddaa (AI)
text: Light: Force drain +1 here. Once per game, if your control, may take Han's Toolkit into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Starships piloted by bounty hunters are power +1 here. All starships may move between here and Nal Hutta as a react.

name: Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes
title: •Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes
text: Once per game, target one non-unique character on table. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than X, retrieve X Force, where X equals the number of copies of that card you have on table (immune to Sense). OR search your Reserve Deck and take one non-unique alien into hand; reshuffle.
lore: One of the few possessions Jabba brought with him from Nar Shaddaa, the smugglers moon orbiting Nal Hutta. A symbol of renewal in Hutt Society.

name: Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & •Out Of Somewhere
title: •Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & •Out Of Somewhere
text: Once per game, target one non-unique character on table. Draw destiny. If destiny < X, retrieve X Force, where X equals the number of copies of that card you have on table (Immune to Sense). OR Take one non-unique alien into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle with more than double your total power, search your Reserve Deck. Any one character you find there may immediately deploy as a 'react;' reshuffle.

name: Narrow Escape
title: Narrow Escape
text: If opponent just initiated battle at a site where you have a Rebel of ability > 2 present, move all of your cards with ability there away (using their landspeed).
lore: Blast doors seal off compartments during battles, hull ruptures or as security measures. Thick doors repel blaster rifle shots.

name: Navy Of The First Order
title: •Navy Of The First Order
text: Deploy on table. [First Order] starships are deploy -1 (-2 to D'Qar) and hyperspeed +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal one [First Order] starship from hand to take a First Order pilot (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and deploy both simultaneously. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Blank.

name: Navy Trooper
title: Navy Trooper
text: Deploy -1 to a mobile site (except on Cloud City). When defending a battle, power +1 (or +2 if also at an interior site). When in battle against an operative, prevents opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny.
lore: Navy troopers are assigned to defend key installations. Trained to protect against alien species and other insurgents.

name: Navy Trooper Fenson
title: •Navy Trooper Fenson
text: Subtracts 3 from Force opponent retrieves for On The Edge and Off The Edge. When at Bunker, adds 2 to deploy cost of each opponent's character (except Ewoks, spies and scouts) to Endor sites (except Rebel Landing Site).
lore: Rendili native skilled at close-quarters combat. Worked with Trooper Vesden to monitor enemy activity on Endor.

name: Navy Trooper Shield Technician
title: •••Navy Trooper Shield Technician
text: Forfeit +2 while with Hewex. When at Bunker (or aboard a Star Destroyer at Endor), cumulatively adds 1 to deploy cost of each opponent's starship and non-Ewok vehicle deploying to Endor (or to your mobile site orbiting Endor)
lore: Many Imperial Navy troopers receive technical as well as combat training, which they use to maintain the Empire's military facilities.

name: Navy Trooper Vesden
title: •Navy Trooper Vesden
text: If present with a Scomp link when Never Tell Me The Odds just reached the top of your Reserve Deck, may 'shield' (add 3 to destiny number of) one of your characters at each location for remainder of turn.
lore: Counterintelligence agent assigned by ISB. Operates sensors designed to protect the control bunker from infiltration.

name: Neb Dulo
title: •Neb Dulo
text: Power +3 when present with your musician. When a battle was just initiated where present, may choose one opponent's character of ability < X to move away for free (or that character is lost), where X = number of your musicians present.
lore: Disciple of Davrilat, a complicated religion based on the sanctity of harmonics. Originally from the desert planet Tocoya. Strong protective instincts.

name: Nebit
title: •Nebit
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. When in a battle with at least two of your other Jawas, adds one battle destiny. When your total battle destiny at Nebit's site is greater than opponent's total battle destiny, Nebit reduces attrition against you by 3.
lore: Jawa leader responsible for organizing raids on rival Jawa factions. Detested warrior. Hates being 'frocked.'

name: Nebulon-B Frigate
title: Nebulon-B Frigate
text: May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, and 2 starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Turbolaser batteries and laser cannons may deploy aboard for free.
lore: Product of Imperial Kuat Drive Yards. Several captured by Alliance. Imperial crews promptly defected. Can be outfitted for a variety of missions requiring mid-size capital starships.

name: Neck And Neck
title: •Neck And Neck
text: If difference between opponent's and your highest race totals < 4, lose 1 Force. Opponent draws no race destiny next control phase. OR If both players have < 10 Life Force remaining, both players retrieve 4 Force.
lore: When Anakin had finally caught up with Sebulba, he knew he needed to make some kind of a move to break away from the Dug and win the race.

name: Neimoidian Advisor
title: •Neimoidian Advisor
text: USED: Use 2 Force to deploy a unique (•) battleground not on table, from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy from your Reserve Deck one Effect which deploys on table (or your side of table) and has no deploy cost; reshuffle. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: 'We must move quickly to disrupt all communication down there.'

name: Neimoidian Pilot
title: Neimoidian Pilot
text: Deploys -2 at Naboo. When deployed aboard your battleship, you may activate 1 Force. Adds 2 to the power of any starship he pilots. Forfeit +2 while piloting.
lore: Trade Federation Neimodian pilots are some of the most desired in the galaxy due to their willingness to follow orders.

name: Nevar Yalnal
title: Nevar Yalnal
text: If both players have a spy at same site, draw destiny. Add 2 if opponent's spy is Undercover. Opponent's spy is lost if total destiny > 2.
lore: Immense Ranat scavenger from Aralia. Slyly spies for anyone willing to pay his price. Outcast. Works as laborer for Hrchek, the Saurin droid trader.

name: Never Tell Me The Odds
title: •Never Tell Me The Odds
text: Insert in opponent's Reserve Deck. When Effect reaches top it is lost and up to the three lowest destiny numbers of each player's characters on table are totaled. Player with lower total loses Force equal to the difference. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'You said you wanted to be around when I made a mistake, well, this could be it, sweetheart.'

name: New Leadership Is Needed
title: •New Leadership Is Needed
text: If you have a senate majority, activate 1 Force. OR If your opponent has a senate majority, place your character with politics at Galactic Senate in Used Pile to place an opponent's character present (your choice) in opponent's Used Pile. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: The political process in the Republic is one whereby even the most powerful positions are fraught with peril.

name: New Leadership Is Needed (V)
title: •New Leadership Is Needed (V)
text: LOST: Take Coruscant Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Plead My Case To The Senate on table, deploy How Liberty Dies and two Effects that deploy on your side of the table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.
lore: The political process in the Republic is one whereby even the most powerful positions are fraught with peril.

name: Ng'ok
title: Ng'ok
text: If opponent just deployed four or more characters to same location this turn, prevent all of those characters from battling this turn. OR if opponent just 'reacted' to a battle, cancel the battle.
lore: Dejarik of a Ng'ok war beast. Foul temper gives rise to bad feelings. Has razor-sharp retractable claws. Used in many systems to frighten off potential attackers.

name: Ng'ok War Beast
title: •Ng'ok War Beast
text: Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Dejarik of a Ng'ok war beast. Foul temper gives rise to bad feelings. Has razor-sharp retractable claws. Used in many systems to frighten off potential attackers.

name: Ni Chuba Na??
title: •Ni Chuba Na??
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn may use 1 Force to look through opponent's Lost Pile and place all docking bays you find there out of play. Once per game may deploy Sebulba from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Your buddy here was about to be turned into orange goo. He picked a fight with a Dug. An especially dangerous Dug called Sebulba.'

name: Ni Chuba Na?? (V)
title: •Ni Chuba Na?? (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy Sebulba from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, may deploy Malastare or Podrace Arena from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While present with Sebulba, Jar Jar's game text is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: 'Your buddy here was about to be turned into orange goo. He picked a fight with a Dug. An especially dangerous Dug called Sebulba.'

name: Niado Duegad
title: •Niado Duegad
text: May not carry or use devices or weapons. Once per turn, may use X Force, where X = 1, 2, or 3, to add twice X to his power for remainder of turn.
lore: Mercenary from Vodran. Niado's culture controls its environment through terraforming facilities. Enhanced adrenal glands allow for short bursts of incredible strength.

name: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By
title: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By
text: Send one of your missing characters at same site as one of your piloted or driven vehicles to your Used Pile. OR Cancel any attempt by one character to 'hide' from a battle.
lore: 'Echo Base, this is Rogue 2. I've found them. Repeat. I've found them.'

name: Nick Of Time
title: •Nick Of Time
text: Deploy on your side of table. During a battle, you may place out of play from hand a copy of any unique (•) card participating in that battle to reduce attrition against you by that card's forfeit value. (Immune to Alter while you occupy a battleground.)
lore: Luke barely escaped being crushed by the AT-AT's massive footpad during the Battle of Hoth.

name: Nien Nunb
title: •Nien Nunb
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. When at a mobile sector, once per turn you may peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck; you may place that card on top of your Used Pile. When with General Calrissian may add one battle destiny.
lore: Brilliant navigator. Former SoroSuub employee. Turned to pirating when that corporation backed the Empire. Tall for a Sullustan.

name: Nien Nunb, Sullustan Smuggler
title: •Nien Nunb, Sullustan Smuggler
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a freighter, it is defense value +2 and opponent's immunity to attrition is limited to < 7 here (< 5 if Lando piloting here).
lore: Brilliant navigator. Former SoroSuub employee. Turned to pirating when that corporation backed the Empire. Tall for a Sullustan.

name: Night Buzzard
title: •Night Buzzard
text: May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Kuruk, who provides ability of 3. Kylo and Knights of Ren deploy -1 to same and related locations. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Blank.

name: Nightfall
title: Nightfall
text: Deploy on any planet system to cause 'nighttime conditions' at related sites. During battles there, both sides add one destiny to power only. Spies deploy free to sites under 'nighttime conditions.'
lore: Tatoo I and Tatoo II, twin suns of Tatooine, create a harsh desert environment, but provide spectacular sunsets. At night, many dangers emerge from the shadows.

name: Nikto
title: Nikto
text: Deploys only to a Jabba's Palace site. Power and forfeit +2 when defending a battle at a Jabba's Palace site.
lore: Several different types if Nikto were sold to Jabba by slavers. Compete with Weequay to prove themselves the stronger species.

name: Ninth Sister
title: •Ninth Sister
text: Defense value -2 while opponent has a weapon present. While at a site, unless opponent's character of ability > 3 here, reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0.
lore: Female Dowutin Inquisitor.

name: Nizuc Bek
title: •Nizuc Bek
text: Power +3 when present with your musician. When present at the start of a battle, may cause one character of ability < X to move away for free (or that character is immediately lost) where X = the number of your musicians present.
lore: Guard from Corulag. Former bouncer at the Mos Eisley cantina. Assigned by Jabba to guard celebrities visiting Jabba's palace. Friend of Wuher. Loves juri juice.

name: No Bargain
title: •No Bargain
text: Deploy on your side of table. While no Imperials are at any Jabba's Palace sites: Rebels are deploy +2, Revolution is canceled and your non-unique aliens are each forfeit +1. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Zeet tu seet. Jabba no tuzindy honkabee.'

name: No Civility, Only Politics
title: •No Civility, Only Politics
text: USED: During your move phase, take one of your characters with politics at Galactic Senate into hand. LOST: If you have a Republic character with politics in battle at a site, add one battle destiny; that character is power and politics = 0 until end of turn.
lore: It's not rare to see a senator using the system to forward his own personal agenda. Much goes on behind closed doors that the Senate never sees.

name: No Civility, Only Politics (V)
title: •No Civility, Only Politics (V)
text: LOST: Take Coruscant Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If My Lord, Is That Legal? on table, deploy With Thunderous Applause and two Effects that deploy on your side of the table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.
lore: It's not rare to see a senator using the system to forward his own personal agenda. Much goes on behind closed doors that the Senate never sees.

name: No Disintegrations!
title: •No Disintegrations!
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your side of table. If a Rebel of ability > 2 is lost (not captured) during a battle involving an opponent's bounty hunter, opponent loses 3 Force. If Vader on table, one bounty hunter involved in that battle (your choice) is also lost.
lore: 'There will be a substantial reward for the one who finds the Millennium Falcon. You are free to use any methods necessary, but I want them alive.'

name: No Disintegrations! (V)
title: •No Disintegrations! (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once per opponent's turn, if their warrior present where a [Cloud City] Rebel (except Luke) is about to be lost, opponent must choose: capture and seize that Rebel or lose 2 Force. For a bounty hunter to fire a weapon, opponent must first use 1 Force (2 if Vader there). [Immune to Alter.]
lore: 'There will be a substantial reward for the one who finds the Millennium Falcon. You are free to use any methods necessary, but I want them alive.'

name: No Escape
title: •No Escape
text: Deploy on table. You may immediately take top card of Lost Pile into hand. Effects, Epic Events, and Objectives are immune to Honor Of The Jedi. At each opponent's <> site, your characters and vehicles are each deploy -3 and your Force generation is +1. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Jabba's influence is not easily ignored. Neither are his voracious and vile appetites. Even Jedi soon learn this lesson.

name: No Escape
title: •No Escape
text: Plays on table. At opponent's <> site where opponent's creature present, you may deploy without presence or Force icons, and your Force generation there is +1.
lore: Jabba's influence is not easily ignored. Neither are his voracious and vile appetites. Even Jedi soon learn this lesson.

name: No Escape (V)
title: •No Escape (V)
text: Deploy on table. When deployed, may take the top card of Lost Pile into hand. During your move phase, may cancel Landing Claw. If Landing Claw was just lost, place it out of play. Elis Helrot and Nabrun Leids are unique (•) and are Lost Interrupts. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Jabba's influence is not easily ignored. Neither are his voracious and vile appetites. Even Jedi soon learn this lesson.

name: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!
title: •No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!
text: If you just lost a Gungan from table, place him in your hand. OR If Jar Jar and Tarpals are in a battle together, add two battle destiny.
lore: 'Mesa think of sumting!'

name: No Match For A Sith
title: •No Match For A Sith
text: If Maul armed with a lightsaber in battle, use 2 Force to draw two destiny. Opponent draws two destiny. If any of your destinies equal any of opponent's destinies, opponent's Jedi is power = 0 for remainder of battle.
lore: Lightsaber duels are so fast and furious that Jedi don't plan their offensive strategy, but instead rely on instinct and their ability to sense an opponent's next strike.

name: No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?
title: No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?
text: No Money, No Parts, No Deal!: Deploy Watto's Junkyard and Mos Espa. {For} remainder of game, Watto's Junkyard is immune to Revolution. If Watto at Watto's Junkyard, opponent may use 8 Force to place Watto in Used Pile and you may retrieve up to 4 Force. {While} this side up, Qui-Gon is power +3. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from your Force drains at Tatooine sites. {Flip} this card if Watto present at Watto's Junkyard and you occupy Mos Espa. You're A Slave?: {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may place a card from hand face down on your side of the table and opponent must choose to lose 2 Force (you place card in Used Pile) or use 2 Force (you deploy that card for free). If opponent uses 2 Force and you cannot deploy card, lose 2 Force and card is lost. Opponent's non-unique aliens are each deploy +3. {Flip} this card if Watto not present at Watto's Junkyard or you do not occupy Mos Espa.

back.title: No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?
back.text: No Money, No Parts, No Deal!: Deploy Watto's Junkyard and Mos Espa. {For} remainder of game, Watto's Junkyard is immune to Revolution. If Watto at Watto's Junkyard, opponent may use 8 Force to place Watto in Used Pile and you may retrieve up to 4 Force. {While} this side up, Qui-Gon is power +3. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from your Force drains at Tatooine sites. {Flip} this card if Watto present at Watto's Junkyard and you occupy Mos Espa. You're A Slave?: {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may place a card from hand face down on your side of the table and opponent must choose to lose 2 Force (you place card in Used Pile) or use 2 Force (you deploy that card for free). If opponent uses 2 Force and you cannot deploy card, lose 2 Force and card is lost. Opponent's non-unique aliens are each deploy +3. {Flip} this card if Watto not present at Watto's Junkyard or you do not occupy Mos Espa.

name: No Questions Asked
title: •No Questions Asked
text: Force generation at sectors a player occupies is +1 for that player. Any independent starship with an alien pilot character aboard is immune to attrition < 4 (or adds 2 to immunity). During your control phase, one of your smugglers at a site related to a system occupied by your freighter or independent starship may either fire a blaster or make a regular move using personal landspeed.

name: Noble Sacrifice
title: Noble Sacrifice
text: If opponent just deployed a character, sacrifice (out of play) from table one of your characters with the same power (even a captured character). You may retrieve Force from Lost Pile equal to your sacrificed character's forfeit value.
lore: 'You can't win Darth. If you strike me down I shall become more powerful than you can possibly imagine.' Obi-Wan's sacrifice gave the Rebels time to escape.

name: None Shall Pass
title: None Shall Pass
text: If opponent just deployed a Rebel to a Jabba's Palace site, (and you have no Imperials at a Jabba's Palace site), return Rebel to opponent's hand. Any Force used to deploy that Rebel remains used, and Rebel may not be deployed for the remainder of the turn.
lore: Jabba's Gamorrean guards keep a watchful eye for unwelcome guests.

name: NOOOOOOOOOOOO!
title: •NOOOOOOOOOOOO!
text: USED: If you just answered 'no' to a Hypo question, opponent loses 3 Force. LOST: Cancel Why Didn't You Tell Me? or I Am Your Father. OR If Luke is about to cross to the Dark Side, he is lost instead.
lore: Sometimes, the truth isn't very pretty.

name: Not Within Sight Or Reach
title: Not Within Sight Or Reach
text: USED: Take Thrawn or Vanto into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle, players may not draw power or attrition destinies. LOST: Once per game, if opponent has deployed two systems and no battleground sites (or a system is 'liberated'), deploy a [Premium] dreadnaught from outside your deck (deploy -3).
lore: When the Empire amasses its fleet, the only option for the Alliance is retreat.

name: Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield
title: •Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield
text: Non-pilot characters aboard starships are forfeit -4. Whenever a player's starship is 'hit', that player loses 1 Force (2 if starship was hit by Droid Starfighter Laser Cannons). At systems where you have only [Trade Federation] starships, all of those starships are immune to attrition < 4. At sites related to a system you occupy, your battle destinies may not be canceled by opponent.

name: Now, This Is Podracing!
title: •Now, This Is Podracing!
text: During battle, add 1 to opponent's just drawn destiny (or to your just drawn weapon destiny). OR If Your Thoughts Dwell On Your Mother on table, take Night Club or Skywalker Hut into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Anakin needed all the help he could get to evade Sebulba's tactics.

name: Nudj
title: Nudj
text: *Ferocity = destiny - 4. Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth and Tatooine) and Dark Waters. Cumulatively absorbs (temporarily cancels) one [Dark Side Force] icon present. Parasite: None.
lore: Tree-nesting reptile. Favors moist caves and marshes. Extremely docile, despite fearsome appearance. Responsive to Force energy.

name: Nute Gunray
title: •Nute Gunray
text: Your destroyer droids and battle droids are each forfeit +1 at same and related sites. While aboard Blockade Flagship, opponent's Jedi may not move or deploy to Bridge, and your destroyer droids are destiny +3 if drawn for battle destiny.
lore: Commanding Viceroy of the Trade Federation forces assigned to the blockade of Naboo. Takes for his own actions. Neimoidian leader.

name: Nute Gunray (V)
title: •Nute Gunray (V)
text: During battle, may cancel game text of a Republic character with ability with ability < 4 present. If with your Republic character (or character with 'Trade Federation' in lore), may add one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Commanding Viceroy of the Trade Federation forces assigned to the blockade of Naboo. Takes for his own actions. Neimoidian leader.

name: Nute Gunray, Neimoidian Viceroy
title: •Nute Gunray, Neimoidian Viceroy
text: Your [Presence] droids and AATs are destiny +1 if drawn for battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may take Take Them Away into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < X, where X = twice the number of [Presence] droids present.
lore: Neimoidian leader. Viceroy to the Trade Federation, but primarily under the influence of Darth Sidious. Ordered to take control of Naboo, and force the Queen to sign a treaty.

name: Nute Gunray, Neimoidian Viceroy (AI)
title: •Nute Gunray, Neimoidian Viceroy (AI)
text: Your [Presence] droids and AATs are destiny +1 if drawn for battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may take Take Them Away into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < X, where X = twice the number of [Presence] droids present.
lore: Neimoidian leader. Viceroy to the Trade Federation, but primarily under the influence of Darth Sidious. Ordered to take control of Naboo, and force the Queen to sign a treaty.

name: Nysad
title: •Nysad
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. May deploy as a 'react' to a Jabba's Palace site or aboard a vehicle at a Tatooine site. Power +3 when defending a battle at a Jabba's Palace site.
lore: Kajain'sa'Nikto. Fiercely loyal to Jabba. Stands guard over the sail barge during the Hutt's many trips to Mos Eisley.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi
text: When a battle was just initiated where present, may use 1 Force to choose one opponent's character of ability = 1 present to move away (for free), or that character is lost. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Jedi Knight. Trained by Yoda. Friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic during the Clone Wars. Mentor of Anakin and Luke Skywalker.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)
text: Obi-Wan's deploy cost may not be increased. Power +1 for each Dark Jedi or Skywalker here. Your 'hit' characters here may not be targeted to be lost. Once per game, may exchange two cards in hand with any one card in Lost Pile. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Jedi Knight. Trained by Yoda. Friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic during the Clone Wars. Mentor of Anakin and Luke Skywalker.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile
text: Adds one battle destiny with Maul, Sidious, or Vader. Opponent's characters here are power and forfeit -1. Once per game, may take into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) (or retrieve into hand) Glancing Blow or Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 6.
lore: Jedi survivor.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight
text: Deploys -2 to Naboo. Power +2 if Maul present. If Qui-Gon is participating in lightsaber combat and Obi-Wan is present, Qui-Gon may use Obi-Wan's combat cards. Immune to Sniper and attrition < 5.
lore: Padawan learner promoted to Jedi Knight after his encounter with Darth Maul. Has sworn to train Anakin Skywalker, even if the Jedi Council forbids it.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner
text: Deploys -2 to Tatooine. If opponent just initiated a battle at a related Tatooine site, may use 2 Force to relocate Obi-Wan to that site. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan. Stayed behind to protect Queen Amidala when Qui-Gon left to explore Mos Espa, but was in constant communication should he be needed.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (AI)
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (AI)
text: Deploys -2 to Tatooine. If opponent just initiated a battle at a related Tatooine site, may use 2 Force to relocate Obi-Wan to that site. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan. Stayed behind to protect Queen Amidala when Qui-Gon left to explore Mos Espa, but was in constant communication should he be needed.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V)
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V)
text: Deploys -2 (and landspeed = 2) on Tatooine. If a card was just stacked on Credits Will Do Fine, may take a non-character card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at opponent's Watto's Junkyard, its Light Side game text is canceled. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan. Stayed behind to protect Queen Amidala when Qui-Gon left to explore Mos Espa, but was in constant communication should he be needed.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V) (AI)
title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V) (AI)
text: Deploys -2 (and landspeed = 2) on Tatooine. If a card was just stacked on Credits Will Do Fine, may take a non-character card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at opponent's Watto's Junkyard, its Light Side game text is canceled. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan. Stayed behind to protect Queen Amidala when Qui-Gon left to explore Mos Espa, but was in constant communication should he be needed.

name: Obi-Wan With Lightsaber
title: •Obi-Wan With Lightsaber
text: Permanent weapon is •Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
lore: 'The Force will be with you... always.'

name: Obi-Wan's Apparition
title: •Obi-Wan's Apparition
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on any site if opponent is generating at least 3 Force more than you. At that site, adjacent sites and same sites as Obi-Wan, players activate Force only if they have presence.
lore: 'Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter.' The inner consciousness of a Jedi can transcend even death.

name: Obi-Wan's Cape
title: •Obi-Wan's Cape
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Rebel or alien. Character is immune to attrition < 5. Also, When a battle was just initiated where present, may use 1 Force to choose one opponent's character of ability = 1 present to move away (for free), or that character is lost.
lore: A symbol of the noble Jedi and his mysterious powers.

name: Obi-Wan's Journal
title: •Obi-Wan's Journal
text: Deploy on Luke or Obi-Wan. Your characters present armed with a unique (•) lightsaber Weapon card may not be Disarmed, once per battle may cancel a weapon destiny just drawn, and that lightsaber's Force drain modifiers may not be canceled. Lost if about to be stolen.
lore: Written by Obi-Wan Kenobi. Used by Luke to construct his lightsaber. Contained instructions on building required tools as well. Keyed to self-destruct if not opened by Luke.

name: Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
title: •Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Obi-Wan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: 'An elegant weapon for a more civilized time.' Miniaturized power cell. Uses rare crystals to focus the lightblade. This lightsaber was personally built by Obi-Wan.

name: Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
title: •Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on [Episode I] Obi-Wan. May add 1 to Force drain if present at a Naboo battleground. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Add 1 if targeting a Dark Jedi. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Constructed by Obi-Wan himself, this Padawan's lightsaber was responsible for tearing an ancient Sith weapon in half.

name: Observation Holocam
title: Observation Holocam
text: Deploy on a site. Adds 1 to the total weapon destiny of each of your automated weapons at same and adjacent sites. During battle, may add the power of one of your characters at an adjacent site you control to your total.
lore: Remote surveillance viewers with droid controllers supplement security. Can activate alarms and automated weapons when needed, bringing help to endangered locations.

name: Observation Holocam (V)
title: Observation Holocam (V)
text: Deploy on your interior site. If opponent just deployed a character or vehicle here, may lose 1 Force to move your character to here using landspeed (at normal use of the Force). Opponent may not 'react' to here. May place out of play to draw top card of Reserve Deck.
lore: Remote surveillance viewers with droid controllers supplement security. Can activate alarms and automated weapons when needed, bringing help to endangered locations.

name: Obsidian 10
title: •Obsidian 10
