text: May deploy with a pilot as a 'react' to any asteroid sector or cloud sector. May add one pilot. OS-72-10 deploys -2 aboard.
lore: Recalled to defend second Death Star during construction. Stationed aboard Thunderflare.

name: Obsidian 7
title: •Obsidian 7
text: Deploy -1 and power +3 at any cloud sector. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2.
lore: TIE fighter modified for upper atmosphere maneuvers. Pilot nicknamed 'Winged Gundark' due to the number of kills earned in high-altitude battles.

name: Obsidian 8
title: •Obsidian 8
text: Deploy -1 and power +3 at any cloud sector. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
lore: Modified TIE fighter. Used most often to pursue raiders attempting to take refuge in the upper atmosphere of nearby planets. Pilot previously stationed aboard Devastator.

name: Obsidian Squadron TIE
title: •••Obsidian Squadron TIE
text: Deploy -1 at any cloud sector. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Power +2 at non-unique cloud sectors. Boosted TIE Cannon may deploy aboard and fires free aboard.
lore: Modified TIE fighter. Specially adapted for atmospheric engagement. Some are fitted with high-output solar panels to support improved weaponry.

name: Ochi
title: •Ochi
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Bestoon Legacy, it is immune to attrition < 5. While [Episode VII] Emperor on table, your total power here is +3. If opponent's character was just placed out of play (even from Lost Pile), opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Assassin.

name: Odd Ball's Torrent Starfighter
title: •Odd Ball's Torrent Starfighter
text: May add 1 clone pilot. Odd Ball deploys -1 aboard. While Odd Ball piloting, power and hyperspeed +1, and adds one destiny to total power. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while Odd Ball piloting).
lore: Blank.

name: Odin Nesloor
title: •Odin Nesloor
text: During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one exterior site to 'transport' (relocate) to another exterior site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Odin's family mysteriously disappeared during a hyperspace jump. He scours the galaxy for information on them, and his best lead has brought him to Tatooine.

name: Odin Nesloor & •First Aid
title: •Odin Nesloor & •First Aid
text: If your character is about to be hit, use 1 Force (free if by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon); for remainder of turn, its forfeit may not be reduced, it may not be used to satisfy attrition, and it is immune to Dr. Evazan. OR Cancel Disarmed. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel a 'react.' OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

name: Off The Edge
title: •Off The Edge
text: Target one of your characters at a Cloud City site. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's destiny number, retrieve Force equal to the distance. If destiny < character's destiny number, lose difference. If destiny = character's destiny number, character is lost.
lore: Despite the brutal attacks of the Dark Lord, dying on Cloud City was not Luke's destiny.

name: Officer Dolphe
title: •Officer Dolphe
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard Bravo 2, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and opponent's battle destiny draws are -2 at same system.
lore: Growing up in a small town outside of Theed, Porro became adept at speeder control and thrust. His decision to volunteer for Bravo Flight made Ric Olie a very happy man.

name: Officer Ellberger
title: •Officer Ellberger
text: Adds 2 to power of anythings she pilots. While piloting Bravo 5 and at same system as a droid starfighter, adds one destiny to attrition only.
lore: Computer systems troubleshooter whose sour past is not discussed by her squad mates. Years of experience enabled her to predict and adjust to droid starfighter tactics.

name: Officer Evax
title: •Officer Evax
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When at a Death Star site, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system as a 'react.'
lore: This Imperial Intelligence leader has a proven track record for predicting Rebel fleet movements. His coordination of starship maneuvers has saved many vulnerable bases.

name: Officer Perosei
title: •Officer Perosei
text: Once during your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to relocate Perosei to an adjacent Naboo site. While with a Republic character during battle, may place Perosei out of play to add 5 to your total power this battle.
lore: Royal Naboo security guard who can disassemble and reassemble a Naboo blaster in less than sixty seconds. During the occupation, was a prisoner at Camp Four.

name: Officer Valin Hess
title: •Officer Valin Hess
text: During battle, may place an Imperial of ability < 4 from your Lost Pile out of play to add X to attrition against opponent, where X = that character's ability. Except during battle, may lose Valin Hess to target an opponent's Undercover spy here; target is lost.
lore: Leader.

name: Offworld Jawas
title: ••Offworld Jawas
text: Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, may use 1 Force to search that Reserve Deck and place one device, weapon, or unpiloted starship there in Lost Pile; reshuffle. If none there, opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Jawa. Scavenger. Thief.

name: Oh, Switch Off
title: Oh, Switch Off
text: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target your droid to be stolen, 'hit' or lost. Droid is protected from all such attempts for remainder of turn. OR Switch OFF any binary droid for remainder of turn.
lore: Mindless philosophy for an overweight glob of grease.

name: Old Allies / We Need Your Help
title: Old Allies / We Need Your Help
text: Old Allies: Deploy Jakku system and Niima Outpost Shipyard (with [Episode VII] Falcon there). May deploy Graveyard Of Giants. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Combined Fleet Action, Harc Seff, Luke, or Jedi. Your Destiny is suspended. Opponent's [Reflections 2] objective targets Rey instead of Luke. While Rey at a battleground site, Visage Of The Emperor is suspended. Once per turn, may deploy a Jakku location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if you control Jakku system and occupy two Jakku battleground sites (or vice versa). We Need Your Help: While this side up, once during opponent's control phase, if you control two Jakku battlegrounds and are about to lose Force (except to a Force drain at a Jakku location), may reduce that Force loss to 1 (may not be further reduced). Once per turn, during battle involving your Resistance character, may subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny. While with Han, your [Episode VII] characters and [Episode VII] starships are defense value +2. Flip this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds.

back.title: Old Allies / We Need Your Help
back.text: Old Allies: Deploy Jakku system and Niima Outpost Shipyard (with [Episode VII] Falcon there). May deploy Graveyard Of Giants. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Combined Fleet Action, Harc Seff, Luke, or Jedi. Your Destiny is suspended. Opponent's [Reflections 2] objective targets Rey instead of Luke. While Rey at a battleground site, Visage Of The Emperor is suspended. Once per turn, may deploy a Jakku location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if you control Jakku system and occupy two Jakku battleground sites (or vice versa). We Need Your Help: While this side up, once during opponent's control phase, if you control two Jakku battlegrounds and are about to lose Force (except to a Force drain at a Jakku location), may reduce that Force loss to 1 (may not be further reduced). Once per turn, during battle involving your Resistance character, may subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny. While with Han, your [Episode VII] characters and [Episode VII] starships are defense value +2. Flip this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds.

name: Old Ben
title: Old Ben
text: Use 1 Force if any of your characters (except Obi-Wan) was just forfeited from a Tatooine site. Mysterious 'crazy wizard' steps in and revives (returns from Lost Pile) that character back to same site.
lore: 'That old man's just a crazy wizard.' Obi-Wan lived in Tatooine's deserts for years...ready for the right moment to act.

name: Old Pirates
title: •Old Pirates
text: If a battle was just initiated involving Han and any Lando, the eventual loser of the battle may not lose cards from Life Force to satisfy battle damage while that player has any cards in hand. OR Cancel Double-Crossing, No-Good Swindler.
lore: 'How you doing, you old pirate? So good to see you.'

name: Old Times
title: •Old Times
text: If Luke and Biggs are defending a battle together (or are in any battle together at Tatooine), add one battle destiny. OR If Luke and Biggs are making an Attack Run, add one battle destiny to your Attack Run total.
lore: 'I'll be right up there with you! And, have I got stories to tell you...'

name: Ominous Rumors
title: •Ominous Rumors
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on Endor system if opponent controls no Endor sites. Your Force drains are +2 at up to X other battleground systems, where X = number of Endor sites you occupy. Effect canceled if opponent controls three Endor sites. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Rumors of a new 'technological terror' filled the galaxy with dread.

name: Ominous Rumors (V)
title: •Ominous Rumors (V)
text: Deploy on Bunker; may choose: Activate 1 Force for each opponent's non-battleground location on table, or take Endor Shield into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. Fenson, Kensaric, and Perimeter Patrol's game text is canceled. Fallen Portal may not target Endor sites. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Rumors of a new 'technological terror' filled the galaxy with dread.

name: Ommni Box
title: Ommni Box
text: Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile or Used Pile.
lore: Difficult-to-play instrument which enhances music. Tech Mo'r plays one for Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes in the Mos Eisley Cantina.

name: Ommni Box & It's Worse
title: Ommni Box & It's Worse
text: USED: Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile. LOST: If It Could Be Worse was just played, it is canceled and you may use X Force to raise damage against opponent by X amount. OR If opponent just lost Force from a battle, play to increase loss by 1 Force.

name: Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)
title: Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)
text: USED: For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to the following cards on table (if any): A Good Blaster At Your Side, No Disintegrations!, Stardust, and They Will Be Lost And Confused. OR Cancel Blast The Door, Kid! or It Could Be Worse. (Immune to It's A Hit!) OR Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile. LOST: If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force.

name: On Target
title: •On Target
text: If you have a piloted capital starship armed with a starship weapon, use 2 Force to target an opponent's starship present. Until end of your next turn, target cannot move and its pilots may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny.
lore: Some Imperial starfighters are equipped with sensors, informing the pilot when an enemy craft has targeted him. The pilot's evasive maneuvers cost him time, but save his life.

name: On The Edge
title: On The Edge
text: Use 1 Force and target one Rebel (on table) of ability > 2. Choose a number from 1 to 6. You may retrieve that amount from your Lost Pile if you now draw destiny > chosen number. If you fail, Rebel is lost.
lore: Luke and Leia nearly fell over the retracted bridge across the Death Star's central core while trying to elude stormtroopers. They were soon trapped on the precipice.

name: On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation
title: •On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation
text: Target an opponent's character at Galactic Senate if you have a senator there with a matching agenda. For remainder of turn: your senator's politics is increased by target's current politics, and target's politics is then reduced to zero.
lore: A political agenda is no use without supporters. And in the world of politics, left and right often meet in the middle.

name: On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon
title: On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon
text: On The Verge Of Greatness: Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships. Once per turn, may deploy a Scarif battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique Imperials, vehicles, and capital starships are deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer). Non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site and Death Star orbiting Scarif. Taking Control Of The Weapon: While this side up, A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere. Vader may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. At Death Star, system it orbits, and sites related to either, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if your non-unique card with ability in battle). During your draw phase, may retrieve a non-unique card with ability. Flip this card if you do not have a leader at a Scarif battleground site. Place out of play if Death Star or Shield Gate not on table.

back.title: On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon
back.text: On The Verge Of Greatness: Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships. Once per turn, may deploy a Scarif battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique Imperials, vehicles, and capital starships are deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer). Non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site and Death Star orbiting Scarif. Taking Control Of The Weapon: While this side up, A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere. Vader may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. At Death Star, system it orbits, and sites related to either, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if your non-unique card with ability in battle). During your draw phase, may retrieve a non-unique card with ability. Flip this card if you do not have a leader at a Scarif battleground site. Place out of play if Death Star or Shield Gate not on table.

name: One More Pass
title: •One More Pass
text: If you are about to draw power harpoon weapon destiny, add ability of one pilot aboard same vehicle.
lore: 'Cable out. Let 'er go!'

name: One-Arm
title: •One-Arm
text: Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to Wampa Cave. For remainder of game, all wampas are selective creatures.
lore: When a wampa is wounded, the other members of its pack band together to repel the threat.

name: Only Jedi Carry That Weapon
title: •Only Jedi Carry That Weapon
text: Plays on table. For opponent to steal a weapon from target character using a non-[Episode I] card, must first draw destiny. If destiny +1 > target's ability, weapon stolen. Otherwise, attempt fails and stealing card is placed out of play.
lore: An elegant weapon for a more civilized age.

name: Only Jedi Carry That Weapon (V)
title: •Only Jedi Carry That Weapon (V)
text: Plays on table. For opponent to steal a weapon from target character using a non-[Episode I] card, must first draw destiny. Unless destiny +1 > target's ability, attempt fails and stealing card is placed out of play. [Episode I] blasters are immune to An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops.
lore: An elegant weapon for a more civilized age.

name: Onyx 1
title: •Onyx 1
text: May deploy -2 with a pilot as a 'react' to same location as any Imperial-class Star Destroyer. May add 1 pilot. Any starship cannon may deploy aboard. Immune to attrition < 4 when Jendon piloting.
lore: Designed to emulate Rebel starfighter advantages. Production began shortly before the Battle of Endor. Armed with laser cannons, ion cannons and missile launchers.

name: Onyx 2
title: •Onyx 2
text: Deploys for free to any mobile system. May deploy with a pilot as a 'react'. May add 1 pilot. Any starship cannon may deploy aboard. Immune to attrition < 4 when Yorr piloting.
lore: Part of limited production run of TIE defenders. Testing of the prototype defender indicated the need for a more powerful hyperdrive, which was added for this production model.

name: Onyx 2 (V)
title: •Onyx 2 (V)
text: May deploy as a 'react'. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed (except as a 'react'), may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand).
lore: Part of limited production run of TIE defenders. Testing of the prototype defender indicated the need for a more powerful hyperdrive, which was added for this production model.

name: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?
title: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?
text: If Nabrun Leids just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Nabrun is lost and all Rebels transported are captured. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just-deployed smuggler from moving this turn. OR Cancel a Kessel Run.
lore: Greedo cheskopokuta klees ruya Solo. Hoko yanee boopa gush Cantina. Cheeco wa Solo's anye nyuma Greedo vakee. Jabba kul steeka et en anpaw.

name: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V)
title: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V)
text: USED: Cancel Nabrun Leids (Immune to Sense) OR Use 1 Force to take a Rodian (or a non-unique alien of your Rep's species) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: During your move phase, 'break cover' of an Undercover spy.
lore: Greedo cheskopokuta klees ruya Solo. Hoko yanee boopa gush Cantina. Cheeco wa Solo's anye nyuma Greedo vakee. Jabba kul steeka et en anpaw.

name: Oola
title: •Oola
text: During your control phase, may cause opponent to reveal entire hand by using X Force, where X = number of cards in opponent's hand. All unique (•) male Imperials or unique (•) male aliens there are placed in opponent's Used Pile.
lore: Female Twi'lek musician. Became a dancer to live a life of luxury. Has worked for Jabba for only two days. Desperate to escape.

name: OOM-9
title: •OOM-9
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May add or subtract one from a just drawn Energy Shell weapon destiny draw here. While at Battle Plains, twice per game may take Open Fire! or Cease Fire! into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Officer battle droid who acted as a unit leader in the attack against the Gungans. Required advice from the Droid Control Ship in order to defeat the Gungan energy shield.

name: Opee Sea Killer
title: •Opee Sea Killer
text: Deploy on table. Cancels Sando Aqua Monster. While no card here, may place an opponent's just-drawn battle destiny face-up here. If opponent just drew battle destiny with the same card title as card here, place both cards in opponent's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: With a vicious array of pointed teeth, the opee sea killer is a fearsome hunter. When outmatched in size, it uses small crevices to avoid bigger predators.

name: Opee Sea Killer
title: •Opee Sea Killer
text: Deploy on table. Cancels Sando Aqua Monster. While no card here, may place an opponent's just-drawn battle destiny face-up here. If opponent just drew battle destiny with the same card title as card here, place both cards in opponent's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The opee sea killer catches its prey with a long, flexible tongue. It uses camouflage to assist in hunting prey, as well as avoiding larger predators like the sando aqua monster.

name: Open Fire!
title: •Open Fire!
text: Deploy on your AAT. Once during your control phase may use 3 Force to fire your AAT Laser Cannon on this AAT for free.
lore: When given the attack coordinates, AAT weaponry can be programmed to track and fire automatically for maximum destruction.

name: Operational As Planned
title: •Operational As Planned
text: USED: Place one card from hand on top of Force Pile. STARTING: If Endor system on table, take Death Star II system, Jerjerrod and any Effect into hand from Reserve Deck. When you draw your starting hand, draw only six more cards. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: 'We shall double our efforts.'

name: Operational As Planned (V)
title: •Operational As Planned (V)
text: USED: Use 1 Force to deploy Krennic or a Jedha location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Death Star on table, deploy Superlaser and up to two Effects that deploy on table and are always immune to Alter. Place this Interrupt in hand.
lore: 'We shall double our efforts.'

name: Oppressive Enforcement
title: •Oppressive Enforcement
text: Plays on table. Your Immediate Effects may play for free. Whenever opponent cancels your card with Sense or Alter, place that canceled card in Used Pile.
lore: The Imperial fleet keeps a tight grip on the systems under its control. Abuses and excesses by local citizens are not tolerated.

name: Oppressive Enforcement
title: •Oppressive Enforcement
text: Deploy on your side of table. Your Imperial capital starships are each destiny +1. Your Immediate Effects may deploy for free. Whenever opponent cancels your card with Sense or Alter, place that canceled card in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Imperial fleet keeps a tight grip on the systems under its control. Abuses and excesses by local citizens are not tolerated.

name: Orbital Bombardment
title: •Orbital Bombardment
text: During battle at a site related to a system your dreadnaught or Star Destroyer occupies, add 1 to your total battle destiny. If you also control that system (or occupy it with Fulminatrix), add 2 instead and the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited.
lore: Blank.

name: Orbital Mine
title: <>Orbital Mine
text: Deploy at the same system as a bomber. 'Explodes' if an opponent's starship deploys or moves here. Draw destiny. Add 2 when targeting a capital starship. Starship lost if total destiny > defense value. Orbital mine is also lost.
lore: Often stolen from the Empire. Used by the Rebellion to protect key spaceports. Can be released to cover the retreat of a fleeing strike force.

name: Ord Mantell
title: •Ord Mantell
text: Dark: Your Bounty Hunters are deploy -2 here. Light: (none)

name: Ord Mantell
title: •Ord Mantell
text: Light: If you control, each of opponent's bounty hunters is forfeit -2. Dark: Each of your bounty hunter pilots add an additional 1 to power of starships they pilot here.

name: Ord Mantell (V)
title: •Ord Mantell (V)
text: Dark: Your [Independent] starships may move here as a 'react.' Once per game, if you control, may take Death Mark into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Your smugglers and [Independent] starships deploy -1 here.

name: Ord Mantell Operative
title: Ord Mantell Operative
text: While at an Ord Mantell site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is power +1 (or +2 if your bounty hunter is on Ord Mantell) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck- reshuffle.
lore: Many Aqualish draft and maintain bounty hunting contracts for the Empire, the Hutts or anyone with credits. Fight against the Alliance to avoid losing their best customer.

name: Order To Engage
title: •Order To Engage
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on opponent's side of table. At the end of each of opponent's battle phases, if a battle did not take place at every location where both players have presence at the end of that phase, opponent loses 3 Force.
lore: Political pressure forced the Empire to join battle with the Alliance in otherwise tactically poor situations. Failure to engage the enemy was considered tantamount to treason.

name: Organa's Ceremonial Necklace
title: •Organa's Ceremonial Necklace
text: Deploy on any Yavin 4 site. Target one Imperial. When Imperial reaches target site, 'steal' necklace. Whenever necklace is present during Force drain: add 1 to Force drain and may then pass (for free) to an adjacent site you control (if any), and so on.
lore: Necklace worn by Princess Leia during the awards ceremony after the Battle of Yavin. A powerful artifact in the Alderaanian royal family for dozens of generations.

name: Organized Attack
title: Organized Attack
text: USED: If a battle was just initiated, each of your X-wings and Y-wings present is power +1 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn. LOST: Lose 1 Force to take up to three non-unique X-wings and/or non-unique Y-wings into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'Hold up here and wait for my signal to start your run.'

name: Orn Free Taa
title: •Orn Free Taa
text: Agendas: taxation, wealth. While in a senate majority, once per turn may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. During opponent's deploy phase, may use X Force to place Taa in your Used Pile. (X = cards in opponent's Force Pile.)
lore: Obese Rutian Twi'lek senator. Once a tax collector, he has used his connections and political power to fuel a myriad of devious plots for whomever can make him the highest offer.

name: Orrimaarko
title: •Orrimaarko
text: When Orrimaarko is in a battle you just won against an Imperial, opponent must lose 2 Force. Immune to attrition < 3 (or < 4 when present at a forest, jungle or exterior Endor site).
lore: Dresselian scout and resistance leader. Worked tirelessly to combat the subjugation of his homeworld before Bothans brought him into contact with the Alliance.

name: Orrimaarko (V)
title: •Orrimaarko (V)
text: If you just won a battle here (or at same site as your scout general), opponent loses 1 Force. While on Endor, adds 1 to your [Endor] Epic Event total for each Endor location you occupy and, once per game, may cancel a Force drain at a related battleground.
lore: Dresselian scout and resistance leader. Worked tirelessly to combat the subjugation of his homeworld before Bothans brought him into contact with the Alliance.

name: Ortolan
title: •••Ortolan
text: Power and forfeit +2 on Hoth or at Dining Room. While at a marker site, cumulatively adds 1 to number of Hoth sites required for opponent to gain a Force drain bonus from Walker Garrison.
lore: Squat, floppy-eared food lovers. Ortolans come from the frigid planet Orto. Communicate above the auditory range of most species.

name: Ortugg
title: •Ortugg
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Functions as a leader if present with another Gamorrean. While at Audience Chamber, all your other Gamorreans are forfeit +2.
lore: Gamorrean in charge of the Gamorreans at Jabba's palace. Posted to stand guard at the entrance cavern. Assigned by Jabba to keep an eye on Tessek.

name: Ortugg (V)
title: •Ortugg (V)
text: Permanent weapon is •Ortugg's Ax (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value). While Ortugg is your Rep, your non-unique Gamorreans are deploy -1 and forfeit +3.
lore: Gamorrean in charge of the Gamorreans at Jabba's palace. Posted to stand guard at the entrance cavern. Assigned by Jabba to keep an eye on Tessek.

name: OS-72-1 In Obsidian 1
title: •OS-72-1 In Obsidian 1
text: Deploy -1 and power +3 at a cloud sector. Permanent pilot is •OS-72-1, who provides ability of 2, adds 2 to power and, at a cloud sector, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Lead starfighter of Obsidian Squadron. Flown by Cive Rashon. Call sign 'Howlrunner.' She served in an elite TIE squadron aboard the Star Destroyer Avenger.

name: OS-72-10
title: •OS-72-10
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if any TIE). When piloting a TIE at a cloud sector, adds one battle destiny and makes that TIE immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 if Obsidian 10).
lore: Pilot of Obsidian 10. Has served aboard the Conquest, the Thunderflare and the Executor. Not interested in advancing his rank as it would remove him from the pilot's seat.

name: OS-72-2 In Obsidian 2
title: •OS-72-2 In Obsidian 2
text: Deploy -1 and power +3 at a cloud sector. Permanent pilot is •OS-72-2, who provides ability of 2, adds 2 to power and, at a cloud sector, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Piloted by Dodson Makraven, wingman of Cive Rashon. Experienced TIE pilot with many kills in atmospheric combat. Nicknamed 'Night Beast' for his many curfew violations.

name: Ounee Ta
title: •Ounee Ta
text: Deploy on table. You may immediately take top card of Lost Pile into hand. None Shall Pass is unique (•) and a Lost Interrupt. At each opponent's <> site, your characters and vehicles are each deploy -3 and your Force generation is +1. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Jabba's decadent behavior makes him susceptible to deception. Leia and Lando exploited this weakness, posing as Jabba's kind of scum.

name: Ounee Ta
title: •Ounee Ta
text: Plays on table. At each opponent's <> site, your Rebels are each deploy -2 and your Force generation is +1.
lore: Jabba's decadent behavior makes him susceptible to deception. Leia and Lando exploited this weakness, posing as Jabba's kind of scum.

name: Ounee Ta (V)
title: •Ounee Ta (V)
text: Deploy on a battleground site. When deployed, may take top card of Lost Pile into hand. Opponent may not modify the deploy cost of your characters deploying here. Once per game, may place an Interrupt (except Ghhhk) from opponent's Lost Pile out of play. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Jabba's decadent behavior makes him susceptible to deception. Leia and Lando exploited this weakness, posing as Jabba's kind of scum.

name: Our Blockade Is Perfectly Legal
title: •Our Blockade Is Perfectly Legal
text: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to add 3 to any battle destiny just drawn. If a blockade agenda here, during your turn you may cancel a 'react' or an attempt by opponent to move away from a battle.
lore: Until it could be proven otherwise, the Trade Federation maintained that they were pursuing a legal means of protesting the taxation of outlying trade routes.

name: Our First Catch Of The Day
title: Our First Catch Of The Day
text: Add 2 to a tractor beam destiny draw. OR Cancel The First Transport Is Away! or Hyper Escape.
lore: 'Sir, Rebel ships are coming into our sector.'

name: Our Most Desperate Hour
title: •Our Most Desperate Hour
text: Deploy on Alderaan. Target one Rebel at Tatooine. When Target reaches Utinni Effect, retrieve one lost Force for each Force-Attuned character you have on table, two for each Force-Sensitive or Jedi. Lose Utinni Effect.
lore: Following her father Bail Organa's instructions, Leia placed the Death Star plans into R2-D2, hoping that they could be delivered safely to Alderaan by Obi-Wan Kenobi.

name: Our Only Hope
title: •Our Only Hope
text: USED: If your Rebel of ability > 2 just won a battle or duel, randomly take into hand one card stacked on Insignificant Rebellion. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: If Luke is in battle (except with Vader), subtract 2 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws.
lore: 'The Emperor knew, as I did, if Anakin were to have any offspring, they would be a threat to him.'

name: Our Only Hope (V)
title: •Our Only Hope (V)
text: Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. OR If Like My Father Before Me on table, take Yoda's Hut or a Death Star II site into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Out Of Commission
title: Out Of Commission
text: During your control phase, use 2 Force to release a starship held by any Tractor Beam. (Not effective on Death Star Tractor Beam if Central Core in play.) OR Randomly select one card from opponent's Lost Pile or Blaster Rack and place out of play.
lore: 'I hope that old man got the tractor beam out of commission or this is gonna be a real short trip.'

name: Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated
title: Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated
text: USED: Use 1 Force to randomly place one card in opponent's Lost Pile out of play. LOST: Cancel one hologram. OR Use 4 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 to destiny for each asteroid sector on table. If total destiny> 3, Imperial Holotable site is 'blown away' (opponent loses 4 Force).

name: Out Of Commission (V)
title: Out Of Commission (V)
text: Choose an artwork card to be lost. OR For remainder of turn, forfeit values may not be increased and opponent may not target your 'hit' cards to be lost. OR During your control phase, use 1 Force to relocate [Set 1] Obi-Wan to an adjacent site.
lore: 'I hope that old man got that tractor beam out of commission or this is gonna be a real short trip.'

name: Out Of Nowhere
title: Out Of Nowhere
text: If opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector where you have a starship with maneuver > 3, use 1 Force to add one battle destiny.
lore: Black market sensor-stealth arrays can be used to hide starships from enemy sensor scans. Stellar interference can naturally shield a starship for surprise attacks.

name: Out Of Somewhere
title: •Out Of Somewhere
text: If opponent just initiated a battle with more than double your total power, search your Reserve Deck. Any one character you find there may deploy as a 'react' (at normal use of the Force). Reshuffle.
lore: When the ghost-like image of Obi-Wan failed to appear, another came out of the light to rescue Luke.

name: Outer Rim Scout
title: Outer Rim Scout
text: Deploy -1 to your [Independent Starship] starship. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a [Independent Starship] starship, instead adds 3 to power and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Suspends Asteroid Sanctuary at related sector.
lore: Smugglers and scouts employed by the ISB. Search the far reaches of the galaxy for Rebel activity and habitable worlds. Know all the smugglers' best hiding places.

name: Outflank
title: •Outflank
text: During a battle, if you have weapons at at least 2 sites adjacent to that battle, add 3 to your total power and add one battle destiny. OR For remainder of turn, your biker scout at an exterior site is power +1 and adds 1 to each of that character's weapon destiny draws.
lore: Commander Igar's defense of Endor called for the use of speeder bikes to harass any attacking Rebels.

name: Outrider
title: •Outrider
text: May add 2 pilots and 1 passenger. Utinni Effects which retrieve Force are immune to Alter, but are placed out of play when completed. While Dash or Leebo piloting, immune to attrition< 4.
lore: Highly modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-2400. KonGar KGDefender military grade ion engines. Griffyn/Y2TG hyperdrive. Never boarded by Imperial customs.

name: Outrider (V)
title: •Outrider (V)
text: May add 2 pilots and 1 passenger. Power, maneuver, and immunity to attrition +1 for each card stacked on A Useless Gesture (limit +3). While Dash or Leebo piloting, immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Highly modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-2400. KonGar KGDefender military grade ion engines. Griffyn/Y2TG hyperdrive. Never boarded by Imperial customs.

name: Outrider (V) (AI)
title: •Outrider (V) (AI)
text: May add 2 pilots and 1 passenger. Power, maneuver, and immunity to attrition +1 for each card stacked on A Useless Gesture (limit +3). While Dash or Leebo piloting, immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Highly modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-2400. KonGar KGDefender military grade ion engines. Griffyn/Y2TG hyperdrive. Never boarded by Imperial customs.

name: Overload
title: Overload
text: Target any weapon (except a Gaderffii Stick or any Ewok weapon). Draw destiny. Weapon lost if destiny < weapon's destiny number. If destiny = 0, the character or starship carrying weapon is also lost.
lore: Weapons like lightsabers, turbolasers and blasters run on powerful energy cells or generators. Occasionally, these cells overheat causing the weapon to unexpectedly explode.

name: Overseeing It Personally
title: •Overseeing It Personally
text: Deploy on Emperor. While at a battleground planet site you control, at each related site where an Imperial is present, your Force drains are +1.
lore: Though reluctant to leave Coruscant. Emperor Palpatine occasionally finds it necessary to personally put lagging Imperial operations back on schedule.

name: Overseeing It Personally (V)
title: •Overseeing It Personally (V)
text: Deploy on your leader. Opponent may not cancel or reduce Force drains at same battleground. If on Emperor, may place Effect in Lost Pile to retrieve an Imperial leader.
lore: Though reluctant to leave Coruscant. Emperor Palpatine occasionally finds it necessary to personally put lagging Imperial operations back on schedule.

name: Overseer
title: •Overseer
text: May add Harc as a pilot. During battle, adds one destiny to total power. If a Dark Jedi or Sith was just deployed to a related site, may deploy a related location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 at Bespin).
lore: Used to combat pirate activity in and around Cloud City. Top speed in atmosphere 1,150 kph. Hyperdrive installed by Bespin Motors.

name: Overwhelmed
title: Overwhelmed
text: During your deploy phase, target a system where your total power is more than double opponent's total power and opponent has no Jedi or starship weapon. Place all opponent's starships there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile.
lore: When the Empire amasses its fleet, the only option for the Alliance is retreat.

name: Owen Lars
title: •Owen Lars
text: Deploys free at Lars' Moisture Farm. Power +2 if at same site as Beru Lars or a Vaporator. If lost from table during opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.
lore: Guardian of Luke Skywalker. Husband of Beru Lars. Brother of Obi- Wan Kenobi. Farmer of moisture. Disapprover of Luke's desire to leave Tatooine.

name: Owen Lars & •Beru Lars
title: •Owen Lars & •Beru Lars
text: Deploy free to Lars' Moisture Farm. Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent has a Stormtrooper at a Tatooine site, you may not play Harvest. If lost during opponent's turn, Luke is power +6 until end of your next turn.
lore: Watchful guardians of Luke Skywalker. When the Lars' moisture farm was attacked by stormtroopers, Luke's life changed forever.

name: OWO-1 With Backup
title: •OWO-1 With Backup
text: Requires +2 Force to use Landspeed. Power +1 for each of opponent's Jedi present. While with a battledroid at a site, draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Opponent's Force drains are -1 at adjacent sites.
lore: Trade Federation battle droid leader assigned to take a squad and destroy what was left of the Jedi ambassadors. His mission went unaccomplished.

name: P-59
title: •P-59
text: Permanent weapon is Twin Cannons (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; if destiny +1 > defense value, target hit and opponent loses 2 Force). Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Trade Federation destroyer droid squad leader. Charged with removing the threat posed by Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi. Found the Jedi hard to kill, but forced their retreat.

name: P-60
title: •P-60
text: Permanent weapon is Twin Cannons (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; if destiny +2 > defense value, target hit and opponent loses 1 Force). While with a destroyer droid at a site, adds one battle destiny.
lore: Trade Federation droideka led by unit commander P-59. Assisted in the attempt to keep the Jedi ambassadors from breaching the battleship's command center.

name: Padme Naberrie
title: •Padme Naberrie
text: Twice per game may deploy Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While present with your Jedi at a site, opponent may not target Amidala with weapons.
lore: Queen Amidala posed as one of her own handmaidens for added safety as well as to keep an eye on her Jedi protectors. Was to be protected by the Jedi at all times.

name: Padme Naberrie (AI)
title: •Padme Naberrie (AI)
text: Twice per game may deploy Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While present with your Jedi at a site, opponent may not target Amidala with weapons.
lore: Queen Amidala posed as one of her own handmaidens for added safety as well as to keep an eye on her Jedi protectors. Was to be protected by the Jedi at all times.

name: Padme Naberrie (V)
title: •Padme Naberrie (V)
text: Cancels Vader's game text here. If with a Skywalker, may add one destiny to attrition. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Queen Amidala posed as one of her own handmaidens for added safety as well as to keep an eye on her Jedi protectors. Was to be protected by the Jedi at all times.

name: Padme Naberrie (V) (AI)
title: •Padme Naberrie (V) (AI)
text: Cancels Vader's game text here. If with a Skywalker, may add one destiny to attrition. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Queen Amidala posed as one of her own handmaidens for added safety as well as to keep an eye on her Jedi protectors. Was to be protected by the Jedi at all times.

name: Paige Tico
title: •Paige Tico
text: Adds 1 to weapon destiny draws and defense value of anything she is aboard as a passenger. While out of play, adds 1 to your total power where you have a Resistance character of ability = 2. If just lost, may place her out of play.
lore: Female gunner.

name: Palace Raider
title: Palace Raider
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (or 3 to power of anything he drives). When driving a transport vehicle, it moves for free and he adds one battle destiny.
lore: Smugglers from many worlds are hunted by the Empire for providing arms and supplies to the Alliance. The Outer Rim is their refuge.

name: Palace Raider (V)
title: Palace Raider (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While You're A Slave? on table, Palace Raiders (including this character) deploy -3. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.
lore: Smugglers from many worlds are hunted by the Empire for providing arms and supplies to the Alliance. The Outer Rim is their refuge.

name: Palejo Reshad
title: •Palejo Reshad
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at Audience Chamber, all your Corellians are power and forfeit +1 (+2 if non-unique) and your Force generation at the Corellia system is +2.
lore: Corellian spice trader. Makes a large profit by selling spice in Jabba's court. Secretly uses part of the profit to help fund the Rebellion.

name: Palpatine, Emperor Returned
title: •Palpatine, Emperor Returned
text: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) except to an [Episode VII] location without a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader.

name: Palpatine, Emperor Returned (AI)
title: •Palpatine, Emperor Returned (AI)
text: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) except to an [Episode VII] location without a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader.

name: Palpatine, Galactic Emperor
title: •Palpatine, Galactic Emperor
text: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a site opponent occupies. Once per turn, may take The Empire's Back into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent may not limit your Force generation at your mobile sites. Immune to attrition.
lore: Since the debacle at Yavin, the Emperor places a premium on the security of his costly war machine. Leader.

name: Panaka's Blaster
title: •Panaka's Blaster
text: Deploy on Panaka. May target a character, creature, or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value. When this blaster hits a character or vehicle in battle, your total power here is +3 for remainder of battle.
lore: Naboo blaster personally modified by Captain Panaka. Boosted by extra power packs that allow it to maintain sustained fire in tense situations.

name: Panaka, Protector Of The Queen
title: •Panaka, Protector Of The Queen
text: Deploys for free to a Naboo site. While with Amidala at a Naboo site, opponent may not target Amidala with weapons. While on Naboo, immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Leader of the Royal Naboo security Forces. Fought alongside Amidala in order to capture Viceroy Nute Gunray.

name: Panaka, Protector Of The Queen (AI)
title: •Panaka, Protector Of The Queen (AI)
text: Deploys for free to a Naboo site. While with Amidala at a Naboo site, opponent may not target Amidala with weapons. While on Naboo, immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Leader of the Royal Naboo security Forces. Fought alongside Amidala in order to capture Viceroy Nute Gunray.

name: Panic
title: Panic
text: If opponent just initiated a battle where opponent has more than double your power, reveal up to 3 cards from your Reserve Deck. Of those 3, deploy anywhere (for free) any characters, starships, vehicles, devices or weapons. Any others are lost.
lore: Cornered by Imperial troops, Han's gambler reflexes led him to do what comes naturally - attack! Surprise assaults work...sometimes.

name: Paploo
title: •Paploo
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each light side icon at same Endor site. May pilot only speeder bikes. Once during each of your control phases, may take one Free Ride into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Ewok scout. Son of Warok. Brave, adventurous thief. Stole an Imperial speeder bike to create a diversion. 'Not bad for a little furball.'

name: Paploo (V)
title: •Paploo (V)
text: While on Endor, Perimeter Patrol is suspended. Once per game, if in battle with a speeder bike (or two scouts), may relocate Paploo and one opponent's character of ability < 4 present with him (unless either are 'hit') to an adjacent site.
lore: Ewok scout. Son of Warok. Brave, adventurous thief. Stole an Imperial speeder bike to create a diversion. 'Not bad for a little furball.'

name: Part Of The Tribe
title: •Part Of The Tribe
text: Deploy on your non-alien, non-Jedi character. When deployed, choose a species of an alien here. Character gains that species. Aliens of that species may deploy (for -1 Force if non-unique) or move here as a 'react'. While on Endor, adds one [Light Side Force] icon.
lore: Wookiees are known to be creatures of great emotion and are very protective of family and friends. Chewbacca has come to treat Luke as a member of his own family.

name: Passage To The Alderaan System
title: •Passage To The Alderaan System
text: If Stolen Data Tapes on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may take a general or a senator into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, may simultaneously deploy [A New Hope] Falcon (deploy -1) and [A New Hope] Han from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Falcon is immune to Gravity Shadow. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Han's smuggling adventures in Corporate Sector and Hutt Space put him in many tight scrapes. He's about to be in another.

name: Passel Argente
title: •Passel Argente
text: Agendas: ambition, taxation. While in a senate majority, opponent's non-unique starships and non-unique vehicles are each deploy +2 and power -1. Argente is politics +X, where X = number of opponent's senators at same site.
lore: A senator known for his ability to deflect blame. It is rumored that Argente receives kickbacks from a few corporations to thwart other companies' developments.

name: Passel Argente (V)
title: •Passel Argente (V)
text: Agendas: ambition, taxation. While in a senate majority, if your only [Coruscant] Political Effect on table is not This Is Outrageous!, it may not be canceled or suspended. Argente is politics +X, where X = number of opponent's characters here.
lore: A senator known for his ability to deflect blame. It is rumored that Argente receives kickbacks from a few corporations to thwart other companies' developments.

name: Path Of Least Resistance
title: •Path Of Least Resistance
text: Cancel Rite of Passage. OR Relocate one of your characters at an interior mobile site to a related interior mobile site.
lore: Yoda didn't say anything bad about taking the 'quick and easy corridor.'

name: Path Of Least Resistance & •Revealed
title: •Path Of Least Resistance & •Revealed
text: Place one opponent's Undercover spy in opponent's Used Pile. OR If opponent has no presence or Force icons, return spy to hand. Any Force used to deploy spy remains used and that card may not deploy this turn. OR Relocate one of your characters at an interior mobile site to a related interior mobile site.

name: Patience!
title: •Patience!
text: If your [Dagobah] objective on table, deploy on table and stack five Jedi Tests from outside the game face up here. I Won't Fail You: Only Luke may be your apprentice. You may deploy face up Jedi Tests from here as if from hand. Place completed Jedi Tests on table. Jedi Tests are suspended (not lost) while Luke not on table. I've Got To Go To Them: Once per turn, if you just lost Force from a Force drain and you do not occupy a battleground, turn a Jedi Test here face down. Remember Your Failure At The Cave: During battle, Jedi Test #3 is suspended unless Luke battling alone.

name: Patrol Craft
title: Patrol Craft
text: Power +1 at Coruscant or Bespin. May add 1 driver and 1 passenger. May deploy or move as a 'react.' At cloud sectors, may move and be targeted by weapons like a starfighter.
lore: Small, enclosed patrol fighter used on many worlds to help maintain order. A cheaper alternative to the Bespin Motors cloud car.

name: Patrol Craft
title: Patrol Craft
text: Power +1 or Coruscant of Bespin. May add 1 driver and 1 passenger. May deploy or move as a 'react.' At cloud sectors, may move and be targeted by weapons like a starfighter.
lore: Small, lightly armed, enclosed vehicle widely used throughout the galaxy. Sometimes used as a pleasure craft by wealthy eccentrics.

name: Peli Motto
title: •Peli Motto
text: While at Starship Graveyard, a Tatooine site, or a docking bay, power +3 and may cancel I've Lost Artoo! or Lateral Damage (or Restraining Bolt here). During your control phase, if at a battleground with Grogu, a Jawa, or a landed starfighter, may retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Female mechanic and scavenger.

name: Perimeter Patrol
title: •Perimeter Patrol
text: Deploy on Bunker. While you control Bunker, each time opponent deploys a vehicle, starship or Rebel to an Endor site (except Rebel Landing Site), that card cannot move or battle for remainder of turn and opponent must lose 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Heavy Imperial patrols on Endor forced the Rebels to deploy covertly. The required stealth measures created many complications.

name: Perimeter Scan
title: Perimeter Scan
text: Use 1 Force to glance at any one card which is face-down at a location. OR Use 1 Force to glance at opponent's hand. You may move each droid spy and Infantry Mine you find there to opponent's Used Pile. OR Cancel Probe Telemetry.
lore: 'It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.'

name: Perimeter Scan (V)
title: Perimeter Scan (V)
text: USED: Play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. OR Target opponent's just-deployed [Maintenance] card. Target may not battle (or allow opponent to deploy cards from Reserve Deck) for remainder of turn. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Cancel Trample (unless targeting an Undercover spy).
lore: 'It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.'

name: Phantom
title: •Phantom
text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. May deploy (with a pilot) or move as a 'react' to same system as a Rebel starship. When with Ghost, adds one destiny to total power.
lore: Phoenix Squadron.

name: Phoenix Squadron Operations
title: •Phoenix Squadron Operations
text: If Lothal on table, deploy on table. Chopper, Sabine, and Zeb are deploy -1. Once per turn, may deploy Malachor, Mandalore, or Seelos (or Chopper, Wedge, Zeb, or an A-wing to a Lothal location) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.

name: Phylo Gandish
title: •Phylo Gandish
text: Deploys for free at a docking bay. Adds 2 to the power of anything she pilots. While at opponent's docking bay, adds 2 to your Force drains there, and your other characters there are defense value +1 and immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Good-natured former pilot whose family owns a galactic transportation company. Years of travel has her to learn many loopholes in spaceport protocol.

name: Physical Choke
title: Physical Choke
text: Cause one Rebel Trooper to be immediately lost. OR If a Dark Jedi is present at a battle you have just won, use 1 Force to attempt to choke any opposing character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's ability, target is lost.
lore: Darth Vader often used physical means of 'persuasion' to get information. Captain Antilles of Tantive IV chose to die rather than reveal the location of the stolen Death Star plans.

name: Physical Choke (V)
title: Physical Choke (V)
text: USED: Take into hand from Reserve Deck and reshuffle (or place in owner's Used Pile) Deactivated Hyperdrive or an Admiral's Order. LOST: During battle, if Vader present with two opponent's characters of ability < 4, add one battle destiny. If any are Rebel troopers, choose one to be 'choked' (lost).
lore: Darth Vader often used physical means of 'persuasion' to get information. Captain Antilles of Tantive IV chose to die rather than reveal the location of the stolen Death Star plans.

name: Pinned Down
title: •Pinned Down
text: Deploy on your side of table. Opponent may not 'react' away from a battle where you have a blaster present. Also, if you have a blaster present when opponent cancels a battle, draw destiny, opponent loses Force equal to destiny draw. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Heavy blaster fire hampered Han's attempts to open the Back Door to the Endor control bunker.

name: Pit Crews
title: •Pit Crews
text: Use 3 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has 3 or more of in hand are lost. OR Use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer. OR Target a Podracer. Draw destiny. If destiny > Podracer's destiny number, target Podracer is 'damaged.'
lore: Pit droids are used by Podracer pilots to assist in the maintenance of their racer. While a high standard is usually maintained, sometimes things can get out of hand.

name: Pit Droid
title: Pit Droid
text: While at Podracer Bay, once during each of your control phases may lose 1 Force to target your Podracer. Place target's top race destiny in Lost Pile, and draw one race destiny. During any control phase may use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer.
lore: Manufactured by Serv-O-Droid on Cyrillia. Collapses into a compact form when hit on the nose.

name: Pitiful Little Band
title: •Pitiful Little Band
text: If your scout is battling opponent's scout, spy or operative, add one battle destiny. OR If you have a spy or scout at Bunker or any prison, place out of play one captured spy of ability < 3 or captured operative there. Retrieve Force equal to double that captive's forfeit.
lore: The Emperor's defense of the forest moon of Endor appeared to work with devastating effectiveness.

name: Planet Defender Ion Cannon
title: •Planet Defender Ion Cannon
text: Deploy on an exterior Rebel Base site. During a battle at related system, may target a capital starship there using 2 Force. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 > armor, all starship weapons aboard target are lost, power = 0 and hyperspeed = 0.
lore: KDY v-150 surface-to-space heavy ion cannon. The most powerful ground-based weapon in the Rebel arsenal. Reserved for strategic installations due to limited supply.

name: Planetary Defenses
title: •Planetary Defenses
text: Plays on any interior site. This location may not be targeted by Proton Bombs.
lore: Key installations are protected from bombardment by a complex network of early-warning sensors, emergency shields and fast-response fighters.

name: Planetary Defenses (V)
title: •Planetary Defenses (V)
text: Plays on any site. This location may not be targeted by Proton Bombs. Cancels Program Trap here. Unless Death Star: Docking Bay 327 on table, Commence Primary Ignition is canceled.
lore: Key installations are protected from bombardment by a complex network of early-warning sensors, emergency shields and fast-response fighters.

name: Planetary Rings
title: <>Planetary Rings
text: Deploy on a battleground planet system. Adds one [Light Side] icon at your related Big One. If a sector was just drawn for asteroid destiny, cancel and redraw that destiny. Once per turn, may deploy a sector to this system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'We're gonna get pulverized if we stay out here much longer.'

name: Planetary Subjugation
title: •Planetary Subjugation
text: Deploy on table. You may add up to 5 to destiny of each TIE Bomber drawn for weapon or battle destiny. You may add 1 to Proton Bomb weapon destiny draws. Asteroid Sanctuary is canceled unless present with opponent's starship. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Empire crushes resistance with massive orbital bombardment. The coordinated attack of a TIE bomber wing reduces a planet's surface to rubble.

name: Plastoid Armor
title: •Plastoid Armor
text: Deploy on a Death Star site where a stormtrooper was just lost. Target one of your characters not on Death Star. When target reaches Utinni Effect, relocate to target. Target is now 'disguised:' gains spy skill, power and forfeit +2, and armor = 5.
lore: Luke and Han took the armor suits from fallen stormtroopers and used them as both protection and disguise to penetrate the detention cell block aboard the Death Star.

name: Plea To The Court
title: •Plea To The Court
text: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to cancel an opponent's Force drain. If a justice agenda here, during a battle where opponent has a weapon and you do not, may cancel a just drawn weapon destiny to cause a re-draw.
lore: Amidala did not hold much hope in the options she had. Regardless of how limited the choices, she had to choose one path to try and avert disaster befalling Naboo.

name: Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion
title: Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion
text: Plead My Case To The Senate: Deploy Galactic Senate and any other [Episode I] location. {For} remainder of game, Rebel and Imperial leaders of ability < 4 are politics +2. Counter Assault and Surprise Assault are canceled. You may deploy cards on your Political Effects to table. At Galactic Senate, weapon destiny draws are -6, creatures are lost and game text of non-Republic characters is canceled. {Flip} this card if you have 3 senators (or 2 senators, at least one with a peace agenda) at Galactic Senate. Sanity And Compassion: {While} this side up, once during your control phase may use 3 Force to place up to two random cards from opponent's hand into their Used Pile. Once per turn may take a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your senators are destiny +2 (or +3 for any character with an order agenda) when drawn for battle or weapon destiny. May use 2 Force at end of a turn to place all cards on your Political Effects into Used Pile. {Flip} this card if you have less than two senators at Galactic Senate.

back.title: Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion
back.text: Plead My Case To The Senate: Deploy Galactic Senate and any other [Episode I] location. {For} remainder of game, Rebel and Imperial leaders of ability < 4 are politics +2. Counter Assault and Surprise Assault are canceled. You may deploy cards on your Political Effects to table. At Galactic Senate, weapon destiny draws are -6, creatures are lost and game text of non-Republic characters is canceled. {Flip} this card if you have 3 senators (or 2 senators, at least one with a peace agenda) at Galactic Senate. Sanity And Compassion: {While} this side up, once during your control phase may use 3 Force to place up to two random cards from opponent's hand into their Used Pile. Once per turn may take a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your senators are destiny +2 (or +3 for any character with an order agenda) when drawn for battle or weapon destiny. May use 2 Force at end of a turn to place all cards on your Political Effects into Used Pile. {Flip} this card if you have less than two senators at Galactic Senate.

name: Plo Koon
title: •Plo Koon
text: Deploys only to Jedi Council Chamber. While at Jedi Council Chamber, immune to attrition and, once per turn if a weapon or battle destiny was just drawn, may cancel and cause a re-draw.
lore: Kel Dor Jedi Council member descended from a long line of Jedi. Known for exceptional sensory skills, Plo Koon's control of the Force is unmatched by most.

name: Plo Koon (V)
title: •Plo Koon (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to same location as Ahsoka (or vice versa). Once per turn, may lose top card of Force Pile to make your character (or piloted [Episode I] starfighter) here forfeit +2 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn.
lore: Kel Dor Jedi Council member descended from a long line of Jedi. Known for exceptional sensory skills, Plo Koon's control of the Force is unmatched by most.

name: Plo Koon (V) (AI)
title: •Plo Koon (V) (AI)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to same location as Ahsoka (or vice versa). Once per turn, may lose top card of Force Pile to make your character (or piloted [Episode I] starfighter) here forfeit +2 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn.
lore: Kel Dor Jedi Council member descended from a long line of Jedi. Known for exceptional sensory skills, Plo Koon's control of the Force is unmatched by most.

name: Plo Koon's Jedi Starfighter
title: •Plo Koon's Jedi Starfighter
text: May add 1 Jedi pilot. *Maneuver = pilot's ability. While Plo piloting, power +2, immune to attrition < 3, and once per turn, may cancel and redraw your weapon or battle destiny just drawn here.
lore: Blank.

name: Plo Koon's Jedi Starfighter (AI)
title: •Plo Koon's Jedi Starfighter (AI)
text: May add 1 Jedi pilot. *Maneuver = pilot's ability. While Plo piloting, power +2, immune to attrition < 3, and once per turn, may cancel and redraw your weapon or battle destiny just drawn here.
lore: Blank.

name: Podrace Prep
title: •Podrace Prep
text: LOST: Instead of drawing race destiny, use a card from hand. STARTING: Deploy Podrace Arena (with a Podracer, opponent may also deploy a Podracer there), Boonta Eve Podrace and any Effect that deploys for free. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
lore: Advanced preparation in Podracing is usually the key to winning. A little extra work at the start can mean a lot in the long run.

name: Podrace Prep (V)
title: •Podrace Prep (V)
text: If Credits Will Do Fine on table, deploy Podrace Arena, a Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, and three Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Opponent may deploy a Podracer (or play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect). Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Advanced preparation in Podracing is usually the key to winning. A little extra work at the start can mean a lot in the long run.

name: Podracer Collision
title: •Podracer Collision
text: USED: If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, search that Reserve Deck and place one Interrupt found there out of play. LOST: Lose 1 Force to remove a race destiny (random selection) from any Podracer and place it in owner's hand.
lore: Podracing demands constant attention to many variables as well as all opponents. Failure to do so can often result in reduced performance.

name: Poe Dameron
title: •Poe Dameron
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploy -1 to Jakku. When piloting, adds one battle destiny. Anything he pilots is immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Leader.

name: Poe Dameron (AI)
title: •Poe Dameron (AI)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploy -1 to Jakku. When piloting, adds one battle destiny. Anything he pilots is immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Leader.

name: Point Man
title: Point Man
text: Cancel Demotion, Restricted Deployment, Commence Recharging, Logistical Delay, They're On Dantooine, Asteroid Sanctuary, Scramble, Order To Engage, No Disintegrations, Asteroids Do Not Concern Me, Report To Lord Vader or What Is Thy Bidding, My Master?
lore: In a military situation, on a regional or galactic scale, commands sometimes get misinterpreted. A local commander giving orders is far more reliable.

name: Point Man (V)
title: Point Man (V)
text: USED: Move a trooper as a 'react' to a battle where you have a leader. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. LOST: During a battle at a site, cancel Keep Your Eyes Open.
lore: In a military situation, on a regional or galactic scale, commands sometimes get misinterpreted. A local commander giving orders is far more reliable.

name: Polarized Negative Power Coupling
title: Polarized Negative Power Coupling
text: Deploy on table. Turn every Used Pile face up. All subsequent cards placed in Used Piles are also turned face up. (Players must commit to using cards before revealing them.) Turn used cards face down whenever they are re-circulated.
lore: Imbalance in a converter's inverse energy field can improperly polarize the negative axis, causing hyperdrive failure. Replacement often requires an inverted engineer.

name: Polis Massa
title: •Polis Massa
text: Light: If your Skywalker here, opponent may not draw more than two battle destiny here. Dark: If a [Skywalker] Epic Event on table, Force drain -1 here. To move or deploy your starship to here requires +1 Force.

name: Ponda Baba
title: •Ponda Baba
text: Power +3 when battling at same site as Dr. Evazan, unless opponent has a lightsaber present. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.
lore: A male Quara (or fingered Aqualish). Thug, smuggler and partner of Dr. Evazan. Has a poor quality cybernetic arm replacement.

name: Ponda Baba (V)
title: •Ponda Baba (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. At same site, non-Jedi Luke may not swing a lightsaber at aliens (or return aliens to hand using his game text). During battle, if with a smuggler, may add one destiny to attrition or make that smuggler forfeit = 0.
lore: A male Quara (or fingered Aqualish). Thug, smuggler and partner of Dr. Evazan. Has a poor quality cybernetic arm replacement.

name: Ponda Baba's Hold-out Blaster
title: •Ponda Baba's Hold-out Blaster
text: Deploy on your smuggler or use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior. May deploy on Ponda Baba as a 'react.' May target a character or creature using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: High-powered, short-barreled blaster. Modified Imperial blaster pistol. Kept concealed by the Aqualish mercenary.

name: Pops
title: •Pops
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 5, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Piloted Gold 5 at Battle of Yavin. Real name Davish Krail. Veteran pilot. Flew fighters for two decades. Wingman of Gold Leader.

name: Porg
title: •••Porg
text: Habitat: Ahch-To sites, either player's starship card (uses no capacity). Does not attack. Starship porg is aboard or characters present with porg are power and defense value -1 (+2 if yours). Adds one [Light Side] icon here.
lore: Blank.

name: Portable Fusion Generator
title: Portable Fusion Generator
text: Deploy on any warrior. When that warrior fires a blaster rifle or artillery weapon, adds 1 to each of that weapon's destiny draws. Also, may add 1 to power of one droid present.
lore: Larger assault weapons require troops to carry their own power sources. Both light and efficient, these units produce ample power for most combat needs.

name: Portable Fusion Generator
title: Portable Fusion Generator
text: Deploy on any warrior. When that warrior fires a blaster rifle or artillery weapon, adds 1 to each of that weapon's destiny draws. Also, may add 1 to power of one droid present.
lore: Lardanis Survival Systems MFCR-200 Power Generator. Used by smugglers and Rebel agents. Highly portable. Powers and charges a wide range of equipment.

name: Portable Scanner
title: Portable Scanner
text: Deploy on your Rebel. Adds 2 to your search party destiny draws where present. Also, once during each of your control phases, may take one device or weapon (except a lightsaber) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Cryoncorp EnhanceScan general-purpose scanner. 1,500-meter lifeform detection range. Motion sensor and metal detection sensors optimized for up to 500 meters.

name: Pote Snitkin
title: •Pote Snitkin
text: When driving a vehicle, that vehicle is power +3 and moves for free. While at Audience Chamber, all your other Skrillings are power +2 and forfeit +1.
lore: Skrilling smuggler. Supplied Jabba's henchmen with weapons when he was Hermi Odle's predecessor. An excellent driver.

name: Pote Snitkin (V)
title: •Pote Snitkin (V)
text: While driving a vehicle, adds one battle destiny and your total ability here may not be reduced. At same and related sites, Skrillings are power and forfeit +2, and, once per game, your just-lost transport vehicle may be 'recycled' (place in Used Pile).
lore: Skrilling smuggler. Supplied Jabba's henchmen with weapons when he was Hermi Odle's predecessor. An excellent driver.

name: Power Harpoon
title: Power Harpoon
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your combat or shuttle vehicle. May target an AT-AT or AT-ST for 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target crashes if destiny + your vehicle's maneuver > 8. Your vehicle crashes if destiny = 0.
lore: High-powered harpoon attached to a retractable flexi-steel tow cable and fusion-head disk designed by Beryl Chiffonage as a reserve defense against Imperial AT-ATs.

name: Power Of The Hutt
title: •Power Of The Hutt
text: Deploy on table. Once during each of your turns, may deploy one Boelo, Bib, Ephant Mon, Jabba's Sail Barge, Jabba's Space Cruiser, or Hutt Influence from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Also, your aliens aboard Jabba's Sail Barge are immune to attrition < 6. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Jabba runs his organization out of a palace built around a B'omarr monastery. His fortress near the border of the western Dune Sea is safe from enemies in Mos Eisley.

name: Power Of The Hutt (V)
title: •Power Of The Hutt (V)
text: Deploy on table. While Nal Hutta on table and your alien at Audience Chamber, [Reflections III] Leia's game text is canceled and, once during opponent's turn, may activate 1 Force. Once per turn, may deploy Hutt Influence, Bib, or a barge from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Jabba runs his organization out of a palace built around a B'omarr monastery. His fortress near the border of the western Dune Sea is safe from enemies in Mos Eisley.

name: Power Pivot
title: •Power Pivot
text: If your piloted starship armed with a starship weapon is in a battle, lose 1 Force to reduce the power of one opponent's starship in that battle to zero. OR Place one opponent's starship just 'hit' in Lost Pile.
lore: Using lateral thrusters, an X-wing can suddenly change direction, rotating around to fire at a pursuing ship.

name: Precise Attack
title: Precise Attack
text: During a battle, target opponent's character or vehicle present with two (or more) of your weapons. Add all weapon destiny draws together. Apply that total separately for each weapon in an order of your choosing.
lore: 'Only Imperial stormtroopers are so precise.'

name: Precise Hit
title: •Precise Hit
text: USED: During a battle at a system or sector, instead of firing one of your starship weapons at a target, reduce that target's power by 4 until end of turn. LOST: During a battle at a system or sector, use 3 Force to cancel one battle destiny just drawn.
lore: 'Luke, trust me.'

name: Precision Targeting
title: Precision Targeting
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on table. Any card which is 'hit' may not be used to satisfy attrition. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Sir, we just lost the main rear deflector shield. One more direct hit on the back quarter and we're done for!'

name: Prepare For A Surface Attack
title: •Prepare For A Surface Attack
text: Deploy on table. Your Force drains at Hoth sites may not be canceled. Once per turn, if you just deployed an AT-AT to a Hoth site, you may deploy (at -2) a Star Destroyer to the Hoth system (or vice versa) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Ruthless and well-equipped for both air and ground assault, Vader's feared Death Squadron came to the icy Rebel Base with total domination in mind.

name: Prepare For A Surface Attack (V)
title: •Prepare For A Surface Attack (V)
text: Deploy on table. AT-AT Cannons deploy -1, fire for free, and add 1 to armor. During your control phase, may take a non-[Jabba's Palace] vehicle weapon (without 'lost' in game text), [Hoth] device, or [Hoth] Epic Event into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Ruthless and well-equipped for both air and ground assault, Vader's feared Death Squadron came to the icy Rebel Base with total domination in mind.

name: Prepare The Chamber
title: •Prepare The Chamber
text: USED: Add 2 to Carbon Freezing destiny. LOST: If one of your Ugnaughts is defending in a battle, add one battle destiny.
lore: Coolant emitted by the TCF32 Carbonite Encasement Apparatus is rumored to have a mildly euphoric effect on Ugnaughts. Individuals on TCF32 duty are regarded with envy.

name: Prepared Defenses
title: •Prepared Defenses
text: USED: Add 1 to your battle destiny just drawn. STARTING: Deploy up to three Effects if each of them deploys for free, is always immune to Alter and has 'deploy on table' (or 'deploy on your side of table') in its game text. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Since the debacle at Yavin, the Emperor places a premium on the security of his costly war machine.

name: Presence Of The Force
title: ••Presence Of The Force
text: Deploy on any location to add one [Dark Side Force] and one [Light Side Force].
lore: A location is affected by the history of the events which occur there. The Force '...binds the galaxy together' and has an ebb and flow.

name: Pride Of The Empire
title: •Pride Of The Empire
text: If opponent just lost a starship in a battle you won, deploy on your participating starfighter. Once during each of opponent's move phases, opponent loses 1 Force (2 if starfighter is a TIE/ln). Also, that starfighter is power +2. (Immune to Control.)
lore: Imperial starships that perform with distinction are highly publicized in an attempt to make the pilots look like heroes to the citizens of the Empire.

name: Pride Of The Empire (V)
title: •Pride Of The Empire (V)
text: If you just deployed a pilot aboard a Black Squadron TIE, deploy on that pilot; pilot's game text may not be canceled. During your turn, may take a Black Squadron pilot into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If pilot just won a battle, retrieve a Black Squadron pilot.
lore: Imperial starships that perform with distinction are highly publicized in an attempt to make the pilots look like heroes to the citizens of the Empire.

name: Prince Xizor
title: •Prince Xizor
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When in battle at a site, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and total ability of 6 or more required for opponent to draw battle destiny here. Immune to attrition < 5 when Vader not here.
lore: Falleen gangster and leader. Black Sun agent. Dark Prince of the Black Sun crime syndicate. Fortifies his personal defenses with information gathered by his agents.

name: Princess Leia
title: •Princess Leia
text: May only deploy on Hoth or Cloud City. Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. May deploy (on Hoth or Cloud City) or move as a 'react' to same site as Han or Luke. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Prominent leader in the struggling Alliance. Former member of the Imperial Senate. Beginning to discover her true heritage. Likes scoundrels.

name: Princess Leia (V)
title: •Princess Leia (V)
text: Leia's deploy cost may not be modified by opponent. Adds one battle destiny if with Han or Vader. May move as a 'react' to same site as an Imperial. Once per turn, may deploy Leia Of Alderaan or Reflection from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Prominent leader in the struggling Alliance. Former member of the Imperial Senate. Beginning to discover her true heritage. Likes scoundrels.

name: Princess Leia Organa
title: •Princess Leia Organa
text: * Deploys free as an escorted captive of Jabba, or a bounty hunter (you may not initiate battle there on the same turn). While a captive, opponent's unique (•) aliens at same site are forfeit -2. If released, retrieve 5 Force. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Captured by Jabba. Princess Leia provided a distraction for his henchbeings. Waiting for the first chance to escape. Really made Jabba's tail wiggle.

name: Princess Organa
title: •Princess Organa
text: While at a Rebel Base location, subtracts 1 from opponent's Force drains at related locations. Once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one Leia Of Alderaan, Reflection or leader of ability < 3 to same location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Adopted by Bail Organa. Former senator of Alderaan. Natural leader. Helped steal the Death Star plans. A key figure in the Rebel Alliance.

name: Prisoner 2187
title: •Prisoner 2187
text: Deploys only if Rescue The Princess on table. May not be transferred while imprisoned. Adds 2 to your Force drains here. For remainder of game, your objective cannot be placed out of play and, if Leia not on table, flip Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself.
lore: Princess Leia Organa. Alderaanian senator. Targeted by Vader for capture and interrogation. The Dark Lord of the Sith wanted her alive.

name: Prisoner 2187 (V)
title: •Prisoner 2187 (V)
text: Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While present at a Death Star site, Force drain +1 where you have a Rebel stormtrooper. While on Death Star (even if imprisoned), Leia may not be transferred and her gametext may not be canceled.
lore: Princess Leia Organa. Alderaanian senator. Targeted by Vader for capture and interrogation. The Dark Lord Of The Sith wanted her alive.

name: Probe Antennae
title: Probe Antennae
text: Deploy on your Probe Droid. Adds 2 to X for that droid. OR Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your other droids. When at a site you control, once during each of your control phases, you may peek at one card randomly selected from opponent's hand.
lore: A probe droid encodes and scrambles messages before using its telescoping antennae to transmit information through hyperspace.

name: Probe Droid
title: Probe Droid
text: Deploys only if a Star Destroyer on table. Once during each of your control phases, may peek at X cards randomly selected from opponent's hand, where X = number of [Light Side Force] icons at same site. May Force drain, initiate battle and be battled.
lore: Arakyd Viper probe droid. Has sensors specifically designed to detect traces of Rebel activity. Equipped with an auto-destruct mechanism. A highly durable spy droid.

name: Probe Droid Laser
title: Probe Droid Laser
text: Deploy on your probe droid. May target an artillery weapon (use 5 as defense value), character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Artillery weapon lost if destiny > defense value. Character or creature hit if destiny > defense value.
lore: Although a probe droid's primary defense is stealth, many models can be equipped with a laser cannon to enhance the droid's combat and sabotage capabilities.

name: Probe Telemetry
title: Probe Telemetry
