lore: Sandtroopers commanded by Governor Aryon do not enjoy their assignment. They find a means of venting their frustrations by harassing the local inhibitors.

name: Tatooine Occupation (V)
title: •Tatooine Occupation (V)
text: Deploy on table. During your control phase, if you occupy Tatooine system, opponent loses 1 Force for each Tatooine battleground site you occupy with a unique (•) trooper. While you have three troopers on Tatooine, immune to Alter and Endor Celebration.
lore: Sandtroopers commanded by Governor Aryon do not enjoy their assignment. They find a means of venting their frustrations by harassing the local inhabitants.

name: Tatooine Utility Belt
title: Tatooine Utility Belt
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. While on Tatooine, that character's power and forfeit are +2.
lore: Survival gear, food and tools are stored in small compartments. Made from bantha hide. Used by Luke and other Tatooine inhabitants.

name: Tatooine: Anchorhead
title: •Tatooine: Anchorhead
text: Light: During your move phase, may move your characters from here to Mos Eisley. Dark: If you occupy, opponent's Anchorhead game text is canceled.

name: Tatooine: Beggar's Canyon
title: •Tatooine: Beggar's Canyon
text: Light: T-16s deploy free (and are power +2) here. If you control with a T-16, Force drain +1 here. Dark: Your womp rats, banthas and Tusken Raiders deploy -1 here.

name: Tatooine: Bluffs
title: •Tatooine: Bluffs
text: Dark: 'Bluff Rules' in effect here. Light: 'Bluff Rules' in effect here.

name: Tatooine: Cantina
title: •Tatooine: Cantina
text: Dark: Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each power +1. Light: Your aliens here are each forfeit +1.

name: Tatooine: Cantina
title: •Tatooine: Cantina
text: Light: Your aliens are each power +1. Dark: Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each forfeit +1.

name: Tatooine: Cantina (V)
title: •Tatooine: Cantina (V)
text: Dark: Once per turn, may deploy Djas Puhr, Tonnika Sisters, or [Jabba's Palace] Wuher here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Unless Obi-Wan here (or at Mos Eisley), you may not move to here during your control phase.

name: Tatooine: City Outskirts
title: •Tatooine: City Outskirts
text: Light: Once per game, may deploy a Jedi here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Maul moves to here for free when using his landspeed.

name: Tatooine: Desert
title: •••Tatooine: Desert
text: Dark: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed. Light: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed.

name: Tatooine: Desert
title: •••Tatooine: Desert
text: Light: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed. Dark: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed.

name: Tatooine: Desert Heart
title: •Tatooine: Desert Heart
text: Dark: Your character movement from here (except for Jawas) requires +1 landspeed. Light: Your character movement from here (except for Jawas) requires +1 landspeed.

name: Tatooine: Desert Heart (V)
title: •Tatooine: Desert Heart (V)
text: Dark: Once per turn, if you just deployed an alien here, may raise your converted [Jabba's Palace] site to the top. Light: Unless you occupy, you must first use 1 Force to deploy a non-alien character here.

name: Tatooine: Desert Landing Site
title: •Tatooine: Desert Landing Site
text: Dark: Maul deploys free here. If Maul here and If The Trace Was Correct on table, Force drain +2 here. Light: If Amidala at a battleground site (or captive), opponent may not Force drain here.

name: Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
title: •Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
text: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

name: Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
title: •Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
text: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

name: Tatooine: Dune Sea
title: •Tatooine: Dune Sea
text: Light: Blank. Dark: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

name: Tatooine: Dune Sea (V)
title: •Tatooine: Dune Sea (V)
text: Light: While Stolen Data Tapes here, Obi-Wan deploys -3 here. Dark: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

name: Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon
title: •Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon
text: Dark: During your control phase, may cause Sarlacc to immediately attack one captive present. Light:

name: Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon (V)
title: •Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon (V)
text: Dark: If Jabba at Audience Chamber, [Set 4] Jabba's Sail Barge deploys -2 here. Light: Once per game, may deploy Boba Fett here from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or Lost Pile.

name: Tatooine: Hutt Canyon
title: •Tatooine: Hutt Canyon
text: Light: If you occupy with a Jawa, opponent may not draw battle destiny here. Dark: If you occupy with a Tusken Raider, opponent may not draw battle destiny here.

name: Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert)
title: •Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert)
text: Light: Your characters here aboard vehicles are each power +1. Dark: Unless you control Hutt Trade Route, your game text on Tatooine: Jabba's Palace is canceled.

name: Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert) (V)
title: •Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert) (V)
text: Light: The first alien you deploy here each turn is deploy -1. Characters here are immune to Sandwhirl. Dark: Unless you occupy, you must first use 1 Force to deploy a non-alien character here.

name: Tatooine: Imperial Landing Site
title: •Tatooine: Imperial Landing Site
text: Dark: Once per turn, if your Imperial here, may deploy a [Hoth] device from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Once per turn, a player who controls this site may raise their converted related location to the top.

name: Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
title: •Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
text: Dark: During your deploy phase, may deploy one Jabba's Palace site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: If you control, opponent's Jabba's Palace game text here is canceled. Immune to Revolution.

name: Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
title: •Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
text: Light: If you occupy with an alien, Bo Shuda cannot be canceled. Dark: When deployed, lose 1 Force for each of your Jabba's Palace sites that you do not occupy.

name: Tatooine: Jawa Camp
title: •Tatooine: Jawa Camp
text: Dark: Your Jawas deploy here for 1 Force from you only. Light: All your Jawas are power and forfeit -1 here.

name: Tatooine: Jawa Camp
title: •Tatooine: Jawa Camp
text: Light: Your Jawas deploy here for 1 Force from you only, for free if Sandcrawler present. Dark: -

name: Tatooine: Jawa Camp (V)
title: •Tatooine: Jawa Camp (V)
text: Dark: If your trooper here and no aliens on Tatooine, Force drain +1 at Jawa Camp. Light: Jawas deploy here for 1 Force from their owner only. Obi-Wan moves to here for free.

name: Tatooine: Jawa Canyon
title: •Tatooine: Jawa Canyon
text: Dark: Your Jawas are each power +2 here. Light: Force drain -1 here unless your Jawa is at this site.

name: Tatooine: Jawa Canyon
title: •Tatooine: Jawa Canyon
text: Light: Your Jawas are each power +1 and forfeit +2 here. Dark: Force drain -1 here unless your Jawa is at this site.

name: Tatooine: Jundland Wastes
title: •Tatooine: Jundland Wastes
text: Dark: Your Tusken Raiders here are each forfeit +1. If you control, Force drain +1 here. Light: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

name: Tatooine: Jundland Wastes
title: •Tatooine: Jundland Wastes
text: Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here (+2 if a Vaporator present). Dark: If you control with a Tusken Raider present, Force drain +1 here.

name: Tatooine: Krayt Dragon Pass
title: •Tatooine: Krayt Dragon Pass
text: Dark: Add 1 to each of your battle destiny draws here for each Tatooine battleground site you occupy. Light: Force drain -1 here if Krayt Dragon Bones on table.

name: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
title: •Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
text: Dark: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. If you control, Force drain +1 here. Light:

name: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
title: •Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
text: Light: Beru Lars and Luke deploy -1 here. Dark: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.

name: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V)
title: •Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V)
text: Light: Anakin, Beru and Owen may move to or from here for free when using landspeed. Dark: Unless Vader or your trooper here, Force drain -1 here (if both here, Force drain +1 instead).

name: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V) (ALT)
title: •Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V) (ALT)
text: Light: Anakin, Beru and Owen may move to or from here for free when using landspeed. Dark: Unless Vader or your trooper here, Force drain -1 here (if both here, Force drain +1 instead).

name: Tatooine: Marketplace
title: •Tatooine: Marketplace
text: Dark: If you occupy, once during each of your control phases may use 3 Force to retrieve 1 Force. Light: If you occupy, once during each of your control phases may use 5 Force to retrieve 1 Force.

name: Tatooine: Marketplace
title: •Tatooine: Marketplace
text: Light: If you control, once during each of your control phases may use 2 Force to retrieve 1 Force. Dark: If you control, once during each of your control phases may use 4 Force to retrieve 1 Force.

name: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
title: •Tatooine: Mos Eisley
text: Dark: Your spies, thieves, bounty hunters and smugglers are each power and forfeit +1 here. Light:

name: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
title: •Tatooine: Mos Eisley
text: Light: During your control phase, you may move free from here directly to Cantina (or vice versa). Dark: -

name: Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V)
title: •Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V)
text: Light: During your move phase, your characters may move between here and Cantina for free. Dark: If opponent controls Cantina with a smuggler, Force drain -1 here.

name: Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V)
title: •Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V)
text: Dark: Imperial stormtroopers here are forfeit +1 (and power +1 if a sandtrooper). Light: Imperial stormtroopers here may not be targeted by Clash Of Sabers or blasters.

name: Tatooine: Mos Espa
title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa
text: Dark: Your smugglers and thieves are power and forfeit +1 here. Light: Unless your smuggler or thief here, Force drain -1 here.

name: Tatooine: Mos Espa
title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa
text: Light: During your control phase, may move your characters from Slave Quarters to here. Dark: -

name: Tatooine: Mos Espa (V)
title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa (V)
text: Dark: Your characters here and at Watto's Junkyard are immune to opponent's Sandwhirl. Light: For remainder of game, sites may not deploy between this site and Watto's Junkyard.

name: Tatooine: Mos Espa (V)
title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa (V)
text: Light: If you occupy, may deploy [Tatooine] A Remote Planet here. Dark: While Mos Espa converted, your Force generation is +2 here.

name: Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay
title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay
text: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

name: Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay
title: •Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay
text: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force. Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

name: Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut
title: •Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut
text: Light: Obi-Wan is deploy -3 here. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V)
title: •Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V)
text: Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny. Dark: -

name: Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (AI)
title: •Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (AI)
text: Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny. Dark:

name: Tatooine: Podrace Arena
title: •Tatooine: Podrace Arena
text: Dark: While either player's race total > 0, no battles or Force drains here. Light: While either player's race total > 0, no battles or Force drains here.

name: Tatooine: Podrace Arena
title: •Tatooine: Podrace Arena
text: Light: While either player's race total > 0, no battles or Force drains here. Dark: While either player's race total > 0, no battles or Force drains here.

name: Tatooine: Podracer Bay
title: •Tatooine: Podracer Bay
text: Light: If you control, once per turn may exchange your top race destiny with top card of Lost Pile. Dark: If you control, once per turn may exchange your top race destiny with top card of Lost Pile.

name: Tatooine: Skywalker Hut
title: •Tatooine: Skywalker Hut
text: Dark: May not be separated from Slave Quarters. Light: Once per turn, may deploy Shmi or [Tatooine] C-3PO here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Tatooine: Slave Quarters
title: •Tatooine: Slave Quarters
text: Light: Once per game may deploy Shmi here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: If Watto present, Force Drain +1 here.

name: Tatooine: Slave Quarters (V)
title: •Tatooine: Slave Quarters (V)
text: Dark: Light: Deploys only as a starting location. If you just chose My Father Has It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, deploy Your Thoughts Dwell On Your Mother from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Tatooine: Tosche Station
title: •Tatooine: Tosche Station
text: Light: You generate +X Force here, where X = power of your highest forfeit character here. Dark: If you occupy, opponent's Tosche Station game text is canceled.

name: Tatooine: Tusken Canyon
title: •Tatooine: Tusken Canyon
text: Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here (+2 if a Gaderffi Stick is present). Light:

name: Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard
title: •Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard
text: Dark: Once per game, may deploy Watto here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Watto deploys -2 here. Light: While Watto here, you may not draw battle destiny here.

name: Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard
title: •Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard
text: Light: While you occupy, Force generation +2 here. Immune to Revolution. Dark: If Watto present, Force drain +1 here and opponent's battle destiny draws here are -2.

name: Tauntaun
title: Tauntaun
text: May add 1 'rider' (passenger). Deploy only on Hoth. Ability = ¼. May move as a 'react' from a battle. May be 'sacrificed' (lost) to make rider immune to Exposure this turn.
lore: First native creature found on Hoth. Roam the icy plans in herds. Illtempered and easily spooked. Smell bad on the outside. Trained as steeds for Rebel patrols.

name: Tauntaun Bones
title: •Tauntaun Bones
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on table. Each opponent's destiny draw, you do the following: (0) Put top used card in hand. (1) lose 1 Force. (2) activate 1 Force. (3) lose this Effect. (4) retrieve top lost card. (5) deploy a character for free. (6+) nothing.
lore: The bones of a tauntaun represent both death and life: death for the prey, life for the predator. A symbol of the ebb and flow of the Force through all things.

name: Tauntaun Handler
title: •••Tauntaun Handler
text: Adds 2 to power of any creature vehicle he rides. When riding a tauntaun, also draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Corman Quien is a typical scout at Echo Base. Captured, tamed and trained the native tauntauns.

name: Tauntaun Skull
title: •Tauntaun Skull
text: During a battle or attack, place out of play one non-droid character, creature or creature vehicle from your Lost Pile. Add its destiny number to your total power. OR Take one Stop Motion or Yaggle Gakkle into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Bones strewn around the cave lair of the wampa are proof of the beat's prowess.

name: Tawss Khaa
title: •Tawss Khaa
text: If you just initiated battle where present, predict the winner. If correct, randomly retrieve 1 Force. If incorrect, lose 1 Force. Power +3 when present with opponent's alien of ability > 3. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Female Nimbanel fortune teller. Roams the wastes of Tatooine. Trained in the ways of a Sakiyan hunter. Now tracks them for the Alliance. Risk-taker.

name: Taym Dren-garen
title: •Taym Dren-garen
text: When on Tatooine, may cancel any result of Krayt Dragon Bones. While at Audience Chamber, all your Tusken Raiders are power = 3 and forfeit +2.
lore: Instigator of several Sand People raids on Tatooine. Keeps the Tusken Raiders well supplied so they can keep local authorities distracted from Jabba's activities.

name: TC-14
title: •TC-14
text: Opponent's Jedi using landspeed from here require +2 Force. During any control phase may place TC-14 out of play to target one opponent's Jedi present. Target Jedi loses all immunity to attrition and is power = 0 for remainder of turn.
lore: Trade Federation-owned protocol droid used by the Neimoidians to distract the Jedi until a plan could be conceived to deal with them.

name: TD-110
title: •TD-110
text: If Send A Detachment Down on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. During battle at a Tatooine site, may place Tactical Support out of play from Lost Pile to add 2 to attrition against opponent.
lore: Sandtrooper leader.

name: TD-4445
title: •TD-4445
text: Once per game, may reveal from hand to take a dewback into hand from outside your deck and deploy both simultaneously. Deploys -2 aboard a dewback. Your characters aboard dewbacks here may not be targeted by axes or lightsabers.
lore: Sandtrooper.

name: Tech Mo'r
title: •Tech Mo'r
text: After using Ommni Box, peek at top X cards of pile or deck just shuffled, where X = number of other musicians at same site. May reshuffle without peeking.
lore: Male Bith musician. Plays Ommni Box in Figrin D'an's band. Lost ownership of instrument to Figrin while gambling.

name: Tedn Dahai
title: •Tedn Dahai
text: For each other musician at same site, during any control phase you may use 1 Force to choose one opponent's alien present. That alien cannot utilize its game text for remainder of that turn.
lore: Male Bith musician. Member in good standing of the Intergalactic Federation of Musicians. Plays the Fanfar in Figrin D'an's band. Once worked for the Empire as a scout.

name: Teebo
title: •Teebo
text: Deploys only on Endor. Power and forfeit +1 for each [Light Side] icon at same Endor site. While on Endor, adds 1 (or 2 if present with Logray) to forfeit of each of your Ewoks at Endor sites.
lore: Ewok watcher of the stars. Musician and poet at heart. Wears a horned Gurreck skull decorated with Churi feathers. Carries a stone hatchet. Student of Logray.

name: Teemto Pagalies' Podracer
title: •Teemto Pagalies' Podracer
text: Deploy on Podrace Arena. Adds 2 to each of your race destinies here. Once during each of your turns, may use 1 Force to place a race destiny here (random selection) in owner's Used Pile, draw one race destiny and place it here.
lore: IPG-X1131 Longtail Podracer. Unusual circular shape is designed around an internal metal cycling ring which stabilizes the non-aerodynamic vehicle.

name: Televan Koreyy
title: •Televan Koreyy
text: Beggar and Frozen Assets are canceled. Your thieves, gamblers, and information brokers at related Tatooine sites are power +1. While at Cantina, Mos Espa, or Marketplace, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Leader of Tatooine's Street Performers And Panhandlers' Guild. Televan can survive on almost nothing, and he keeps tight controls on other Guild members. Information broker.

name: Temmin 'Snap' Wexley
title: •Temmin 'Snap' Wexley
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Imperials and bounty hunters deploy +1 here. Once per game, if a battle droid was just lost from same location, may steal it into hand.
lore: Blank.

name: Tempest 1
title: •Tempest 1
text: May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. Landspeed may not be increased. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Each of its weapon destiny draws is +1.
lore: Command vehicle for Commander Igar. Uses an adapted TIE targeting system to combat maneuverable T-47s. Utilized in the subjugation of Kashyyyk. Enclosed.

name: Tempest Scout
title: Tempest Scout
text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. May move as a 'react' for 1 additional Force. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Your Elite Squadron stormtroopers are deploy -1 to same site.
lore: Manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards under the close supervision of the Empire. Often used in conjunction with AT-ATs in an anti-personnel role. Enclosed.

name: Tempest Scout 1
title: •Tempest Scout 1
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. May move as a 'react' for free. When Arnet piloting, immune to attrition < 4 and adds 1 to attrition against opponent here.
lore: Enclosed AT-ST assigned as first response to incidents at Endor control bunker. Piloted by Lieutenant Arnet.

name: Tempest Scout 2
title: •Tempest Scout 2
text: Deploy -1 to Endor. May add 2 pilots or passengers. May move as a 'react'. Immune to attrition < 3 when Marquand piloting. Your scouts may move here as a 'react'.
lore: Assigned to coordinate battle activities with the Endor biker scout detachment. Enclosed. First saw battle in Kashyyyk forests.

name: Tempest Scout 3
title: •Tempest Scout 3
text: May deploy or move as a 'react' to a forest or Endor site. May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
lore: Enclosed. Assigned to the task of searching for potential Rebel traps. Modified to help cover more territory to accomplish this task.

name: Tempest Scout 3 (V)
title: •Tempest Scout 3 (V)
text: May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Unless this vehicle 'hit,' your other vehicles here may not be targeted by artillery weapons, vehicle weapons, or opponent's Interrupts.
lore: Enclosed. Assigned to the task of searching for potential Rebel traps. Modified to help cover more territory to accomplish this task.

name: Tempest Scout 4
title: •Tempest Scout 4
text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. AT-ST Dual Cannon deploys free aboard and may target at an adjacent site.
lore: Enclosed vehicle. Equipped with a prototype targeting computer. Maintains accuracy even in dense foliage. Energy diverted from propulsion to weapons systems.

name: Tempest Scout 5
title: •Tempest Scout 5
text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. May move as a 'react'. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Adds 1 to your total power in battle at same site for each of your other piloted combat vehicles present.
lore: Uses experimental command and control software to coordinate combat data. Enclosed.

name: Tempest Scout 6
title: •Tempest Scout 6
text: May deploy -2 as a 'react'. May move as a 'react' for free. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 2.
lore: Enclosed. Modified for perimeter patrol. Elite crew trained for many months over heavily forested terrain.

name: Ten Numb
title: •Ten Numb
text: Deploys -2 aboard Blue Squadron 5. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to total weapon destiny of any B-wing he pilots.
lore: Sullustan gunner. Pilot of Blue 5. Ordered to head a B-wing attack against Imperial command ships at the Battle Of Endor.

name: Tendau Bendon
title: •Tendau Bendon
text: Agendas: justice, peace. While in a senate majority, if you have at least one card in hand, once during your control phase may place your hand in Used Pile to draw up to four cards from Reserve Deck.
lore: Ithorian senator. Called on by his people to represent them in the Senate, though his heart is not in politics. Voted against the taxation of trade routes.

name: Tentacle
title: Tentacle
text: If opponent just played an Interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table and stack that Interrupt here. All Interrupts of that title are unique (•). (Immune to Control.)
lore: Dianogas use their seven tentacles for both locomotion and catching food. The few survivors of such attacks claim that a dianoga tentacle has the strength of a hydro-clamp.

name: Tentacle (V)
title: Tentacle (V)
text: Deploy on table. Rebel Barrier is a Lost Interrupt. If no card stacked here, may stack one Interrupt just played here. To play any new Interrupt of the same name, player must first stack it here. Once per game, may shuffle any deck or pile. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Dianogas use their seven tentacles for both locomotion and catching food. The few survivors of such attacks claim that a dianoga tentacle has the strength of a hydro-clamp.

name: Tessek
title: •Tessek
text: Whenever your opponent deploys a character of destiny 1, you may activate 1 Force. While at Audience Chamber, adds 1 to your Force drains where you have a non-unique alien and all your non-unique aliens are deploy -1.
lore: Quarien accountant. Embezzling from Jabba. Leader. Escaped Mon Calamari after its subjugation by the Empire. Plotting to kill Jabba and free the Hutt's captives.

name: Tey How
title: •Tey How
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything she pilots. While aboard a battleship, whenever you must lose Force from a Force drain at a system within 2 parsecs of How, may use X Force to reduce the loss by X.
lore: Neimoidian Trade Federation communications officer to Nute Gunray. Had audio and visual mechanics surgically implanted to assist her in shipboard operations.

name: Thank The Maker
title: Thank The Maker
text: Use 1 Force during opponent's control phase if you have a droid on the table and were drained of at least 5 Force. Draw destiny. That number of cards are randomly selected and retrieved from your Lost Pile.
lore: Reference to 'One Who Creates,' used by droids in an almost religious way. C-3PO used phrase upon getting a much-needed cleansing oil bath.

name: That Thing's Operational
title: •That Thing's Operational
text: Deploy on Reactor Core. Death Star II may move (hyperspeed = 3). While Death Star II orbits a system you occupy (except Endor), once during each of your control phases, opponent loses X Force, where X = 2 plus number of related battleground sites you occupy. Once during each of opponent's control phases, opponent's piloted starfighter here may attempt to 'blow away' Death Star II. Draw destiny. Add 3 if armed with torpedoes or missiles. Add pilot's ability. If total destiny > 8, starships here may attempt to 'escape' and Death Star II is 'blown away' (lose double Force).

name: That's It, The Rebels Are There!
title: That's It, The Rebels Are There!
text: If you have a probe droid at a site during your control phase, move one of your starships to the related system. That starship cannot move again this turn.
lore: 'That is the system and I'm sure Skywalker is with them.'

name: That's One
title: •That's One
text: Deploy on Chewie. He is immune to attrition < 4 at exterior sites. Visored Vision is immune to Sense. While at same battleground site as Han, Chewie adds 1 to each of his weapon destiny draws and Life Debt is a Used Interrupt during a battle there.
lore: Considering the life debt he owed to Han and his personal commitment to the Rebel Alliance, Chewie quickly volunteered to fly the stolen shuttle to Endor.

name: The Bith Shuffle
title: The Bith Shuffle
text: Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile or Used Pile.
lore: Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes play at the Cantina with a distinctive rocking motion. When Luke arrived, they were playing one of their favorite songs, 'Mad About Me.'

name: The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach
title: The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach
text: Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Used Pile. OR During your move phase, relocate one of your characters (unless Disarmed) from Weather Vane to any Cloud City site. Character may not move for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Imperial Barrier or The Shield Doors Must Be Closed.

name: The Camp
title: •The Camp
text: Deploy on table. Each non-battleground docking bay generates no more than one Force for either player. Opponent's aliens deploy +1 on Tatooine (or +2 if non-unique or to same Tatooine site as your Jedi, or +4 if both). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: An isolated camp protected by Obi-Wan and Captain Panaka was established at the Queen's starship while Qui-Gon searched for a way to repair the leaking hyperdrive.

name: The Circle Is Now Complete
title: The Circle Is Now Complete
text: If Vader and Obi-Wan are present at same site, use 1 Force to initiate a duel between them. Compare their power, and add 2 if that character is armed with a lightsaber. Loser (lowest total) of duel is placed out of play.
lore: Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought a final lightsaber duel near Hangar Bay 327 on the Death Star. 'When I left you I was but the learner; now I am the master.'

name: The Client
title: •The Client
text: During your control phase, if present at a site and your bounty hunter occupies a battleground, opponent loses 1 Force. Once per game, if you just lost a bounty hunter anywhere, may take a bounty hunter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Blank.

name: The Client's Bounty
title: •The Client's Bounty
text: Deploy on opponent's just deployed character. Once per turn, if a bounty hunter here, may reveal the top card of each player's Reserve Deck. If this character about to be captured, retrieve 2 Force (3 if The Client on table) and return this card to your hand. [Immune to Control.]
lore: One of the most profitable occupations in the galaxy is hunting down and capturing wanted beings. The more notable the quarry, the more profitable the venture.

name: The Dark Path
title: The Dark Path
text: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may peek at the top three cards of your Reserve Deck. Place any two of those three in your Lost Pile.
lore: 'If once you start down the dark path, forever will it dominate your destiny. Consume you it will, as it did Obi- Wan's apprentice.'

name: The Dark Path (V)
title: The Dark Path (V)
text: Deploy on table. Add one [Dark Side Force] icon at each site where you have a 'Hatred' card. Once per game, target two battleground sites you occupy; one at a time, stack top card of your Lost Pile face down (as a 'Hatred' card) at those locations. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'If once you start down the dark path, forever will it dominate your destiny. Consume you it will, as it did Obi- Wan's apprentice.'

name: The Dead Speak!
title: •The Dead Speak!
text: If I Will Finish What You Started on table, deploy on table. While [Episode VII] Emperor on Exegol, attrition against opponent is +2 at same location as Kylo, Rey, or Snoke and, once per game, may deploy an [Episode VII] battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Blank.

name: The Deflector Shield Is Too Strong
title: •The Deflector Shield Is Too Strong
text: Landed starfighters and vehicles aboard starships are forfeit = 0. Once during your control phase may target your droid starfighter and opponent's starfighter present at same system. Both players draw destiny. You add your starfighter's power and maneuver. Opponent adds starfighter's power. Starship with lowest total is lost.

name: The Destiny Of A Jedi
title: The Destiny Of A Jedi
text: USED: Move your [Episode VII] Jedi as a 'react.' STARTING: If The Galaxy May Need A Legend on table, deploy Be With Me and up to two Effects that deploy on table, deploy for free, and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Blank.

name: The Ebb Of Battle
title: •The Ebb Of Battle
text: Activate 1 Force. OR Add 1 to your just-drawn duel destiny. OR If under your Dark Jedi as one of that character's combat cards, reveal to opponent and place in your Lost Pile to cancel an opponent's Force drain.
lore: Lightsaber confrontations are a complex dance of feints, strikes, parries and footwork. Mistakes are rarely forgiven.

name: The Emperor
title: •The Emperor
text: Deploys only to Coruscant or Death Star II. Never moves to a site occupied by opponent (even if carried). If Vader or Xizor here, and Luke is not on table, adds 2 to attrition against opponent at other locations. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader. Secretive manipulator of the galaxy. Played Darth Vader and Prince Xizor off against one another in his relentless pursuit of 'young Skywalker.'

name: The Emperor's Hand
title: •The Emperor's Hand
text: USED: Take Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If a battle just ended that your [Premium] Mara won, opponent loses 1 Force and, if Emperor on table, may relocate your Mara to a battleground site. LOST: Retrieve Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
lore: Blank.

name: The Emperor's Prize
title: •The Emperor's Prize
text: If Luke was just 'frozen,' deploy on Emperor or Detention Block Corridor. Target Luke and Vader. When reached by targets, place Utinni Effect on Luke and opponent must lose Force from Life Force equal to half their Life Force (round down). If Luke released, lose Utinni Effect. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Vader thought that by capturing Luke, he would crush the Alliance's last hope. But, there was another...

name: The Emperor's Shield
title: •The Emperor's Shield
text: Deploys -2 to Endor, Death Star II or same location as Thrawn. May deploy as a 'react'. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3. Power +3 at Endor or when Emperor is at same or related location.
lore: Top outer rim pilots hand picked by Admiral Thrawn. Sent to protect the Emperor during his inspection of the second Death Star.

name: The Emperor's Sword
title: •The Emperor's Sword
text: Deploys -2 to Coruscant or Death Star II. May deploy as a 'react'. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3. Power +3 at Coruscant or when Emperor is at same or related location.
lore: Elite pilots sworn to defend the Emperor to the death. Assigned older TIEs due to their years of experience with them. Stationed at Coruscant but always travel with the Emperor.

name: The Emperor, Relentless
title: •The Emperor, Relentless
text: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a site opponent occupies. Players do not retrieve Force for initiating a battle. While Agents Of Black Sun on table, your total battle destiny is +1 where you have a Black Sun agent. Immune to attrition.
lore: Leader. Secretive manipulator of the galaxy. Played Darth Vader and Prince Xizor off against one another in his relentless pursuit of 'young Skywalker.'

name: The Empire Knows We're Here / Prepare For Ground Assault
title: The Empire Knows We're Here / Prepare For Ground Assault
text: The Empire Knows We're Here: Deploy Hoth and 1st Marker. For remainder of game, Hoth Energy Shield does not extend beyond 1st Marker. You may not deploy Ice Storm, [Special Edition] Leia, systems, or characters of ability > 4. Echo Base Garrison is immune to Alter. Once per turn, may deploy Echo Command Center or a marker site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, your Force drains are +1 at Hoth system. During your control phase, if you occupy two battleground marker sites, retrieve 1 Force. Flip this card if opponent occupies your Hoth location. Prepare For Ground Assault: While this side up, cancels Hoth Sentry, Sunsdown, and the game text of your Admiral's Orders and unique (•) characters (except gunners, pilots, and troopers on table). Cards 'hit' by your artillery or vehicle weapons may not be used to satisfy attrition. If you just initiated battle, may peek at top X cards of your Used Pile, where X = number of Hoth battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Used Pile. Flip this card if opponent does not occupy your Hoth location.

Flip this card if opponent does not occupy your Hoth location.

name: The Empire's Back
title: The Empire's Back
text: If Vader, Tarkin, Motti or Tagge is lost, use 2 Force to retrieve one of them from the Lost Pile. OR Use 4 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take Vader, Tarkin, Motti, or Tagge into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.
lore: 'No star system will dare oppose the Emperor now.'

name: The Empire's Back (V)
title: The Empire's Back (V)
text: If two Imperials (or two Black Sun agents) in battle, re-circulate and shuffle your Reserve Deck. OR Once per game, if Emperor or Tarkin on table, Allegations Of Corruption stacks opponent's just played Interrupt; this does not count toward that card's once per game limit.
lore: 'No star system will dare oppose the Emperor now.'

name: The Falcon
title: •The Falcon
text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Once per game, during your move phase, may make an additional move. While [Episode VII] Chewie, [Episode VII] Han, or Rey piloting maneuver = 6 and immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Blank.

name: The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage
title: •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage
text: May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. While [Episode VII] Han or Rey piloting, maneuver +2 and immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if at a site, may flip this card (even if unpiloted).May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable, even if unpiloted. While Finn or Rey aboard, immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if piloted, may flip this card.
lore: The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well.

back.title: •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage
back.text: May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. Once during your move phase, if at a site, may flip this card (even if unpiloted).May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable, even if unpiloted. While Finn or Rey aboard, immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if piloted, may flip this card.
back.lore: Han's 'special modifications' for Millennium Falcon included security mechanisms, deflector shields, hull plating, faster hyperdrive and enhanced weapons. Enclosed.

name: The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed
title: The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed
text: The First Order Reigns: Deploy Crait and D'Qar systems, Salt Plateau, and Tracked Fleet. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Bow To The First Order or cards with ability except [Episode VII] cards. Once per turn, may [download] a card with 'Supremacy' in title or an [Episode VII] battleground. While this side up, opponent loses no more than 1 Force to your Force drains at systems. Supremacy is deploy = 7 to [Episode VII] systems. Flip this card if Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated.' The Resistance Is Doomed: While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a non-unique trooper (or non-unique [First Order] vehicle) from Lost Pile. While Kylo occupies a Crait location, your Force drains at battlegrounds where you have two First Order characters are +1. While Kylo controls Salt Plateau, opponent may not Force drain where their character or permanent pilot is alone and opponent's Force retrieval is canceled. Place out of play if Kylo was just forfeited from a battle you lost at Salt Plateau where Han, Leia, or Luke present.

back.title: The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed
back.text: The First Order Reigns: Deploy Crait and D'Qar systems, Salt Plateau, and Tracked Fleet. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Bow To The First Order or cards with ability except [Episode VII] cards. While Kylo occupies a Crait location, your Force drains at battlegrounds where you have two First Order characters are +1. While Kylo controls Salt Plateau, opponent may not Force drain where their character or permanent pilot is alone and opponent's Force retrieval is canceled. Place out of play if Kylo was just forfeited from a battle you lost at Salt Plateau where Han, Leia, or Luke present.

name: The First Order Was Just The Beginning
title: •The First Order Was Just The Beginning
text: If I Want That Map on table, deploy on table. Locations where there is a Resistance Agent or Rey gain [Episode VII]. Once per turn, may deploy a Jakku or Kijimi battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique [Episode VII] troopers are forfeit +1. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Blank.

name: The First Transport Is Away!
title: •The First Transport Is Away!
text: Deploy on any system (except Hoth). Target a Medium Transport at a Hoth site. When reached by target: Retrieve X Force, where X = twice the number of passengers. Relocate Utinni Effect to Hoth system. Your total power is +2 in battles at Hoth sites.
lore: 'When you've gotten past the energy shield, proceed directly to the rendezvous point. Understood? Good luck!'

name: The Force Is Strong In My Family
title: The Force Is Strong In My Family
text: Deploy on table (only at start of game) and choose: My Father Has It: Anakin (and [Episode I] Obi-Wan) I Have It: Luke (and [Set 1] Obi-Wan) You Have That Power, Too: Rey (and [Episode VII] Luke) [Set 16] Anakin is deploy -1. Your total Force generation is +1. You may not deploy Boss Nass' Chambers or Jedi (except Yoda and the chosen characters). If you just initiated battle involving a Skywalker (or if opponent's Sidious just lost from table), may retrieve 1 Force.

name: The Force Is Strong With This One
title: The Force Is Strong With This One
text: If Luke and an Imperial with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two destiny if Imperial is Vader).
lore: Luke's piloting skills and Force abilities made his X-wing a difficult target for Darth Vader as they raced down the Death Star trench.

name: The Force Is Strong With This One (V)
title: The Force Is Strong With This One (V)
text: If your Padawan or Skywalker is in battle with a Dark Jedi, either add one battle destiny or cancel I Have You Now. OR If Luke is in battle with an opponent's character of ability > 3, add one battle destiny.
lore: Luke's piloting skills and Force abilities made his X-wing a difficult target for Darth Vader as they raced down the Death Star trench.

name: The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker
title: The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker
text: The Galaxy May Need A Legend: Deploy Ahch-To: Saddle and any [Episode VII] battleground. For remainder of game, Luke deploys only to Ahch-To. You may not Force drain on Ahch-To. You may not deploy [Episode I] locations or non-[Episode VII] characters of ability > 4. Once per game, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy an Ahch-To location or [Episode VII] battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May flip this card if Luke on Ahch-To and a battle was just initiated involving a Resistance character. We Need Luke Skywalker: Immediately place Luke out of play (ignore [Death Star II] objective restrictions, if any). For remainder of battle, weapons may not be fired. While this side up, opponent's immunity to attrition is limited to < 6. Once during your turn, may peek at the top card of your Force Pile and Reserve Deck; place both cards (in any order) on top of one of those piles. Where you have two unique (•) Resistance characters, your Force drains are +1 and, once per turn during battle, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny to cause a redraw.

back.title: The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker
back.text: The Galaxy May Need A Legend: Deploy Ahch-To: Saddle and any [Episode VII] battleground. For remainder of game, Luke deploys only to Ahch-To. You may not Force drain on Ahch-To. You may not deploy [Episode I] locations or non-[Episode VII] characters of ability > 4. Once per game, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy an Ahch-To location or [Episode VII] battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May flip this card if Luke on Ahch-To and a battle was just initiated involving a Resistance character. We Need Luke Skywalker: Immediately place Luke out of play (ignore [Death Star II] objective restrictions, if any). For remainder of battle, weapons may not be fired. While this side up, opponent's immunity to attrition is limited to < 6. Once during your turn, may peek at the top card of your Force Pile and Reserve Deck; place both cards (in any order) on top of one of those piles. Where you have two unique (•) Resistance characters, your Force drains are +1 and, once per turn during battle, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny to cause a redraw.

name: The Garbage Will Do
title: •The Garbage Will Do
text: Once per game, choose: During battle, place the top card of your Lost Pile out of play to add its destiny number to your total power. OR Peek at the cards stacked on Graveyard Of Giants; take (or steal) one starfighter or vehicle there into hand.
lore: Blank.

name: The Grand Inquisitor
title: •The Grand Inquisitor
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a Jedi or Padawan just lost from same site as any Inquisitor, opponent loses 1 Force. If a Jedi or Padawan just moved from here, Inquisitors present may follow that character (using landspeed). Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Pau'an leader.

name: The Grand Inquisitor (AI)
title: •The Grand Inquisitor (AI)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a Jedi or Padawan just lost from same site as any Inquisitor, opponent loses 1 Force. If a Jedi or Padawan just moved from here, Inquisitors present may follow that character (using landspeed). Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Pau'an leader.

name: The Grand Inquisitor's Lightsaber
title: •The Grand Inquisitor's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on an Inquisitor. Dodge may not target characters here. May target a character. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value. If hit by Grand Inquisitor, target's forfeit = 0.
lore: Blank.

name: The Gravest Of Circumstances
title: •The Gravest Of Circumstances
text: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to add 3 to a battle destiny just drawn. If a taxation agenda here, during your turn may place any one card from hand on Used Pile; opponent must use 1 Force or lose 1 Force.
lore: 'The Naboo system has been invaded by the droid armies of the Trade Federation.'

name: The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train
title: The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train
text: The Hidden Path: Deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order. For remainder of game, you may not deploy <> locations, Anakin, or Jedi (except Jedi survivors) or play A Jedi's Resilience. Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons. Once per turn, may deploy a Jabiim location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, you may not play Nabrun Leids. Your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1. Once per turn, may deploy a holocron from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites. Gather Allies And Train: While this side up, Jedi survivors are deploy -1. if your holocron is about to leave table, place it in Used Pile. Opponent's total battle destiny where they have a character of ability > 4 is -1. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move. At the end of opponent's turn, if Jedi occupy two battleground sites, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Jedi do not occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.

name: The Hutts Are Gangsters
title: •The Hutts Are Gangsters
text: Deploy on table. While Amidala with Jabba, her game text is canceled. While you occupy an [Episode I] Tatooine site with [Episode I] Jabba, once per turn you may place a card from hand in your Used Pile to draw a card from Reserve Deck. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'If they discovered her...'

name: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One
title: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One
text: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone: Deploy Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts, and Credits Will Do Fine. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except unique (•) aliens, Republic characters and starships, and [Episode I] Jedi. Your Destiny is suspended. While this side up, once per game may take Coruscant and/or Tatooine system into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. You may not deploy any systems. Maul is immune to attrition. {Flip} this card if there are 4 or more cards beneath Credits Will Do Fine. We'll Need A New One: {While} this side up, your unique (•) Republic characters are power +1 and forfeit +2. Aliens may not have their deploy cost modified and Imperials deploy +1 to Tatooine sites. Whenever you draw battle destiny (unless canceled), may retrieve 1 Force (Force retrieved in this way may be taken into hand.) While Queen's Royal Starship at a planet system, once during each of opponent's control phases may activate up to 2 Force. Once during each of your control phases, opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground site you occupy with a senator.

back.title: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One
back.text: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone: Deploy Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts, and Credits Will Do Fine. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except unique (•) aliens, Republic characters and starships, and [Episode I] Jedi. title: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One (V)

Your Destiny is suspended. You lose no Force from [Reflections 2] objectives. {While} this side up, once per game may take an [Episode I] system into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. name: The Mythrol / •The Mythrol
title: •The Mythrol / •The Mythrol
text: The Mythrol's game text may not be canceled. If about to leave table, place out of play. Plays only during start of game by revealing from outside your deck to replace a just-deployed Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower. If not revealed, place this card under your Starting Effect. [Set 1] Despair targets The Mythrol instead of Jabba's Prize. Cancels Stunning Leader here. If just released, either flip this card or place it out of play.

back.title: •The Mythrol / •The Mythrol
back.text: If either player just deployed a card with ability here, you may use 1 Force to place The Mythrol out of play; if card was Din Djarin or a bounty hunter, you may activate 2 Force. If about to leave table, place out of play.

name: The Phantom Menace
title: •The Phantom Menace
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if Maul on table, may deploy a Neimoidian from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While present with opponent's Jedi, Maul is defense value +2 and immune to attrition. If Maul just lost, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Mysterious hologram that communicates with the Trade Federation, directing their blockade of Naboo. 'This is getting out of hand. Now there are two of them!'

name: The Phantom Menace (AI)
title: •The Phantom Menace (AI)
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if Maul on table, may deploy a Neimoidian from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While present with opponent's Jedi, Maul is defense value +2 and immune to attrition. If Maul just lost, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Mysterious hologram that communicates with the Trade Federation, directing their blockade of Naboo. 'This is getting out of hand. Now there are two of them!'

name: The Planet That It's Farthest From
title: •The Planet That It's Farthest From
text: Deploy on Tatooine system or Dagobah system. Target another system. At locations related to target system, opponent's Force drain modifiers are canceled. Effect canceled of opponent controls this system. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Rebellion operates freely in many Outer Rim territories, allowing them to ignore Imperial activities in the core systems.

name: The Point Is Conceded
title: •The Point Is Conceded
text: If you have a senate majority, activate 1 Force. OR If your opponent has a senate majority, place your senator at Galactic Senate in Used Pile to place an opponent's character present (your choice) in opponent's Used Pile. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: Political pressure carefully applied with a generous helping of Republic procedure can negate the strongest of motions.

name: The Professor
title: •The Professor
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on your side of the table (free if C-3PO on table). If you have a protocol droid aboard a starship or vehicle in a battle, you may use X Force to reduce the battle damage against you by X (by X + 1 if a Nav Computer character is also aboard).
lore: Protocol droids are programmed to interface with a variety of computer technologies. Quick and precise interpretation can dramatically increase operational efficiency.

name: The Republic No Longer Functions
title: •The Republic No Longer Functions
text: Plays on table. While you have 14 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand. Once per turn (even at start of turn), may suspend a [Coruscant] Political Effect for remainder of turn. If Monnok just played, may place a card from hand in Used Pile.
lore: The first step in removing a political opponent is to bring their reputation into question.

name: The Rise Of Skywalker
title: •The Rise Of Skywalker
text: LOST: Peek at the cards in your Force Pile. STARTING: If your starting location was a [Skywalker] site, deploy The Force Is Strong In My Family and two Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
lore: Blank.

name: The Shield Doors Must Be Closed
title: The Shield Doors Must Be Closed
text: Deploy between Echo Docking Bay and innermost marker site. When under 'nighttime conditions,' no movement is allowed to or from Echo Docking Bay unless it is to or from an Echo site.
lore: 'Your highness, there's nothing more we can do tonight. The shield doors must be closed.'

name: The Shield Is Down!
title: •The Shield Is Down!
text: Deploy on table. If Rebel Strike Team on table, your Force generation is +1 at Endor sites and you may deploy Back Door from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. When Bunker 'blown away,' retrieve 8 Force and opponent must place their hand in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Lando's confidence in the Rebel strike team on the forest moon was rewarded, and proved to be a decisive factor at the Battle of Endor.

name: The Shield Is Down! (V)
title: •The Shield Is Down! (V)
text: Deploy on table. Your scouts move for free to and from Back Door when using their landspeed. Once per turn, may deploy an Endor battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While an Explosive Charge at Bunker, flip Rebel Strike Team and Garrison Destroyed may not flip. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Lando's confidence in the Rebel strike team on the forest moon was rewarded, and proved to be a decisive factor at the Battle of Endor.

name: The Shield Will Be Down In Moments / Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base!
title: The Shield Will Be Down In Moments / Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base!
text: The Shield Will Be Down In Moments: Deploy 5th Marker, [Set 17] 4th Marker, 1st Marker, and [Set 9] Prepare For A Surface Attack. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Rebel Base Occupation, Sunsdown, or Dark Jedi (except Vader). AT-AT cannons may not fire during your control phase. Echo Base Sensors is canceled. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a Hoth location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force to You May Start Your Landing. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away.' Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base!: While this side up, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Imperial leader in battle. Rebel Leadership and We're Doomed are Lost Interrupts. Once per turn, may deploy a snowtrooper from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once during your control phase, may choose: retrieve bottom card of Lost Pile into hand or peek at the top X cards from opponent's Reserve Deck, where X = number of Hoth locations you control; replace in any order. Place out of play if you do not occupy a Hoth site with an AT-AT, Imperial leader, or snowtrooper.

back.title: The Shield Will Be Down In Moments / Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base!

name: The Signal
title: •The Signal
text: USED: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy from your Reserve Deck one Effect which has no deploy cost; reshuffle. Place Interrupt in the Lost Pile.
lore: With a quick motion of his hand, Luke signaled Artoo and dramatically changed the situation.

name: The Time For Our Attack Has Come
title: •The Time For Our Attack Has Come
text: If you just initiated a second battle this turn, deploy on table. When you lose a battle, you may place Immediate Effect in Used Pile to cancel all battle damage against you, unless Draw Their Fire on table. (Immune to Control.)
lore: 'With the Imperial Fleet spread throughout the galaxy in a vain effort to engage us, it is relatively unprotected.'

name: The Way Of Things
title: •The Way Of Things
text: Deploy on table. If Yoda is on Dagobah and Jedi Test #3 is present with target apprentice, it is completed. Also, you may not play Surprise Assault. Each apprentice on Dagobah is landspeed = 2 and may not be targeted by Set For Stun. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'When nine hundred years old you reach, look as good you will not. Hmmm?'

name: Thedit
title: •Thedit
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. When in a battle with at least two of your other Jawas, adds one battle destiny. When your total battle destiny at Thedit's site is greater than opponent's total battle destiny, Thedit reduces attrition against you by 3.
lore: Organizes perimeter patrols for Kalit's territory. Inspiring leader. Keeps a watchful eye for krayt dragons, Tusken Raiders, and Wittin's bandits.

name: There Are Many Hunting You Now
title: •There Are Many Hunting You Now
text: Deploy on table. Once during your turn, may stack top card of Lost Pile face down (as a 'Hatred' card) on an opponent's character with your Inquisitor. Opponent must choose to lose 1 Force or that character's game text is canceled for remainder of turn. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Blank.

name: There Is Another
title: •There Is Another
text: Plays on Your Destiny unless Leia or Luke has been deployed this game (even as a captive). We're The Bait is lost. Opponent's Objective and [Death Star II] Effects target Leia instead of Luke. Attempts to cross Leia over are -2. Opponent loses no Force to their Objective.
lore: Princess Leia Organa. Alderaanian senator. Targeted by Vader for capture and interrogation. The Dark Lord of the Sith wanted her alive.

name: There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him
title: There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him
text: There Is Good In Him: Deploy Chief Chirpa's Hut (with [Death Star II] Luke and Luke's Lightsaber there), Endor: Landing Platform and I Feel The Conflict. {For} remainder of game, you may not play Alter, Strangle, or Captive Fury. {While} this side up, your Force generation is +2 at Luke's site. While an Imperial is at Landing Platform, you may not Force drain or generate Force at Luke's location. When any Imperial is at Luke's site, Luke is captured (seized by an Imperial, if possible, even if not a warrior). {Flip} this card if Luke captured. I Can Save Him: {While} this side up, at end of each of opponent's turns, opponent loses 2 Force unless Vader is escorting Luke. At any time, an Imperial escorting Luke may transfer Luke to Vader, if present with Vader. Vader may not transfer Luke. Once during each of your turns, if Vader present with Luke (even as a non-frozen captive), may shuffle Reserve Deck and draw destiny. If destiny > 14, Vader crosses to Light Side, totally depleting opponent's Life Force. {Flip} if Luke neither present with Vader nor a captive.

back.title: There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him
back.text: There Is Good In Him: Deploy Chief Chirpa's Hut (with [Death Star II] Luke and Luke's Lightsaber there), Endor: Landing Platform and I Feel The Conflict. {For} remainder of game, you may not play Alter, Strangle, or Captive Fury. {While} this side up, your Force generation is +2 at Luke's site. Once during each of your turns, if Vader present with Luke (even as a non-frozen captive), may shuffle Reserve Deck and draw destiny. If destiny > 14, Vader crosses to Light Side, totally depleting opponent's Life Force. {Flip} if Luke neither present with Vader nor a captive.

name: There Is No Conflict
title: •There Is No Conflict
text: USED: If your Imperial of ability > 2 just won a battle, randomly take into hand one card stacked on I Feel The Conflict. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: If Vader in battle, subtract 2 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws.
lore: 'That name no longer has any meaning.'

name: There Is No Try
title: •There Is No Try
text: Plays on table. Sense and Alter are now Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force.
lore: 'Always with you what cannot be done.'

name: There Is No Try
title: •There Is No Try
text: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are now Lost Interrupts. Also, when any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Always with you what cannot be done.'

name: There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement
title: •There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement
text: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are now Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force. Your Immediate Effects may deploy for free. Whenever opponent cancels your card with Sense or Alter, place that canceled card in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

name: There They Are!
title: •There They Are!
text: If a battle was just initiated, your non-unique battle droids are each power +1 for remainder of battle. (Immune to Sense if battle at a Naboo site.) OR Take a non-unique battle droid or non-unique droid starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: When unexplained droid losses are detected, a Droid Control Ship can call in reinforcements in seconds.

name: There'll Be Hell To Pay
title: •••There'll Be Hell To Pay
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played Interrupt here. To play any new Interrupt of the same name, player must first stack it here and use +1 Force for each Interrupt in stack, even if Interrupt is normally free. (Immune to Control.)
lore: Luke's dream of joining the Academy often distracted him from his chores, sometimes resulting in his having to pay the price for his impatience.

name: Thermal Detonator
title: •Thermal Detonator
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on any bounty hunter. When collecting a bounty, adds 3 to Force retrieved. Also, may 'detonate' at same site. Draw 3 destiny. All cards (except Effects) with any of those destiny numbers at that site are lost. Thermal Detonator also lost.
lore: Strictly regulated. Dangerously unstable. Explosive baradium core. Class-A type has blast radius of 20 meters. Can be programmed with a very sensitive deadman's switch.

name: Theron Nett
title: •Theron Nett
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 10 during battle, adds one destiny to total power only. When at Ord Mantell system, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.
lore: Experienced smuggler from Ord Mantell. Piloted Red 10 at the Battle of Yavin. Long-time wingman of Garven Dreis.

name: Theron Nett (V)
title: •Theron Nett (V)
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While at a battleground system, opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' May lose 1 Force (free if piloting Red 10) to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting.
lore: Experienced smuggler from Ord Mantell. Piloted Red 10 at the Battle of Yavin. Long-time wingman of Garven Dreis.

name: They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent
title: They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent
text: They Have No Idea We're Coming: Deploy Scarif system, Data Vault (with Stardust there), and Massassi War Room. For remainder of game, Baze, Chirrut, and Rebel troopers are spies. You may not deploy Taking Them With Us or Jedi. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy Rogue One, a corvette, or a Scarif site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if you control two Scarif locations. Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent: While this side up, your spies are defense value +2 (and power +1 if with Stardust) and are immune to Undercover. While Stardust on your spy, opponent may not cancel your Force drains at battlegrounds. Once per turn, may place a Rebel in your Lost Pile out of play to make a regular move with your Rebel spy during your control phase or cancel an attempt to target your non-Undercover Rebel spy with a weapon. Flip this card if you do not occupy two Scarif locations (unless Rogue One at a Scarif site you occupy).

back.title: They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent
back.text: They Have No Idea We're Coming: Deploy Scarif system, Data Vault (with Stardust there), and Massassi War Room. For remainder of game, Baze, Chirrut, and Rebel troopers are spies. You may not deploy Taking Them With Us or Jedi. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy Rogue One, a corvette, or a Scarif site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if you control two Scarif locations. Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent: While this side up, your spies are defense value +2 (and power +1 if with Stardust) and are immune to Undercover. While Stardust on your spy, opponent may not cancel your Force drains at battlegrounds. Once per turn, may place a Rebel in your Lost Pile out of play to make a regular move with your Rebel spy during your control phase or cancel an attempt to target your non-Undercover Rebel spy with a weapon. Flip this card if you do not occupy two Scarif locations (unless Rogue One at a Scarif site you occupy).

name: They Must Never Again Leave This City
title: •They Must Never Again Leave This City
text: Deploy on table. Opponent's movement from a Bespin location to a non-Bespin location requires +1 Force. Once per game, Executor deploys for free to Bespin system. Once per turn, may take into hand a TIE just forfeited from a Bespin location.
lore: Vader's plans were to turn the city in the clouds into a graveyard for the Rebellion.

name: They Will Be No Match For You
title: •They Will Be No Match For You
text: Deploy on table. When Maul initiates a duel, Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (or Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe) is not placed out of play. While armed with a lightsaber, Maul's duel destiny draws are each +1. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'At last we will reveal ourselves to the Jedi.'

name: They Will Be No Match For You (V)
title: •They Will Be No Match For You (V)
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy Maul's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At start of opponent's control phase, may relocate Maul to same site as a Jedi. May place this Effect out of play to deploy Maul's Lightsaber from Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'At last we will reveal ourselves to the Jedi.'

name: They Win This Round
title: •They Win This Round
text: If opponent just Force drained you at a location, deploy on that location. Opponent's Force drains here are +1. Your battle destiny draws here are +1 If you control this location, may place Immediate Effect in Used Pile to retrieve 4 Force. (Immune to Control.)
lore: The Queen realized that you must give up one battle in order to have an advantage in the next.

name: They'd Be Crazy To Follow Us
title: •They'd Be Crazy To Follow Us
text: Use 1 Force to target a starship at an asteroid sector or a 'blown away' system. For remainder of turn, you may add 2 to destiny totals targeting the armor or maneuver of that starship.
lore: Flying into an asteroid field is considered to be certain death except by Han Solo, Rycar Ryjerd and the terminally insane.

name: They're Coming In Too Fast!
title: •They're Coming In Too Fast!
text: If you have a piloted starship armed with a starship weapon, select one opponent's starship present to lose all immunity to attrition for remainder of turn. OR Cancel A Few Maneuvers.
lore: 'We're not out of this yet!'

name: They're On Dantooine
title: They're On Dantooine
text: Once per game, use 2 Force to deploy on Dantooine system. Target Death Star. Opponent may not play Commence Primary Ignition until target reaches Dantooine, canceling Utinni Effect.
lore: 'You would prefer another target? A military target? Then name the system!'

name: They're Still Coming Through!
title: They're Still Coming Through!
text: Cancel Rebel Barrier, It's A Trap!, or Smoke Screen. OR Re-target Fallen Portal by choosing up to two of opponent's characters there instead of your own. OR Peek at the top card of your Force Pile; either return it, or place it under your Force Pile or Reserve Deck.
lore: Despite the barriers erected, sometimes a determined opponent cannot be kept out.

name: They're Tracking Us
title: •They're Tracking Us
text: If opponent just deployed a planet site, deploy the related system from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel one opponent's 'react' unless opponent uses 2 additional Force.
lore: 'Not this ship, sister.'

name: They're Tracking Us (V)
title: •They're Tracking Us (V)
text: USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: 'Not this ship, sister.'

name: They've Shut Down The Main Reactor
title: •They've Shut Down The Main Reactor
text: If you have a piloted capital starship armed with a starship weapon or equipped with a tractor beam, use 2 Force to target an opponent's starship present. Until end of your next turn, target cannot move and its pilots may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny.
lore: 'We'll be destroyed for sure!'

name: Third Sister
title: •Third Sister
text: Deploys +3 to your location. Obi-Wan is not a general. Once per turn, if opponent's card just moved from here, opponent loses 1 Force. Your characters here move (using landspeed) to sites opponent occupies for free. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Female Inquisitor.

name: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further
title: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further
text: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time: Deploy one Cloud City battleground site. May deploy Secret Plans and/or All Wrapped Up. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may take Bespin system, Bespin: Cloud City, Dark Deal or Cloud City Occupation into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your [Cloud City], [Jabba's Palace] and [Special Edition] characters are immune to Goo Nee Tay when deploying to Bespin Locations. {Flip} this card if Dark Deal on table and you occupy Bespin System and Bespin: Cloud City. Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: {While} this side up, Surreptitious Glance may not cancel Dark Deal, The Planet That It's Farthest From is suspended if targeting Bespin. Opponent loses 8 Force when you play All Too Easy. At each Bespin location you control with an Imperial, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent. If you have an alien/imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2 (+4 if alien is an Ugnaught). {Flip} this card if Dark Deal is canceled, if opponent controls Bespin or if Bespin is 'blown away'.

back.title: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further
back.text: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time: Deploy one Cloud City battleground site. May deploy Secret Plans and/or All Wrapped Up. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may take Bespin system, Bespin: Cloud City, Dark Deal or Cloud City Occupation into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your [Cloud City], [Jabba's Palace] and [Special Edition] characters are immune to Goo Nee Tay when deploying to Bespin Locations. {Flip} this card if Dark Deal on table and you occupy Bespin System and Bespin: Cloud City. Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: {While} this side up, Surreptitious Glance may not cancel Dark Deal, The Planet That It's Farthest From is suspended if targeting Bespin. Opponent loses 8 Force when you play All Too Easy. At each Bespin location you control with an Imperial, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent. If you have an alien/imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2 (+4 if alien is an Ugnaught). {Flip} this card if Dark Deal is canceled, if opponent controls Bespin or if Bespin is 'blown away'.

name: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)
title: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)
text: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time: Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders or [Death Star II] Executor. During your control phase, your Lando may make a regular move. Once during your turn, may take Dark Deal, Vader's Bounty, or [Special Edition] Bespin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if you control three Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than three Bespin locations. Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: While this side up, Sense and Alter may not be played. Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled. While your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.

back.title: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)
back.text: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time: Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders or [Death Star II] Executor. During your control phase, your Lando may make a regular move. Once during your turn, may take Dark Deal, Vader's Bounty, or [Special Edition] Bespin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if you control three Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than three Bespin locations. Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: While this side up, Sense and Alter may not be played. Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled. While your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.

name: This Is Absolutely Right
title: •This Is Absolutely Right
text: If Han and Leia are present together at a battleground site (and neither is Undercover), choose one of the following: Your Force drain is +1 at that site this turn. OR Opponent's Force drains at related locations are -1 next turn. OR Cancel This Is Still Wrong.
lore: 'He's my brother.'

name: This Is All Your Fault
title: This Is All Your Fault
text: Lose a droid to cancel all attrition against you at same site this turn. OR Re-target an opponent's weapon to one of your droids at same site as target. If droid is 'hit', use original target's forfeit number.
lore: 'We seem to be made to suffer. It's our lot in life.'

name: This Is Even Better
title: •This Is Even Better
text: If Han and Leia are together in a battle you just lost, forfeit one of them to satisfy all battle damage and attrition against you. OR If Han is a captive and a battle was just initiated where you have Leia (or vice versa), add one battle destiny. OR Cancel This Is Still Wrong.
lore: It took escape from Hoth, asteroids, slugs, capture, refreshments with Vader, torture and the inevitable carbon-freezing to get Leia to reveal her true feelings for Han.

name: This Is Just Wrong
title: •This Is Just Wrong
text: Deploy on any male character. Target a female character on table. Target is power -2. Utinni Effect canceled when present with target.
lore: 'Why, I guess you don't know everything about women yet.'

name: This Is More Like It
title: This Is More Like It
text: During a battle, lose X Force to reduce attrition against you by X. OR Cancel This Is Just Wrong.
lore: 'You like me because I'm a scoundrel. There aren't enough scoundrels in your life.' 'I happen to like nice men.' 'I'm a nice man.' 'No you're not, you're ..'

name: This Is MY Ship!
title: •This Is MY Ship!
text: USED: If Hera is piloting Ghost in battle, draw one destiny and subtract it from opponent's attrition against you. LOST: If Chopper, Ezra, Hera, Kanan, Sabine or Zeb in a battle, they each add 1 to your total battle destiny.

name: This Is No Cave
title: This Is No Cave
text: Relocate one starfighter from a Big One to the related site (or vice versa) for free (opens Slug's mouth if closed). If smuggler aboard, starfighter is immune to attrition and subtracts 5 from asteroid destiny until end of your next turn. OR Cancel Corrosive Damage.
lore: The largest space slug on record was 900 meters long. Han suspected he had discovered one that was somewhat larger.

name: This Is Not Good
title: •This Is Not Good
text: USED: For remainder of turn, subtract 2 from any attempt to 'blow away' Blockade Flagship. LOST: During any deploy phase, use 3 Force to target any starship at same system as your battleship. Target is hyperspeed = 0 until end of turn.
lore: 'Everything's overheated.'

name: This Is Our Rebellion
title: •This Is Our Rebellion
text: Peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of your Lothal sites on table; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. OR Cancel an attempt to target your starship with a weapon or tractor beam.
lore: Blank.

name: This Is Outrageous!
title: •This Is Outrageous!
text: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to cancel an opponent's Force drain. If a trade agenda here, once during your turn, you may place a card from hand in Lost Pile, shuffle that pile, and take top card into hand.
lore: 'I recommend a commission be sent to Naboo to ascertain the truth!'

name: This Is Some Rescue!
title: This Is Some Rescue!
text: Cancel I'm Here To Rescue You, Plastoid Armor, Out Of Commission, Alternatives To Fighting, Cell 2187 or Ewok Rescue.
lore: 'When you came in here, didn't you have a plan for getting out?'

name: This Is Still Wrong
title: •This Is Still Wrong
text: If a battle was just initiated where opponent has a female targeted by This Is Just Wrong, add one battle destiny. OR Search your Reserve Deck, take one This Is Just Wrong into hand and reshuffle. OR Cancel This Is More Like It.
lore: Han: 2. Luke: 2. Chewie: 0.

name: This Is Where The Fun Begins
title: •This Is Where The Fun Begins
text: If a battle was just initiated, each of your [Republic] starfighters present is power +1 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn. OR If Anakin and Obi-Wan are in a battle together, cancel one opponent's destiny just drawn (except a battle destiny).
