lore: Blank.

name: Thok & Thug
title: •Thok & Thug
text: Deploys -2 to a Jabba's Palace site. If opponent just initiated battle at same site, may use X Force (limit 2) to add twice X to power. Your alien leaders present may not be targeted by weapons. End of your turn: Use 2 Force to maintain OR Lose 1 Force to place in Used Pile OR Place out of play.
lore: Jabba the Hutt knew that having a big, strong, dumb guard was good, but having lots of them is better.

name: Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
title: Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
text: USED: Cancel Nabrun Leids. LOST: During your move phase, cancel Landing Claw. OR Cancel Hyper Escape, Closer?! or one 'react.'
lore: 'I don't know how we're gonna get out of this one.'

name: Thrawn Pincer
title: •Thrawn Pincer
text: USED: Add 1 to hyperspeed of a dreadnaught or Star Destroyer for each artwork card on table for remainder of turn. LOST: Once per game, if your [Set 19] objective just `studied' a vehicle or starship, relocate your Star Destroyer from anywhere on table to that battle.
lore: The Empire's efficient, fear-driven logistical systems can quickly divert weapons and equipment from one conflict to another, focusing on regions of highest strategic priority.

name: Thrawn's Art Collection
title: •Thrawn's Art Collection
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on table. If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at same battleground as Thrawn, opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks it here face up. (These stacked cards are artwork cards.) [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Blank.

name: Threepio
title: •Threepio
text: Deploys -2 on Endor. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent for each Ewok in battle at same site. If just lost from table during battle, may go to Used Pile. At same and related sites, Cloud city icon, Jabba's Palace icon, and Endor icon characters are immune to Bad Feeling Have I.
lore: Against his programming to impersonate a deity. Worshiped by the Ewoks. 'Aaaahhhhh-uuuuhhhhh. Aaaahhhhh-uuuuhhhhh. Aaaahhhhhuuuuhhhhh.'

name: Threepio With His Parts Showing
title: •Threepio With His Parts Showing
text: If in a battle with Shmi at a site, once per battle may place top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck. Once per turn may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.
lore: Protocol droid designed by Anakin in order to help his mother. C-3PO was not to be sold when Anakin left with Qui-Gon Jinn for Coruscant.

name: Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)
title: •Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)
text: If in a battle with Shmi at a site, once per battle may place top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck. Once per turn may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.
lore: Protocol droid designed by Anakin in order to help his mother. C-3PO was not to be sold when Anakin left with Qui-Gon Jinn for Coruscant.

name: Through The Corridor
title: •Through The Corridor
text: If opponent just initiated battle against Maul where opponent has two Jedi, cancel that battle and you may relocate one of those Jedi (your choice) to any adjacent site. That Jedi may not move for remainder of turn. (Immune to Sense.)
lore: Obi-Wan was anxious, Qui-Gon was patient, and Maul was angry.

name: Through The Force Things You Will See
title: Through The Force Things You Will See
text: At the end of any player's draw phase, cause that player to place Used Pile face up on top of Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut, and replace. When face-up cards are removed from Reserve Deck, they are treated as normal (no longer remain face up).
lore: One training exercise for a Jedi's apprentice is to invert one's view to see things from a different perspective. 'The future, the past. Old friends long gone.'

name: Throw Me Another Charge
title: •Throw Me Another Charge
text: Take one automated weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Add 1 to Deactivate The Shield Generator total. OR Cancel Trooper Charge, Blasted Droid, Trooper Assault or Dark Jedi Presence.
lore: Han knew that it was urgent that he quickly finished his assignment.

name: Thrown Back
title: •Thrown Back
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on table. During your move phase, if opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, you may use 4 Force to place all but 8 (random choice) in Used Pile. Once during any control phase, you may place up to three cards from hand in Used Pile.
lore: Being sent to dispose of two Jedi is the battle droid equivalent of a really bad day at the office.

name: Thrown Back (V)
title: •Thrown Back (V)
text: Plays on table. At end of a turn, if opponent has 15 or more cards in hand, may use 3 Force to shuffle all but 9 (random selection) into Used Pile. If Monnok or Drop! just targeted your hand, may reveal 3 cards from hand; they cannot be removed or checked for duplicates.
lore: Being sent to dispose of two Jedi is the battle droid equivalent of a really bad day at the office.

name: Thul Fain
title: •Thul Fain
text: Deploys free to your [Independent Starship] starship. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When with Lieutenant Tanbris in a battle at a system, adds 2 to each of your battle destiny draws.
lore: Gambler who bets on how long the Rancor's victims will last. Formerly an Imperial pilot who worked with Lieutenant Tanbris. Now a smuggler for Jabba.

name: Thunderflare
title: •Thunderflare
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1. Turbolaser Batteries deploy and fire free here.
lore: Overpowered Star Destroyer. Energy is transferred from hyperdrive to weapons. Patrol duties in the Core Worlds make it a common first assignment for junior officers.

name: Thunderflare (V)
title: •Thunderflare (V)
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 TIEs. While Khurgee aboard, power, armor, and hyperspeed +2. While Death Star II on table, Thunderflare moves for free. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
lore: Overpowered Star Destroyer. Energy is transferred from hyperdrive to weapons. Patrol duties in the Core Worlds make it a common first assignment for junior officers.

name: Tibanna Gas Miner
title: Tibanna Gas Miner
text: When at a site, adds 1 to your Force drains at related cloud sectors. Also, during your activate phase, if at a Cloud City site and you control Bespin: Cloud City, may cumulatively activate 1 Force for every cloud sector on Bespin.
lore: One of the many Cloud City miners who are willingly employed by greedy corporations exploiting planetary atmospheres. Unconcerned with environmental repercussions.

name: Tibanna Gas Miner
title: Tibanna Gas Miner
text: When at a site, adds 1 to your Force drains at related cloud sectors. Also, during your activate phase, if at a Cloud City site and you control Bespin: Cloud City, may cumulatively activate 1 Force for every cloud sector on Bespin.
lore: Long-time Cloud City resident Willrow Hood. Employed by a mining company which is sympathetic to the Rebels and sells them Tibanna gas at a discount.

name: Tibrin
title: •Tibrin
text: Light: If you occupy, during your control phase, may exchange three cards in hand for any one card in your Lost Pile. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Tibrin Operative
title: Tibrin Operative
text: While at a Tibrin site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is forfeit +1 (and power +1 if your Ishi Tib is on Tibrin) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Tibrin from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: To disrupt the enslavement of the Ishi Tib by the Empire, some Rodian hunters were sent to harass Imperial troop movements on Tibrin.

name: TIE Advanced x1
title: TIE Advanced x1
text: Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
lore: TIE advanced x1 fighter boasting improved power plant, stronger shields, armored hull and enhanced weapons. Deployed to elite Imperial Navy pilots.

name: TIE Assault Squadron
title: TIE Assault Squadron
text: * Replaces 3 TIE/lns at one location (TIE/lns go to Used Pile). Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3.
lore: Imperial strategy relies on quantity over quality. Although many of their pilots have low motivation, this is compensated by 'wolfpack' group tactics.

name: TIE Avenger
title: TIE Avenger
text: Deploy -1 to same system as any Imperial capital starship. May add 1 pilot. Boosted TIE Cannon may deploy aboard.
lore: Design based on Lord Vader's prototype Advanced x1. Manufactured until replaced by the more economical TIE Interceptor. Equipped with deflector shields and a hyperdrive.

name: TIE Bomber
title: TIE Bomber
text: Power +2 during a Bombing Run battle. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1. At any time during your turn, may use 1 Force to 'diffuse' (lose or return to hand) any one Orbital Mine present.
lore: Because fleet orbital bombardment often destroyed entire cities, the double-pod TIE surface assault starfighter was developed to allow more precise and controlled targeting.

name: TIE Defender Mark I
title: TIE Defender Mark I
text: May deploy as a `react'. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Any starship cannon may deploy aboard. Power - 2 while opponent has a starfighter present with higher maneuver.
lore: First production run of TIE defender design. Powerful P-sz9.7 sublight engines. Fire-linked laser cannons. Aft blind spot exploited by maneuverable enemy starfighters.

name: TIE Fighter
title: TIE Fighter
text: Deploy -1 to same system as any Imperial capital starship. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
lore: TIE or Twin Ion Engine. TIE/ln model is Empire's most common fighter. Quick and maneuverable. Solar-panel wings supplement power generator. Built by Sienar Fleet Systems.

name: TIE Interceptor
title: TIE Interceptor
text: Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Power +1 when present with an X-wing. During each battle, may fire one starship weapon aboard twice.
lore: Advanced TIE design. Assigned to elite squadrons, such as the 181st. Developed with enhanced weapons and maneuverability to defeat the Incom X-wing design.

name: TIE Scout
title: TIE Scout
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 passenger, or 2 passengers. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
lore: Limited production, light reconnaissance starship. Minimal armor and weapons. Long-range sensor and communications array. Scouts for Rebel activity.

name: TIE Sentry Ships
title: •TIE Sentry Ships
text: If opponent just initiated a Force drain at a system, cloud sector or asteroid sector, you may 'react' by deploying TIEs and pilots to that location (at normal use of the Force).
lore: Several TIEs were assigned to patrol Cloud City prior to the Imperial occupation of Bespin. Their instructions were to herd any vessels attempting to escape toward the Executor.

name: TIE Sentry Ships (V)
title: •TIE Sentry Ships (V)
text: USED: If you just drew a starship for destiny, take that starship into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a starship into hand.
lore: Several TIEs were assigned to patrol Cloud City prior to the Imperial occupation of Bespin. Their instructions were to herd any vessels attempting to escape toward the Executor.

name: TIE Vanguard
title: TIE Vanguard
text: Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. You may deploy cards to same system or sector as a 'react'.
lore: Reconnaissance starfighter. Often deployed first to gather detailed information on enemy starship movement before full fleet engagement.

name: Tight Squeeze
title: •Tight Squeeze
text: If you have a lone vehicle or starfighter in a battle or Attack Run at Beggar's Canyon, Cloud City, Death Star: Trench or an asteroid sector, use 1 Force. At the end of that battle or Attack Run, opponent must forfeit two participating vehicles or starfighters.
lore: Rebel pilots often join the Rebellion from Outer Rim worlds. Bush pilots fly by the seat of their pants, giving them a huge advantage in close quarters.

name: Tigran Jamiro
title: •Tigran Jamiro
text: Deploy only on Yavin 4 or Hoth, but may move elsewhere. Opponent's aliens and Imperials may not move from same site as Tigran to an Echo or an interior Yavin site.
lore: Senior logistics officer from Onderon. Left Dantooine to serve on Yavin 4 before coming to Hoth. All personnel entering Echo Base must report to him.

name: Tikkes
title: •Tikkes
text: Agenda: wealth. While in a senate majority, your Force generation is +2 at battlegrounds you control, and Honor Of The Jedi is suspended. Once during your deploy phase, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile into hand.
lore: Quarren senator elected by the people of Mon Calamari. Has amassed considerable wealth through a multitude of political deals, but still moves to gain more.

name: Timer Mine
title: Timer Mine
text: Deploy on opponent's side at same site as one of your mining droids. 'Explodes' at beginning of your next turn. Draw destiny. That number of opponent's characters there are immediately lost (owner's choice). Timer Mine is also lost.
lore: A timer-activated explosive device designed to be placed by a mining droid. Originally used in ore and spice mines for demolition. Altered for military use.

name: Timer Mine
title: Timer Mine
text: Deploy on opponent's side at same site as one of your mining droids. 'Explodes' at beginning of your next turn. Draw destiny. That number of opponent's characters there are immediately lost (owner's choice). Timer Mine is also lost.
lore: A timer-activated explosive device designed to be placed by a mining droid. Typically used in ore and spice mines for demolition. Also has many military applications.

name: Tiree
title: •Tiree
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 2, also adds 1 to maneuver and (when in Death Star: Trench) adds 1 to total of Attack Run.
lore: Piloted Gold 2 as defensive cover for Gold Leader during attack run in Death Star trench at the Battle of Yavin.

name: TK-422
title: •TK-422
text: Deploys only as an Undercover spy at same site as an Imperial. While Undercover, Imperials are deploy +1 at related sites. May voluntarily 'break cover' only during your move phase by using 3 Force. Captured if 'cover broken' by opponent.
lore: Corellian smuggler. Spy. Han stole the armor and identity of an enemy soldier that boarded the Millennium Falcon. Bluffed his way into the detention area.

name: TK-422 (V)
title: •TK-422 (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Stormtrooper. Deploys only if Cell 2187 on table. Han's weapon destiny draws are +1 for each trooper here. While with a stormtrooper (or armed with a blaster), adds one battle destiny. Cancels Trooper Assault here.
lore: Corellian smuggler. Spy. Han stole the armor and identity of an enemy soldier that boarded the Millennium Falcon. Bluffed his way into the detention area.

name: Tobias Beckett
title: •Tobias Beckett
text: If Vos or a [Set 13] smuggler on table, destiny +3 when drawn for destiny. Cancels Aurra's game text here. If just lost, may place out of play (for remainder of game, Han adds one battle destiny). If opponent just initiated a battle here, Beckett may fire a blaster.
lore: Glee Anselmian smuggler. Information broker, musician, and thief.

name: Tonnika Sisters
title: •Tonnika Sisters
text: Twice during each of your control phases, may use 2 Force to draw 2 destiny for 2 chances at a destiny = 2. If successful, may steal or destroy up to 2 weapons or 2 devices present.
lore: Twins. Thieves. Con artists. Spies. Swindlers. Double agents. Brea and Senni use their natural charm to sway the unwary on the fringe of society.

name: Tonnika Sisters (V)
title: •Tonnika Sisters (V)
text: Assassins. Power and forfeit +2 at a cantina or night club. Twice during battle, may double your just drawn battle destiny of 2. Twice per game, if you have exactly two cards in hand, may draw two cards from Reserve Deck. Immune to Kiffex.
lore: Twins. Thieves. Con artists. Spies. Swindlers. Double agents. Brea and Senni use their natural charm to sway the unwary on the fringe of society.

name: Too Close For Comfort
title: •Too Close For Comfort
text: USED: If your character was just targeted by a weapon, opponent must use 2 Force or the targeting is canceled. LOST: Cancel Hit Racer or Podracer Collision.
lore: Anakin needed all the help he could get to evade Sebulba's tactics.

name: Too Cold For Speeders
title: Too Cold For Speeders
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your side of table. Non-creature vehicles at marker sites under 'nighttime conditions' are power = 0, maneuver = 0 and landspeed = 0.
lore: 'We're having some trouble adapting them to the cold.'

name: Toonbuck Toora
title: •Toonbuck Toora
text: Agendas: ambition, taxation, wealth. While in a senate majority, once per turn may add 1 to your total attrition in battle for each character with an ambition agenda at Galactic Senate.
lore: Female senator and member of her planet's ruling class. Her original optimism in the political process has been eroded by witnessing bribery, corruption and petty bickering.

name: Torture
title: •Torture
text: USED: Cancel Never Tell Me The Odds if it was just inserted or revealed. (Immune to Sense). LOST: Target a droid at Droid Workshop that you have captured or stolen. Droid is lost. Retrieve Force equal to droid's forfeit (doubled if stolen).
lore: 'We have been without an interpreter since our master got angry with our last protocol droid and disintegrated him.'

name: Toryn Farr
title: •Toryn Farr
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. When at any war room, adds 1 to weapon destiny draws of your Planet Defender Ion Cannon on same planet.
lore: Chief Controller at Echo Command. Responsible for communicating orders to the troops. Personally gives firing orders to Ion Cannon Control.

name: Toryn Farr (V)
title: •Toryn Farr (V)
text: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Your total battle destiny here is +1 (+2 if piloting a transport). Once per turn, if a battle just ended here, may 'rescue' (retrieve from Lost Pile) a Rebel of ability < 3 forfeited from same location this turn.
lore: Chief Controller at Echo Command. Responsible for communicating orders to the troops. Personally gives firing orders to Ion Cannon Control.

name: Tracked Fleet
title: •Tracked Fleet
text: Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand (or from top of Lost Pile) face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).

name: Tractor Beam
title: Tractor Beam
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Star Destroyer. At the end of a battle at same system or sector, may target an opponent's starship present (except Mon Calamari Star Cruiser) using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny > defense value.
lore: Captures enemy vessels for boarding. When used in conjunction with an ion cannon, tractor beams can ensnare even the most maneuverable starships.

name: Trade Federation Battleship
title: Trade Federation Battleship
text: May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. While with any starfighter, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: Massive cargo vessels that were converted by the Trade Federation into armed battleships. Each is equipped with a large contingent of droid starfighters and battle droids.

name: Trade Federation Droid Control Ship
title: <>Trade Federation Droid Control Ship
text: May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While a droid starfighter here, adds one battle destiny.
lore: These heavily modified battleships are used to control and direct the Trade Federation's automated army. Easily identified by its array of sensors and antennae.

name: Trade Federation Landing Craft
title: Trade Federation Landing Craft
text: May add 2 pilots and 6 vehicles. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. While at a site, once during your deploy phase may take an MTT into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: C-9979 landing craft designed to transport and unload Multi Troop Transports and its battle droid cargo as rapidly as possible.

name: Trade Federation Tactics
title: •Trade Federation Tactics
text: Use 2 Force to target a starship at same system as your [Trade Federation] starship armed with a weapon. Target is forfeit = 0 until end of turn. OR During battle, add X to your total power, where X = armor of one of your [Trade Federation] starships in that battle.
lore: Organizations as wealthy as the Trade Federation can afford large amounts of military hardware, all purchased under the guise of protecting their commercial interests.

name: Trade Federation Tactics (V)
title: •Trade Federation Tactics (V)
text: USED: Cancel an attempt to use a weapon to target your capital starship. LOST: Re-target On Target to an opponent's capital starship armed with a weapon. OR Take Blockade Support Ship or Invisible Hand into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Organizations as wealthy as the Trade Federation can afford large amounts of military hardware, all purchased under the guise of protecting their commercial interests.

name: Traffic Control
title: Traffic Control
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your side of table. During your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.
lore: Expert traffic controllers coordinate launches faster than automated launch systems. Rebel bases scramble fighters quickly during Imperial attacks.

name: Tragedy Of Plagueis
title: •Tragedy Of Plagueis
text: Deploy on table. If Revenge Of The Sith on table, your Sidious may be targeted by Force Lightning and Lord Sidious may use his game text as if alone. Once per game, if Sidious with a Dark Jedi, may retrieve a character into hand. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: Blank.

name: Trample
title: Trample
text: If you have a piloted AT-AT or AT-ST present at a site, target opponent's character, 'crashed' vehicle or unpiloted vehicle without armor present. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny > ability. Vehicle lost if destiny < 7.
lore: The enormous feet of a walker are designed for mobility on many types of terrain. They also can be used by merciless pilots to crush the Rebellion.

name: Trandoshan
title: Trandoshan
text: Power and Forfeit +1 at same site as a Wookiee or while Bossk at Audience Chamber. When in battle at same site as a bounty, adds 1 to attrition against opponent.
lore: Trandoshans refer to themselves as T'doshok. Hate Wookiees. Many have come to work for Jabba, attempting to emulate the success of Bossk.

name: Transmission Terminated
title: Transmission Terminated
text: Cancel one hologram. OR Use 3 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 to destiny for each asteroid sector on table. If total destiny > 3, Imperial Holotable site is 'blown away' (opponent loses 4 Force).
lore: After the mission, the Death Squadron HoloNet communications system reported fifteen system errors: ten computer malfunctions, four power failures and one asteroid.

name: Transmission Terminated (V)
title: Transmission Terminated (V)
text: USED: Target a starship. For remainder of turn, target may not use tractor beams, fire weapons, or 'cloak.' LOST: Cancel a hologram. OR Cancel the game text of Emperor's Power or an Admiral's Order until start of your turn.
lore: After the mission, the Death Squadron HoloNet communications system reported fifteen system errors: ten computer malfunctions, four power failures and one asteroid.

name: Trap Door
title: •Trap Door
text: If you have no characters at Rancor Pit at end of your deploy phase, target a character (even a captive) at Audience Chamber. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > ability, target relocated to Rancor Pit and, if a captive, released to Light Side of Rancor Pit (not Used Pile).
lore: 'Boscka!'

name: Treva Horme
title: •Treva Horme
text: During your control phase, may 'sell' one Interrupt card from hand. Opponent must use X Force, where X = destiny of that card or entire Force Pile (opponent's choice). Place sold card on opponent's Used Pile and activate X Force.
lore: Lutrillian. Primary saleswoman and executive planner for Planet Dreams, Inc. Monitors production schedules and accounting. Really enjoys making a sales pitch.

name: Trinto Duaba
title: Trinto Duaba
text: If there are cards in the opponent's Used Pile during your battle phase, draw one destiny. All cards there with the same destiny number are lost.
lore: A Stennes Shifter, a near-human race. Have ability to blend unnoticed into crowds. Trinto profits from turning lawbreakers over to Imperial authorities.

name: Trooper Assault
title: Trooper Assault
text: If a battle was just initiated at a site, each of your troopers present is power +2 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn.
lore: An assault of stormtroopers caused Leia, Chewie and Lando to retreat. When working together, the troopers' powerful onslaught can appear unstoppable.

name: Trooper Charge
title: Trooper Charge
text: Select one of your troopers in a battle to make a 'charge.' If that trooper is a Death Star Trooper, it is power +3 this battle. If any other trooper, power +2. However, that trooper must be forfeited at end of battle.
lore: Imperial troopers are fearless and totally indoctrinated. Backed by the most powerful weapons and starships in the galaxy, they tend to consider themselves invincible.

name: Trooper Davin Felth
title: •Trooper Davin Felth
text: While he is on Tatooine, Local Trouble and Look Sir, Droids are Used Interrupts. Opponent may select target when using Friendly Fire at same site as Felth.
lore: Dispatched to Tatooine to apprehend renegade droids fleeing the Tantive IV. Suspected to have misgivings about Imperial methods. Allegedly shot his commander in the back.

name: Trooper Jerrol Blendin
title: •Trooper Jerrol Blendin
text: Deploys only on Cloud City, but may move elsewhere. Power +2 when participating in a battle you initiate. Opponent may use 2 Force to 'bribe' (exclude) Blendin from battle.
lore: Corrupt captain of the Cloud City Wing Guard. Began working during the administration of Baron Raynor. Easily bribed. Keeps the peace through intimidation.

name: Trooper Sabacc
title: •Trooper Sabacc
text: Requirements: A gambler or trooper at a site. Wild cards (2-7): Imperial and Rebel leaders. (Troopers may use weapons as wildcards.) Clone cards: Locations and droids. Stakes: One transport vehicle without armor or one character weapon.
lore: Sabacc is a popular game for off-duty Imperial stormtroopers throughout the galaxy.

name: Trooper Sabacc
title: •Trooper Sabacc
text: Requirements: A gambler or trooper at a site. Wild cards (2-7): Imperial and Rebel leaders. (Troopers may use weapons as wild cards.) Clone cards: Locations and droids. Stakes: One transport vehicle without armor or one character weapon.
lore: Troopers stationed at various outposts play this sabacc variant to pass the time between assignments.

name: Trooper Utris M'toc
title: •Trooper Utris M'toc
text: Deploys only on Cloud City, but may move elsewhere. Deploys free to same Cloud City site as Lando. Power +2 when defending a battle. Your other Cloud City troopers are forfeit +2 where present.
lore: Imzig Cloud City trooper and Wing Guard leader. Attempts to protect Cloud City citizens from less reputable members of local constabulary. Never accepts a bribe.

name: TT-6
title: •TT-6
text: May add 7 passengers. Once per turn, may deploy a battle droid leader to same site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if your AAT or STAP present).
lore: Primary command liaison transport. Contains the majority of officer battle droids. Has priority to unload as soon as the area is secured. Enclosed.

name: TT-9
title: •TT-9
text: May add 4 passengers and 3 STAPs. Once per turn, may deploy a STAP to same site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if your AAT or STAP present).
lore: Auxiliary mobilization supply transport. Coordinates with the Droid Control Ship to determine whether additional STAPs are needed in any given area. Enclosed.

name: Tuanul Villager
title: •••Tuanul Villager
text: If with your other Resistance character and present at a site, adds 1 to your Force drains here and may place this character in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny here.
lore: Blank.

name: Tunnel Vision
title: Tunnel Vision
text: Search your Force Pile and take one card into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.
lore: Han could always see the light at the end of the tunnel.

name: Turbolaser Battery
title: Turbolaser Battery
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on your Star Destroyer or any mobile system. May target a starship using 2 Force. Draw two destiny. Subtract 2 if targeting a capital starship. Otherwise, subtract 5. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: High-powered blasters. Require power generators, cryogenic cooling units and large crews. More effective against capital starships than starfighters.

name: Turn It Off! Turn It Off!
title: Turn It Off! Turn It Off!
text: USED: Cancel any attempt to place a 'hit' starship, vehicle or droid in the Used Pile rather than the Lost Pile. OR Cancel Han's Toolkit. LOST: Cancel Crash Site Memorial.
lore: 'Turn it off! Turn it off! Off! TURN IT OFF!'

name: Turn It Off! Turn It Off! (V)
title: Turn It Off! Turn It Off! (V)
text: Play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. OR If opponent just deployed a [Maintenance] card, it may not battle for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Out Of Commission (if attempting to place a card out of play). (Immune to Sense.)
lore: 'Turn it off! Turn it off! Off! TURN IT OFF!'

name: Tusken Breath Mask
title: •Tusken Breath Mask
text: Deploy on any Tatooine site where you have just won a battle. Target one of your characters not at Tatooine. Upon reaching, target takes mask. While on Tatooine, target's power and forfeit are +2 and has immunity to attrition of exactly 3.
lore: Sand People use a special mask to reclaim exhaled moisture in the hot, harsh environment of Tatooine. Protects by filtering blowing sand and dispersing excess heat.

name: Tusken Raider
title: Tusken Raider
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Power +1 if another non-unique Tusken Raider present. If you have four or more non-unique Tusken Raiders present, your total power here is +2.
lore: 'Sand People.' Ride banthas. Wield gaderffi (gaffi) sticks. Wear eye protectors and breath masks. Violent, nomadic, desert survival experts. 'Urrrg! Ur Ur Uur!'

name: Tusken Raider
title: Tusken Raider
text: While at Podrace Arena, if opponent just placed race destiny on their Podracer, once per turn may use 3 Force to 'shoot' (no other Tusken Raiders may 'shoot' this turn.) Draw destiny. If destiny > 3, place race destiny in opponent's hand.
lore: Tusken Raiders are constantly taking bets to see who can hit the most Podracers on the Boonta Eve racetrack.

name: Tusken Raider With Hunting Rifle
title: Tusken Raider With Hunting Rifle
text: Permanent weapon is Hunting Rifle (may target a character or creature; draw destiny; target hit and forfeit -2 if destiny +1 > defense value. If firing from Dune Sea, Jundland Wastes, or a canyon, targets at an adjacent site or adds 1 to weapon destiny).
lore: Blank.

name: Tusken Scavengers
title: Tusken Scavengers
text: Use 1 Force to draw destiny. If destiny < the number of Tusken Raiders on table, you may scavenge (search through) the opponent's Used Pile. All vehicles, weapons or devices you find there are lost.
lore: 'Sand People always ride single file to hide their numbers.' They frequently attack strangers as they scavenge for useful equipment. Looted Luke's landspeeder.

name: Twi'lek Advisor
title: •Twi'lek Advisor
text: USED: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy from your Reserve Deck one Effect which has no deploy cost; reshuffle. Place Interrupt in the Lost Pile.
lore: 'He's no Jedi.'

name: Twi'lek Advisor (V)
title: •Twi'lek Advisor (V)
text: If Audience Chamber on table, deploy Passenger Deck or a pit from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Deploy an alien leader or Twi'lek to Audience Chamber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: 'He's no Jedi.'

name: Twilight Is Upon Me
title: •Twilight Is Upon Me
text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, may take The Force Is Strong With This One or [Death Star II] Anakin Skywalker into hand from Reserve Deck: reshuffle. May use 2 Force to cancel Dark Jedi Presence or You Are Beaten (unless canceling Uncontrollable Fury). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: When a Jedi dies, the spirit spreads through the Force and touches the living.

name: Twilight Is Upon Me (V)
title: •Twilight Is Upon Me (V)
text: If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Your personal Force generation = 2. Once per turn, may deploy a mobile docking bay from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2). [Immune to Alter.]
lore: When a Jedi dies, the spirit spreads through the Force and touches the living.

name: Twin Suns Of Tatooine / Well Trained In The Jedi Arts
title: Twin Suns Of Tatooine / Well Trained In The Jedi Arts
text: Twin Suns Of Tatooine: Deploy Tatooine system and a non-Jabba's Palace Tatooine site. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy Jabba's Palace sites or Sandwhirl. {While} this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if you control two Tatooine battleground sites (at least one with a Dark Jedi) and occupy Tatooine system, and opponent controls no Tatooine sites. Well Trained In The Jedi Arts: {While} this side up, once per game, may deploy Tatooine Occupation from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle Reserve Deck. For opponent to move a character or vehicle from same site as your Dark Jedi requires +1 Force. {Flip} this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.

back.title: Twin Suns Of Tatooine / Well Trained In The Jedi Arts
back.text: Twin Suns Of Tatooine: Deploy Tatooine system and a non-Jabba's Palace Tatooine site. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy Jabba's Palace sites or Sandwhirl. {While} this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if you control two Tatooine battleground sites (at least one with a Dark Jedi) and occupy Tatooine system, and opponent controls no Tatooine sites. Well Trained In The Jedi Arts: {While} this side up, once per game, may deploy Tatooine Occupation from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle Reserve Deck. For opponent to move a character or vehicle from same site as your Dark Jedi requires +1 Force. {Flip} this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.

name: Tycho Celchu
title: •Tycho Celchu
text: Deploys -2 aboard Green Squadron 3. Adds 3 to power of any starfighter he pilots. When piloting Green Squadron 3 or any X-wing, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Spy fighting for the memory of his homeworld of Alderaan. Rogue Squadron pilot. Volunteered to fly an A-wing at the Battle of Endor. Former TIE fighter pilot.

name: Tycho Celchu (V)
title: •Tycho Celchu (V)
text: Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. May reveal from hand to steal an unpiloted TIE from opponent's Lost Pile and deploy both simultaneously. Any snub fighter he pilots is maneuver +1 and immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Spy fighting for the memory of his homeworld of Alderaan. Rogue Squadron pilot. Volunteered to fly an A-wing at the Battle of Endor. Former TIE fighter pilot.

name: Tycho In Green Squadron 3
title: •Tycho In Green Squadron 3
text: May deploy as a 'react'. Permanent pilot is •Tycho, who provides ability of 2 and adds 3 to his [Death Star 2] Epic Event destiny draws. During battle, may target a starfighter; target's immunity to attrition is canceled.
lore: Flown by Tycho Celchu at the Battle of Endor. Modified canopy improves pilot vision in tight confines. Assigned to fly top cover for Millennium Falcon.

name: Tydirium
title: •Tydirium
text: May deploy (and your characters may deploy aboard) even without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. While Tydirium is at a system location, your scouts deploy -1 aboard.
lore: Stolen Imperial Lambda-class shuttle. Supposedly carried parts and technical crew. Delivered General Solo's crack team of Rebel scouts to the forest moon of Endor.

name: Tydirium (V)
title: •Tydirium (V)
text: May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per game, may retrieve Fly Casual. While alone and piloted by [Endor] Han, immune to attrition and adds one battle destiny.
lore: Stolen Imperial Lambda-class shuttle. Supposedly carried parts and technical crew. Delivered General Solo's crack team of Rebel scouts to the forest moon of Endor.

name: Tydirium (V) (ALT)
title: •Tydirium (V) (ALT)
text: May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per game, may retrieve Fly Casual. While alone and piloted by [Endor] Han, immune to attrition and adds one battle destiny.
lore: Stolen Imperial Lambda-class shuttle. Supposedly carried parts and technical crew. Delivered General Solo's crack team of Rebel scouts to the forest moon of Endor.

name: Tyrant
title: •Tyrant
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1. When using Tractor Beam, adds 1 to destiny draw.
lore: Assigned to Admiral Ozzel's Death Squadron. Attempted to capture Rebel starships fleeing the Hoth system.

name: Tzizvvt
title: •Tzizvvt
text: May 'fly' (move) only during your deploy phase, up to two sites away, for 1 Force. Power +1 at Trash Compactor, any Dagobah site or same site as Dark Waters or Tarkin.
lore: This male Brizzit, from the planet Jandoon, is hiding from the Imperials on the remote world Tatooine. He hopes to procure passage to the Outer Rim before the Empire finds him.

name: U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)
title: •U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)
text: Deploys only to a site as an Undercover spy. If Undercover at a battle, adds his power to Light Side. If U-3PO just had his 'cover broken,' Light Side may steal him.
lore: This protocol droid served in the House of Alderaan's Diplomatic Corps. Imperials altered its programming for espionage, making the droid an unwitting spy for the Empire.

name: Ubrikkian 9000 Z001
title: Ubrikkian 9000 Z001
text: May add 1 driver and 2 passengers. May move as a 'react.'
lore: Enclosed repulsorlift landspeeder. Micro-thrusters placed around spherical hull. Seats three. Extremely maneuverable. Top speed of 160 km per hour.

name: Ubrikkian Industries
title: •Ubrikkian Industries
text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, may reveal an alien with 'vehicle' in game text from hand to take a transport vehicle into hand (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Your drivers are immune to Clash Of Sabers. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Blank.

name: Ugloste
title: •Ugloste
text: Power +2 at Trash Compactor, Droid Junkheap, Incinerator or Carbonite Chamber. Functions as a leader if present with another Ugnaught. Where present, other Ugnaughts are forfeit +2 and double their bonus to Carbon-Freezing destiny.
lore: Ugnaught assigned to determine how to use carbon-freezing on humans. Placed in charge or the Ugnaught workers on Cloud City. Formerly enslaved by humans.

name: Ugnaught
title: Ugnaught
text: When at Carbonite Chamber, cumulatively adds 1 to each Carbon- Freezing destiny draw. During your control phase, may lose 1 Force from hand to search your Lost Pile and take one weapon or device into hand.
lore: Cheap manual labor from Gentes in the Anoat system. Make up Cloud City's second largest population. Responsible for maintenance and menial chores throughout the city.

name: Uh-oh!
title: •Uh-oh!
text: Deploy on Your side of table. While no Rebels at any Jabba's Palace sites, at all such sites: Imperials are deploy +2, Bo Shuda may not be canceled, Expand the Empire is canceled and your non-unique aliens are each forfeit +1 (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Imperial law had no place in the Hutt's domain.

name: Ultimatum
title: •Ultimatum
text: Plays on table. While you occupy at least 3 battlegrounds or opponent occupies no battlegrounds, you lose no more than 2 Force from each Force drain or 'insert' card.
lore: 'Jabba! This is your last chance. Free us or die.'

name: Ultimatum
title: •Ultimatum
text: Deploy on your side of table. While you occupy at least three battlegrounds or opponent occupies no battle grounds, you lose no more than 2 Force from each Force drain or 'insert' card. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'Jabba! This is your last chance. Free us or die.'

name: Umpass-stay
title: •Umpass-stay
text: Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace site. Each of your other musicians at same site is power +2 and immune to attrition < 3. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Klatooinian born into slavery to Desilijic Hutt clan on Shawti. Musician. Works as a spy for Jabba at his desert fortress while playing drums for visiting bands.

name: Uncertain Is The Future
title: Uncertain Is The Future
text: Use 3 Force. Each player places hand onto Reserve Deck (if possible), then places Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws cards from Reserve Deck equal to the number of cards just placed from hand onto Reserve Deck (if any).
lore: Even a Jedi cannot always foresee future events.

name: Uncivilized Blaster
title: •Uncivilized Blaster
text: Deploy on your warrior. May target a character, creature, or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value. If hit by Corran, Kanan, or Obi-Wan, target may not be used to satisfy attrition, and opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Blank.

name: Uncontrollable Fury
title: •Uncontrollable Fury
text: Deploy on Vader. He is power +2, but neither adds 1 to battle destiny nor allows Tarkin to cancel destiny. Opponent loses 2 Force at end of each of opponent's turns in which Vader did not battle and you had a character of ability > 3 on table. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The rage of the Dark Lord.

name: Under Attack
title: Under Attack
text: During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor present with your warrior. Draw destiny. If warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber, add 3 to destiny draw (7 if both). Vehicle (and grenade) lost if total destiny > armor.
lore: With the Rebels' limited resources and small numbers, desperate strategies are often required.

name: Undercover
title: Undercover
text: Deploy on your spy at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Spy is now Undercover. During your deploy phase, may voluntarily 'break cover' (lose Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: The Empire maintains a network of spies attempting to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance or misinform their operatives.

name: Undercover
title: Undercover
text: Deploy on your spy at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Spy is now Undercover. During your deploy phase, may voluntarily 'break cover' (lose Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Alliance Intelligence expends considerable resources to infiltrate the Imperial military bureaucracy, but the ISB's security sweeps make these shadowy operations dangerous.

name: Understand Art, Understand A Species
title: •Understand Art, Understand A Species
text: If an Imperial leader just won a battle, opponent loses 1 Force (and stacks it on Thrawn's Art Collection if possible). OR Suspend Ancient Watering Hole for remainder of turn. OR If you have 4 artwork cards, you retrieve 1 Force and opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: The Empire considers alien species to be inferior.

name: Underworld Contacts
title: •Underworld Contacts
text: Deploy on a Tatooine site. Your Force generation here is +1. Opponent may not cancel or modify Force drains at each Tatooine battleground site where you have two aliens with different card titles. At any time, you may use 2 Force to raise your converted Tatooine site to top.
lore: Influence, like any commodity, has a price in the Outer Rim territories.

name: Unexpected Interruption
title: •Unexpected Interruption
text: Use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Interrupt into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.
lore: 'Sir! Sir! I've isolated the reverse power flux coupling!'

name: Unfriendly Fire
title: Unfriendly Fire
text: If an AT-AT, an AT-ST, Jabba's Sail Barge or Planet Defender Ion Cannon has just been lost at a site, draw destiny. All cards with that destiny number at that site are lost.
lore: 'Get the gun! Point it at the deck!'

name: Unkar Plutt
title: •Unkar Plutt
text: Your battle destiny draws here are +¼ for each device, droid, starship, vehicle, or weapon card here. During battle with an opponent's droid, adds one destiny to total power. Once per game, may retrieve a device or character weapon.
lore: Crolute scavenger and thief.

name: Unlimited Power!
title: •Unlimited Power!
text: Deploy on table. Emperor and Maul are lost. At the start of your turn, if Sidious on Coruscant (or Insidious Prisoner on table), may place two cards from hand on Reserve Deck, reshuffle, and draw two cards from Reserve Deck. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Eliciting fear from the opponent gives the dark side a powerful advantage.

name: Unsalvageable
title: •Unsalvageable
text: During your turn, target an opponent's unpiloted starship present at a system, or an opponent's unpiloted vehicle. Target is lost (along with any cards aboard it). OR Cancel Hyper Escape, Power Pivot, or Out Of Commission.
lore: With mounting pressure from superior forces, the Rebellion sometimes has to abandon its crippled equipment in order to simply get its personnel out alive.

name: Ur'Ru'r
title: •Ur'Ru'r
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. While at Tusken Canyon, Jundland Wastes or same Tatooine site as UroRRuR'R'R, adds 2 to each of your battle destiny draws at Tatooine sites where you have a Tusken Raider.
lore: Fierce Tusken Raider. Ransacks homes and moisture farms on the borders of Mos Espa.

name: URoRRuR'R'R
title: •URoRRuR'R'R
text: Deploys only on on Tatooine. When at same site as another Tusken Raider, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
lore: Leader of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. Skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes in search of unwary travelers.

name: URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha
title: •URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha
text: May add 2 'riders' (passengers). Ability = ½. Adds 1 to power of each of your Tusken Raiders and other banthas present. When ridden by URoRRuR'R'R, adds one battle destiny.
lore: Raised by RR'uruurr for personal use by URoRRuR'R'R. Alpha male of his bantha herd. Has trampled many Jawas. Nicknamed 'Rrr'ur'R.

name: URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle
title: •URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on URoRRuR'R'R or Chief Bast, 3 on your non-droid character. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting a character. Add 2 if targeting a creature. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Owning a hunting rifle is an important status symbol in Tusken culture. URoRRuR'R'R scavenged this weapon from a starship wreck near Anchorhead.

name: Utinni!
title: Utinni!
text: If one of your Jawas is at the same location as any Utinni Effect, 'steal' that Utinni Effect into your hand, to use or lose as your own. OR Cancel any Interrupt or Effect with 'Jawa' in the card name.
lore: The Jawa who shot R2-D2 with an ionization gun called to his companions, 'Utinni!', the Jawa word for 'come here!'

name: Utinni!
title: Utinni!
text: If one of your Jawas is at the same location as any Utinni Effect, 'steal' that Utinni Effect into your hand, to use or lose as your own. OR Cancel any Interrupt or Effect with 'Jawa' in the card name.
lore: Jawa trade language word for 'Come here!' Jawas work communally and scavenge for equipment.

name: Utinni! (V)
title: Utinni! (V)
text: Deploy or move a Jawa as a 'react' (for -1 Force). OR If a battle was just initiated where you have three Jawas, choose: Use a magnetic suction tube. OR Each of your Jawas and sandcrawlers there are power and forfeit +1 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn.
lore: Jawa trade language word for 'Come here!' Jawas work communally and scavenge for equipment.

name: Uutkik
title: •Uutkik
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Once during each of your control phases, may lose 1 Force to steal into hand one transport vehicle, character weapon or device from opponent's Lost Pile.
lore: Experienced Jawa thief. Pilfers equipment and hijacks vehicles from unwary bystanders in Mos Eisley. Het Nkik's ugliest cousin.

name: V-4X-D Ski Speeder
title: V-4X-D Ski Speeder
text: May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react'. Matching vehicle for any Resistance pilot. Pilot's power = 0, and if targeted by Force Lightning, Trample, or a weapon, may use this card's defense value instead.
lore: Blank.

name: Vader
title: •Vader
text: Must deploy on Death Star, but may move elsewhere. May not be deployed if two or more of opponent's unique (•) characters on table. If in a losing battle, draw destiny. If destiny > 4, 'choke' (lose) one Imperial present (your choice).
lore: Sought to extinguish all Jedi. Former student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Seduced by the dark side of the Force.

name: Vader (V)
title: •Vader (V)
text: [Pilot] 3. If alone and a battle was just initiated here, may take Lightsaber Parry, Physical Choke, or Vader's Anger into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent's non-Jedi characters here are power and forfeit -1. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 7 if with a Jedi).
lore: Sought to extinguish all Jedi. Former student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Seduced by the dark side of the Force.

name: Vader's Anger
title: •Vader's Anger
text: USED: Add 1 to your just-drawn lightsaber weapon destiny draw. LOST: If a duel was just initiated, place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck.
lore: Anger and aggression fuel the dark side of the Force.

name: Vader's Anger (V)
title: •Vader's Anger (V)
text: Vader follows (using landspeed for free) an opponent's character that just moved from same site. OR If Vader in battle alone, your total battle destiny is +1 for each character in battle. OR If Vader in battle, cancel Dodge, It's A Trap!, or Obi-Wan's Journal.
lore: Anger and aggression fuel the dark side of the Force.

name: Vader's Bounty
title: •Vader's Bounty
text: Deploy on a Rebel of ability > 2. If subsequently captured, seized by a bounty hunter and then transferred to a prison where Vader is present, retrieve Force equal to character's forfeit (+4 if Luke) and lose Effect. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: 'We would be honored if you would join us.'

name: Vader's Cape
title: •Vader's Cape
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on one of your Imperials or aliens. Immune to attrition < 5. When in battle, adds 1 to each of your battle destiny draws.
lore: A symbol of the Dark Lord of the Sith, and of the seductive power of the dark side.

name: Vader's Custom TIE
title: •Vader's Custom TIE
text: May add 1 pilot. If Vader is pilot, Custom TIE is immune to attrition < 4.
lore: TIE advanced x1 prototype. First of a limited production run leading to the development of the TIE Interceptor. At Vader's insistence a hyperdrive was installed.

name: Vader's Custom TIE (V)
title: •Vader's Custom TIE (V)
text: May add 1 pilot. Vader deploys -2 aboard. While Vader piloting, immune to attrition < 5, and during battle, may cancel game text of a passenger (or pilot of ability < 4) here.
lore: TIE advanced x1 prototype. First of a limited production run leading to the development of the TIE Interceptor. At Vader's insistence a hyperdrive was installed.

name: Vader's Eye
title: •Vader's Eye
text: If Vader is defending a battle alone at a site, add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. OR If any other Imperial with ability > 2 is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny.
lore: Darth Vader's armored mask and life-support system provide him with extraordinary physical protection in duels and battles, in addition to his Dark Jedi combat skill.

name: Vader's Lightsaber
title: •Vader's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Custom-built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars, he wielded this weapon while hunting down the last of the Jedi. Cuts through almost anything except another lightsaber blade.

name: Vader's Lightsaber (V)
title: •Vader's Lightsaber (V)
text: Deploy on [Episode I] Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting Obi-Wan. Add 1 if targeting a Padawan. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Custom-built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars, he wielded this weapon while hunting down the last of the Jedi. Cuts through almost anything except another lightsaber blade.

name: Vader's Lightsaber (V) (ALT)
title: •Vader's Lightsaber (V) (ALT)
text: Deploy on [Episode I] Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting Obi-Wan. Add 1 if targeting a Padawan. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Custom-built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars, he wielded this weapon while hunting down the last of the Jedi. Cuts through almost anything except another lightsaber blade.

name: Vader's Machination
title: •Vader's Machination
text: If Vader's Malediction on table, deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy a Mustafar location or a lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At start of opponent's control phase, Vader may relocate between [Cloud City] Chasm Walkway and opponent's battleground site as a regular move (for free). [Immune to Alter.]
lore: 'Join me, and together we can rule the galaxy as father and son.'

name: Vader's Malediction
title: •Vader's Malediction
text: If Vader is your apprentice, deploy on table. Vader's game text may not be canceled. While Vader alone, armed with a [Death Star II] lightsaber, and present at a site, your Force drains there are +1. If you just drew Vader for destiny, may take him into hand. [Immune to Alter.]
lore: '... And together, we can rule the galaxy as father and son!'

name: Vader's Obsession
title: •Vader's Obsession
text: During your move phase, if Vader moves to Luke's site from an adjacent site, begin a duel between them. Each adds two destiny to power. Winner retrieves lost Force equal to the difference. Loser loses same amount of Force, plus the character.
lore: Vader sought to hunt down and destroy all Jedi. After completing the circle with Obi-Wan, he turned his attention to the young Skywalker.

name: Vader's Obsession (V)
title: •Vader's Obsession (V)
text: If Vader is your apprentice, choose: take The Works into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Uncontrollable Fury. (Immune to Run Luke, Run!) OR At start of your battle phase, move Vader (using landspeed) to a site you do not occupy.
lore: Vader sought to hunt down and destroy all Jedi. After completing the circle with Obi-Wan, he turned his attention to the young Skywalker.

name: Vader's Personal Shuttle
title: •Vader's Personal Shuttle
text: May add 1 pilot and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. Moves for free. While Vader aboard, opponent must have ability > 5 to draw battle destiny at same system. May not Talon Roll.
lore: Customized transport of Lord Vader. Employs advanced sensor jamming gear. Modified with enhanced tactical displays constructed to the Dark Lord's specifications.

name: Vader's Personal Shuttle (V)
title: •Vader's Personal Shuttle (V)
text: May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. Vader deploys -3 aboard. While Vader piloting at a battleground, maneuver +2 and you lose no Force to Uncontrollable Fury or You Must Confront Vader.
lore: Customized transport of Lord Vader. Employs advanced sensor jamming gear. Modified with enhanced tactical displays constructed to the Dark Lord's specifications.

name: Val
title: •Val
text: May forfeit in place of your 'hit' [Set 13] smuggler here, restoring that smuggler to normal. Permanent weapon is Blaster Pistol (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
lore: Female scout, smuggler, and thief.

name: Vanee
title: •Vanee
text: Deploys -2 to Holotheatre, Meditation Chamber, or a Vader's Castle site. Once during your turn, may activate 1 Force. Once per game, may take a card with 'Vader' in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Blank.

name: Vanee (AI)
title: •Vanee (AI)
text: Deploys -2 to Holotheatre, Meditation Chamber, or a Vader's Castle site. Once during your turn, may activate 1 Force. Once per game, may take a card with 'Vader' in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Blank.

name: Vaporator
title: Vaporator
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on any Tatooine site. Cannot be moved. Protects all characters at same site, or an adjacent site, from Gravel Storm.
lore: Essential for life on desert planets. Condenses water vapor from atmosphere. Has purification filters and coolant tanks. Protects against drought and harsh conditions.

name: Vedain
title: •Vedain
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. During your control phase, if at a Jabba's Palace site, may use 2 Force to make a 'wager'. Both players draw one destiny. Player with lower number loses 1 Force.
lore: Kajain'sa'Nikto scout. Sold by his family into slavery to Jabba. Gambler. Plays sabacc with his fellow Nikto.

name: Veers
setName: Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two Player Game
title: •Veers
text: Must deploy on Hoth, but may move elsewhere. May not be deployed if three or more of opponent's unique (•) characters on table. Snowtroopers at same site are forfeit +1.
lore: General of the AT-AT assault armor division sent by Darth Vader to crush the Rebellion on Hoth. Cold and ruthless.

name: Veers (V)
title: •Veers (V)
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Leader. Once per turn, may reveal from hand to deploy 6th Marker or Blizzard 1 to Hoth from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Deploys free aboard Blizzard 1. While piloting Blizzard 1, adds one destiny to total power.
lore: General of the AT-AT assault armor division sent by Darth Vader to crush the Rebellion on Hoth. Cold and ruthless.

name: Vehicle Mine
title: Vehicle Mine
text: Deploy at same exterior site as your mining droid. 'Explodes' if starfighter (use 5 as defense value) or non-creature vehicle deploys or moves to or across same site. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +2 > defense value. Vehicle Mine is also lost.
lore: Launches and detonates when activated by a passing metallic mass or the repulsorlift field of an approaching speeder. The shrapnel can hit even the quickest craft.

name: Vehicle Mine
title: Vehicle Mine
text: Deploy at same exterior site as your mining droid. 'Explodes' if starfighter (use 5 as defense value) or non-creature vehicle deploys or moves to or across same site. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +2 > defense value. Vehicle Mine also lost.
lore: Mine controlled by microcircuitry calibrated to ignore infantry and creatures. Explodes only when triggered by metallic vehicles.

name: Velken Tezeri
title: •Velken Tezeri
text: When at a site you control, allows your Seekers to deploy free there. Also allows your Seekers to move for free and to ignore any or all potential target(s) whenever you choose.
lore: Assigned by Jabba to work with Hermi Odle. Former technician for the Empire. Developed a method to remotely control seekers. Plotting to kill Jabba.

name: Velken Tezeri (V)
title: •Velken Tezeri (V)
text: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Smuggler. While present at a pit, adds 1 to your Force drains here. Unless 'hit' (or Gamall Wironicc here), your other characters here may not be targeted by lightsabers. May not target Luke with weapons.
lore: Assigned by Jabba to work with Hermi Odle. Former technician for the Empire. Developed a method to remotely control seekers. Plotting to kill Jabba.

name: Vengeance
title: •Vengeance
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 1 vehicle and 6 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Your TIE/lns are forfeit +2 at same location. Power +2 at Nal Hutta.
lore: Part of Darth Vader's Death Squadron. Support vessel for the fleet's starfighters. Cargo areas converted into hangar space for additional TIE fighters.

name: Vengeance (V)
title: •Vengeance (V)
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 6 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Whenever you win a battle here, opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: Part of Darth Vader's Death Squadron. Support vessel for the fleet's starfighters. Cargo areas converted into hangar space for additional TIE fighters.

name: Vibro-Ax
title: Vibro-Ax
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on any alien warrior. Adds 1 to power. May target a character using 1 Force. Both players draw destiny. Target immediately excluded from battle if warrior's power + your destiny > target's power + opponent's destiny.
lore: SoroSuub BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax. Powered by an ultrasonic generator concealed in the shaft. Jabba's skiff guards use them to prod victims into the Sarlacc's nest.

name: Vibro-Ax
title: Vibro-Ax
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on any alien warrior. Adds 1 to power. May target a character using 1 Force. Both players draw destiny. Target immediately excluded from battle if warrior's power + your destiny > target's power + opponent's destiny.
lore: Vibrating blade powered by an energy cell hidden within the shaft. Used by many moisture farmers to prod banthas and other animals.

name: Vice Admiral Holdo
title: •Vice Admiral Holdo
text: Adds 2 to power of any capital starship she pilots. During battle, if piloting a capital starship, may place it and Holdo out of play to add X to your total battle destiny, where X is that starship's armor + hyperspeed.
lore: Female leader.

name: Vicrul
title: •Vicrul
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +1 for each opponent's card out of play. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.
lore: Knight of Ren.

name: Victory-Class Star Destroyer
title: Victory-Class Star Destroyer
text: May add 4 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle and 3 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Adds 1 to your total power in battles at related planet sites.
lore: Commissioned by the Old Republic at end of the Clone Wars, Rendili StarDrive's Victory-class starship is atmosphere-capable but has a low sublight speed.

name: Vigo
title: •••Vigo
text: Deploys for free on Coruscant. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a non-Coruscant battleground site and Vengeance Of The Dark Prince is on table, Force drain +1 here. Forfeit +2 when present with Xizor or another Vigo.
lore: One of Xizor's hand-picked lieutenants. Ascended as Black Sun agent from gangster to manager. Earned title of Vigo from old Tionese for 'nephew'.

name: Vigo (V)
title: •••Vigo (V)
text: Deploys -1 to Coruscant. While present with Xizor, forfeit +2 and opponent's spies may not deploy to same non-battleground site. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy a non-war room battleground planet site (or system) not already on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: One of Xizor's hand-picked lieutenants. Ascended as Black Sun agent from gangster to manager. Earned title of Vigo from old Tionese for 'nephew'.

name: Vine Snake
title: Vine Snake
text: Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth). Attacks a character by attaching. X starts at 0. Every move phase, draw destiny; each time destiny > ability, add 1 to X. Character is power -X (eaten if power = 0).
lore: Found on various planets throughout the galaxy. Hides among hanging vines, dropping on unsuspecting travelers that pass beneath. Kills its victims through gradual constriction.

name: Vine Snake
title: Vine Snake
text: Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth). Parasite: Non-droid Character. Each move phase, draw destiny; each time destiny > ability, add 1 to X (X starts at 0). Host is power -X (eaten if power = 0).
lore: Constricts hapless victims. Prey usually struggles at first, then weakens as strength diminishes. Difficult to spot. Common hazard on less-developed worlds.

name: Virago
title: •Virago
text: Permanent Pilot provides 1 ability. May add Xizor as pilot (suspends permanent pilot). Xizor deploys -3 aboard. When Xizor piloting, adds one battle destiny and immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Prototype designed by MandalMotors to Prince Xizor's exacting specifications. Contains four separate power generators to power advanced flight controls and engines.

name: Visage
title: •Visage
text: May deploy even with out presence or Force icons (except to Rendezvous Point). May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1.
lore: Outfitted to chart unknown expanses of Outer Rim. Staff includes galactic cartography contingent. Considered a joke assignment by most lower-ranked Naval officers.

name: Visage Of The Emperor
title: •Visage Of The Emperor
text: Lose 2 Force to deploy on Executor: Holotheatre or Death Star: Conference Room. At the end of each player's turn, each player must lost 1 Force. Effect canceled if opponent controls this site. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Palpatine's hologram. Imposing. Ominous. Intimidating. Instrument for the evil Emperor's sinister reach across the galaxy. Used on a secret frequency of the Imperial HoloNet.

name: Visage Of The Emperor (V)
title: •Visage Of The Emperor (V)
text: Lose 2 Force to deploy on Vader's Castle. Your Force generation here may not be limited. Each player loses 1 Force at the end of their own turn. Once per game, may take a lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Palpatine's hologram. Imposing. Ominous. Intimidating. Instrument for the evil Emperor's sinister reach across the galaxy. Used on a secret frequency of the Imperial HoloNet.

name: Visored Vision
title: ••Visored Vision
text: Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling. Then you choose:USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that Interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that interrupt found there is lost.
lore: It's 15 parsecs to Kessel, we've replaced the negative power coupling, it's dark and we're wearing welding goggles. Hit it.

name: Vizam
title: •Vizam
text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Power +3 when defending a battle. If with your Advosze during your control phase, may search Reserve Deck, take one vehicle weapon into hand and reshuffle. Your vehicle weapons deploy free at same site.
lore: Kajain'sa'Nikto. Keeps Jabba's vehicles and starships well armed. Has hidden several weapon caches on board Jabba's sail barge.

name: Vote Now!
title: •Vote Now!
text: During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate.
lore: With enough political support, any number of devious plans can be put into motion.

name: Vote Now!
title: •Vote Now!
text: During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate.
lore: 'Vote now! Vote now! Vote now!'

name: Vote Of No Confidence
title: •Vote Of No Confidence
text: Plays on table. While you have 14 or fewer cards in hand, opponent may not remove cards from your hand. Once per turn (even at start of turn), may suspend a [Coruscant] Political Effect for remainder of turn. If Grimtaash just played, may place a card from hand in Used Pile.
lore: 'He is mired by baseless accusations of corruption.'

name: Voyeur
title: ••Voyeur
text: Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling. Then you choose:USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that Interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that interrupt found there is lost.
lore: As there are very few local authorities on Dagobah, peeping Nav Computers can get away with just about anything.

name: Vul Tazaene
title: •Vul Tazaene
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Twice during battle at same system, may use 2 Force to add 2 to any destiny of 2. If present with Tonnika Sisters, Vul and Tonnika Sisters are lost.
lore: Security officer from Kiffex searching for the Tonnika sisters. In love with one of them, he's not sure which.

name: Wakeelmui
title: •Wakeelmui
text: Dark: If Kuat is on table, Force generation +2 for you here. Light: If you occupy, all TIEs deploy +1 (+2 if you control). Your movement to here requires +1 Force.

name: Wakeelmui (V)
title: •Wakeelmui (V)
text: Dark: Your TIEs may deploy here as a 'react.' Light: While opponent has more starships here than you, your starships here are power -1.

name: Walker Barrage
title: Walker Barrage
text: If you have a piloted AT-AT present at a site, target opponent's artillery weapon at same or adjacent exterior site. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > forfeit. Also, one opponent's character at same site as target (random selection) lost if destiny +1 > 6.
lore: Before an AT-AT's troops can disembark to engage the enemy, the walker must first destroy the Rebel traitors' defensive emplacements.

name: Walker Garrison
setName: Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two Player Game
title: Walker Garrison
text: If Veers is at an exterior Hoth site, use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one AT-AT into your hand. OR If you have 3 AT-ATs at three different Hoth sites, your Force drains are +2 at Hoth locations this turn.
lore: When efficiently deployed, a squadron of AT-ATs can quickly take control of a wide area, making it easy for imperial forces to dominate a planet.

name: Walker Garrison (V)
title: Walker Garrison (V)
text: If your [Hoth] objective on table, choose: take [Premium] Veers or a [Premium] AT-AT into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a site if your AT-AT occupies a related battleground site. OR Retrieve an AT-AT Cannon.
lore: When efficiently deployed, a squadron of AT-ATs can quickly take control of a wide area, making it easy for Imperial forces to dominate a planet.

name: Walker Sighting
title: •Walker Sighting
text: If opponent just moved or deployed an AT-AT to a planet site, search your Reserve Deck for up to three exterior sites of that planet and immediately deploy them. Shuffle, cut and replace.
lore: 'Echo station, 3TA. We have spotted Imperial walkers.' A Rebel tactic is to put as much ground as possible between walkers and Rebel troops, allowing time to prepare a defense.

name: Walker Sighting (V)
title: •Walker Sighting (V)
text: Cancel Too Cold For Speeders. OR Unless opponent's AT-AT or AT-ST at a battleground site, retrieve 1 Force for each Rebel Base location you control (limit 3). OR Your Rebels and T-47s at sites where opponent has an AT-AT or AT-ST are power +2 for remainder of turn.
lore: 'Echo station, 3TA. We have spotted Imperial walkers.' A Rebel tactic is to put as much ground as possible between walkers and Rebel troops, allowing time to prepare a defense.

name: Wall Of Fire
title: Wall Of Fire
text: If you have a piloted AT-AT present at a site, target any number of opponent's troopers present at same or adjacent exterior site. Draw destiny. If destiny > number of troopers targeted, they are lost.
lore: Walkers are capable of incinerating entire infantry units in seconds. Rebel troops refer to the deadly barrage as the 'wall of fire.'

name: Wampa
title: Wampa
text: * Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploy only to Wampa Cave or unoccupied marker site. Defeated characters are eaten or relocated to Wampa Cave (opponent of victim chooses).
lore: Sly, carnivorous beast which stalks the snow-packed tundra. Wampas frequently drag their prey to an ice cave for storage. They always prefer to devour their victims alive.

name: Warrant Officer M'Kae
title: •Warrant Officer M'Kae
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May use 1 Force to take one tractor beam, Our First Catch Of The Day or Besieged into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Hard-working Avenger signal officer. Coordinates and tests tractor beam operations. Apprises Executor of his ship's activities and relays orders from the flagship to his captain.

name: Warrior's Courage
title: •Warrior's Courage
text: If any warrior is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny. OR If Leia is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny.
lore: Each Rebel soldier is driven by bravery and a belief in the Rebel Alliance's ideal of freedom. Courageous and quick-thinking Rebels often defeat Imperial legions.

name: Wars Not Make One Great
title: •Wars Not Make One Great
text: Deploy on any location. For either player to initiate a battle or Force drain anywhere, that player must use +1 Force. Effect canceled if opponent controls this location.
lore: A Jedi seeks nonviolent solutions to problems, but may fight to preserve the existence of life. An apprentice must learn which battles to fight and which to avoid.

name: Wat Tambor
title: •Wat Tambor
text: Opponent may not target your Republic characters with weapons unless each of your [Presence] droids present with them are 'hit.' [Set 8] Where Are Those Droidekas?! ignores Wat Tambor. Once per game, may draw two cards from Reserve Deck.
lore: Skakoan leader. Trade Federation. Techno Union.

name: Watch Your Back!
title: •Watch Your Back!
text: During a battle at a system or sector, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the maneuver number of your starfighter in that battle.
lore: 'Fighters above you, coming in!'

name: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough
title: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough
text: Watch Your Step: Deploy Cantina, Docking Bay 94 and Tatooine System. {For} remainder of game, opponent activates no Force at your Cantina. Your cards with ability are deploy +6 except Luke, smugglers, freighters, and [Independent] starships. Opponent's game text on Kessel is canceled. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may take Corellia or Kessel into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if you occupy two battlegrounds with smugglers or have completed two Kessel Runs. This Place Can Be A Little Rough: {While} this side up, your Force generation is +1 at each system you control with a smuggler. Opponent's Force generation at non-battleground locations is limited to 1. When you have two or more smugglers in a battle, add one battle destiny. Each of your smugglers is forfeit +2. Once during each turn, may play one interrupt from Lost Pile as if from hand (then place that card out of play). Sense, Alter, and Keep Your Eyes Open may not be played. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds (unless you have completed two Kessel Runs).

back.title: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough
back.text: Watch Your Step: Deploy Cantina, Docking Bay 94 and Tatooine System. {For} remainder of game, opponent activates no Force at your Cantina. Your cards with ability are deploy +6 except Luke, smugglers, freighters, and [Independent] starships. Opponent's game text on Kessel is canceled. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may take Corellia or Kessel into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if you occupy two battlegrounds with smugglers or have completed two Kessel Runs. This Place Can Be A Little Rough: {While} this side up, your Force generation is +1 at each system you control with a smuggler. Opponent's Force generation at non-battleground locations is limited to 1. When you have two or more smugglers in a battle, add one battle destiny. Each of your smugglers is forfeit +2. Once during each turn, may play one interrupt from Lost Pile as if from hand (then place that card out of play). Sense, Alter, and Keep Your Eyes Open may not be played. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds (unless you have completed two Kessel Runs).

name: Watto
title: •Watto
text: May 'fly' (landspeed = 2). Once during each of your turns, may take Watto's Chance Cube into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Toydarian junk dealer. Skilled gambler. Won Shmi and Anakin in a Podrace bet with Gardulla the Hutt. Jedi mind tricks don't work on him, only money.

name: Watto (AI)
title: •Watto (AI)
text: May 'fly' (landspeed = 2). Once during each of your turns, may take Watto's Chance Cube into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
lore: Toydarian junk dealer. Skilled gambler. Won Shmi and Anakin in a Podrace bet with Gardulla the Hutt. Jedi mind tricks don't work on him, only money.

name: Watto's Box
title: •Watto's Box
text: Deploy on table if all of your race totals = 0. When a player wins a Podrace, adds 5 to the amount retrieved. When a player loses a Podrace, adds 5 to the amount lost. (Immune to Alter.)
lore: Fortunes are won and lost every day on the Outer Rim. Watto is a master at getting his cut.

name: Watto's Chance Cube
title: •Watto's Chance Cube
text: If Watto is in a battle at a site, draw destiny. If destiny is odd, your total battle destiny = 0 this battle. If destiny is even, add two battle destiny.
lore: 'We'll let fate decide, huh?'

name: We Can Still Outmaneuver Them
title: •We Can Still Outmaneuver Them
text: USED: Search your Reserve Deck. Take one Collision! or Egregious Pilot Error into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace. LOST: If opponent just initiated a battle with at least two capital starships at a system where you have a lone starfighter, add two battle destiny.
lore: They're as clumsy as they are stupid.

name: We Didn't Hit It
title: •We Didn't Hit It
text: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at systems you control. Opponent's non-unique starfighters are deploy +1 (or +2 to a system you occupy). (Immune to Alter.)
lore: When severely outnumbered by opponents, any help is good help.

name: We Don't Have Time For This
title: •We Don't Have Time For This
text: If Amidala and Panaka are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR Target an interior Naboo site where opponent has a battle droid. Draw destiny. If destiny > number of battle droids at that site, one of them is lost (opponent's choice).
lore: Amidala and Panaka have the weapons training to pin down and remove the greatest combat threat.

name: We Don't Need Their Scum
title: We Don't Need Their Scum
